B4L01-1-01.chinese: 那位業務員不但謙虛而且誠實，你有需要的話可以請他協助。
B4L01-1-01.pinyin: Nà wèi yèwùyuán bùdàn qiānxū érqiě chéngshí, nǐ yǒu xūyào de huà kěyǐ qǐng tā xiézhù.
B4L01-1-01.english: That salesman is not only modest but also honest; if you need anything, you can ask him for assistance.

B4L01-1-02.chinese: 他在我們公司負責的業務是交通意外保險。
B4L01-1-02.pinyin: Tā zài wǒmen gōngsī fùzé de yèwù shì jiāotōng yìwài bǎoxiǎn.
B4L01-1-02.english: The business he is responsible for at our company is traffic accident insurance.

B4L01-1-03.chinese: 我是家中第二個兒子，大哥比我大三歲，平常相處得還不錯。
B4L01-1-03.pinyin: Wǒ shì jiā zhōng dì èr gè érzi, dàgē bǐ wǒ dà sān suì, píngcháng xiāngchǔ de hái bùcuò.
B4L01-1-03.english: I am the second son in the family; my eldest brother is three years older than me, and we get along quite well normally.

B4L01-1-04.chinese: 到新公司報到以前，應先把個人的態度及觀念調整好。
B4L01-1-04.pinyin: Dào xīn gōngsī bàodào yǐqián, yīng xiān bǎ gèrén de tàidù jí guānniàn tiáozhěng hǎo.
B4L01-1-04.english: Before reporting for duty at a new company, you should first adjust your personal attitude and mindset well.

B4L01-1-05.chinese: 今明兩天的天氣可能從晴天轉雨天，出門前記得帶傘。
B4L01-1-05.pinyin: Jīn míng liǎng tiān de tiānqì kěnéng cóng qíngtiān zhuǎn yǔtiān, chūmén qián jìde dài sǎn.
B4L01-1-05.english: The weather today and tomorrow may turn from sunny to rainy; remember to bring an umbrella before going out.

B4L01-1-06.chinese: 這臺洗衣機不轉了，請你拿去修理一下。
B4L01-1-06.pinyin: Zhè tái xǐyījī bù zhuàn le, qǐng nǐ ná qù xiūlǐ yīxià.
B4L01-1-06.english: This washing machine has stopped rotating; please take it to be repaired.

B4L01-1-07.chinese: 每個國家打招呼的方式都不太一樣。
B4L01-1-07.pinyin: Měi gè guójiā dǎ zhāohū de fāngshì dōu bù tài yīyàng.
B4L01-1-07.english: The ways of greeting in every country are not quite the same.

B4L01-1-08.chinese: 哇！這家小吃店的臭豆腐好辣、好臭哇！怎麼有客人受的了這種味道哇？
B4L01-1-08.pinyin: Wa! Zhè jiā xiǎochī diàn de chòu dòufu hǎo là, hǎo chòu wa! Zěnme yǒu kèrén shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng wèidào wa?
B4L01-1-08.english: Wow! The stinky tofu at this snack shop is so spicy and smells so stinky! How can any customer stand this smell?

B4L01-1-09.chinese: 隔壁家的小子相當懂事，附近的鄰居們都很喜歡他。
B4L01-1-09.pinyin: Gébì jiā de xiǎozi xiāngdāng dǒngshì, fùjìn de línjūmen dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
B4L01-1-09.english: The young fellow next door is quite sensible; the neighbors nearby all like him very much.

B4L01-1-10.chinese: 要想擁有好身材，除了注意營養，還得多運動。
B4L01-1-10.pinyin: Yào xiǎng yōngyǒu hǎo shēncái, chúle zhùyì yíngyǎng, hái děi duō yùndòng.
B4L01-1-10.english: If you want to have a good figure, besides paying attention to nutrition, you also need to exercise more.

B4L01-1-11.chinese: 臺北當地的夜市有很多好吃的宵夜，改天我帶你去嘗嘗。
B4L01-1-11.pinyin: Táiběi dāngdì de yèshì yǒu hěn duō hǎochī de xiāoyè, gǎitiān wǒ dài nǐ qù chángchang.
B4L01-1-11.english: The local night markets in Taipei have many delicious late-night snacks; another day I'll take you to try them.

B4L01-1-12.chinese: 那家義大利餐廳太貴了，除非打折，要不然我不會去。
B4L01-1-12.pinyin: Nà jiā Yìdàlì cāntīng tài guì le, chúfēi dǎzhé, yàobùrán wǒ bù huì qù.
B4L01-1-12.english: That Italian restaurant is too expensive; unless there's a discount, otherwise I won't go.

B4L01-1-13.chinese: 在國外遇見好久沒聯絡的好友，是一件很開心的事情。
B4L01-1-13.pinyin: Zài guówài yùjiàn hǎojiǔ méi liánluò de hǎoyǒu, shì yī jiàn hěn kāixīn de shìqing.
B4L01-1-13.english: Meeting a good friend you haven't contacted for a long time abroad is a very happy thing.

B4L01-1-14.chinese: 你等一下要幹嘛？要不要跟我們一起去看電影？
B4L01-1-14.pinyin: Nǐ děng yīxià yào gànmá? Yào bùyào gēn wǒmen yīqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng?
B4L01-1-14.english: What are you going to do in a bit? Do you want to go see a movie with us?

B4L01-1-15.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
B4L01-1-15.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
B4L01-1-15.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

B4L01-1-16.chinese: 自己開店做老闆，事事都得自己來，其實不太容易。
B4L01-1-16.pinyin: Zìjǐ kāidiàn zuò lǎobǎn, shìshì dōu děi zìjǐ lái, qíshí bù tài róngyì.
B4L01-1-16.english: Opening your own shop and being the boss means you have to do everything yourself; actually, it's not that easy.

B4L01-1-17.chinese: 這家店的咖啡很好喝，你有他們的名片嗎？
B4L01-1-17.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de kāfēi hěn hǎohē, nǐ yǒu tāmen de míngpiàn ma?
B4L01-1-17.english: The coffee at this shop is very good; do you have their business card?

B4L01-1-18.chinese: 危險物品必須放在小朋友伸手拿不到的地方。
B4L01-1-18.pinyin: Wēixiǎn wùpǐn bìxū fàng zài xiǎopéngyǒu shēnshǒu ná bù dào de dìfāng.
B4L01-1-18.english: Dangerous items must be placed in a place where children cannot reach out and get them.

B4L01-1-19.chinese: 覺得累的時候，可以伸伸雙手雙腳，讓身體動一動。
B4L01-1-19.pinyin: Juéde lèi de shíhòu, kěyǐ shēn shēn shuāngshǒu shuāngjiǎo, ràng shēntǐ dòng yī dòng.
B4L01-1-19.english: When you feel tired, you can stretch your hands and feet to let your body move a bit.

B4L01-1-20.chinese: 從小我父母就去世了，一直是我大哥、大嫂在照顧我的。
B4L01-1-20.pinyin: Cóngxiǎo wǒ fùmǔ jiù qùshì le, yīzhí shì wǒ dàgē, dàsǎo zài zhàogù wǒ de.
B4L01-1-20.english: My parents passed away when I was little; it has always been my eldest brother and sister-in-law who have been taking care of me.

B4L01-1-21.chinese: 要是你有看電視的空，就幫我把髒衣服放到洗衣機裡吧。
B4L01-1-21.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ yǒu kàn diànshì de kòngr, jiù bāng wǒ bǎ zāng yīfu fàng dào xǐyījī lǐ ba.
B4L01-1-21.english: If you have free time to watch TV, then help me put the dirty clothes in the washing machine.

B4L01-1-22.chinese: 我有很急的事找張先生，請他到辦公室後回電，謝謝。
B4L01-1-22.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu hěn jí de shì zhǎo Zhāng xiānsheng, qǐng tā dào bàngōngshì hòu huídiàn, xièxie.
B4L01-1-22.english: I have something very urgent to discuss with Mr. Zhang; please have him call back after he arrives at the office. Thank you.

B4L01-1-23.chinese: 收到別人的信時，應該回信告訴對方收到了，這是一種禮貌。
B4L01-1-23.pinyin: Shōudào biérén de xìn shí, yīnggāi huíxìn gàosu duìfāng shōudào le, zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐmào.
B4L01-1-23.english: When you receive a letter from someone, you should write back to tell the other person that you have received it; this is a kind of courtesy.

B4L01-1-24.chinese: 在臺灣，收到禮物的人要找機會回禮，表達自己的感謝。
B4L01-1-24.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, shōudào lǐwù de rén yào zhǎo jīhuì huílǐ, biǎodá zìjǐ de gǎnxiè.
B4L01-1-24.english: In Taiwan, people who receive gifts should find an opportunity to give a gift in return to express their gratitude.

B4L01-1-25.chinese: 昨晚我接了好幾通沒有聲音的電話，真的很討厭。
B4L01-1-25.pinyin: Zuówǎn wǒ jiē le hǎo jǐ tōng méiyǒu shēngyīn de diànhuà, zhēn de hěn tǎoyàn.
B4L01-1-25.english: Last night I received several silent phone calls; it was really annoying.

B4L01-1-26.chinese: 上週末我們去爬山，走到半路時忽然吹起大風來，害我們不得不下山。
B4L01-1-26.pinyin: Shàng zhōumò wǒmen qù páshān, zǒu dào bànlù shí hūrán chuī qǐ dàfēng lái, hài wǒmen bùdébù xiàshān.
B4L01-1-26.english: Last weekend we went mountain climbing, and when we had walked halfway, suddenly a strong wind started blowing, which forced us to have to go down the mountain.

B4L01-1-27.chinese: 外面下著大雨，路很滑，請小心開車。
B4L01-1-27.pinyin: Wàimiàn xià zhe dàyǔ, lù hěn huá, qǐng xiǎoxīn kāichē.
B4L01-1-27.english: It's raining heavily outside, the road is very slippery, please drive carefully.

B4L01-1-28.chinese: 我去樓下的超市買點菜，待會兒做些家鄉菜給你嘗嘗。
B4L01-1-28.pinyin: Wǒ qù lóuxià de chāoshì mǎi diǎn cài, dàihuìr zuò xiē jiāxiāng cài gěi nǐ chángchang.
B4L01-1-28.english: I'm going to the supermarket downstairs to buy some groceries; in a moment I'll cook some hometown dishes for you to try.

B4L01-1-29.chinese: 你最好別穿著拖鞋去參加正式活動，要不然別人可能認為你不懂禮貌。
B4L01-1-29.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo bié chuān zhe tuōxié qù cānjiā zhèngshì huódòng, yàobùrán biérén kěnéng rènwéi nǐ bù dǒng lǐmào.
B4L01-1-29.english: You'd better not wear slippers to attend a formal event, otherwise others might think you don't understand manners.

B4L01-1-30.chinese: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
B4L01-1-30.pinyin: Huālián nà jǐ jiā lǚguǎn de shuāngrén kèfáng dōu kèmǎn le, wǒmen háishì dìng mínsù ba.
B4L01-1-30.english: The double guest rooms at those hotels in Hualien are all fully booked; we'd better book a homestay instead.

B4L01-1-31.chinese: 他這幾年因為投資生意發了，婚姻生活也很幸福，運氣非常好。
B4L01-1-31.pinyin: Tā zhè jǐ nián yīnwèi tóuzī shēngyì fā le, hūnyīn shēnghuó yě hěn xìngfú, yùnqì fēicháng hǎo.
B4L01-1-31.english: In recent years he has become wealthy from investing in business, his married life is also very happy, and his luck is extremely good.

B4L01-1-32.chinese: 想讓別人看得起你，你得先看得起自己。
B4L01-1-32.pinyin: Xiǎng ràng biérén kàndeqǐ nǐ, nǐ děi xiān kàndeqǐ zìjǐ.
B4L01-1-32.english: If you want others to show respect for you, you must first show respect for yourself.

B4L01-1-33.chinese: 如果看不清楚黑板上的字，你可以靠近一點兒。
B4L01-1-33.pinyin: Rúguǒ kàn bù qīngchǔ hēibǎn shàng de zì, nǐ kěyǐ kàojìn yīdiǎnr.
B4L01-1-33.english: If you can't see the words on the blackboard clearly, you can move a bit closer.

B4L01-1-34.chinese: 一個人做錯事多半是自己造成的，不能一做錯就怪別人。
B4L01-1-34.pinyin: Yī ge rén zuòcuò shì duōbàn shì zìjǐ zàochéng de, bùnéng yī zuòcuò jiù guài biérén.
B4L01-1-34.english: When a person does something wrong, it is mostly caused by themselves; you can't just blame others as soon as you make a mistake.

B4L01-1-35.chinese: 有人花大半輩子的時間工作，陪親人的時間卻非常少。
B4L01-1-35.pinyin: Yǒu rén huā dàbàn bèizi de shíjiān gōngzuò, péi qīnrén de shíjiān què fēicháng shǎo.
B4L01-1-35.english: Some people spend more than half their lifetime working, yet the time they spend with their family is very little.

B4L01-1-36.chinese: 心裡很平靜(peaceful)的人，就算居住在人車又多又吵的市區，仍然覺得自在。
B4L01-1-36.pinyin: Xīnlǐ hěn píngjìng de rén, jiùsuàn jūzhù zài rén chē yòu duō yòu chǎo de shìqū, réngrán juéde zìzài.
B4L01-1-36.english: People who are very peaceful inside, even if they live in an urban district with many people and cars and lots of noise, still feel at ease.

B4L01-1-37.chinese: 叔叔時常跟我聊他到世界各地旅行的故事，真是有意思。
B4L01-1-37.pinyin: Shūshu shícháng gēn wǒ liáo tā dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng de gùshì, zhēn shì yǒu yìsi.
B4L01-1-37.english: My uncle often chats with me about his stories of traveling around the world; it's really interesting.

B4L01-1-38.chinese: 對我來說，幸福就是在身邊有一群願意互相幫助的好友。
B4L01-1-38.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, xìngfú jiùshì zài shēnbiān yǒu yī qún yuànyì hùxiāng bāngzhù de hǎoyǒu.
B4L01-1-38.english: To me, happiness is having a group of good friends around who are willing to help each other.

B4L01-1-39.chinese: 人與人之間的感情很珍貴，就算擁有再多的錢也買不到。
B4L01-1-39.pinyin: Rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de gǎnqíng hěn zhēnguì, jiùsuàn yōngyǒu zài duō de qián yě mǎi bù dào.
B4L01-1-39.english: The affection between people is very precious; even if you have a lot of money, you can't buy it.

B4L01-1-40.chinese: 他們從小時候就很要好，有困難時一起解決，有好東西也會分給對方。
B4L01-1-40.pinyin: Tāmen cóng xiǎoshíhou jiù hěn yàohǎo, yǒu kùnnán shí yīqǐ jiějué, yǒu hǎo dōngxi yě huì fēn gěi duìfāng.
B4L01-1-40.english: They have been close friends since childhood; when they have difficulties, they solve them together, and when they have good things, they share them with each other.

B4L01-1-41.chinese: 呀！會議室裡怎麼擺著一個大蛋糕，是誰買的呀？
B4L01-1-41.pinyin: Ya! Huìyìshì lǐ zěnme bǎi zhe yī ge dà dàngāo, shì shéi mǎi de ya?
B4L01-1-41.english: Ah! Why is there a big cake placed in the meeting room? Who bought it?

B4L01-1-42.chinese: 我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
B4L01-1-42.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tuìxiū le, bùguò hái shícháng gēn jǐ wèi yàohǎo de tóngshì tōngxìn.
B4L01-1-42.english: I have already retired, but I still often correspond with a few close colleagues.

B4L01-1-43.chinese: 大家都喜歡很貴的手機，可是他就不喜歡，覺得能用就好。
B4L01-1-43.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xǐhuān hěn guì de shǒujī, kěshì tā jiù bù xǐhuān, juéde néng yòng jiù hǎo.
B4L01-1-43.english: Everyone likes very expensive cell phones, but he just doesn't like them; he thinks as long as it works, it's fine.

B4L01-1-44.chinese: 前天我收到大學的來信，才知道我被錄取了，真開心。
B4L01-1-44.pinyin: Qiántiān wǒ shōudào dàxué de láixìn, cái zhīdào wǒ bèi lùqǔ le, zhēn kāixīn.
B4L01-1-44.english: The day before yesterday I received an incoming letter from the university, and only then did I learn that I had been admitted; I'm really happy.

B4L01-1-45.chinese: 我看見路口有人舉著一面牌子，上面是銷售房屋的廣告。
B4L01-1-45.pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn lùkǒu yǒu rén jǔ zhe yī miàn páizi, shàngmiàn shì xiāoshòu fángwū de guǎnggào.
B4L01-1-45.english: I saw someone at the intersection holding up a sign, on which was an advertisement for selling houses.

B4L01-1-46.chinese: 雖然我是臺灣人，不過臺灣有一些地方我可是從來都沒去過。
B4L01-1-46.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ shì Táiwān rén, bùguò Táiwān yǒu yīxiē dìfāng wǒ kěshì cónglái dōu méi qùguò.
B4L01-1-46.english: Although I am Taiwanese, there are indeed some places in Taiwan that I have never been to.

B4L01-1-47.chinese: 寄掛號信雖然貴了一點兒，可是比較可靠。
B4L01-1-47.pinyin: Jì guàhàoxìn suīrán guì le yīdiǎnr, kěshì bǐjiào kěkào.
B4L01-1-47.english: Although sending a registered letter is a bit more expensive, it is more reliable.

B4L01-1-48.chinese: 小王做事非常粗心，因此公司一直不敢把重要的業務交給他。
B4L01-1-48.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng zuòshì fēicháng cūxīn, yīncǐ gōngsī yīzhí bù gǎn bǎ zhòngyào de yèwù jiāo gěi tā.
B4L01-1-48.english: Xiao Wang is very careless in doing things, so the company has never dared to hand important business over to him.

B4L01-1-49.chinese: 我玩了整晚的手機遊戲，結果第二天差點被爸爸打一頓。
B4L01-1-49.pinyin: Wǒ wán le zhěng wǎn de shǒujī yóuxì, jiéguǒ dì-èr tiān chàdiǎn bèi bàba dǎ yī dùn.
B4L01-1-49.english: I played mobile games all night, and as a result, the next day I almost got a beating from my dad.

B4L01-1-50.chinese: 他對自己很小氣，可是對朋友卻很大方。
B4L01-1-50.pinyin: Tā duì zìjǐ hěn xiǎoqì, kěshì duì péngyǒu què hěn dàfāng.
B4L01-1-50.english: He is very stingy with himself, but he is very generous with friends.

B4L01-1-51.chinese: 明天的露營活動還欠什麼東西？我可以帶過來。
B4L01-1-51.pinyin: Míngtiān de lùyíng huódòng hái qiàn shénme dōngxi? Wǒ kěyǐ dài guòlái.
B4L01-1-51.english: What else do we still owe for tomorrow's camping activity? I can bring it over.

B4L01-1-52.chinese: 剛剛大家推來推去的，結果把瓶子給打破了，這算誰的錯？
B4L01-1-52.pinyin: Gānggāng dàjiā tuīlái tuīqù de, jiéguǒ bǎ píngzi gěi dǎpò le, zhè suàn shéi de cuò?
B4L01-1-52.english: Just now everyone was pushing it back and forth, and as a result the bottle got broken—whose fault is this considered to be?

B4L01-2-01.chinese: 隨著科技越來越進步，手機的功能也越來越多。
B4L01-2-01.pinyin: Suízhe kējì yuèláiyuè jìnbù, shǒujī de gōngnéng yě yuèláiyuè duō.
B4L01-2-01.english: Along with technology becoming more and more advanced, the functions of cell phones are also becoming more and more numerous.

B4L01-2-02.chinese: 我們約好下星期一在線上開會，討論辦員工運動會的事情。
B4L01-2-02.pinyin: Wǒmen yuēhǎo xià xīngqīyī zài xiànshàng kāihuì, tǎolùn bàn yuángōng yùndònghuì de shìqing.
B4L01-2-02.english: We agreed to hold a meeting online next Monday to discuss the matter of organizing the employees' sports meet.

B4L01-2-03.chinese: 華人過新年時，如果到好友家拜訪，都會帶著禮物。
B4L01-2-03.pinyin: Huárén guò xīnnián shí, rúguǒ dào hǎoyǒu jiā bàifǎng, dōu huì dàizhe lǐwù.
B4L01-2-03.english: When Chinese people celebrate the New Year, if they pay a visit to a good friend's home, they always bring gifts.

B4L01-2-04.chinese: 我跟朋友的愛好一樣，都喜歡露營。
B4L01-2-04.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou de àihào yíyàng, dōu xǐhuan lùyíng.
B4L01-2-04.english: My friend and I have the same hobby—we both like camping.

B4L01-2-05.chinese: 我心中有兩個夢想，一是當歌星，另一個是去各國旅行。
B4L01-2-05.pinyin: Wǒ xīn zhōng yǒu liǎng ge mèngxiǎng, yī shì dāng gēxīng, lìng yí ge shì qù gè guó lǚxíng.
B4L01-2-05.english: I have two dreams in my heart: one is to become a singer, and the other is to travel to various countries.

B4L01-2-06.chinese: 個子小的人，不見得力量也小。
B4L01-2-06.pinyin: Gèzi xiǎo de rén, bújiànde lìliàng yě xiǎo.
B4L01-2-06.english: People who are small in stature are not necessarily small in strength.

B4L01-2-07.chinese: 他有一點兒膽小，又容易緊張，我看這件事你先別告訴他。
B4L01-2-07.pinyin: Tā yǒu yìdiǎnr dǎnxiǎo, yòu róngyì jǐnzhāng, wǒ kàn zhè jiàn shì nǐ xiān bié gàosu tā.
B4L01-2-07.english: He is a bit timid and also easily gets nervous; I think you'd better not tell him about this matter yet.

B4L01-2-08.chinese: 你要大膽一點兒，不喜歡的事情就拒絕。
B4L01-2-08.pinyin: Nǐ yào dàdǎn yìdiǎnr, bù xǐhuan de shìqing jiù jùjué.
B4L01-2-08.english: You need to be a bit more bold—if you don't like something, just refuse it.

B4L01-2-09.chinese: 有的父母讓孩子嘗試打工，是為了讓孩子更加獨立。
B4L01-2-09.pinyin: Yǒude fùmǔ ràng háizi chángshì dǎgōng, shì wèile ràng háizi gèngjiā dúlì.
B4L01-2-09.english: Some parents let their children try working part-time in order to make their children more independent.

B4L01-2-10.chinese: 父母對孩子表現的肯定，就是給孩子最好的鼓勵。
B4L01-2-10.pinyin: Fùmǔ duì háizi biǎoxiàn de kěndìng, jiùshì gěi háizi zuì hǎo de gǔlì.
B4L01-2-10.english: Parents' affirmation of their children's performance is the best encouragement for the children.

B4L01-2-11.chinese: 我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
B4L01-2-11.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng wàng le bǎ lèsè ná chūqù diū, háohǎo nǐ tíxǐng wǒ.
B4L01-2-11.english: I just forgot to take the garbage out to throw away—good thing you reminded me.

B4L01-2-12.chinese: 跟別人握手時，握得太久或太緊都是沒有禮貌的行為。
B4L01-2-12.pinyin: Gēn biérén wòshǒu shí, wò de tài jiǔ huò tài jǐn dōu shì méiyǒu lǐmào de xíngwéi.
B4L01-2-12.english: When shaking hands with others, holding on too long or too tightly is impolite behavior.

B4L01-2-13.chinese: 前幾天他們因為一點兒小誤會吵了一架，還好現在和好了。
B4L01-2-13.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān tāmen yīnwèi yìdiǎnr xiǎo wùhuì chǎo le yí jià, háohǎo xiànzài héhǎo le.
B4L01-2-13.english: A few days ago they had a quarrel because of a small misunderstanding—good thing they've become reconciled now.

B4L01-2-14.chinese: 有人說，想了解一個人的真心，就得看他做的事、他說的話。
B4L01-2-14.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, xiǎng liǎojiě yí ge rén de zhēnxīn, jiù děi kàn tā zuò de shì, tā shuō de huà.
B4L01-2-14.english: Some people say that if you want to understand a person's sincerity, you have to look at what they do and what they say.

B4L01-2-15.chinese: 人人都有屬於自己的長處，要對自己更有信心。
B4L01-2-15.pinyin: Rénrén dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de chángchù, yào duì zìjǐ gèng yǒu xìnxīn.
B4L01-2-15.english: Everyone has their own strengths; you should have more confidence in yourself.

B4L01-2-16.chinese: 剛學的詞和語法最好常使用、多複習，如此才能加深記憶。
B4L01-2-16.pinyin: Gāng xué de cí hé yǔfǎ zuì hǎo cháng shǐyòng, duō fùxí, rúcǐ cái néng jiāshēn jìyì.
B4L01-2-16.english: It's best to frequently use and review more the words and grammar you've just learned—only in this way can you deepen your memory.

B4L01-2-17.chinese: 他跟我道歉時一點兒誠意都沒有，所以我不會原諒他。
B4L01-2-17.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ dàoqiàn shí yìdiǎnr chéngyì dōu méiyǒu, suǒyǐ wǒ bú huì yuánliàng tā.
B4L01-2-17.english: When he apologized to me, he didn't have even a bit of sincerity, so I won't forgive him.

B4L01-2-18.chinese: 想吃得安心、吃得健康，自己親手做是必需的。
B4L01-2-18.pinyin: Xiǎng chī de ānxīn, chī de jiànkāng, zìjǐ qīnshǒu zuò shì bìxū de.
B4L01-2-18.english: If you want to eat with peace of mind and eat healthily, making it yourself is necessary.

B4L01-2-19.chinese: 答應別人的事就要做到，這才是有信用的人。
B4L01-2-19.pinyin: Dāying biérén de shì jiù yào zuòdào, zhè cái shì yǒu xìnyòng de rén.
B4L01-2-19.english: When you agree to do something for someone, you must do it—only then are you a person with credit.

B4L01-2-20.chinese: 機會來了就應該好好把握，不然就太可惜了。
B4L01-2-20.pinyin: Jīhuì lái le jiù yīnggāi háohǎo bǎwò, bùrán jiù tài kěxī le.
B4L01-2-20.english: When an opportunity comes, you should grasp it well; otherwise, it would be too much of a pity.

B4L01-2-21.chinese: 這家醫院昨天半夜發生嚴重的火災，受傷的人數約有三十名。
B4L01-2-21.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn zuótiān bànyè fāshēng yánzhòng de huǒzāi, shòushāng de rénshù yuē yǒu sānshí míng.
B4L01-2-21.english: This hospital had a serious fire in the middle of the night yesterday; the number of people injured was about thirty.

B4L01-2-22.chinese: 下週五有上百位家長會到我們學校，一同參加全校運動會。
B4L01-2-22.pinyin: Xià zhōuwǔ yǒu shàngbǎi wèi jiāzhǎng huì dào wǒmen xuéxiào, yìtóng cānjiā quánxiào yùndònghuì.
B4L01-2-22.english: Next Friday, hundreds of parents will come to our school to participate together in the whole-school sports meet.

B4L01-2-23.chinese: 想找吃喝玩樂的朋友不難，想有一位知心的朋友卻不容易。
B4L01-2-23.pinyin: Xiǎng zhǎo chī hē wánlè de péngyou bù nán, xiǎng yǒu yí wèi zhīxīn de péngyou què bù róngyì.
B4L01-2-23.english: Finding friends to eat, drink, and have fun with is not hard, but wanting to have an intimate friend is not easy.

B4L01-2-24.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
B4L01-2-24.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
B4L01-2-24.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

B4L02-1-01.chinese: 我要去郵局辦事，有什麼事要我順便替你辦的嗎？
B4L02-1-01.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù yóujú bànshì, yǒu shénme shì yào wǒ shùnbiàn tì nǐ bàn de ma?
B4L02-1-01.english: I'm going to the post office to handle some affairs; is there anything you want me to handle for you while I'm at it?

B4L02-1-03.chinese: 我姑姑跟姑丈結婚已經有二十年了，感情一直很好。
B4L02-1-03.pinyin: Wǒ gūgu gēn gūzhàng jiéhūn yǐjīng yǒu èrshí nián le, gǎnqíng yīzhí hěn hǎo.
B4L02-1-03.english: My paternal aunt and her husband (my uncle) have been married for twenty years already, and their relationship has always been very good.

B4L02-1-04.chinese: 圖書館入口那裡寫著不能帶食物進去，你吃完再進去吧。
B4L02-1-04.pinyin: Túshūguǎn rùkǒu nàlǐ xiězhe bù néng dài shíwù jìnqù, nǐ chī wán zài jìnqù ba.
B4L02-1-04.english: At the library entrance, it says you can't bring food in, so finish eating before you go in.

B4L02-1-05.chinese: A:哎，有沒有看見我的錢包？ B:哎，你怎麼又在找東西了呢？ A:哎，年紀大了就是這樣？ B:哎，你還年輕呢！讓我幫你一起找吧。
B4L02-1-05.pinyin: A: Āi, yǒu méiyǒu kànjiàn wǒ de qiánbāo? B: Āi, nǐ zěnme yòu zài zhǎo dōngxi le ne? A: Āi, niánjì dà le jiùshì zhèyàng? B: Āi, nǐ hái niánqīng ne! Ràng wǒ bāng nǐ yīqǐ zhǎo ba.
B4L02-1-05.english: A: Hey, have you seen my wallet? B: Hey, how come you're looking for things again? A: Hey, that's just how it is when you get old, I guess? B: Hey, you're still young! Let me help you look for it together.

B4L02-1-06.chinese: 他大哥跟大嫂是同年同月同日生的，真是太巧了。
B4L02-1-06.pinyin: Tā dàgē gēn dàsǎo shì tóng nián tóng yuè tóng rì shēng de, zhēn shì tài qiǎo le.
B4L02-1-06.english: His eldest brother and eldest sister-in-law were born on the same year, same month, and same day—it's really such a coincidence.

B4L02-1-07.chinese: 在這家網路書店購買商品，顧客得先匯款。一般購物網站都是等收到顧客的匯款後，才寄出商品的。
B4L02-1-07.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā wǎnglù shūdiàn gòumǎi shāngpǐn, gùkè děi xiān huìkuǎn. Yībān gòuwù wǎngzhàn dōu shì děng shōudào gùkè de huìkuǎn hòu, cái jìchū shāngpǐn de.
B4L02-1-07.english: To purchase products at this online bookstore, customers must first remit money. Generally, shopping websites all wait until they have received the customer's remittance before they send out the products.

B4L02-1-08.chinese: 這家公司非常重視每位客戶的需求。
B4L02-1-08.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī fēicháng zhòngshì měi wèi kèhù de xūqiú.
B4L02-1-08.english: This company highly values every client's needs.

B4L02-1-09.chinese: 他這個月花了太多錢，因此連水電費、房租都繳不出來。
B4L02-1-09.pinyin: Tā zhège yuè huā le tài duō qián, yīncǐ lián shuǐdiànfèi, fángzū dōu jiǎo bù chūlái.
B4L02-1-09.english: He spent too much money this month, so he can't even pay his water and electricity bills and rent.

B4L02-1-10.chinese: 這面牆壁上的圖畫真美，是誰畫的？
B4L02-1-10.pinyin: Zhè miàn qiángbì shàng de túhuà zhēn měi, shì shéi huà de?
B4L02-1-10.english: The picture on this wall is really beautiful—who painted it?

B4L02-1-11.chinese: 天哪！這次期末考真不容易呀，要是考不好被當了，怎麼辦哪？
B4L02-1-11.pinyin: Tiān na! Zhè cì qīmòkǎo zhēn bù róngyì ya, yàoshì kǎo bù hǎo bèi dāng le, zěnme bàn na?
B4L02-1-11.english: Oh my! This final exam is really not easy—if I don't do well and get flunked, what will I do?

B4L02-1-12.chinese: 這種鬧鐘有點特別，響了以後得按三下才能關掉。
B4L02-1-12.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng nàozhōng yǒudiǎn tèbié, xiǎng le yǐhòu děi àn sān xià cái néng guān diào.
B4L02-1-12.english: This kind of alarm clock is a bit special: after it rings, you have to press it three times before you can turn it off.

B4L02-1-13.chinese: 自從有了抽號機以後，人們就不需要站著排隊了。
B4L02-1-13.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le chōuhàojī yǐhòu, rénmen jiù bù xūyào zhànzhe páiduì le.
B4L02-1-13.english: Ever since there have been queue ticket dispensers, people no longer need to stand in line.

B4L02-1-14.chinese: 現在的手機都具有語音轉成文字的功能，用來記錄事情非常便利。
B4L02-1-14.pinyin: Xiànzài de shǒujī dōu jùyǒu yǔyīn zhuǎn chéng wénzì de gōngnéng, yòng lái jìlù shìqíng fēicháng biànlì.
B4L02-1-14.english: Today's mobile phones all have the function of converting voice into text, which is very convenient for recording things.

B4L02-1-15.chinese: 他說的華語帶點兒家鄉口音，聽起來很親切。
B4L02-1-15.pinyin: Tā shuō de Huáyǔ dài diǎnr jiāxiāng kǒuyīn, tīng qǐlái hěn qīnqiè.
B4L02-1-15.english: The Mandarin he speaks carries a bit of a hometown accent, which sounds very warm and friendly.

B4L02-1-16.chinese: 要是你在百貨公司掉了東西，可以去服務中心的櫃臺問問。
B4L02-1-16.pinyin: Yàoshì nǐ zài bǎihuò gōngsī diào le dōngxi, kěyǐ qù fúwù zhōngxīn de guìtái wènwen.
B4L02-1-16.english: If you lose something in the department store, you can go ask at the service center counter.

B4L02-1-17.chinese: 我去醫院看完病後，醫生給了我一張單子去櫃檯付錢和領藥。
B4L02-1-17.pinyin: Wǒ qù yīyuàn kàn wán bìng hòu, yīshēng gěi le wǒ yī zhāng dānzi qù guìtái fù qián hé lǐng yào.
B4L02-1-17.english: After I finished seeing the doctor at the hospital, the doctor gave me a form to go to the counter to pay and pick up medicine.

B4L02-1-18.chinese: 一個人的想法會隨著身分、角色的不同而改變。
B4L02-1-18.pinyin: Yī ge rén de xiǎngfǎ huì suízhe shēnfèn, juésè de bùtóng ér gǎibiàn.
B4L02-1-18.english: A person's way of thinking will change along with differences in identity and role.

B4L02-1-19.chinese: 您想辦簽證的話，請先準備好相關證件再來辦理。
B4L02-1-19.pinyin: Nín xiǎng bàn qiānzhèng de huà, qǐng xiān zhǔnbèi hǎo xiāngguān zhèngjiàn zài lái bànlǐ.
B4L02-1-19.english: If you want to apply for a visa, please prepare the relevant documents first before coming to handle it.

B4L02-1-20.chinese: 學習是別人無法代你去做的，得親自來。
B4L02-1-20.pinyin: Xuéxí shì biérén wúfǎ dài nǐ qù zuò de, děi qīnzì lái.
B4L02-1-20.english: Learning is something others cannot do on your behalf—you have to do it yourself.

B4L02-1-21.chinese: 身分證是用來證明一個人的身分時使用的。
B4L02-1-21.pinyin: Shēnfènzhèng shì yòng lái zhèngmíng yī ge rén de shēnfèn shí shǐyòng de.
B4L02-1-21.english: An identity card is used when proving a person's identity.

B4L02-1-22.chinese: 銀行裡有很多種表格，看你辦什麼事，就用什麼表格。
B4L02-1-22.pinyin: Yínháng lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhǒng biǎogé, kàn nǐ bàn shénme shì, jiù yòng shénme biǎogé.
B4L02-1-22.english: There are many kinds of forms in the bank; depending on what you're doing, you use the corresponding form.

B4L02-1-23.chinese: 我老婆最近又忙又累，因此我特地在餐桌上頭擺了她最愛的紅玫瑰，讓她開心一下。為了打開(to open up)國外市場，公司上頭決定增加網路銷售方面的經費。
B4L02-1-23.pinyin: Wǒ lǎopo zuìjìn yòu máng yòu lèi, yīncǐ wǒ tèdì zài cānzhuō shàngtou bǎi le tā zuì ài de hóng méiguī, ràng tā kāixīn yīxià. Wèile dǎkāi guówài shìchǎng, gōngsī shàngtou juédìng zēngjiā wǎnglù xiāoshòu fāngmiàn de jīngfèi.
B4L02-1-23.english: My wife has been both busy and tired recently, so I specially placed her favorite red roses on top of the dining table to cheer her up a bit. In order to open up overseas markets, the company's higher-ups decided to increase funding for online sales.

B4L02-1-24.chinese: 在我們學校，上課時是不能使用手機的，連老師也不能破壞規定。那所學校規定學生不能帶手機上學，是希望他們專心學習。
B4L02-1-24.pinyin: Zài wǒmen xuéxiào, shàngkè shí shì bù néng shǐyòng shǒujī de, lián lǎoshī yě bù néng pòhuài guīdìng. Nà suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng bù néng dài shǒujī shàngxué, shì xīwàng tāmen zhuānxīn xuéxí.
B4L02-1-24.english: At our school, you cannot use mobile phones during class—even teachers cannot break the rule. That school stipulates that students cannot bring mobile phones to school because it hopes they will concentrate on their studies.

B4L02-1-25.chinese: 出國旅遊的時候，能帶的現金是有限制的。
B4L02-1-25.pinyin: Chūguó lǚyóu de shíhòu, néng dài de xiànjīn shì yǒu xiànzhì de.
B4L02-1-25.english: When traveling abroad, the cash you can bring is limited.

B4L02-1-26.chinese: 國內幾家銀行決定從明年起，降低跨行匯款的手續費。
B4L02-1-26.pinyin: Guónèi jǐ jiā yínháng juédìng cóng míngnián qǐ, jiàngdī kuàháng huìkuǎn de shǒuxùfèi.
B4L02-1-26.english: Several domestic banks have decided that starting next year, they will lower the service fees for interbank remittances.

B4L02-1-27.chinese: 那輛腳踏車對個子小的我來說太高了，腳很難跨過去。我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
B4L02-1-27.pinyin: Nà liàng jiǎotàchē duì gèzi xiǎo de wǒ lái shuō tài gāo le, jiǎo hěn nán kuà guòqù. Wǒmen dàxué qiánnián qǐ yǐ kāifàng kuàxiào xuǎnkè, zēngjiā gè xiào de jiāoliú jīhuì.
B4L02-1-27.english: That bicycle is too high for me, since I'm short, so it's hard to straddle my leg over it. Our university has offered cross-school course selection since the year before last, increasing opportunities for exchange between schools.

B4L02-1-28.chinese: 收到帳單的時候得準時去繳費，以免超過時間後得繳更多錢。
B4L02-1-28.pinyin: Shōudào zhàngdān de shíhou děi zhǔnshí qù jiǎofèi, yǐmiǎn chāoguò shíjiān hòu děi jiǎo gèng duō qián.
B4L02-1-28.english: When you receive the bill, you must go pay it on time, so as to avoid having to pay more money after the deadline.

B4L02-1-29.chinese: 窗外正下著大雨，我又沒帶傘，看來得在公司多留一會兒了。
B4L02-1-29.pinyin: Chuāngwài zhèng xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒ yòu méi dài sǎn, kànlái děi zài gōngsī duō liú yīhuìr le.
B4L02-1-29.english: It's raining heavily outside the window, and I didn't bring an umbrella, so it seems that I'll have to stay at the office a while longer.

B4L02-1-30.chinese: 如果你想到菲律賓旅行，還是帶著美金到當地換錢比較方便。
B4L02-1-30.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng dào Fēilǜbīn lǚxíng, háishì dàizhe měijīn dào dāngdì huànqián bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
B4L02-1-30.english: If you want to travel to the Philippines, it's more convenient to bring US dollars and exchange money locally.

B4L02-1-31.chinese: 中國開放國內投資後，想投資人民幣的人也越來越多了。
B4L02-1-31.pinyin: Zhōngguó kāifàng guónèi tóuzī hòu, xiǎng tóuzī rénmínbì de rén yě yuèláiyuè duō le.
B4L02-1-31.english: After China opened up domestic investment, more and more people want to invest in RMB.

B4L02-1-32.chinese: 週末的時候，火車站的賣票窗口總是排滿了人。
B4L02-1-32.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, huǒchēzhàn de mài piào chuāngkǒu zǒngshì pái mǎn le rén.
B4L02-1-32.english: On weekends, the ticket windows at the train station are always fully lined up with people.

B4L02-1-33.chinese: 這家公司雖然要求員工得穿西裝上班，但費用全是公司負擔的。
B4L02-1-33.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán yāoqiú yuángōng děi chuān xīzhuāng shàngbān, dàn fèiyòng quán shì gōngsī fùdān de.
B4L02-1-33.english: Although this company requires employees to wear suits to work, the cost is entirely borne by the company.

B4L02-1-34.chinese: 要是新買的商品有問題，七天以內可帶收據到店裡處理。
B4L02-1-34.pinyin: Yàoshi xīn mǎi de shāngpǐn yǒu wèntí, qī tiān yǐnèi kě dài shōujù dào diànlǐ chǔlǐ.
B4L02-1-34.english: If there's a problem with a newly purchased product, within seven days you can bring the receipt to the store to handle it.

B4L02-1-35.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很貼心，只要客人一上門，立刻提供面紙給客人擦手。
B4L02-1-35.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn tiēxīn, zhǐyào kèrén yī shàngmén, lìkè tígōng miànzhǐ gěi kèrén cā shǒu.
B4L02-1-35.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very considerate; as soon as customers come in, they immediately provide tissues for them to wipe their hands.

B4L02-1-36.chinese: 這份文件很急，請你下班以前傳真給對方公司。
B4L02-1-36.pinyin: Zhè fèn wénjiàn hěn jí, qǐng nǐ xiàbān yǐqián chuánzhēn gěi duìfāng gōngsī.
B4L02-1-36.english: This document is very urgent; please fax it to the other company before you get off work.

B4L02-1-37.chinese: 老闆說，除了緊急情況，下班時間別打電話找他。
B4L02-1-37.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shuō, chúle jǐnjí qíngkuàng, xiàbān shíjiān bié dǎ diànhuà zhǎo tā.
B4L02-1-37.english: The boss said that except for urgent situations, don't call him after work hours.

B4L02-1-38.chinese: 有張紙卡在傳真機裡，你拿得出來嗎？
B4L02-1-38.pinyin: Yǒu zhāng zhǐ kǎ zài chuánzhēnjī lǐ, nǐ ná de chūlái ma?
B4L02-1-38.english: There's a piece of paper stuck in the fax machine; can you get it out?

B4L02-1-39.chinese: 到銀行開戶，必須本人親自去辦理。
B4L02-1-39.pinyin: Dào yínháng kāihù, bìxū běnrén qīnzì qù bànlǐ.
B4L02-1-39.english: To open an account at a bank, you must go in person to handle it.

B4L02-1-40.chinese: 我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。夏天的時候容易流汗，讓衣服變得黏黏的，真不舒服。
B4L02-1-40.pinyin: Wǒ de xiédǐ kuàiyào diào xiàlái le, děi qù diànlǐ qǐng rén bǎ tā zhān qǐlái. Tā bùguǎn wǒ máng bù máng, lǎoshì niánzhe wǒ liáotiān, ràng wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn fán. Xiàtiān de shíhou róngyì liúhàn, ràng yīfu biànde niánnián de, zhēn bù shūfu.
B4L02-1-40.english: My shoe sole is about to fall off; I need to go to the shop and ask someone to glue it back on. Regardless of whether I'm busy or not, he's always clinging to me to chat, which makes me feel a bit annoyed. In summer, it's easy to sweat, making clothes sticky, which is really uncomfortable.

B4L02-1-41.chinese: 印章也叫圖章，華人常在重要的文件上使用印章。
B4L02-1-41.pinyin: Yìnzhāng yě jiào túzhāng, Huárén cháng zài zhòngyào de wénjiàn shàng shǐyòng yìnzhāng.
B4L02-1-41.english: A seal is also called a stamp; Chinese people often use seals on important documents.

B4L02-1-42.chinese: 冰店的生意好壞得看季節，冬天的生意總是不如夏天。
B4L02-1-42.pinyin: Bīngdiàn de shēngyì hǎohuài děi kàn jìjié, dōngtiān de shēngyì zǒngshì bùrú xiàtiān.
B4L02-1-42.english: Whether a shaved ice shop's business is good or bad depends on the season; business in winter is always not as good as in summer.

B4L02-1-43.chinese: 教授打算向學校申請一筆經費，進行高山地區的調查計畫。
B4L02-1-43.pinyin: Jiàoshòu dǎsuàn xiàng xuéxiào shēnqǐng yī bǐ jīngfèi, jìnxíng gāoshān dìqū de diàochá jìhuà.
B4L02-1-43.english: The professor plans to apply to the school for a sum of funding to carry out a survey project in the high mountain areas.

B4L02-1-44.chinese: 在網路上，商品的交易雖然方便，但也應注意安全問題。許小姐知道社團網友想賣手機，就拿二手(second hand)筆電去交易，結果對方同意了。
B4L02-1-44.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù shàng, shāngpǐn de jiāoyì suīrán fāngbiàn, dàn yě yīng zhùyì ānquán wèntí. Xǔ xiǎojiě zhīdào shètuán wǎngyǒu xiǎng mài shǒujī, jiù ná èrshǒu bǐdiàn qù jiāoyì, jiéguǒ duìfāng tóngyì le.
B4L02-1-44.english: Online, although product transactions are convenient, you should also pay attention to safety issues. Miss Xu knew that a club netizen wanted to sell a cell phone, so she took a second-hand laptop to trade, and the other party agreed.

B4L02-1-45.chinese: 老是忘記東西不見得是因為個性迷糊，也可能與健康有關。
B4L02-1-45.pinyin: Lǎoshì wàngjì dōngxi bù jiànde shì yīnwèi gèxìng míhú, yě kěnéng yǔ jiànkāng yǒuguān.
B4L02-1-45.english: Always forgetting things is not necessarily because of an absentminded personality; it may also be related to health.

B4L02-1-46.chinese: 公司交給你的支票記得要收好，別弄丟了。
B4L02-1-46.pinyin: Gōngsī jiāo gěi nǐ de zhīpiào jìde yào shōu hǎo, bié nòngdiū le.
B4L02-1-46.english: Remember to put away the check the company gave you properly; don't lose it.

B4L02-1-47.chinese: 你上班別遲到，小心公司扣你的錢！
B4L02-1-47.pinyin: Nǐ shàngbān bié chídào, xiǎoxīn gōngsī kòu nǐ de qián!
B4L02-1-47.english: Don't be late for work; be careful the company might dock your pay!

B4L02-1-48.chinese: 我剛來臺灣，不知道怎麼在銀行開戶存錢，請教我怎麼申請。
B4L02-1-48.pinyin: Wǒ gāng lái Táiwān, bù zhīdào zěnme zài yínháng kāihù cúnqián, qǐng jiào wǒ zěnme shēnqǐng.
B4L02-1-48.english: I just came to Taiwan and don't know how to open an account and deposit money at a bank; please teach me how to apply.

B4L02-1-49.chinese: 有幾位學生的期中考沒考好，教授要他們下星期補考。出門上班前，我才發現短裙破了，不得不先補號再去上班，結果就遲到了。
B4L02-1-49.pinyin: Yǒu jǐ wèi xuéshēng de qīzhōngkǎo méi kǎo hǎo, jiàoshòu yào tāmen xià xīngqī bǔkǎo. Chūmén shàngbān qián, wǒ cái fāxiàn duǎnqún pò le, bùdébù xiān bǔ hǎo zài qù shàngbān, jiéguǒ jiù chídào le.
B4L02-1-49.english: Several students didn't do well on the midterm exam, so the professor wants them to take a make-up exam next week. Before going out to work, I discovered that my skirt was torn, and I had no choice but to mend it first before going to work, and as a result, I was late.

B4L02-1-50.chinese: 媽媽常一邊看做菜節目，一邊把作法抄下來。
B4L02-1-50.pinyin: Māma cháng yībiān kàn zuòcài jiémù, yībiān bǎ zuòfǎ chāo xiàlái.
B4L02-1-50.english: Mom often watches cooking shows while copying down the recipes.

B4L02-2-01.chinese: 他曾替公司談成了三億美元的生意，因此老闆讓他當經理。
B4L02-2-01.pinyin: Tā céng tì gōngsī tán chéng le sān yì měiyuán de shēngyì, yīncǐ lǎobǎn ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
B4L02-2-01.english: He once negotiated a three-hundred-million-dollar deal for the company, so the boss made him manager.

B4L02-2-02.chinese: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
B4L02-2-02.pinyin: Nà wèi fúzhuāng shèjìshī xiāngdāng xǐ'ài shíbā shìjì shí de Ōuzhōu chuántǒng fēnggé.
B4L02-2-02.english: That fashion designer quite loves the traditional European style of the 18th century.

B4L02-2-03.chinese: 假如東西買回家後常擺著不用，那樣的消費就是不必要的。在開心消費前應先想想，那些商品是不是需要的。
B4L02-2-03.pinyin: Jiǎrú dōngxī mǎi huí jiā hòu cháng bǎi zhe bù yòng, nàyàng de xiāofèi jiù shì bù bìyào de. Zài kāixīn xiāofèi qián yīng xiān xiǎngxiang, nàxiē shāngpǐn shì bu shì xūyào de.
B4L02-2-03.english: If things are often left unused after being bought and brought home, that kind of consumption is unnecessary. Before happily consuming, you should first think about whether those products are needed.

B4L02-2-04.chinese: 國外旅行時隨時攜帶護照、信用卡，可讓你玩得安心又順利。
B4L02-2-04.pinyin: Guówài lǚxíng shí suíshí xiédài hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, kě ràng nǐ wán de ānxīn yòu shùnlì.
B4L02-2-04.english: When traveling abroad, carrying your passport and credit card at all times can let you have fun with peace of mind and smoothly.

B4L02-2-05.chinese: 你別把剛領的鈔票放在口袋裡，很容易不見的。
B4L02-2-05.pinyin: Nǐ bié bǎ gāng lǐng de chāopiào fàng zài kǒudài lǐ, hěn róngyì bùjiàn de.
B4L02-2-05.english: Don't put the banknotes you just withdrew in your pocket; they can easily go missing.

B4L02-2-06.chinese: 我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
B4L02-2-06.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiārù shèhuì fúwù zǔzhī, bāngzhù biérén de tóngshí yě ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng.
B4L02-2-06.english: I want to join a social service organization; while helping others, I can also let myself grow.

B4L02-2-08.chinese: 刷卡買東西很方便，用讀卡機器刷一下信用卡就能付錢了。
B4L02-2-08.pinyin: Shuākǎ mǎi dōngxī hěn fāngbiàn, yòng dúkǎ jīqì shuā yīxià xìnyòngkǎ jiù néng fù qián le.
B4L02-2-08.english: Using a credit card to buy things is very convenient; with a card reader, you just swipe the credit card once and you can pay.

B4L02-2-09.chinese: 他剛去超市買了一把刷子，想趁週末時好好把浴室刷乾淨。
B4L02-2-09.pinyin: Tā gāng qù chāoshì mǎi le yī bǎ shuāzi, xiǎng chèn zhōumò shí hǎohǎo bǎ yùshì shuā gānjìng.
B4L02-2-09.english: He just went to the supermarket and bought a scrub brush; he wants to take advantage of the weekend to scrub the bathroom clean properly.

B4L02-2-10.chinese: 在臺灣，碰到緊急情況可撥110，請警察提供協助。
B4L02-2-10.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, pèngdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng kě bō 110, qǐng jǐngchá tígōng xiézhù.
B4L02-2-10.english: In Taiwan, when encountering an emergency, you can dial 110 to ask the police for assistance.

B4L02-2-12.chinese: 信用卡的正面和背面都有一組號碼，在線上刷卡時用得到。
B4L02-2-12.pinyin: Xìnyòngkǎ de zhèngmiàn hé bèimiàn dōu yǒu yī zǔ hàomǎ, zài xiànshàng shuākǎ shí yòng de dào.
B4L02-2-12.english: Both the front side and the back of a credit card have a set of numbers; they are used when swiping the card online.

B4L02-2-13.chinese: 有一些口罩正面跟反面的差異很小，不過一般來說，正面的顏色較深，反面的顏色較淺。
B4L02-2-13.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē kǒuzhào zhèngmiàn gēn fǎnmiàn de chāyì hěn xiǎo, bùguò yībān lái shuō, zhèngmiàn de yánsè jiào shēn, fǎnmiàn de yánsè jiào qiǎn.
B4L02-2-13.english: For some masks, the difference between the front side and the reverse side is very small, but generally speaking, the front side is darker in color and the reverse side is lighter.

B4L02-2-14.chinese: 以前人們常用磁帶來存電腦的重要資料。
B4L02-2-14.pinyin: Yǐqián rénmen cháng yòng cídài lái cún diànnǎo de zhòngyào zīliào.
B4L02-2-14.english: In the past, people often used magnetic tape to store important computer data.

B4L02-2-15.chinese: 發展科技對國家來說很重要，不過也應該注意環保問題。
B4L02-2-15.pinyin: Fāzhǎn kējì duì guójiā lái shuō hěn zhòngyào, bùguò yě yīnggāi zhùyì huánbǎo wèntí.
B4L02-2-15.english: Developing technology is very important for a country, but attention should also be paid to environmental protection issues.

B4L02-2-16.chinese: 現在的電腦晶片速度越來越快，功能也越來越多了。
B4L02-2-16.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànnǎo jīngpiàn sùdù yuè lái yuè kuài, gōngnéng yě yuè lái yuè duō le.
B4L02-2-16.english: Today's computer chips are getting faster and faster in speed, and their functions are also becoming more and more numerous.

B4L02-2-17.chinese: 華語中心的學生想在臺灣的銀行開戶，得先準備在學證明。
B4L02-2-17.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn de xuésheng xiǎng zài Táiwān de yínháng kāihù, děi xiān zhǔnbèi zàixué zhèngmíng.
B4L02-2-17.english: Students at the Mandarin Training Center who want to open an account at a bank in Taiwan must first prepare a certificate of enrollment.

B4L02-2-18.chinese: 到國外旅遊時身上別攜帶太多鈔票，否則錢丟了就麻煩了。
B4L02-2-18.pinyin: Dào guówài lǚyóu shí shēnshang bié xiédài tài duō chāopiào, fǒuzé qián diū le jiù máfan le.
B4L02-2-18.english: When traveling abroad, don't carry too many banknotes on you; otherwise, if the money is lost, it will be troublesome.

B4L02-2-19.chinese: 你寄報告給老師前最好確認一下地址，萬一老師沒收到，到時你就麻煩了。
B4L02-2-19.pinyin: Nǐ jì bàogào gěi lǎoshī qián zuìhǎo quèrèn yīxià dìzhǐ, wànyī lǎoshī méi shōudào, dào shí nǐ jiù máfan le.
B4L02-2-19.english: Before you mail the report to the teacher, you'd better confirm the address; if the teacher doesn't receive it, you'll be in trouble when the moment comes.

B4L02-2-20.chinese: 他做事很慢，時常要人催他。
B4L02-2-20.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn màn, shícháng yào rén cuī tā.
B4L02-2-20.english: He does things very slowly; he often needs people to press him.

B4L02-2-21.chinese: 你在銀行存的錢越多，得到的利息也越多。
B4L02-2-21.pinyin: Nǐ zài yínháng cún de qián yuè duō, dédào de lìxī yě yuè duō.
B4L02-2-21.english: The more money you deposit in the bank, the more interest you get.

B4L02-2-22.chinese: 一個人要學會儲蓄，需要用錢的時候，就不必擔心沒錢可用。
B4L02-2-22.pinyin: Yī ge rén yào xuéhuì chǔxù, xūyào yòng qián de shíhou, jiù bùbì dānxīn méi qián kě yòng.
B4L02-2-22.english: A person needs to learn to save money; when you need to use money, you then don't have to worry about having no money to use.

B4L02-2-23.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
B4L02-2-23.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
B4L02-2-23.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

B4L02-2-25.chinese: 想申請獎學金的話，得先影印你的證件，再把影本寄給學校。
B4L02-2-25.pinyin: Xiǎng shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn de huà, děi xiān yìngyìn nǐ de zhèngjiàn, zài bǎ yǐngběn jì gěi xuéxiào.
B4L02-2-25.english: If you want to apply for a scholarship, you must first photocopy your ID, and then mail the photocopy to the school.

B4L02-2-26.chinese: 我習慣來這家銀行存款，因為這裡的員工都十分親切。你在辦一些國家的簽證時，他們得看你的銀行存款。
B4L02-2-26.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn lái zhè jiā yínháng cúnkuǎn, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yuángōng dōu shífēn qīnqiè. Nǐ zài bàn yīxiē guójiā de qiānzhèng shí, tāmen děi kàn nǐ de yínháng cúnkuǎn.
B4L02-2-26.english: I am used to coming to this bank to deposit money, because the employees here are all very friendly. When you apply for visas for some countries, they need to see your bank savings.

B4L02-2-27.chinese: 如果工作太忙，每天最少還是應該運動半個小時，對健康比較好。
B4L02-2-27.pinyin: Rúguǒ gōngzuò tài máng, měitiān zuìshǎo háishì yīnggāi yùndòng bàn ge xiǎoshí, duì jiànkāng bǐjiào hǎo.
B4L02-2-27.english: If work is too busy, you should still exercise at least half an hour every day; it is better for your health.

B4L02-2-28.chinese: 在臺灣鐵路局的網站訂票，一人最多只能訂六張搭車當天的票。
B4L02-2-28.pinyin: Zài Táiwān Tiělùjú de wǎngzhàn dìng piào, yī rén zuìduō zhǐ néng dìng liù zhāng dā chē dāngtiān de piào.
B4L02-2-28.english: When booking tickets on the Taiwan Railways Administration website, each person can book at most six tickets for the day of travel.

B4L02-2-29.chinese: 當你急著需要某個物品時，不管划不划算，都非買不可。
B4L02-2-29.pinyin: Dāng nǐ jízhe xūyào mǒu gè wùpǐn shí, bùguǎn huá bù huásuàn, dōu fēi mǎi bùkě.
B4L02-2-29.english: When you urgently need a certain item, regardless of whether it is cost-effective or not, you simply must buy it.

B4L03-1-01.chinese: 去郵局領包裹的時候，記得帶身分證、圖章還有通知單。
B4L03-1-01.pinyin: Qù yóujú lǐng bāoguǒ de shíhou, jìde dài shēnfènzhèng, túzhāng hái yǒu tōngzhīdān.
B4L03-1-01.english: When going to the post office to pick up a parcel, remember to bring your ID card, seal, and notification slip.

B4L03-1-02.chinese: 噢，沒問題，你就放心交給我吧。
B4L03-1-02.pinyin: Ō, méi wèntí, nǐ jiù fàngxīn jiāo gěi wǒ ba.
B4L03-1-02.english: Oh, no problem, just hand it over to me with confidence.

B4L03-1-04.chinese: 他把這塊長方形蛋糕分成兩塊三角形的。
B4L03-1-04.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè kuài chángfāngxíng dàngāo fēn chéng liǎng kuài sānjiǎoxíng de.
B4L03-1-04.english: He divided this rectangular cake into two triangular pieces.

B4L03-1-05.chinese: 市中心有座正方形的廣場，民眾經常到那裡散步。
B4L03-1-05.pinyin: Shìzhōngxīn yǒu zuò zhèngfāngxíng de guǎngchǎng, mínzhòng jīngcháng dào nàlǐ sànbù.
B4L03-1-05.english: In the city center there is a square plaza; people often go there for a walk.

B4L03-1-07.chinese: A:聽說百貨公司的衣服要降價了，現在降了嗎？ B:夏天的衣服降價了，因為已經開始賣冬天的衣服了。
B4L03-1-07.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō bǎihuò gōngsī de yīfu yào jiàngjià le, xiànzài jiàng le ma? B: Xiàtiān de yīfu jiàngjià le, yīnwèi yǐjīng kāishǐ mài dōngtiān de yīfu le.
B4L03-1-07.english: A: I heard that the department store's clothes are going to drop in price; have they dropped now? B: Summer clothes have dropped in price, because they've already started selling winter clothes.

B4L03-1-08.chinese: 鞋子的尺寸很重要，太大或是太小都不舒服。
B4L03-1-08.pinyin: Xiézi de chǐcùn hěn zhòngyào, tài dà huòshì tài xiǎo dōu bù shūfu.
B4L03-1-08.english: The size of shoes is very important; whether too big or too small, they are uncomfortable.

B4L03-1-09.chinese: 我們無法決定生命的長度，卻能夠決定生活的品質。
B4L03-1-09.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ juédìng shēngmìng de chángdù, què nénggòu juédìng shēnghuó de pǐnzhì.
B4L03-1-09.english: We cannot decide the length of life, but we can decide the quality of life.

B4L03-1-10.chinese: 你穿的這件衣服肩膀寬度很合適，就是長度太長了，要是能改短一些就好了。
B4L03-1-10.pinyin: Nǐ chuān de zhè jiàn yīfu jiānbǎng kuāndù hěn héshì, jiùshì chángdù tài cháng le, yàoshì néng gǎi duǎn yīxiē jiù hǎo le.
B4L03-1-10.english: The shoulder width of this piece of clothing you're wearing is very suitable; it's just that the length is too long. If only it could be shortened a bit, that would be good.

B4L03-1-11.chinese: 這座橋對車子的高度有限制，開大車的人要小心。
B4L03-1-11.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo duì chēzi de gāodù yǒu xiànzhì, kāi dàchē de rén yào xiǎoxīn.
B4L03-1-11.english: This bridge has a height restriction for vehicles; those driving large vehicles should be careful.

B4L03-1-12.chinese: 搭飛機時，行李的重量是有限制的，大約一件25公斤。
B4L03-1-12.pinyin: Dā fēijī shí, xínglǐ de zhòngliàng shì yǒu xiànzhì de, dàyuē yī jiàn èrshíwǔ gōngjīn.
B4L03-1-12.english: When taking a plane, the weight of luggage is restricted, about 25 kilograms per piece.

B4L03-1-13.chinese: 上網買鞋子前先比一下腳的大小，才知道選哪個尺寸。
B4L03-1-13.pinyin: Shàngwǎng mǎi xiézi qián xiān bǐ yīxià jiǎo de dàxiǎo, cái zhīdào xuǎn nǎge chǐcùn.
B4L03-1-13.english: Before buying shoes online, first measure the size of your feet, only then will you know which size to choose.

B4L03-1-14.chinese: 中國與美國之間的貿易問題很嚴重，這個新聞早就上電視了。
B4L03-1-14.pinyin: Zhōngguó yǔ Měiguó zhījiān de màoyì wèntí hěn yánzhòng, zhège xīnwén zǎo jiù shàng diànshì le.
B4L03-1-14.english: The trade issue between China and the United States is very serious; this news appeared on TV long ago.

B4L03-1-15.chinese: 那家超市蔬菜水果的種類很多，可提供民眾較多的選擇。
B4L03-1-15.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì shūcài shuǐguǒ de zhǒnglèi hěn duō, kě tígōng mínzhòng jiào duō de xuǎnzé.
B4L03-1-15.english: That supermarket has many kinds of vegetables and fruits, which can provide people with more choices.

B4L03-1-16.chinese: 那家文具店賣的文具種類很多，像筆、書包、本子等學生用品，不僅品質好，價錢也不貴。
B4L03-1-16.pinyin: Nà jiā wénjù diàn mài de wénjù zhǒnglèi hěn duō, xiàng bǐ, shūbāo, běnzi děng xuésheng yòngpǐn, bùjǐn pǐnzhì hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
B4L03-1-16.english: The stationery store sells many kinds of stationery, such as pens, backpacks, notebooks, and other student supplies; not only is the quality good, but the price is also not expensive.

B4L03-1-17.chinese: 這些跟卡通人物有關書籍，很適合兒童閱讀。
B4L03-1-17.pinyin: Zhèxiē gēn kǎtōng rénwù yǒuguān de shūjí, hěn shìhé értóng yuèdú.
B4L03-1-17.english: These books related to cartoon characters are very suitable for children to read.

B4L03-1-18.chinese: 對上班族來說，上網買牙刷、內衣褲、面紙等日用品，既輕鬆又方便。
B4L03-1-18.pinyin: Duì shàngbānzú lái shuō, shàngwǎng mǎi yáshuā, nèiyīkù, miànzhǐ děng rìyòngpǐn, jì qīngsōng yòu fāngbiàn.
B4L03-1-18.english: For office workers, buying daily commodities such as toothbrushes, underwear, and tissues online is both relaxing and convenient.

B4L03-1-19.chinese: 吃了健康食品以後，還是得經常運動才能擁有好身材。
B4L03-1-19.pinyin: Chī le jiànkāng shípǐn yǐhòu, háishì děi jīngcháng yùndòng cái néng yōngyǒu hǎo shēncái.
B4L03-1-19.english: After eating health food, you still need to exercise regularly to have a good figure.

B4L03-1-20.chinese: 不管做任何事都應先了解情況，省得白花精神。
B4L03-1-20.pinyin: Bùguǎn zuò rènhé shì dōu yīng xiān liǎojiě qíngkuàng, shěngde bái huā jīngshén.
B4L03-1-20.english: No matter what you do, you should first understand the situation, so as to avoid wasting energy in vain.

B4L03-1-21.chinese: 送禮品給外國朋友前，最好先了解不同國家的送禮習慣。
B4L03-1-21.pinyin: Sòng lǐpǐn gěi wàiguó péngyǒu qián, zuìhǎo xiān liǎojiě bùtóng guójiā de sònglǐ xíguàn.
B4L03-1-21.english: Before giving gifts to foreign friends, it's best to first understand the gift-giving customs of different countries.

B4L03-1-22.chinese: 前主任一天到晚做研究，連周末也不休息，這樣身體怎麼受得了？
B4L03-1-22.pinyin: Qián zhǔrèn yītiāndàowǎn zuò yánjiū, lián zhōumò yě bù xiūxi, zhèyàng shēntǐ zěnme shòudeliǎo?
B4L03-1-22.english: The former director did research all day long, not even resting on weekends; how could his body endure that?

B4L03-1-23.chinese: 我覺得跳舞這項活動對健康很有幫助，還可以交到很多朋友。
B4L03-1-23.pinyin: Wǒ juéde tiàowǔ zhè xiàng huódòng duì jiànkāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù, hái kěyǐ jiāo dào hěn duō péngyǒu.
B4L03-1-23.english: I think the activity of dancing is very helpful for health, and you can also make many friends.

B4L03-1-24.chinese: 按照商品目錄的說明，消費滿五百元可以打八五折。
B4L03-1-24.pinyin: Ànzhào shāngpǐn mùlù de shuōmíng, xiāofèi mǎn wǔbǎi yuán kěyǐ dǎ bāwǔzhé.
B4L03-1-24.english: According to the product catalog, if you spend 500 yuan, you can get a 15% discount.

B4L03-1-26.chinese: A:這幾雙拖鞋我都喜歡，不知道怎麼挑選？ B:這容易，你挑雙便宜的就好。
B4L03-1-26.pinyin: A: Zhè jǐ shuāng tuōxié wǒ dōu xǐhuān, bù zhīdào zěnme tiāoxuǎn? B: Zhè róngyì, nǐ tiāo shuāng piányi de jiù hǎo.
B4L03-1-26.english: A: I like all these pairs of slippers; I don't know how to choose? B: That's easy, just pick a cheap pair.

B4L03-1-27.chinese: 爸爸挑選西裝時，最重視的是品質，其次才是式樣。
B4L03-1-27.pinyin: Bàba tiāoxuǎn xīzhuāng shí, zuì zhòngshì de shì pǐnzhì, qícì cái shì shìyàng.
B4L03-1-27.english: When Dad chooses a suit, what he values most is quality; style comes second.

B4L03-1-28.chinese: 小張的個性比較懶，很少主動幫同事的忙。
B4L03-1-28.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng de gèxìng bǐjiào lǎn, hěn shǎo zhǔdòng bāng tóngshì de máng.
B4L03-1-28.english: Little Zhang's personality is rather lazy; he rarely takes the initiative to help his colleagues.

B4L03-1-29.chinese: 吃完飯到櫃臺結帳前，應該先看清楚帳單有沒有錯。
B4L03-1-29.pinyin: Chī wán fàn dào guìtái jiézhàng qián, yīnggāi xiān kàn qīngchu zhàngdān yǒu méiyǒu cuò.
B4L03-1-29.english: After eating, before going to the counter to pay the bill, you should first check clearly whether there are any mistakes on the bill.

B4L03-1-30.chinese: 那家禮品店的商品樣式不錯，並且價格合理，所以生意很好。
B4L03-1-30.pinyin: Nà jiā lǐpǐn diàn de shāngpǐn yàngshì bùcuò, bìngqiě jiàgé hélǐ, suǒyǐ shēngyì hěn hǎo.
B4L03-1-30.english: That gift shop's product styles are quite good, and also the prices are reasonable, so business is very good.

B4L03-1-31.chinese: 我想出國當背包客，除了能打開視野，並能訓練自己更獨立。
B4L03-1-31.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chūguó dāng bēibāokè, chúle néng dǎkāi shìyě, bìng néng xùnliàn zìjǐ gèng dúlì.
B4L03-1-31.english: I want to go abroad as a backpacker; besides being able to broaden my horizons, and also train myself to be more independent.

B4L03-1-32.chinese: 國外商品來到本國後，賣出的價錢往往比國外高出一兩成。
B4L03-1-32.pinyin: Guówài shāngpǐn lái dào běnguó hòu, mài chū de jiàqián wǎngwǎng bǐ guówài gāo chū yī liǎng chéng.
B4L03-1-32.english: After foreign goods arrive in this country, the selling price is often one or two tenths higher than abroad.

B4L03-1-33.chinese: 如果你是那家網路商店的會員，購買任何商品都可以便宜兩成。
B4L03-1-33.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ shì nà jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de huìyuán, gòumǎi rènhé shāngpǐn dōu kěyǐ piányi liǎng chéng.
B4L03-1-33.english: If you are a member of that online store, you can buy any product for twenty percent cheaper.

B4L03-1-34.chinese: 學校規定新生必須在開學前一週完成註冊手續。
B4L03-1-34.pinyin: Xuéxiào guīdìng xīnshēng bìxū zài kāixué qián yī zhōu wánchéng zhùcè shǒuxù.
B4L03-1-34.english: The school stipulates that new students must complete the registration procedures one week before the semester starts.

B4L03-1-35.chinese: 不斷複習生字卡片能幫我們記住新的字。
B4L03-1-35.pinyin: Bùduàn fùxí shēngzì kǎpiàn néng bāng wǒmen jìzhù xīn de zì.
B4L03-1-35.english: Constantly reviewing vocabulary flashcards can help us remember new characters.

B4L03-1-36.chinese: 室友A:嘿，吃完飯後不能把碗筷擺在桌子讓別人洗喔。室友B:不好意思，我這就去洗。室友A:嘿，你還真聽話(obedient)啊。
B4L03-1-36.pinyin: Shìyǒu A: Hēi, chī wán fàn hòu bùnéng bǎ wǎnkuài bǎi zài zhuōzi ràng biérén xǐ o. Shìyǒu B: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ zhè jiù qù xǐ. Shìyǒu A: Hēi, nǐ hái zhēn tīnghuà a.
B4L03-1-36.english: Roommate A: Hey, after eating you can't leave your bowls and chopsticks on the table for others to wash. Roommate B: Sorry, I'll go wash them right now. Roommate A: Hey, you really are obedient!

B4L03-1-37.chinese: 你搭飛機去美國的話，得確認行李有沒有超過五十磅，多了就得付錢了。
B4L03-1-37.pinyin: Nǐ dā fēijī qù Měiguó de huà, děi quèrèn xínglǐ yǒu méiyǒu chāoguò wǔshí bàng, duō le jiù děi fù qián le.
B4L03-1-37.english: If you take a plane to the US, you have to confirm whether your luggage exceeds fifty pounds; if it's over, you'll have to pay.

B4L03-1-38.chinese: 註了冊以後，新生要把相關證件各影印一份，交給學校。
B4L03-1-38.pinyin: Zhù le cè yǐhòu, xīnshēng yào bǎ xiāngguān zhèngjiàn gè yǐngyìn yī fèn, jiāo gěi xuéxiào.
B4L03-1-38.english: After registering, new students must photocopy one copy of each relevant document and submit them to the school.

B4L03-1-39.chinese: 那家工廠的設備及員工都嚴重缺乏，哪裡有辦法進一步發展？
B4L03-1-39.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng de shèbèi jí yuángōng dōu yánzhòng quēfá, nǎlǐ yǒu bànfǎ jìnyībù fāzhǎn?
B4L03-1-39.english: That factory is severely lacking in both equipment and employees; how could there be any way to develop further?

B4L03-1-40.chinese: 臺灣的超商有店到店的送貨服務，不但速度快，運費也不貴。
B4L03-1-40.pinyin: Táiwān de chāoshāng yǒu diàn dào diàn de sònghuò fúwù, bùdàn sùdù kuài, yùnfèi yě bù guì.
B4L03-1-40.english: Convenience stores in Taiwan offer store-to-store delivery service; not only is it fast, but the shipping fee is also inexpensive.

B4L03-1-41.chinese: 這幾箱書都是我念過的課本跟參考資料，打算送給育幼院的孩子。
B4L03-1-41.pinyin: Zhè jǐ xiāng shū dōu shì wǒ niàn guò de kèběn gēn cānkǎo zīliào, dǎsuàn sòng gěi yùyòuyuàn de háizi.
B4L03-1-41.english: These few boxes of books are all textbooks and reference materials I've studied; I plan to give them to the children at the orphanage.

B4L03-1-43.chinese: 過年時什麼都漲，連搭計程車的時候，車費都漲價了。
B4L03-1-43.pinyin: Guònián shí shénme dōu zhǎng, lián dā jìchéngchē de shíhou, chēfèi dōu zhǎngjià le.
B4L03-1-43.english: During Chinese New Year everything goes up in price; even when taking a taxi, the fare has increased.

B4L03-1-44.chinese: 百貨公司經常辦活動及送贈品，都是為了鼓勵客人多消費。
B4L03-1-44.pinyin: Bǎihuò gōngsī jīngcháng bàn huódòng jí sòng zèngpǐn, dōu shì wèile gǔlì kèrén duō xiāofèi.
B4L03-1-44.english: Department stores often hold events and give away free gifts, all to encourage customers to spend more.

B4L03-1-45.chinese: 小李離婚後才知道失去老婆很痛苦，不過後悔也來不及了。
B4L03-1-45.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ líhūn hòu cái zhīdào shīqù lǎopo hěn tòngkǔ, bùguò hòuhuǐ yě láibují le.
B4L03-1-45.english: Only after divorcing did Little Li realize that losing his wife is very painful, but it's too late to be regretful.

B4L03-1-46.chinese: 在臺灣，退火車票得早一點兒，越晚退的話，扣的錢也越多。
B4L03-1-46.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, tuì huǒchē piào děi zǎo yīdiǎnr, yuè wǎn tuì de huà, kòu de qián yě yuè duō.
B4L03-1-46.english: In Taiwan, you have to return train tickets early; the later you return them, the more money is deducted.

B4L03-1-47.chinese: 假如他不聽你的，颱風天堅持去爬山，發生意外也是他活該。
B4L03-1-47.pinyin: Jiǎrú tā bù tīng nǐ de, táifēng tiān jiānchí qù páshān, fāshēng yìwài yě shì tā huógāi.
B4L03-1-47.english: If he doesn't listen to you and insists on going mountain climbing on a typhoon day, if an accident happens, it serves him right.

B4L03-1-48.chinese: 別人對你有誤會的時候用不著生氣，解釋清楚就好。
B4L03-1-48.pinyin: Biérén duì nǐ yǒu wùhuì de shíhou yòngbuzháo shēngqì, jiěshì qīngchu jiù hǎo.
B4L03-1-48.english: When others misunderstand you, there's no need to get angry; just explain clearly.

B4L03-1-49.chinese: 這件事他就可以幫你了，你還用得著去別的地方請人嗎？
B4L03-1-49.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tā jiù kěyǐ bāng nǐ le, nǐ hái yòngdezháo qù bié de dìfāng qǐng rén ma?
B4L03-1-49.english: He can help you with this matter, so do you still need to go ask someone else elsewhere?

B4L03-1-50.chinese: 購物時不能只看包裝，品質才是最重要的。
B4L03-1-50.pinyin: Gòuwù shí bùnéng zhǐ kàn bāozhuāng, pǐnzhì cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
B4L03-1-50.english: When shopping, you can't just look at the packaging; quality is what's most important.

B4L03-1-51.chinese: 冷氣機裡的網子要常拆下來洗，不然可能吹出髒空氣。
B4L03-1-51.pinyin: Lěngqì jī lǐ de wǎngzi yào cháng chāi xiàlái xǐ, bùrán kěnéng chuī chū zāng kōngqì.
B4L03-1-51.english: The filter net in the air conditioner should often be taken apart and washed, otherwise it might blow out dirty air.

B4L03-1-52.chinese: 他的獎學金申請書因少了一份資料，已被學校退回。
B4L03-1-52.pinyin: Tā de jiǎngxuéjīn shēnqǐngshū yīn shǎo le yī fèn zīliào, yǐ bèi xuéxiào tuìhuí.
B4L03-1-52.english: His scholarship application was returned by the school because it was missing one document.

B4L03-2-01.chinese: 現代社會資訊很發達，一發生重要事情，立刻就上電視、上報了。
B4L03-2-01.pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì zīxùn hěn fādá, yī fāshēng zhòngyào shìqíng, lìkè jiù shàng diànshì, shàng bào le.
B4L03-2-01.english: In modern society, information is very developed; as soon as an important event happens, it immediately appears on TV and in the newspapers.

B4L03-2-02.chinese: 他愛亂花錢，三天下來，就把一個月的生活費花光了。
B4L03-2-02.pinyin: Tā ài luàn huā qián, sān tiān xiàlái, jiù bǎ yí ge yuè de shēnghuófèi huā guāng le.
B4L03-2-02.english: He loves to spend money recklessly; over three days, he spent his whole month's living expenses.

B4L03-2-03.chinese: 購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
B4L03-2-03.pinyin: Gòuwù wǎngzhàn huì bǎ chángjiàn de gòuwù wèntí jí chǔlǐ fāngshì fàng zài wǎngyè shàng, tígōng gěi gùkè cānkǎo.
B4L03-2-03.english: Shopping websites will put commonly seen shopping problems and how to handle them on their web pages, providing them for customers' reference.

B4L03-2-04.chinese: 這家店面的租金太高，所以一直租不出去。
B4L03-2-04.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànmiàn de zūjīn tài gāo, suǒyǐ yìzhí zū bù chūqù.
B4L03-2-04.english: The rent for this retail property is too high, so it has remained unrented.

B4L03-2-05.chinese: 做生意前得先算一下成本，划算才去做。
B4L03-2-05.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì qián děi xiān suàn yíxià chéngběn, huásuàn cái qù zuò.
B4L03-2-05.english: Before doing business, you must first calculate the costs; only do it if it's worth it.

B4L03-2-06.chinese: 相同的商品，每家商店給的折扣都不相同。
B4L03-2-06.pinyin: Xiāngtóng de shāngpǐn, měi jiā shāngdiàn gěi de zhékòu dōu bù xiāngtóng.
B4L03-2-06.english: For the same product, the discount each store offers is different.

B4L03-2-07.chinese: 拿到購物收據，要是發現算錯帳了，就請店員再算一次。
B4L03-2-07.pinyin: Ná dào gòuwù shōujù, yàoshi fāxiàn suàn cuò zhàng le, jiù qǐng diànyuán zài suàn yí cì.
B4L03-2-07.english: When you get the shopping receipt, if you find that the bill has been calculated wrong, ask the clerk to calculate it again.

B4L03-2-08.chinese: 在學習新知識的過程中，總是會有開心與煩惱的時候。
B4L03-2-08.pinyin: Zài xuéxí xīn zhīshì de guòchéng zhōng, zǒngshì huì yǒu kāixīn yǔ fánnǎo de shíhou.
B4L03-2-08.english: In the process of learning new knowledge, there will always be times of happiness and worry.

B4L03-2-09.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
B4L03-2-09.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
B4L03-2-09.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

B4L03-2-10.chinese: 根據車禍調查的結果，保險公司及對方應各賠我十萬元。
B4L03-2-10.pinyin: Gēnjù chēhuò diàochá de jiéguǒ, bǎoxiǎn gōngsī jí duìfāng yīng gè péi wǒ shí wàn yuán.
B4L03-2-10.english: According to the results of the car accident investigation, the insurance company and the other party should each compensate me one hundred thousand dollars.

B4L03-2-11.chinese: 要是你想建議公司採購新設備，可以上網填採購單。
B4L03-2-11.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng jiànyì gōngsī cǎigòu xīn shèbèi, kěyǐ shàngwǎng tián cǎigòu dān.
B4L03-2-11.english: If you want to suggest that the company purchase new equipment, you can fill out a purchase form online.

B4L03-2-12.chinese: 這次颱風可能帶來大量雨水，地形較低的地區應該多注意。
B4L03-2-12.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng kěnéng dàilái dàliàng yǔshuǐ, dìxíng jiào dī de dìqū yīnggāi duō zhùyì.
B4L03-2-12.english: This typhoon may bring a great amount of rain, so areas with lower terrain should pay more attention.

B4L03-2-13.chinese: 他昨天在酒吧的花費，比我一個月的生活費還高。
B4L03-2-13.pinyin: Tā zuótiān zài jiǔbā de huāfèi, bǐ wǒ yí ge yuè de shēnghuófèi hái gāo.
B4L03-2-13.english: His expenses at the bar yesterday were even higher than my living expenses for a month.

B4L03-2-14.chinese: 他每次出國，都會幫朋友代購許多具有當地特色的商品。
B4L03-2-14.pinyin: Tā měi cì chūguó, dōu huì bāng péngyǒu dàigòu xǔduō jùyǒu dāngdì tèsè de shāngpǐn.
B4L03-2-14.english: Every time he goes abroad, he buys on behalf of friends many products with local characteristics.

B4L03-2-16.chinese: 過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
B4L03-2-16.pinyin: Guònián shí, zhùmíng diǎnxīn diàn dōu huì shōudào dàliàng de dìngdān, shènzhì yǒu gùkè zài bàn nián qián jiù xià dìngdān le.
B4L03-2-16.english: During Chinese New Year, famous pastry shops receive a large number of orders; some customers even place orders half a year in advance.

B4L03-2-17.chinese: 小王對農業很有興趣，家裡的倉庫擺滿了種田用的工具。
B4L03-2-17.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng duì nóngyè hěn yǒu xìngqù, jiālǐ de cāngkù bǎi mǎn le zhòngtián yòng de gōngjù.
B4L03-2-17.english: Xiao Wang is very interested in agriculture; the warehouse at home is filled with tools for farming.

B4L03-2-18.chinese: 過海關時，請配合相關人員檢查行李。
B4L03-2-18.pinyin: Guò hǎiguān shí, qǐng pèihé xiāngguān rényuán jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
B4L03-2-18.english: When going through customs, please cooperate with the relevant personnel in inspecting your luggage.

B4L03-2-19.chinese: 顧客付了錢，賣家也交了貨，這樣子交易才算完成。
B4L03-2-19.pinyin: Gùkè fù le qián, màijiā yě jiāo le huò, zhèyàngzi jiāoyì cái suàn wánchéng.
B4L03-2-19.english: The customer has paid, and the seller has delivered the goods; only then is the transaction considered complete.

B4L03-2-20.chinese: 那位畫家的作品，很多國內外的買家都十分感興趣。
B4L03-2-20.pinyin: Nà wèi huàjiā de zuòpǐn, hěn duō guónèi wài de mǎijiā dōu shífēn gǎn xìngqù.
B4L03-2-20.english: Many buyers, both domestic and foreign, are very interested in that painter's works.

B4L03-2-21.chinese: 在臺灣，上網訂好火車票後，可選擇到車站或便利商店取票。
B4L03-2-21.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, shàngwǎng dìng hǎo huǒchē piào hòu, kě xuǎnzé dào chēzhàn huò biànlì shāngdiàn qǔ piào.
B4L03-2-21.english: In Taiwan, after booking train tickets online, you can choose to pick up the tickets at the station or at a convenience store.

B4L03-2-22.chinese: 你把廣告設計得那麼小，這樣的宣傳怎麼有效果呢？
B4L03-2-22.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ guǎnggào shèjì de nàme xiǎo, zhèyàng de xuānchuán zěnme huì yǒu xiàoguǒ ne?
B4L03-2-22.english: You designed the advertisement so small; how could such promotion be effective?

B4L03-2-23.chinese: 他利用發傳單的方式來宣傳自己新開的餐廳。
B4L03-2-23.pinyin: Tā lìyòng fā chuándān de fāngshì lái xuānchuán zìjǐ xīn kāi de cāntīng.
B4L03-2-23.english: He uses the method of handing out fliers to promote his newly opened restaurant.

B4L03-2-24.chinese: 他個性獨立，加上做事總是很細心，因此老闆很欣賞他。
B4L03-2-24.pinyin: Tā gèxìng dúlì, jiāshàng zuòshì zǒngshì hěn xìxīn, yīncǐ lǎobǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
B4L03-2-24.english: He has an independent personality; on top of that, he is always very careful in doing things, so the boss appreciates him very much.

B4L03-2-25.chinese: 青少年期的心理變化相當大，需要父母及老師多關心。
B4L03-2-25.pinyin: Qīngshàonián qī de xīnlǐ biànhuà xiāngdāng dà, xūyào fùmǔ jí lǎoshī duō guānxīn.
B4L03-2-25.english: During the adolescent period, psychological changes are quite large, and parents and teachers need to care more.

B4L03-2-26.chinese: 會賺錢雖然重要，可是有的人認為會存錢、不亂花錢更重要。
B4L03-2-26.pinyin: Huì zhuànqián suīrán zhòngyào, kěshì yǒude rén rènwéi huì cúnqián, bú luàn huāqián gèng zhòngyào.
B4L03-2-26.english: Although being able to earn money is important, some people think that being able to save money and not spend it recklessly is even more important.

B4L04-1-01.chinese: 跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
B4L04-1-01.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yǐn jiǔ shì yí jiàn kāixīn de shì, búguò yǐn jiǔ guòdù què kěnéng shānghài shēntǐ.
B4L04-1-01.english: Drinking alcohol with friends is a happy thing, but excessive drinking may harm your health.

B4L04-1-02.chinese: 他今天忙得不得了，連喝一口水的時間都沒有。
B4L04-1-02.pinyin: Tā jīntiān máng de bùdéliǎo, lián hē yī kǒu shuǐ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
B4L04-1-02.english: He is incredibly busy today; he doesn't even have time for a single mouthful of water.

B4L04-1-03.chinese: A:喲，你今天怎麼穿得這麼帥？ B:下午要參加公司茶會，得穿得正式一些？ A:那下次跟我約會時，也要這麼穿呦！
B4L04-1-03.pinyin: A: Yō, nǐ jīntiān zěnme chuān de zhème shuài? B: Xiàwǔ yào cānjiā gōngsī cháhuì, děi chuān de zhèngshì yīxiē? A: Nà xià cì gēn wǒ yuēhuì shí, yě yào zhème chuān yo!
B4L04-1-03.english: A: Oh! How come you're dressed so handsome today? B: I have to attend the company tea party this afternoon, so I need to dress a bit formally? A: Then next time you go on a date with me, you should dress like this too!

B4L04-1-04.chinese: 他願意挑戰自己的工作能力，並積極地克服挫折，真是難得。
B4L04-1-04.pinyin: Tā yuànyì tiǎozhàn zìjǐ de gōngzuò nénglì, bìng jījí de kèfú cuòzhé, zhēn shì nándé.
B4L04-1-04.english: He is willing to challenge his own work abilities and actively overcome setbacks; that is truly rare.

B4L04-1-05.chinese: 在交通不方便的地區上班，得一大早就出門才行。
B4L04-1-05.pinyin: Zài jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn de dìqū shàngbān, děi yīdàzǎo jiù chūmén cái xíng.
B4L04-1-05.english: To work in an area with inconvenient transportation, you have to leave early in the morning.

B4L04-1-06.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
B4L04-1-06.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ tiáojiàn hǎo de dìqū, bùdàn nóngchǎnpǐn zhǒnglèi jiào duō, jiàgé yě piányi.
B4L04-1-06.english: In areas with good geographical conditions, not only are there more types of agricultural produce, but the prices are also cheaper.

B4L04-1-07.chinese: 這種麵不必煮，只要倒進熱水、泡幾分鐘，就可以吃了。
B4L04-1-07.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng miàn bùbì zhǔ, zhǐyào dào jìn rèshuǐ, pào jǐ fēnzhōng, jiù kěyǐ chī le.
B4L04-1-07.english: This kind of noodles doesn't need to be boiled; just pour hot water over them, let them brew for a few minutes, and they're ready to eat.

B4L04-1-08.chinese: 公司辦公室裡有咖啡機，隨時想煮一壺熱咖啡都很方便。
B4L04-1-08.pinyin: Gōngsī bàngōngshì lǐ yǒu kāfēijī, suíshí xiǎng zhǔ yī hú rè kāfēi dōu hěn fāngbiàn.
B4L04-1-08.english: There is a coffee machine in the company office; whenever you want to brew a pot of hot coffee, it's very convenient.

B4L04-1-09.chinese: 想要泡出一壺好茶或是一杯好咖啡，都是需要功夫的。
B4L04-1-09.pinyin: Xiǎngyào pào chū yī hú hǎo chá huòshì yī bēi hǎo kāfēi, dōu shì xūyào gōngfu de.
B4L04-1-09.english: To brew a good pot of tea or a good cup of coffee, both require effort.

B4L04-1-10.chinese: 利用暑期打工不只可以賺點兒零用錢，還可以增加工作經驗。
B4L04-1-10.pinyin: Lìyòng shǔqī dǎgōng bùzhǐ kěyǐ zhuàn diǎnr língyòngqián, hái kěyǐ zēngjiā gōngzuò jīngyàn.
B4L04-1-10.english: Taking a summer job during the summer vacation not only earns you some pocket money but also increases your work experience.

B4L04-1-11.chinese: 每年大學迎新時，學校總是會辦舞會歡迎大家。
B4L04-1-11.pinyin: Měi nián dàxué yíngxīn shí, xuéxiào zǒngshì huì bàn wǔhuì huānyíng dàjiā.
B4L04-1-11.english: Every year during the university orientation, the school always holds a dance to welcome everyone.

B4L04-1-12.chinese: 這次茶會主要是為了招待客戶，同時透過這個茶會來發表公司的新產品。
B4L04-1-12.pinyin: Zhè cì cháhuì zhǔyào shì wèile zhāodài kèhù, tóngshí tòuguò zhège cháhuì lái fābiǎo gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn.
B4L04-1-12.english: This tea party is mainly to entertain clients, and at the same time, through this tea party, to launch the company's new products.

B4L04-1-13.chinese: 警察亮出證件，叫那個正在吸毒的人乖乖把毒品交出來。
B4L04-1-13.pinyin: Jǐngchá liàng chū zhèngjiàn, jiào nàge zhèngzài xīdú de rén guāiguāi bǎ dúpǐn jiāo chūlái.
B4L04-1-13.english: The police officer showed his ID and told the person who was taking drugs to obediently hand over the drugs.

B4L04-1-14.chinese: 那個廚師很有一手，能用一條魚做出五道菜。
B4L04-1-14.pinyin: Nàge chúshī hěn yǒu yīshǒu, néng yòng yī tiáo yú zuò chū wǔ dào cài.
B4L04-1-14.english: That chef is very skilled; he can make five dishes from one fish.

B4L04-1-15.chinese: 茶食就是喝茶時配著吃的點心、小吃。「茶點」的意思有三種，包含：「茶食」、「茶和點心」、「用茶做的點心」。
B4L04-1-15.pinyin: Cháshí jiùshì hē chá shí pèi zhe chī de diǎnxīn, xiǎochī. “Chádiǎn” de yìsi yǒu sān zhǒng, bāohán: “cháshí”, “chá hé diǎnxīn”, “yòng chá zuò de diǎnxīn”.
B4L04-1-15.english: Tea snacks are the dim sum and small eats that accompany tea when drinking. The term “tea snacks” has three meanings, including: “tea snacks,” “tea and dim sum,” and “dim sum made with tea.”

B4L04-1-16.chinese: 太太：要是你閒著沒事，就幫我泡一壺熱茶吧。先生：我哪裡閒？我馬上要開雲端會議了，可是忙得很呢！
B4L04-1-16.pinyin: Tàitai: Yàoshi nǐ xián zhe méishì, jiù bāng wǒ pào yī hú rè chá ba. Xiānsheng: Wǒ nǎlǐ xián? Wǒ mǎshàng yào kāi yúnduān huìyì le, kěshì máng de hěn ne!
B4L04-1-16.english: Wife: If you're idle with nothing to do, then help me brew a pot of hot tea. Husband: How am I idle? I'm about to start a cloud meeting; I'm really busy!

B4L04-1-18.chinese: 茶樹的葉子沒有被破壞的話，做出來的茶葉品質都比較好。
B4L04-1-18.pinyin: Cháshù de yèzi méiyǒu bèi pòhuài de huà, zuò chūlái de cháyè pǐnzhì dōu bǐjiào hǎo.
B4L04-1-18.english: If the leaves of the tea tree have not been damaged, the quality of the tea leaves produced is generally better.

B4L04-1-19.chinese: 我們不能因為自來水很方便，就不愛惜水資源。
B4L04-1-19.pinyin: Wǒmen bùnéng yīnwèi zìláishuǐ hěn fāngbiàn, jiù bù àixī shuǐ zīyuán.
B4L04-1-19.english: We shouldn't fail to cherish water resources just because tap water is very convenient.

B4L04-1-20.chinese: 那件名牌長裙才兩千元而已，用不著跟老闆殺價。
B4L04-1-20.pinyin: Nà jiàn míngpái chángqún cái liǎngqiān yuán éryǐ, yòngbuzháo gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
B4L04-1-20.english: That brand-name long skirt is only two thousand yuan, that's all; there's no need to haggle with the shopkeeper.

B4L04-1-21.chinese: 同事搬新家，我們送他一組茶具，恭喜他吧。
B4L04-1-21.pinyin: Tóngshì bān xīn jiā, wǒmen sòng tā yī zǔ chájù, gōngxǐ tā ba.
B4L04-1-21.english: A colleague is moving to a new home; let's give him a tea set to congratulate him.

B4L04-1-22.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很厲害，一隻手能端好幾個盤子。
B4L04-1-22.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn lìhài, yī zhī shǒu néng duān hǎo jǐ gè pánzi.
B4L04-1-22.english: The waiter at that restaurant is very impressive; he can hold several plates level with one hand.

B4L04-1-23.chinese: 火鍋(hotpot)剛煮好時很燙，吃的時候小心點兒。
B4L04-1-23.pinyin: Huǒguō gāng zhǔ hǎo shí hěn tàng, chī de shíhou xiǎoxīn diǎnr.
B4L04-1-23.english: Hotpot is scalding hot when it's just cooked, so be careful when eating it.

B4L04-1-24.chinese: 文化中心跟大學合辦了一場音樂會，吸引不少民眾參加。
B4L04-1-24.pinyin: Wénhuà zhōngxīn gēn dàxué hé bàn le yī chǎng yīnyuèhuì, xīyǐn bùshǎo mínzhòng cānjiā.
B4L04-1-24.english: The cultural center and the university jointly held a concert, attracting many people to attend.

B4L04-1-26.chinese: 我姑姑的房間裡有淡淡的玫瑰花味兒，那種氣味真香。
B4L04-1-26.pinyin: Wǒ gūgu de fángjiān lǐ yǒu dàndàn de méiguīhuā wèir, nà zhǒng qìwèi zhēn xiāng.
B4L04-1-26.english: There is a faint rose scent in my aunt's room; that smell is really fragrant.

B4L04-1-27.chinese: 這道菜是用新鮮蔬果做的，不僅味道甘甜，對健康也有好處。
B4L04-1-27.pinyin: Zhè dào cài shì yòng xīnxiān shūguǒ zuò de, bùjǐn wèidào gāntián, duì jiànkāng yě yǒu hǎochù.
B4L04-1-27.english: This dish is made with fresh vegetables and fruits; not only does it taste sweet, but it is also good for your health.

B4L04-1-28.chinese: 我跟朋友手機的式樣很接近，難怪我們常常拿錯。
B4L04-1-28.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyǒu shǒujī de shìyàng hěn jiējìn, nánguài wǒmen chángcháng ná cuò.
B4L04-1-28.english: My friend's and my cell phones are very similar in style; no wonder we often take the wrong one.

B4L04-1-29.chinese: 醫生告訴我，喝這瓶藥前得先搖一搖。
B4L04-1-29.pinyin: Yīshēng gàosù wǒ, hē zhè píng yào qián děi xiān yáo yī yáo.
B4L04-1-29.english: The doctor told me that before drinking this bottle of medicine, I must first shake it.

B4L04-1-30.chinese: 他們在露營活動中現學現唱了八首歌，真是了不起。
B4L04-1-30.pinyin: Tāmen zài lùyíng huódòng zhōng xiàn xué xiàn chàng le bā shǒu gē, zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
B4L04-1-30.english: At the camping activity, they learned and sang eight songs on the spot; that's really amazing.

B4L04-1-31.chinese: 很濃的茶跟很濃的咖啡一樣，都會讓人睡不著覺。
B4L04-1-31.pinyin: Hěn nóng de chá gēn hěn nóng de kāfēi yīyàng, dōu huì ràng rén shuì bù zháo jiào.
B4L04-1-31.english: Strong tea, like strong coffee, will keep people from sleeping.

B4L04-1-32.chinese: 我考慮接受公司的安排，到國外協助市場調查工作。
B4L04-1-32.pinyin: Wǒ kǎolǜ jiēshòu gōngsī de ānpái, dào guówài xiézhù shìchǎng diàochá gōngzuò.
B4L04-1-32.english: I am considering accepting the company's arrangement to go abroad to assist with market research work.

B4L04-1-33.chinese: 鮮奶是做冰淇淋、甜點不可少的東西。
B4L04-1-33.pinyin: Xiānnǎi shì zuò bīngqílín, tiándiǎn bùkě shǎo de dōngxi.
B4L04-1-33.english: Fresh milk is an indispensable thing for making ice cream and desserts.

B4L04-1-34.chinese: 這是我剛買回來的魚，吃起來又鮮又甜。
B4L04-1-34.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ gāng mǎi huílái de yú, chī qǐlái yòu xiān yòu tián.
B4L04-1-34.english: This is the fish I just bought; it tastes both fresh and sweet.

B4L04-1-35.chinese: 臺灣的年輕人愛喝咖啡，因此很多地方都是咖啡店比茶館多。
B4L04-1-35.pinyin: Táiwān de niánqīngrén ài hē kāfēi, yīncǐ hěn duō dìfāng dōu shì kāfēidiàn bǐ cháguǎn duō.
B4L04-1-35.english: Young people in Taiwan love to drink coffee, so in many places there are more coffee shops than teahouses.

B4L04-1-36.chinese: 我爺爺習慣吃中式早餐，每天早上都是吃包子配豆漿。
B4L04-1-36.pinyin: Wǒ yéye xíguàn chī zhōngshì zǎocān, měitiān zǎoshang dōu shì chī bāozi pèi dòujiāng.
B4L04-1-36.english: My grandfather is used to eating a Chinese-style breakfast; every morning he has steamed buns with soy milk.

B4L04-1-37.chinese: 這家民宿提供西式、中式兩種早餐，既豐富又好吃。
B4L04-1-37.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù tígōng xīshì, zhōngshì liǎng zhǒng zǎocān, jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī.
B4L04-1-37.english: This bed and breakfast offers both Western-style and Chinese-style breakfasts, which are both rich and delicious.

B4L04-1-38.chinese: 臺灣人常用花生、紅豆做傳統點心。
B4L04-1-38.pinyin: Táiwānrén cháng yòng huāshēng, hóngdòu zuò chuántǒng diǎnxīn.
B4L04-1-38.english: Taiwanese people often use peanuts and red beans to make traditional snacks.

B4L04-1-39.chinese: 中國人看傳統戲劇時都喜歡準備一盤瓜子，邊吃邊欣賞。
B4L04-1-39.pinyin: Zhōngguórén kàn chuántǒng xìjù shí dōu xǐhuān zhǔnbèi yī pán guāzǐ, biān chī biān xīnshǎng.
B4L04-1-39.english: When Chinese people watch traditional opera, they all like to prepare a plate of melon seeds and enjoy them while watching.

B4L04-1-40.chinese: 我種了一些瓜，賣了五分之四，剩下的就全送人了。
B4L04-1-40.pinyin: Wǒ zhòng le yīxiē guā, mài le wǔ fēn zhī sì, shèngxià de jiù quán sòng rén le.
B4L04-1-40.english: I grew some melons and sold four-fifths of them; the rest I gave all away.

B4L04-1-41.chinese: 在歐洲，小麥做的各種食品常被當作餐桌上的主要食物。
B4L04-1-41.pinyin: Zài Ōuzhōu, xiǎomài zuò de gè zhǒng shípǐn cháng bèi dàngzuò cānzhuō shàng de zhǔyào shíwù.
B4L04-1-41.english: In Europe, various foods made from wheat are often regarded as the main food on the dining table.

B4L04-1-42.chinese: 不少人利用新年期間到國外旅行，國內過年的氣氛就越來越淡了。
B4L04-1-42.pinyin: Bù shǎo rén lìyòng xīnnián qījiān dào guówài lǚxíng, guónèi guònián de qìfēn jiù yuèláiyuè dàn le.
B4L04-1-42.english: Many people take advantage of the New Year period to travel abroad, so the atmosphere of celebrating the New Year domestically is becoming weaker and weaker.

B4L04-1-43.chinese: 購物是一種享受，超過個人需求的消費，卻只會帶來煩惱。
B4L04-1-43.pinyin: Gòuwù shì yī zhǒng xiǎngshòu, chāoguò gèrén xūqiú de xiāofèi, què zhǐ huì dàilái fánnǎo.
B4L04-1-43.english: Shopping is a kind of enjoyment, but spending that exceeds personal needs only brings worries.

B4L04-1-44.chinese: 姊姊覺得木頭地板很麻煩，因為得跪著擦才擦得乾淨。
B4L04-1-44.pinyin: Jiějie juéde mùtou dìbǎn hěn máfan, yīnwèi děi guì zhe cā cái cā de gānjìng.
B4L04-1-44.english: My older sister thinks wooden floors are troublesome because you have to kneel to wipe them to get them clean.

B4L04-1-45.chinese: 當周圍環境很靜的時候，可以聽見平常聽不到的聲音。
B4L04-1-45.pinyin: Dāng zhōuwéi huánjìng hěn jìng de shíhou, kěyǐ tīngjiàn píngcháng tīng bù dào de shēngyīn.
B4L04-1-45.english: When the surrounding environment is very quiet, you can hear sounds that you normally cannot hear.

B4L04-1-46.chinese: 談戀愛時不能太花心，(也)就是說不能見一個就愛一個。
B4L04-1-46.pinyin: Tán liàn'ài shí bùnéng tài huāxīn, (yě) jiùshì shuō bùnéng jiàn yī gè jiù ài yī gè.
B4L04-1-46.english: When dating, you shouldn't be too fickle; in other words, you can't fall in love with every person you meet.

B4L04-1-47.chinese: 公司的午餐時間很短，因此同事們總是吃得很趕。
B4L04-1-47.pinyin: Gōngsī de wǔcān shíjiān hěn duǎn, yīncǐ tóngshìmen zǒngshì chī de hěn gǎn.
B4L04-1-47.english: The company's lunch break is very short, so colleagues always eat in a hurry.

B4L04-1-48.chinese: 我很怕熱，不過天氣太冷的時候，也不得不開暖氣。
B4L04-1-48.pinyin: Wǒ hěn pà rè, bùguò tiānqì tài lěng de shíhou, yě bùdébù kāi nuǎnqì.
B4L04-1-48.english: I am very afraid of heat, but when the weather is too cold, I have no choice but to turn on the heater.

B4L04-1-49.chinese: 在冬天，臺灣南部比北部暖和，你可以到南部享受暖暖的陽光。
B4L04-1-49.pinyin: Zài dōngtiān, Táiwān nánbù bǐ běibù nuǎnhuo, nǐ kěyǐ dào nánbù xiǎngshòu nuǎnnuǎn de yángguāng.
B4L04-1-49.english: In winter, southern Taiwan is warmer than the north; you can go to the south to enjoy the warm sunshine.

B4L04-1-50.chinese: 今天氣溫只有零下(below zero)三度，我家沒暖氣，不管穿多厚的衣服，全身還是冰冰的。
B4L04-1-50.pinyin: Jīntiān qìwēn zhǐyǒu língxià sān dù, wǒ jiā méi nuǎnqì, bùguǎn chuān duō hòu de yīfu, quánshēn háishì bīngbīng de.
B4L04-1-50.english: Today the temperature is only three degrees below zero. My home has no heater, and no matter how thick the clothes I wear, my whole body still feels icy cold.

B4L04-1-51.chinese: 世界上再困難的問題，不管早或晚都會有聰明的人解開的。
B4L04-1-51.pinyin: Shìjiè shàng zài kùnnán de wèntí, bùguǎn zǎo huò wǎn dōu huì yǒu cōngmíng de rén jiě kāi de.
B4L04-1-51.english: No matter how difficult a problem in the world is, sooner or later there will be a smart person to solve it.

B4L04-1-53.chinese: 有一些中式餐廳的桌上會擺一壺茶，要式客人覺得菜太油，就能喝口茶，解解嘴裡油膩的味道。
B4L04-1-53.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē zhōngshì cāntīng de zhuō shàng huì bǎi yī hú chá, yào shì kèrén juéde cài tài yóu, jiù néng hē kǒu chá, jiě jiě zuǐ lǐ yóunì de wèidào.
B4L04-1-53.english: Some Chinese restaurants place a pot of tea on the table; if guests feel the food is too oily, they can take a sip of tea to reduce the greasy taste in their mouths.

B4L04-1-54.chinese: 雖然新租的房子空間不大，環境倒挺乾淨的。
B4L04-1-54.pinyin: Suīrán xīn zū de fángzi kōngjiān bù dà, huánjìng dào tǐng gānjìng de.
B4L04-1-54.english: Although the newly rented house is not spacious, the environment is actually quite clean.

B4L04-1-55.chinese: 身體不舒服時，就應該吃對身體負擔較小、容易消化的食物。
B4L04-1-55.pinyin: Shēntǐ bù shūfu shí, jiù yīnggāi chī duì shēntǐ fùdān jiào xiǎo, róngyì xiāohuà de shíwù.
B4L04-1-55.english: When you feel unwell, you should eat food that is less of a burden on the body and easy to digest.

B4L04-2-01.chinese: 這家便利商店現在有「咖啡、茶飲買一送一」的優惠活動。
B4L04-2-01.pinyin: Zhè jiā biànlì shāngdiàn xiànzài yǒu “kāfēi, cháyǐn mǎi yī sòng yī” de yōuhuì huódòng.
B4L04-2-01.english: This convenience store now has a “buy one get one free” promotion on coffee and tea drinks.

B4L04-2-02.chinese: 我們國家出口的農產品很有名，不但價格低，品質又好。
B4L04-2-02.pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā chūkǒu de nóngchǎnpǐn hěn yǒumíng, bùdàn jiàgé dī, pǐnzhì yòu hǎo.
B4L04-2-02.english: The agricultural products our country exports are very famous; not only is the price low, but the quality is also good.

B4L04-2-03.chinese: 這裡的資源不多，大部分的石油得從國外進口。
B4L04-2-03.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de zīyuán bù duō, dà bùfèn de shíyóu děi cóng guówài jìnkǒu.
B4L04-2-03.english: There are not many resources here; most of the oil has to be imported from abroad.

B4L04-2-05.chinese: 我的家鄉出產小麥、葡萄，可是不產茶。
B4L04-2-05.pinyin: Wǒ de jiāxiāng chūchǎn xiǎomài, pútao, kěshì bù chǎn chá.
