B4L04-2-05.english: My hometown produces wheat and grapes, but it does not produce tea.

B4L04-2-06.chinese: 我來臺灣，算起來才三個月而已，卻已去過十幾家茶館了。
B4L04-2-06.pinyin: Wǒ lái Táiwān, suàn qǐlái cái sān ge yuè éryǐ, què yǐ qùguo shí jǐ jiā cháguǎn le.
B4L04-2-06.english: In total, it has only been three months since I came to Taiwan, yet I have already been to more than ten tea houses.

B4L04-2-07.chinese: 到別人家做客時不能太隨便，以免發生不愉快的事。
B4L04-2-07.pinyin: Dào biérén jiā zuòkè shí bù néng tài suíbiàn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng bù yúkuài de shì.
B4L04-2-07.english: When you are a guest at someone else’s home, you must not be too casual, so as to avoid unpleasant things happening.

B4L04-2-08.chinese: 上個星期我去鄉下旅行，當地人非常好客。
B4L04-2-08.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ qù xiāngxià lǚxíng, dāngdìrén fēicháng hàokè.
B4L04-2-08.english: Last week I traveled to the countryside; the local people were very hospitable.

B4L04-2-09.chinese: 在這個地區，山地是最主要的地形，因此人口較少。
B4L04-2-09.pinyin: Zài zhège dìqū, shāndì shì zuì zhǔyào de dìxíng, yīncǐ rénkǒu jiào shǎo.
B4L04-2-09.english: In this region, mountainous terrain is the most dominant landform; therefore, the population is relatively small.

B4L04-2-10.chinese: 假如缺乏陽光、空氣和水這三項條件，植物就無法生長。
B4L04-2-10.pinyin: Jiǎrú quēfá yángguāng, kōngqì hé shuǐ zhè sān xiàng tiáojiàn, zhíwù jiù wúfǎ shēngzhǎng.
B4L04-2-10.english: If plants lack the three conditions of sunlight, air, and water, they cannot grow.

B4L04-2-11.chinese: 地球氣溫越來越高，世界各地氣候的變化也越來越明顯。
B4L04-2-11.pinyin: Dìqiú qìwēn yuè lái yuè gāo, shìjiè gèdì qìhòu de biànhuà yě yuè lái yuè míngxiǎn.
B4L04-2-11.english: The Earth’s temperature is getting higher and higher, and climate changes around the world are also becoming more and more obvious.

B4L04-2-12.chinese: 這個山區種了許多茶樹，到了收穫季節，就會有一群採茶姑娘上山採茶。
B4L04-2-12.pinyin: Zhège shānqū zhòng le xǔduō cháshù, dào le shōuhuò jìjié, jiù huì yǒu yī qún cǎi chá gūniang shàngshān cǎi chá.
B4L04-2-12.english: Many tea trees are planted in this mountainous area; when the harvest season comes, a group of tea-picking girls will go up the mountain to pick tea.

B4L04-2-13.chinese: 這種植物的葉子尖尖的，流出來的汁又臭又黏，觀察時要小心。
B4L04-2-13.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de yèzi jiān jiān de, liú chūlái de zhī yòu chòu yòu nián, guānchá shí yào xiǎoxīn.
B4L04-2-13.english: The leaves of this plant are pointy, and the sap that flows out is both smelly and sticky; be careful when observing it.

B4L04-2-14.chinese: 他沖咖啡的技術很好，香味總是比別人沖的濃。
B4L04-2-14.pinyin: Tā chōng kāfēi de jìshù hěn hǎo, xiāngwèi zǒngshì bǐ biérén chōng de nóng.
B4L04-2-14.english: His coffee-brewing technique is very good; the aroma is always stronger than that of coffee brewed by others.

B4L04-2-15.chinese: 每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
B4L04-2-15.pinyin: Měi ge shídài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de jiàzhí biāozhǔn, shèhuì xísú jí shēnghuó guījǔ yě cháng suízhe shídài gǎibiàn.
B4L04-2-15.english: Every era has its own value standards, and social customs and life rules also often change with the times.

B4L04-2-16.chinese: 華人送禮最重心意，以這種方式向收禮的人表達關心與祝福。
B4L04-2-16.pinyin: Huárén sònglǐ zuì zhòng xīnyì, yǐ zhè zhǒng fāngshì xiàng shōu lǐ de rén biǎodá guānxīn yǔ zhùfú.
B4L04-2-16.english: Chinese people place the greatest value on thoughtfulness when giving gifts, using this way to express care and blessings to the recipient.

B4L04-2-17.chinese: 廚師們都會好好保養他們的用具，以免影響做菜的品質。
B4L04-2-17.pinyin: Chúshīmen dōu huì hǎohǎo bǎoyǎng tāmen de yòngjù, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng zuò cài de pǐnzhì.
B4L04-2-17.english: Chefs all take good care of their utensils, so as to avoid affecting the quality of their cooking.

B4L04-2-18.chinese: 銀做的東西雖然漂亮，不過不好保養。
B4L04-2-18.pinyin: Yín zuò de dōngxi suīrán piàoliang, bùguò bù hǎo bǎoyǎng.
B4L04-2-18.english: Although things made of silver are beautiful, they are not easy to maintain.

B4L04-2-19.chinese: 那家商店不只賣日用品，另外也賣食品和文具。
B4L04-2-19.pinyin: Nà jiā shāngdiàn bùzhǐ mài rìyòngpǐn, lìngwài yě mài shípǐn hé wénjù.
B4L04-2-19.english: That store not only sells daily necessities; in addition, it also sells food and stationery.

B4L05-1-01.chinese: 資源回收不分你我他，一個人的回收是榜樣，一群人的回收是力量。
B4L05-1-01.pinyin: Zīyuán huíshōu bù fēn nǐ wǒ tā, yī ge rén de huíshōu shì bǎngyàng, yī qún rén de huíshōu shì lìliàng.
B4L05-1-01.english: Resource recycling does not distinguish between you, me, and others; one person’s recycling is an example, and a group of people’s recycling is power.

B4L05-1-02.chinese: 開早餐店很辛苦，大清早老闆就得起來準備。
B4L05-1-02.pinyin: Kāi zǎocāndiàn hěn xīnkǔ, dàqīngzǎo lǎobǎn jiù děi qǐlái zhǔnbèi.
B4L05-1-02.english: Running a breakfast shop is very hard; early in the morning, the owner has to get up to prepare.

B4L05-1-03.chinese: 在路上撿到錢包可以交給警察，請他們幫忙處理。
B4L05-1-03.pinyin: Zài lùshang jiǎn dào qiánbāo kěyǐ jiāo gěi jǐngchá, qǐng tāmen bāngmáng chǔlǐ.
B4L05-1-03.english: If you pick up a wallet on the street, you can hand it over to the police and ask them to help handle it.

B4L05-1-04.chinese: 這次颱風雨大風又強，大街上不少店家都關店休息。
B4L05-1-04.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǔ dà fēng yòu qiáng, dàjiē shang bùshǎo diànjiā dōu guān diàn xiūxi.
B4L05-1-04.english: This typhoon brought heavy rain and strong winds; on the main street, many shops closed to rest.

B4L05-1-05.chinese: 一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
B4L05-1-05.pinyin: Yī jiā cāntīng yàoshi shòu huānyíng, jiùsuàn bǎ diàn guān zài jiāoqū de mǒu ge xiǎo xiàngzi lǐ, yě háishì shícháng kèmǎn.
B4L05-1-05.english: If a restaurant is popular, even if it is tucked away in a small alley in the suburbs, it will still often be full of customers.

B4L05-1-06.chinese: 那位客人在地攤買東西揀來揀去，最後又不買，難怪老闆滿臉不高興的樣子。
B4L05-1-06.pinyin: Nà wèi kèrén zài dìtān mǎi dōngxi jiǎn lái jiǎn qù, zuìhòu yòu bù mǎi, nánguài lǎobǎn mǎn liǎn bù gāoxìng de yàngzi.
B4L05-1-06.english: That customer kept picking and choosing while shopping at the street stall, and in the end didn’t buy anything; no wonder the owner looked unhappy.

B4L05-1-07.chinese: A:你快點把衣服換好。還不出門，就趕不上飛機嘍？ B:好啦，我知道了。
B4L05-1-07.pinyin: A: Nǐ kuài diǎn bǎ yīfu huàn hǎo. Hái bù chūmén, jiù gǎn bù shàng fēijī lou? B: Hǎo la, wǒ zhīdào le.
B4L05-1-07.english: A: Hurry up and get changed. If you don't leave now, you won't catch the plane, you know? B: Okay, I got it.

B4L05-1-09.chinese: 食品罐頭吃完以後把罐子洗乾淨，就可以回收了。
B4L05-1-09.pinyin: Shípǐn guàntou chī wán yǐhòu bǎ guànzi xǐ gānjìng, jiù kěyǐ huíshōu le.
B4L05-1-09.english: After you finish eating canned food, wash the can clean, and then it can be recycled.

B4L05-1-10.chinese: 我採花的時候被刺了一下，不過還好不太痛。
B4L05-1-10.pinyin: Wǒ cǎi huā de shíhou bèi cì le yīxià, bùguò hái hǎo bù tài tòng.
B4L05-1-10.english: When I was picking flowers, I got pricked once, but fortunately it didn't hurt too much.

B4L05-1-11.chinese: 我昨天割草時沒戴帽子，整張臉都因為陽光太強而變紅了。
B4L05-1-11.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gē cǎo shí méi dài màozi, zhěng zhāng liǎn dōu yīnwèi yángguāng tài qiáng ér biàn hóng le.
B4L05-1-11.english: When I mowed the lawn yesterday, I didn't wear a hat, and my whole face turned red because the sunlight was too strong.

B4L05-1-12.chinese: 她做的籃子很漂亮，很多人買來當作禮物。
B4L05-1-12.pinyin: Tā zuò de lánzi hěn piàoliang, hěn duō rén mǎi lái dàngzuò lǐwù.
B4L05-1-12.english: The baskets she makes are very pretty; many people buy them as gifts.

B4L05-1-13.chinese: 部分國家規定，騎腳踏車時是不能載人的。
B4L05-1-13.pinyin: Bùfèn guójiā guīdìng, qí jiǎotàchē shí shì bù néng zài rén de.
B4L05-1-13.english: Some countries stipulate that when riding a bicycle, you cannot carry passengers.

B4L05-1-14.chinese: 我每天騎車上班前，總是習慣先檢查摩托車的輪子正不正常。
B4L05-1-14.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān qí chē shàngbān qián, zǒngshì xíguàn xiān jiǎnchá mótuōchē de lúnzi zhèng bù zhèngcháng.
B4L05-1-14.english: Before I ride my bike to work every day, I always habitually first check whether the motorcycle's tires are normal.

B4L05-1-15.chinese: 我每個月都會清一次冷氣，這樣比較省電，風也比較涼。
B4L05-1-15.pinyin: Wǒ měi gè yuè dōu huì qīng yī cì lěngqì, zhèyàng bǐjiào shěng diàn, fēng yě bǐjiào liáng.
B4L05-1-15.english: I clean the air conditioner once every month; this way it saves more electricity, and the air is cooler too.

B4L05-1-16.chinese: 他把我的手機壓壞了，我要他買一支賠我。
B4L05-1-16.pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ de shǒujī yā huài le, wǒ yào tā mǎi yī zhī péi wǒ.
B4L05-1-16.english: He pressed my phone and broke it; I want him to buy one to compensate me.

B4L05-1-17.chinese: 我喜歡玻璃做的杯子，用起來比較安心，看起來也很漂亮。
B4L05-1-17.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān bōli zuò de bēizi, yòng qǐlái bǐjiào ānxīn, kàn qǐlái yě hěn piàoliang.
B4L05-1-17.english: I like cups made of glass; they feel safer to use, and they look pretty too.

B4L05-1-18.chinese: 這間教室的門有問題，得用力才能打開。
B4L05-1-18.pinyin: Zhè jiān jiàoshì de mén yǒu wèntí, děi yònglì cái néng dǎkāi.
B4L05-1-18.english: The door of this classroom has a problem; you have to exert force to open it.

B4L05-1-19.chinese: 你放餅乾盒的時候輕一點兒，餅乾碎了就不好吃、不好拿了。
B4L05-1-19.pinyin: Nǐ fàng bǐnggān hé de shíhou qīng yīdiǎnr, bǐnggān suì le jiù bù hǎochī, bù hǎo ná le.
B4L05-1-19.english: When you put down the cookie box, be a bit gentler; if the cookies break into pieces, they won't taste good and won't be easy to pick up.

B4L05-1-20.chinese: 會議資料的分類不必太仔細，分得簡單清楚就行了。
B4L05-1-20.pinyin: Huìyì zīliào de fēnlèi bùbì tài zǐxì, fēn de jiǎndān qīngchu jiù xíng le.
B4L05-1-20.english: The classification of meeting materials doesn't need to be too detailed; as long as it's simple and clear, that's fine.

B4L05-1-21.chinese: 這個牌子的衛生紙打八折，很多人搶著購買。
B4L05-1-21.pinyin: Zhè ge páizi de wèishēngzhǐ dǎ bā zhé, hěn duō rén qiǎng zhe gòumǎi.
B4L05-1-21.english: This brand of toilet paper is 20% off; many people are rushing to buy it.

B4L05-1-22.chinese: 他在超市隨手買了瓶飲料，回家後才發現有效日期快到了，只好趕快喝完。
B4L05-1-22.pinyin: Tā zài chāoshì suíshǒu mǎi le píng yǐnliào, huí jiā hòu cái fāxiàn yǒuxiào rìqī kuài dào le, zhǐhǎo gǎnkuài hē wán.
B4L05-1-22.english: He conveniently bought a bottle of drink at the supermarket, and only after getting home did he discover that the expiration date was almost up, so he had no choice but to hurry and finish drinking it.

B4L05-1-23.chinese: 妹妹提了一個小桶水，很細心地幫爸爸擦櫃子。
B4L05-1-23.pinyin: Mèimei tí le yī gè xiǎo tǒng shuǐ, hěn xìxīn de bāng bàba cā guìzi.
B4L05-1-23.english: My younger sister carried a small bucket of water and carefully helped Dad wipe the cabinet.

B4L05-1-24.chinese: 他上課時偷偷出去拿了蛋糕進來，原來是要幫老師慶祝生日。
B4L05-1-24.pinyin: Tā shàngkè shí tōutōu chūqù ná le dàngāo jìnlái, yuánlái shì yào bāng lǎoshī qìngzhù shēngrì.
B4L05-1-24.english: During class, he secretly went out and brought a cake in; it turned out he was going to help celebrate the teacher's birthday.

B4L05-1-25.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
B4L05-1-25.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
B4L05-1-25.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

B4L05-1-26.chinese: 這家超商食品賣不完就丟掉的作法，不但白白浪費食物，回收處理的成本也增加了，長期下來十分浪費。
B4L05-1-26.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshāng shípǐn mài bù wán jiù diū diào de zuòfǎ, bùdàn báibái làngfèi shíwù, huíshōu chǔlǐ de chéngběn yě zēngjiā le, chángqī xiàlái shífēn làngfèi.
B4L05-1-26.english: This convenience store's practice of throwing away food that isn't sold out not only wastes food for nothing, but the cost of recycling processing also increases; over the long term, it is extremely wasteful.

B4L05-1-27.chinese: 電腦和手機要是不常擦的話，比馬桶還骯髒。
B4L05-1-27.pinyin: Diànnǎo hé shǒujī yàoshi bù cháng cā de huà, bǐ mǎtǒng hái āngzāng.
B4L05-1-27.english: If computers and cell phones aren't wiped often, they are dirtier than toilet bowls.

B4L05-1-28.chinese: 在路邊的攤子享受小吃，得注意他們處理食物的方式衛不衛生。
B4L05-1-28.pinyin: Zài lùbiān de tānzi xiǎngshòu xiǎochī, děi zhùyì tāmen chǔlǐ shíwù de fāngshì wèi bù wèishēng.
B4L05-1-28.english: When enjoying snacks at roadside stalls, you need to pay attention to whether their way of handling food is hygienic or not.

B4L05-1-29.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
B4L05-1-29.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
B4L05-1-29.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

B4L05-1-30.chinese: 人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
B4L05-1-30.pinyin: Rénlèi pòhuài le zìrán, jiù shì pòhuài le zìjǐ de shēnghuó huánjìng.
B4L05-1-30.english: When humans destroy nature, they are destroying their own living environment.

B4L05-1-31.chinese: 向圖書館借的書籍要是超過規定的時間沒還，可是要罰錢的。
B4L05-1-31.pinyin: Xiàng túshūguǎn jiè de shūjí yàoshi chāoguò guīdìng de shíjiān méi huán, kěshì yào fá qián de.
B4L05-1-31.english: If books borrowed from the library are not returned within the stipulated time, you will indeed be fined money.

B4L05-1-32.chinese: 一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
B4L05-1-32.pinyin: Yī gè guójiā guāng shì yīkào miǎnfèi qiānzhèng, shì wúfǎ xīyǐn guówài yóukè lái lǚxíng de.
B4L05-1-32.english: A country solely relying on free visas is unable to attract foreign tourists to travel.

B4L05-1-33.chinese: 上課光聽老師教是沒用的，還要親自練習幾遍。
B4L05-1-33.pinyin: Shàngkè guāng tīng lǎoshī jiāo shì méiyòng de, hái yào qīnzì liànxí jǐ biàn.
B4L05-1-33.english: In class, merely listening to the teacher teach is useless; you also need to practice it yourself several times.

B4L05-1-34.chinese: 台灣有句著名的廣告台詞「心動不如馬上行動」，意思是當個人有了想法之後，光是想是沒用的，得立刻行動才行。
B4L05-1-34.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu jù zhùmíng de guǎnggào táicí “xīndòng bùrú mǎshàng xíngdòng”, yìsi shì dāng gèrén yǒu le xiǎngfǎ zhīhòu, guāng shì xiǎng shì méiyòng de, děi lìkè xíngdòng cái xíng.
B4L05-1-34.english: Taiwan has a famous advertising slogan, “Acting immediately is better than just being moved.” It means that after a person has an idea, merely thinking about it is useless; one must take action immediately.

B4L05-1-36.chinese: 這班學生多數都會說法國話，其中有半數是從歐洲來的。
B4L05-1-36.pinyin: Zhè bān xuéshēng duōshù dōu huì shuō Fǎguóhuà, qízhōng yǒu bànshù shì cóng Ōuzhōu lái de.
B4L05-1-36.english: Most of the students in this class can speak French; half of them are from Europe.

B4L05-1-37.chinese: 這輛卡車有十二個輪子，大約能載二十五噸的物品。
B4L05-1-37.pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎchē yǒu shí'èr ge lúnzi, dàyuē néng zài èrshíwǔ dūn de wùpǐn.
B4L05-1-37.english: This truck has twelve wheels and can carry about twenty-five tons of goods.

B4L05-1-38.chinese: 對大多數人來說，沒有用的垃圾是廢物，有用的垃圾是資源。
B4L05-1-38.pinyin: Duì dàduōshù rén lái shuō, méiyǒu yòng de lājī shì fèiwù, yǒuyòng de lājī shì zīyuán.
B4L05-1-38.english: For most people, useless garbage is waste, and useful garbage is a resource.

B4L05-1-39.chinese: 家中的廢車可送到汽車修理工廠回收，多多少少能賣點錢。
B4L05-1-39.pinyin: Jiā zhōng de fèichē kě sòng dào qìchē xiūlǐ gōngchǎng huíshōu, duōduōshǎoshǎo néng mài diǎn qián.
B4L05-1-39.english: The derelict car at home can be sent to an auto repair shop for recycling; you can more or less sell it for some money.

B4L05-1-40.chinese: 奶奶把變黃的蔬菜葉子埋在地裡，讓它變成草地的營養。
B4L05-1-40.pinyin: Nǎinai bǎ biàn huáng de shūcài yèzi mái zài dì lǐ, ràng tā biànchéng cǎodì de yíngyǎng.
B4L05-1-40.english: Grandma buried the yellowed vegetable leaves in the ground, letting them become nutrition for the lawn.

B4L05-1-41.chinese: 露營最開心的就是當營火(campfire)燃燒時，大家在營火周圍又唱又跳。
B4L05-1-41.pinyin: Lùyíng zuì kāixīn de jiùshì dāng yínghuǒ ránshāo shí, dàjiā zài yínghuǒ zhōuwéi yòu chàng yòu tiào.
B4L05-1-41.english: The happiest part of camping is when the campfire is burning, everyone sings and dances around the campfire.

B4L05-1-42.chinese: 完全按照別人的話來工作，是很省事沒錯，卻失去了讓自己進步的機會。
B4L05-1-42.pinyin: Wánquán ànzhào biérén de huà lái gōngzuò, shì hěn shěngshì méicuò, què shīqù le ràng zìjǐ jìnbù de jīhuì.
B4L05-1-42.english: Working completely according to others' words is indeed very trouble-saving, but it loses the opportunity to let yourself improve.

B4L05-1-43.chinese: 那位博士在本次會議中所提到的問題，值得我們進一步研究。
B4L05-1-43.pinyin: Nà wèi bóshì zài běn cì huìyì zhōng suǒ tí dào de wèntí, zhídé wǒmen jìnyībù yánjiū.
B4L05-1-43.english: The problems that that PhD mentioned in this conference are worth our further study.

B4L05-1-44.chinese: 不論是工業或家庭廢水，對人們的健康都有不好的影響。
B4L05-1-44.pinyin: Bùlùn shì gōngyè huò jiātíng fèishuǐ, duì rénmen de jiànkāng dōu yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
B4L05-1-44.english: Whether industrial or household waste water, it all has a bad impact on people's health.

B4L05-1-45.chinese: 人類活動產生許多垃圾，不但汙染了環境，更改變了全球氣候。
B4L05-1-45.pinyin: Rénlèi huódòng chǎnshēng xǔduō lājī, bùdàn wūrǎn le huánjìng, gèng gǎibiàn le quánqiú qìhòu.
B4L05-1-45.english: Human activities produce a lot of garbage, which not only polluted the environment but also changed the global climate.

B4L05-1-46.chinese: 每次看到有河流經過的都市，就會想起我生長的家鄉。
B4L05-1-46.pinyin: Měi cì kàndào yǒu héliú jīngguò de dūshì, jiù huì xiǎngqǐ wǒ shēngzhǎng de jiāxiāng.
B4L05-1-46.english: Every time I see a city with a river passing through it, I think of the hometown where I grew up.

B4L05-1-47.chinese: 生命就像海洋一樣，只有勇敢的人們才能抵達海的另一邊。
B4L05-1-47.pinyin: Shēngmìng jiù xiàng hǎiyáng yíyàng, zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn de rénmen cái néng dǐdá hǎi de lìng yì biān.
B4L05-1-47.english: Life is like the ocean; only brave people can reach the other side of the sea.

B4L05-1-48.chinese: 工廠排水系統得設計好，以免汙染自然環境。
B4L05-1-48.pinyin: Gōngchǎng pái shuǐ xìtǒng děi shèjì hǎo, yǐmiǎn wūrǎn zìrán huánjìng.
B4L05-1-48.english: The factory's drainage system must be well designed, lest it pollute the natural environment.

B4L05-1-49.chinese: 汽車的汽油燃燒不完全的話，容易產生很多廢氣。
B4L05-1-49.pinyin: Qìchē de qìyóu ránshāo bù wánquán de huà, róngyì chǎnshēng hěn duō fèiqì.
B4L05-1-49.english: If a car's gasoline does not burn completely, it easily produces a lot of exhaust fumes.

B4L05-1-50.chinese: 空氣越髒，人們的肺也就越不健康。
B4L05-1-50.pinyin: Kōngqì yuè zāng, rénmen de fèi yě jiù yuè bù jiànkāng.
B4L05-1-50.english: The dirtier the air, the less healthy people's lungs are.

B4L05-1-51.chinese: 做任何事以前要先想清楚，這麼做會有什麼後果。
B4L05-1-51.pinyin: Zuò rènhé shì yǐqián yào xiān xiǎng qīngchu, zhème zuò huì yǒu shénme hòuguǒ.
B4L05-1-51.english: Before doing anything, you must first think clearly what consequences doing so will have.

B4L05-1-52.chinese: 那家工廠排出的廢氣很毒，附近已經有不少民眾生病了。
B4L05-1-52.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de fèiqì hěn dú, fùjìn yǐjīng yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng shēngbìng le.
B4L05-1-52.english: The exhaust fumes emitted by that factory are very poisonous; many people nearby have already gotten sick.

B4L05-1-53.chinese: 他的夢想是利用水來當作交通工具的燃料，可是很多人認為不可能。
B4L05-1-53.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì lìyòng shuǐ lái dāngzuò jiāotōng gōngjù de ránliào, kěshì hěn duō rén rènwéi bù kěnéng.
B4L05-1-53.english: His dream is to use water as fuel for transportation vehicles, but many people think it is impossible.

B4L05-1-54.chinese: 想把菜園照顧好，平時就得多用心，看到蟲子就得處理。
B4L05-1-54.pinyin: Xiǎng bǎ càiyuán zhàogù hǎo, píngshí jiù děi duō yòngxīn, kàndào chóngzi jiù děi chǔlǐ.
B4L05-1-54.english: If you want to take good care of the vegetable garden, you must be more attentive in daily life; when you see bugs, you must deal with them.

B4L05-1-55.chinese: 再過幾天就要過年了，在此願大家新年平安，事事如意。
B4L05-1-55.pinyin: Zài guò jǐ tiān jiù yào guònián le, zài cǐ yuàn dàjiā xīnnián píng'ān, shìshì rúyì.
B4L05-1-55.english: In a few days it will be Chinese New Year; here I wish everyone a peaceful new year and that everything goes as you wish.

B4L05-1-56.chinese: 夏天一到，就有不少遊客到海灘，光著身體享受陽光與海風。
B4L05-1-56.pinyin: Xiàtiān yí dào, jiù yǒu bùshǎo yóukè dào hǎitān, guāngzhe shēntǐ xiǎngshòu yángguāng yǔ hǎifēng.
B4L05-1-56.english: As soon as summer arrives, many tourists go to the beach, baring their bodies and enjoying the sunshine and sea breeze.

B4L05-1-57.chinese: 大地就像我們的母親一樣，一直保護著我們。
B4L05-1-57.pinyin: Dàdì jiù xiàng wǒmen de mǔqīn yíyàng, yìzhí bǎohùzhe wǒmen.
B4L05-1-57.english: The earth is like our mother, always protecting us.

B4L05-2-01.chinese: 他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
B4L05-2-01.pinyin: Tā kào zìjǐ de lìliàng, jīngguò le shí nián, zhōngyú wánchéng le zhège fāmíng.
B4L05-2-01.english: Relying on his own strength, after ten years, he finally completed this invention.

B4L05-2-02.chinese: 市長宣布明天因為颱風的風雨太大，不上班、不上課。
B4L05-2-02.pinyin: Shìzhǎng xuānbù míngtiān yīnwèi táifēng de fēngyǔ tài dà, bù shàngbān, bù shàngkè.
B4L05-2-02.english: The mayor announced that tomorrow, because the typhoon's wind and rain are too strong, there will be no work and no school.

B4L05-2-03.chinese: 醫生提醒我少吃油、鹽和糖，以減輕身體的負擔。
B4L05-2-03.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng wǒ shǎo chī yóu, yán hé táng, yǐ jiǎnqīng shēntǐ de fùdān.
B4L05-2-03.english: The doctor reminded me to eat less oil, salt, and sugar in order to lighten the body's burden.

B4L05-2-04.chinese: 用過一面的紙張別急著丟，另一面也可以用。
B4L05-2-04.pinyin: Yòng guò yī miàn de zhǐzhāng bié jízhe diū, lìng yī miàn yě kěyǐ yòng.
B4L05-2-04.english: Don't rush to throw away paper that has been used on one side; the other side can also be used.

B4L05-2-05.chinese: 他以前化學成績常不及格，沒想到現在卻是有名的化學教授。
B4L05-2-05.pinyin: Tā yǐqián huàxué chéngjī cháng bù jígé, méi xiǎngdào xiànzài què shì yǒumíng de huàxué jiàoshòu.
B4L05-2-05.english: He used to often fail chemistry, but unexpectedly now he is a famous chemistry professor.

B4L05-2-06.chinese: 停電(power failure)的時候有支手電筒，做起事來比較方便。
B4L05-2-06.pinyin: Tíngdiàn de shíhòu yǒu zhī shǒudiàntǒng, zuò qǐ shì lái bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
B4L05-2-06.english: When there is a power failure, having a flashlight makes doing things more convenient.

B4L05-2-07.chinese: 那件事我已經跟你重複說過好多次了，你怎麼還問我？
B4L05-2-07.pinyin: Nà jiàn shì wǒ yǐjīng gēn nǐ chóngfù shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme hái wèn wǒ?
B4L05-2-07.english: I have already said that matter to you repeatedly many times; how come you are still asking me?

B4L05-2-08.chinese: 開冷氣時如果能好好利用電扇，房間很快就涼了。
B4L05-2-08.pinyin: Kā lěngqì shí rúguǒ néng hǎohǎo lìyòng diànshàn, fángjiān hěn kuài jiù liáng le.
B4L05-2-08.english: When turning on the air conditioner, if you can make good use of an electric fan, the room will cool down quickly.

B4L05-2-09.chinese: 從前有很多生活用具都是用銅做的，像銅杯、銅碗什麼的。
B4L05-2-09.pinyin: Cóngqián yǒu hěn duō shēnghuó yòngjù dōu shì yòng tóng zuò de, xiàng tóng bēi, tóng wǎn shénme de.
B4L05-2-09.english: In the past, many household items were made of copper, like copper cups, copper bowls, and so on.

B4L05-2-10.chinese: 颱風過後，很多電線被強風吹壞了，需要幾天才能恢復正常。
B4L05-2-10.pinyin: Táifēng guò hòu, hěn duō diànxiàn bèi qiángfēng chuī huài le, xūyào jǐ tiān cái néng huīfù zhèngcháng.
B4L05-2-10.english: After the typhoon, many power lines were damaged by strong winds and will need several days to return to normal.

B4L05-2-11.chinese: 家裡用不到的毯子可以拿給環保社團，他們會送給需要的家庭。
B4L05-2-11.pinyin: Jiālǐ yòng bù dào de tǎnzi kěyǐ ná gěi huánbǎo shètuán, tāmen huì sòng gěi xūyào de jiātíng.
B4L05-2-11.english: Blankets that are not used at home can be given to environmental groups; they will give them to families in need.

B4L05-2-13.chinese: 今天百貨公司有優惠活動，買一條床單就送一床被子(quilt)。
B4L05-2-13.pinyin: Jīntiān bǎihuò gōngsī yǒu yōuhuì huódòng, mǎi yī tiáo chuángdān jiù sòng yī chuáng bèizi.
B4L05-2-13.english: Today the department store has a special promotion: buy one bed sheet and get one quilt free.

B4L05-2-16.chinese: 這條棉被是用品質很好的棉花做的，裡面的棉又白又溫暖。
B4L05-2-16.pinyin: Zhè tiáo miánbèi shì yòng pǐnzhì hěn hǎo de miánhuā zuò de, lǐmiàn de mián yòu bái yòu wēnnuǎn.
B4L05-2-16.english: This cotton quilt is made from high-quality cotton; the cotton inside is both white and warm.

B4L05-2-17.chinese: 我把房間裡那條黑色繩子看成蛇，嚇了我一大跳。
B4L05-2-17.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ fángjiān lǐ nà tiáo hēisè shéngzi kàn chéng shé, xià le wǒ yī dà tiào.
B4L05-2-17.english: I mistook that black rope in the room for a snake and got a big scare.

B4L05-2-18.chinese: 那件襯衫的材料百分之百是棉，穿起來十分舒服。
B4L05-2-18.pinyin: Nà jiàn chènshān de cáiliào bǎifēnzhī bǎi shì mián, chuān qǐlái shífēn shūfu.
B4L05-2-18.english: The material of that shirt is one hundred percent cotton, so it feels very comfortable to wear.

B4L05-2-19.chinese: 這些帶子是我小學的記錄，我請朋友把它存進電腦裡。
B4L05-2-19.pinyin: Zhèxiē dàizi shì wǒ xiǎoxué de jìlù, wǒ qǐng péngyǒu bǎ tā cún jìn diànnǎo lǐ.
B4L05-2-19.english: These tapes are records from my elementary school days; I asked a friend to save them onto the computer.

B4L05-2-20.chinese: 家裡的衛生紙快用完了，下班回家時順便買幾卷吧。
B4L05-2-20.pinyin: Jiālǐ de wèishēngzhǐ kuài yòng wán le, xiàbān huí jiā shí shùnbiàn mǎi jǐ juǎn ba.
B4L05-2-20.english: The toilet paper at home is almost used up; on your way home from work, buy a few rolls while you're at it.

B4L05-2-21.chinese: 人的一生就如一場電影，故事中的每個人都是主角。
B4L05-2-21.pinyin: Rén de yīshēng jiù rú yī chǎng diànyǐng, gùshì zhōng de měi gè rén dōu shì zhǔjiǎo.
B4L05-2-21.english: A person's life is like a movie; everyone in the story is the main character.

B4L05-2-22.chinese: 他很喜歡買文具，尤其是筆，各國進口的原子筆他都有。
B4L05-2-22.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān mǎi wénjù, yóuqí shì bǐ, gè guó jìnkǒu de yuánzǐbǐ tā dōu yǒu.
B4L05-2-22.english: He really likes buying stationery, especially pens; he has ballpoint pens imported from various countries.

B4L05-2-23.chinese: 今天兩小時的會議，因為要討論的事增加而延長了三十分。
B4L05-2-23.pinyin: Jīntiān liǎng xiǎoshí de huìyì, yīnwèi yào tǎolùn de shì zēngjiā ér yáncháng le sānshí fēn.
B4L05-2-23.english: Today's two-hour meeting was extended by thirty minutes because the matters to discuss increased.

B4L05-2-24.chinese: 過度消費及使用塑膠材料的產品，都會增加自然環境的負擔。
B4L05-2-24.pinyin: Guòdù xiāofèi jí shǐyòng sùjiāo cáiliào de chǎnpǐn, dōu huì zēngjiā zìrán huánjìng de fùdān.
B4L05-2-24.english: Excessive consumption and the use of plastic material products will both increase the burden on the natural environment.

B4L05-2-25.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
B4L05-2-25.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
B4L05-2-25.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

B4L05-2-26.chinese: 如果能好好利用食物材料，就能有效地減少廚餘。
B4L05-2-26.pinyin: Rúguǒ néng hǎohǎo lìyòng shíwù cáiliào, jiù néng yǒuxiào de jiǎnshǎo chúyú.
B4L05-2-26.english: If food materials can be used well, kitchen waste can be effectively reduced.

B4L06-1-01.chinese: 元旦那天因為不少人放假，大部分餐廳都客滿了。
B4L06-1-01.pinyin: Yuándàn nà tiān yīnwèi bù shǎo rén fàngjià, dà bùfèn cāntīng dōu kèmǎn le.
B4L06-1-01.english: On New Year's Day, because many people had the day off, most restaurants were full.

B4L06-1-02.chinese: 離我家不遠的劇院，是請著名設計師來設計的。
B4L06-1-02.pinyin: Lí wǒ jiā bù yuǎn de jùyuàn, shì qǐng zhùmíng shèjìshī lái shèjì de.
B4L06-1-02.english: The theater not far from my home was designed by a famous designer.

B4L06-1-03.chinese: 那位演員有劇場表演的經驗，所以導演決定用他。
B4L06-1-03.pinyin: Nà wèi yǎnyuán yǒu jùchǎng biǎoyǎn de jīngyàn, suǒyǐ dǎoyǎn juédìng yòng tā.
B4L06-1-03.english: That actor has experience in theater performances, so the director decided to use him.

B4L06-1-04.chinese: 這首古老民謠的風格很獨特，不管大人小孩都會唱。
B4L06-1-04.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gǔlǎo mínyáo de fēnggé hěn dútè, bùguǎn dàrén xiǎohái dōu huì chàng.
B4L06-1-04.english: The style of this ancient ballad is very unique; regardless of adults or children, everyone can sing it.

B4L06-1-05.chinese: 為了在這場鋼琴演奏中有優秀的表現，小戴早晚不停地練習。
B4L06-1-05.pinyin: Wèile zài zhè chǎng gāngqín yǎnzòu zhōng yǒu yōuxiù de biǎoxiàn, Xiǎo Dài zǎowǎn bùtíng de liànxí.
B4L06-1-05.english: In order to have an excellent performance in this piano performance, Xiao Dai practices non-stop morning and evening.

B4L06-1-06.chinese: 這種巧克力是情人節最熱門的商品，總是一下子就賣光了。
B4L06-1-06.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qiǎokèlì shì Qíngrénjié zuì rèmén de shāngpǐn, zǒngshì yīxiàzi jiù mài guāng le.
B4L06-1-06.english: This kind of chocolate is the most popular product for Valentine's Day; it always sells out in no time.

B4L06-1-07.chinese: 大型體育活動常選擇在都市舉行，主要原因是交通方便。
B4L06-1-07.pinyin: Dàxíng tǐyù huódòng cháng xuǎnzé zài dūshì jǔxíng, zhǔyào yuányīn shì jiāotōng fāngbiàn.
B4L06-1-07.english: Large-scale sports events are often chosen to be held in cities; the main reason is convenient transportation.

B4L06-1-08.chinese: 以前我的小學老師總是親切地教導我們，讓我到現在還是很懷念她。
B4L06-1-08.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ de xiǎoxué lǎoshī zǒngshì qīnqiè de jiàodǎo wǒmen, ràng wǒ dào xiànzài háishì hěn huáiniàn tā.
B4L06-1-08.english: My elementary school teacher used to teach us kindly, which makes me still cherish her memory even now.

B4L06-1-09.chinese: 他們班明天有一場籃球比賽，我想到現場替他們加油。
B4L06-1-09.pinyin: Tāmen bān míngtiān yǒu yī chǎng lánqiú bǐsài, wǒ xiǎng dào xiànchǎng tì tāmen jiāyóu.
B4L06-1-09.english: Their class has a basketball game tomorrow; I want to go to the scene to cheer them on.

B4L06-1-10.chinese: 生命就像一片海洋，有時穩定有時瘋狂。
B4L06-1-10.pinyin: Shēngmìng jiù xiàng yī piàn hǎiyáng, yǒushí wěndìng yǒushí fēngkuáng.
B4L06-1-10.english: Life is like an ocean, sometimes stable and sometimes crazy.

B4L06-1-11.chinese: 當掉進海裡的小孩被救上來時，大家都激動地歡呼了起來。
B4L06-1-11.pinyin: Dāng diào jìn hǎi lǐ de xiǎohái bèi jiù shànglái shí, dàjiā dōu jīdòng de huānhū le qǐlái.
B4L06-1-11.english: When the child who had fallen into the sea was rescued, everyone excitedly cheered.

B4L06-1-12.chinese: 當別人表現得很好時，別忘了為他們鼓掌，給他們鼓勵。
B4L06-1-12.pinyin: Dāng biérén biǎoxiàn de hěn hǎo shí, bié wàngle wèi tāmen gǔzhǎng, gěi tāmen gǔlì.
B4L06-1-12.english: When others perform well, don't forget to applaud for them and give them encouragement.

B4L06-1-13.chinese: 我罵他是因為他太可惡了，你要我別生氣，我真的忍不住。
B4L06-1-13.pinyin: Wǒ mà tā shì yīnwèi tā tài kěwù le, nǐ yào wǒ bié shēngqì, wǒ zhēnde rěn bù zhù.
B4L06-1-13.english: I scolded him because he was too detestable; you want me not to get angry, but I really cannot help it.

B4L06-1-14.chinese: 牙痛時最好快點兒去看醫生，不然越忍越疼。
B4L06-1-14.pinyin: Yátòng shí zuìhǎo kuài diǎnr qù kàn yīshēng, bùrán yuè rěn yuè téng.
B4L06-1-14.english: When you have a toothache, it's best to see a doctor quickly; otherwise, the more you endure it, the more it hurts.

B4L06-1-16.chinese: 每次比賽到了緊張的時候，觀眾就大聲叫喊，我也跟著喊。
B4L06-1-16.pinyin: Měi cì bǐsài dào le jǐnzhāng de shíhòu, guānzhòng jiù dàshēng jiàohǎn, wǒ yě gēnzhe hǎn.
B4L06-1-16.english: Every time the game reaches a tense moment, the audience shouts loudly, and I shout along too.

B4L06-1-17.chinese: 我坐在公園裡看著花兒隨著風搖擺，那個樣子真是可愛極了。
B4L06-1-17.pinyin: Wǒ zuò zài gōngyuán lǐ kànzhe huār suízhe fēng yáobǎi, nàge yàngzi zhēnshi kě'ài jí le.
B4L06-1-17.english: I sat in the park watching the flowers sway with the wind; that appearance was really extremely cute.

B4L06-1-18.chinese: 這部電影一點兒都不吸引人，就算錯過了也無所謂。
B4L06-1-18.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yīdiǎnr dōu bù xīyǐn rén, jiùsuàn cuòguò le yě wúsuǒwèi.
B4L06-1-18.english: This movie is not attractive at all; even if you miss it, it doesn't matter.

B4L06-1-19.chinese: 經理因商品售完而跟顧客道歉，並表示明天就會補上。
B4L06-1-19.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīn shāngpǐn shòu wán ér gēn gùkè dàoqiàn, bìng biǎoshì míngtiān jiù huì bǔ shàng.
B4L06-1-19.english: The manager apologized to the customer because the product was sold out, and indicated that it would be restocked tomorrow.

B4L06-1-20.chinese: 學校的游泳比賽報名時間到今天截止，有興趣的同學別錯過了。
B4L06-1-20.pinyin: Xuéxiào de yóuyǒng bǐsài bàomíng shíjiān dào jīntiān jiézhǐ, yǒu xìngqù de tóngxué bié cuòguò le.
B4L06-1-20.english: Registration for the school's swimming competition closes today; classmates who are interested should not miss it.

B4L06-1-21.chinese: 有好的投資機會就該好好掌握，不要等到事後才開始後悔。
B4L06-1-21.pinyin: Yǒu hǎo de tóuzī jīhuì jiù gāi hǎohǎo zhǎngwò, bùyào děngdào shìhòu cái kāishǐ hòuhuǐ.
B4L06-1-21.english: When there is a good investment opportunity, you should grasp it well; don't wait until afterwards to start regretting.

B4L06-1-22.chinese: 我買了海洋公園的門票，打算利用週末帶孩子一起去逛逛。
B4L06-1-22.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le hǎiyáng gōngyuán de ménpiào, dǎsuàn lìyòng zhōumò dài háizi yīqǐ qù guàngguang.
B4L06-1-22.english: I bought tickets for the Ocean Park and plan to take the children to stroll around there together on the weekend.

B4L06-1-23.chinese: 今年下雪的時間提早了，氣候改變或許是最主要的原因。
B4L06-1-23.pinyin: Jīnnián xià xuě de shíjiān tízǎo le, qìhòu gǎibiàn huòxǔ shì zuì zhǔyào de yuányīn.
B4L06-1-23.english: This year the time of snowfall came earlier than planned; climate change is perhaps the main reason.

B4L06-1-24.chinese: 明天的會議改時間了，你趕緊通知大家。
B4L06-1-24.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì gǎi shíjiān le, nǐ gǎnjǐn tōngzhī dàjiā.
B4L06-1-24.english: Tomorrow's meeting has been rescheduled; you hurry and notify everyone.

B4L06-1-26.chinese: 練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
B4L06-1-26.pinyin: Liànxí bābǎi gōngchǐ pǎobù shí, jiàoliàn chúle yào dàjiā jìde zìjǐ shì pǎo dì jǐ bàng de, bìngqiě tíxǐng wǒmen bǎ bàngzi ná hǎo.
B4L06-1-26.english: When practicing the 800-meter run, the coach not only told everyone to remember which leg of the relay they were running, but also reminded us to hold the baton well.

B4L06-1-27.chinese: 我住的地方距離公司很近，省了很多時間與交通費。
B4L06-1-27.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng jùlí gōngsī hěn jìn, shěng le hěn duō shíjiān yǔ jiāotōngfèi.
B4L06-1-27.english: The place where I live is very close to the company, which saves a lot of time and transportation costs.

B4L06-1-28.chinese: 演唱會開演前，工作人員請大家不要拿手機錄現場的情況。
B4L06-1-28.pinyin: Yǎnchànghuì kāiyǎn qián, gōngzuò rényuán qǐng dàjiā bùyào ná shǒujī lù xiànchǎng de qíngkuàng.
B4L06-1-28.english: Before the concert begins, the staff ask everyone not to use their phones to record the scene.

B4L06-1-29.chinese: 彩色照片看起來很真實，不過黑白照片給人的感覺也很特別。
B4L06-1-29.pinyin: Cǎisè zhàopiàn kàn qǐlái hěn zhēnshí, bùguò hēibái zhàopiàn gěi rén de gǎnjué yě hěn tèbié.
B4L06-1-29.english: Color photos look very realistic, but black-and-white photos also give people a very special feeling.

B4L06-1-30.chinese: 學校邀請李教授來演講，內容相當精彩，讓我有很大的收穫。
B4L06-1-30.pinyin: Xuéxiào yāoqǐng Lǐ jiàoshòu lái yǎnjiǎng, nèiróng xiāngdāng jīngcǎi, ràng wǒ yǒu hěn dà de shōuhuò.
B4L06-1-30.english: The school invited Professor Li to give a lecture; the content was quite wonderful, which gave me a great harvest.

B4L06-1-31.chinese: 球員的表現讓教練不斷搖頭，並表示得加強平常的訓練。
B4L06-1-31.pinyin: Qiúyuán de biǎoxiàn ràng jiàoliàn bùduàn yáotóu, bìng biǎoshì děi jiāqiáng píngcháng de xùnliàn.
B4L06-1-31.english: The players' performance made the coach constantly shake his head, and he indicated that they need to strengthen their regular training.

B4L06-1-32.chinese: 七歲以下的孩子對手部動作還無法完全地掌握，因此不應要求他們正確地握筆。
B4L06-1-32.pinyin: Qī suì yǐxià de háizi duì shǒubù dòngzuò hái wúfǎ wánquán de zhǎngwò, yīncǐ bù yīng yāoqiú tāmen zhèngquè de wò bǐ.
B4L06-1-32.english: Children under seven years old still cannot fully master hand movements, so they should not be required to hold a pen correctly.

B4L06-1-33.chinese: 我看到前面有人跟我揮手，可是我不認識那個人。
B4L06-1-33.pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào qiánmiàn yǒu rén gēn wǒ huī shǒu, kěshì wǒ bù rènshí nàge rén.
B4L06-1-33.english: I saw someone in front waving at me, but I don't know that person.

B4L06-1-34.chinese: 對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
B4L06-1-34.pinyin: Duì zìjǐ de shìyè hěn rèqíng de rén, jiù bù pà tiǎozhàn rènhé kùnnán.
B4L06-1-34.english: People who are very passionate about their careers are not afraid to challenge any difficulties.

B4L06-1-35.chinese: 每次到了特別的節日，張先生就會送鮮花給太太，真是浪漫。
B4L06-1-35.pinyin: Měi cì dào le tèbié de jiérì, Zhāng xiānsheng jiù huì sòng xiānhuā gěi tàitai, zhēn shì làngmàn.
B4L06-1-35.english: Every time a special holiday comes, Mr. Zhang sends fresh flowers to his wife; it's truly romantic.

B4L06-1-36.chinese: 在大都市，早上起床能聽見鳥叫聲，那真是太難得了。
B4L06-1-36.pinyin: Zài dà dūshì, zǎoshang qǐchuáng néng tīngjiàn niǎo jiào shēng, nà zhēn shì tài nándé le.
B4L06-1-36.english: In a big city, being able to hear the sound of birds chirping when you get up in the morning is truly rare.

B4L06-1-37.chinese: 上臺報告以前要把資料準備好，以免到時候手忙腳亂的。
B4L06-1-37.pinyin: Shàngtái bàogào yǐqián yào bǎ zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, yǐmiǎn dào shíhou shǒumángjiǎoluàn de.
B4L06-1-37.english: Before going on stage to give a report, you need to prepare your materials well, so that you won't be in a rush and confused when the time comes.

B4L06-1-38.chinese: 聽見他欣賞的那位歌星來演唱的消息，令他興奮地跳了起來。
B4L06-1-38.pinyin: Tīngjiàn tā xīnshǎng de nà wèi gēxīng lái yǎnchàng de xiāoxi, lìng tā xīngfèn de tiào le qǐlái.
B4L06-1-38.english: Hearing the news that the singer he admires was coming to sing, he jumped up with excitement.

B4L06-1-40.chinese: 所有令人傷腦筋的過程，都是為了使自己變成腦筋很好的人。
B4L06-1-40.pinyin: Suǒyǒu lìng rén shāng nǎojīn de guòchéng, dōu shì wèile shǐ zìjǐ biànchéng nǎojīn hěn hǎo de rén.
B4L06-1-40.english: All the brain-racking processes are for the purpose of making oneself a person with a good brain.

B4L06-1-41.chinese: A:哎呀！我的手機掉到河裡了。 （shock or annoyance）B:那真是傷腦筋，看來你只好再買一支了。
B4L06-1-41.pinyin: A: Āiyā! Wǒ de shǒujī diào dào hé lǐ le. B: Nà zhēn shì shāng nǎojīn, kànlái nǐ zhǐhǎo zài mǎi yī zhī le.
B4L06-1-41.english: A: Oh no! My cell phone fell into the river. B: That's really a headache; it seems you'll have to buy another one.

B4L06-1-42.chinese: 儘管他沒主持過什麼節目，他的獨特風格仍然引起大家注意。
B4L06-1-42.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā méi zhǔchí guò shénme jiémù, tā de dútè fēnggé réngrán yǐnqǐ dàjiā zhùyì.
B4L06-1-42.english: Although he has never hosted any programs, his unique style still attracted everyone's attention.

B4L06-1-43.chinese: 要是你覺得那部電影很爛，我們就走吧，又不是非看不可。
B4L06-1-43.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde nà bù diànyǐng hěn làn, wǒmen jiù zǒu ba, yòu bù shì fēi kàn bùkě.
B4L06-1-43.english: If you think that movie is really lousy, let's leave; it's not like we absolutely have to watch it.

B4L06-1-44.chinese: 他說的話都很有道理，不是廢話，只是你聽不進去而已。
B4L06-1-44.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà dōu hěn yǒu dàolǐ, bù shì fèihuà, zhǐshì nǐ tīng bù jìnqù éryǐ.
B4L06-1-44.english: What he says is all very reasonable, not nonsense; it's just that you won't take it in.

B4L06-1-45.chinese: 樂團主唱的唱歌技巧，對樂團演出表現的影響相當大。
B4L06-1-45.pinyin: Yuètuán zhǔchàng de chànggē jìqiǎo, duì yuètuán yǎnchū biǎoxiàn de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
B4L06-1-45.english: The lead vocalist's singing skills have a considerable impact on the band's performance.

B4L06-1-46.chinese: 在表演以前準備得越多，上舞臺就越有自信。
B4L06-1-46.pinyin: Zài biǎoyǎn yǐqián zhǔnbèi de yuè duō, shàng wǔtái jiù yuè yǒu zìxìn.
B4L06-1-46.english: The more you prepare before a performance, the more confident you will be when you go on stage.

B4L06-2-01.chinese: 要是你對文藝領域不了解，最好不要隨便批評別人的作品。
B4L06-2-01.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ duì wényì lǐngyù bù liǎojiě, zuìhǎo bùyào suíbiàn pīpíng biérén de zuòpǐn.
B4L06-2-01.english: If you don't understand the field of literature and art, you'd better not casually criticize others' works.

B4L06-2-02.chinese: 他迷上足球，所以買了各式各樣的足球鞋。
B4L06-2-02.pinyin: Tā mí shàng zúqiú, suǒyǐ mǎi le gè shì gè yàng de zúqiú xié.
B4L06-2-02.english: He is fascinated by soccer, so he bought all kinds of soccer shoes.

B4L06-2-03.chinese: 他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
B4L06-2-03.pinyin: Tā cóng yīnyuè xuéyuàn bìyè yǐhòu jiù jiārù gējùtuán, dào shìjiè gèdì biǎoyǎn.
B4L06-2-03.english: After graduating from the music conservatory, he joined an opera troupe and performed all over the world.

B4L06-2-05.chinese: 從那個偶像團體的舞蹈，就可以看出他們練(to practice)舞時花了多少工夫。
B4L06-2-05.pinyin: Cóng nàge ǒuxiàng tuántǐ de wǔdǎo, jiù kěyǐ kànchū tāmen liàn wǔ shí huā le duōshǎo gōngfu.
B4L06-2-05.english: From that idol group's dancing, you can tell how much effort they put into practicing dance.

B4L06-2-06.chinese: 現在很少年輕人看得懂京劇，其實京劇沒那麼難。
B4L06-2-06.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn shǎo niánqīngrén kàn de dǒng jīngjù, qíshí jīngjù méi nàme nán.
B4L06-2-06.english: Nowadays very few young people can understand Beijing opera; actually, Beijing opera is not that difficult.

B4L06-2-07.chinese: 龍在中國人的心目中具有特殊的地位。
B4L06-2-07.pinyin: Lóng zài Zhōngguórén de xīnmùzhōng jùyǒu tèshū de dìwèi.
B4L06-2-07.english: In the hearts of Chinese people, the dragon holds a special status.

B4L06-2-08.chinese: 每次當我回憶起大學的社團生活，就會想到那一群知心好友。
B4L06-2-08.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒ huíyì qǐ dàxué de shètuán shēnghuó, jiù huì xiǎngdào nà yī qún zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
B4L06-2-08.english: Every time I recall my university club life, I think of that group of close friends.

B4L06-2-09.chinese: 為了更有效地利用地球資源，我寧願減少不必要的生活享受。
B4L06-2-09.pinyin: Wèile gèng yǒuxiào de lìyòng dìqiú zīyuán, wǒ nìngyuàn jiǎnshǎo bù bìyào de shēnghuó xiǎngshòu.
B4L06-2-09.english: In order to use Earth's resources more effectively, I would rather reduce unnecessary life pleasures.

B4L06-2-10.chinese: 那位母親寧可犧牲自己的生命，也要保護孩子的安全。
B4L06-2-10.pinyin: Nà wèi mǔqīn nìngkě xīshēng zìjǐ de shēngmìng, yě yào bǎohù háizi de ānquán.
B4L06-2-10.english: That mother would rather sacrifice her own life to protect her child's safety.

B4L06-2-11.chinese: 病人受傷的地方如果沒有好好處理，很容易會被感染。
B4L06-2-11.pinyin: Bìngrén shòushāng de dìfāng rúguǒ méiyǒu hǎohǎo chǔlǐ, hěn róngyì huì bèi gǎnrǎn.
B4L06-2-11.english: If the injured area of a patient is not properly treated, it can easily become infected.

B4L06-2-12.chinese: 電視臺常在熱門比賽的轉播中放一些廣告，靠這種方式來賺錢。
B4L06-2-12.pinyin: Diànshìtái cháng zài rèmén bǐsài de zhuǎnbō zhōng fàng yīxiē guǎnggào, kào zhè zhǒng fāngshì lái zhuànqián.
B4L06-2-12.english: TV stations often place some advertisements during the broadcast of popular matches, relying on this method to make money.

B4L06-2-13.chinese: 網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
B4L06-2-13.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhíbō de nèiróng gèzhǒng-gèyàng, shènzhì yǒu rén yīnwèi zhíbō píngrì shēnghuó ér biànchéng míngxīng.
B4L06-2-13.english: The content of live internet broadcasts is all kinds of things; some people even become stars because they live-broadcast their everyday life.

B4L06-2-14.chinese: 你帶著邀請卡給門口的服務人員檢查，才能入場參加活動。
B4L06-2-14.pinyin: Nǐ dài zhe yāoqǐngkǎ gěi ménkǒu de fúwù rényuán jiǎnchá, cái néng rùchǎng cānjiā huódòng.
B4L06-2-14.english: You bring your invitation card for the service staff at the entrance to check, and only then can you enter the venue to participate in the event.

B4L06-2-15.chinese: 如果想入會員並享受我們健身房所提供的服務，請您到櫃臺辦理。
B4L06-2-15.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng rù huìyuán bìng xiǎngshòu wǒmen jiànshēnfáng suǒ tígōng de fúwù, qǐng nín dào guìtái bànlǐ.
B4L06-2-15.english: If you want to become a member and enjoy the services provided by our gym, please go to the counter to handle it.

B4L06-2-16.chinese: 那家商店的廣告牌子被一陣強風吹起後，還差一點打到路上的摩托車，真可怕。
B4L06-2-16.pinyin: Nà jiā shāngdiàn de guǎnggào páizi bèi yī zhèn qiángfēng chuī qǐ hòu, hái chà yīdiǎn dǎ dào lùshàng de mótuōchē, zhēn kěpà.
B4L06-2-16.english: After that shop's advertising sign was blown up by a gust of strong wind, it almost hit a motorcycle on the road; it was really scary.

B4L06-2-17.chinese: 當聽到周博士多年的研究終於有了成果時，所有員工都給他最大的掌聲。
B4L06-2-17.pinyin: Dāng tīngdào Zhōu bóshì duōnián de yánjiū zhōngyú yǒu le chéngguǒ shí, suǒyǒu yuángōng dōu gěi tā zuì dà de zhǎngshēng.
B4L06-2-17.english: When they heard that Dr. Zhou's years of research had finally produced results, all the employees gave him the biggest applause.

B4L06-2-18.chinese: 我雖然尊敬他，卻不認同他所堅持的觀點。
B4L06-2-18.pinyin: Wǒ suīrán zūnjìng tā, què bù rèntóng tā suǒ jiānchí de guāndiǎn.
B4L06-2-18.english: Although I respect him, I do not approve of the viewpoint he insists on.

B4L06-2-19.chinese: 電腦展內的人太多了，大家擠來擠去的，真是受不了。
B4L06-2-19.pinyin: Diànnǎo zhǎn nèi de rén tài duō le, dàjiā jǐ lái jǐ qù de, zhēn shì shòu bù liǎo.
B4L06-2-19.english: There are too many people inside the computer exhibition; everyone is crowding in and squeezing around—it's really unbearable.

B4L06-2-20.chinese: 爬山時如果碰到大雨就應避免繼續前進，以免發生危險。
B4L06-2-20.pinyin: Páshān shí rúguǒ pèngdào dàyǔ jiù yīng bìmiǎn jìxù qiánjìn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
B4L06-2-20.english: When mountain climbing, if you encounter heavy rain, you should avoid continuing to advance, so as to prevent danger from occurring.

B4L06-2-21.chinese: 碰到困難無法繼續前進時，暫時後退等待機會也是一種作法。
B4L06-2-21.pinyin: Pèngdào kùnnán wúfǎ jìxù qiánjìn shí, zànshí hòutuì děngdài jīhuì yě shì yī zhǒng zuòfǎ.
B4L06-2-21.english: When you encounter difficulties and cannot continue to advance, temporarily retreating and waiting for an opportunity is also a kind of approach.

B4L06-2-22.chinese: 上星期電視臺的人來訪問我們，請我們談談學習華語的經驗。
B4L06-2-22.pinyin: Shàng xīngqī diànshìtái de rén lái fǎngwèn wǒmen, qǐng wǒmen tán tan xuéxí Huáyǔ de jīngyàn.
B4L06-2-22.english: Last week people from the TV station came to interview us, asking us to talk about our experience learning Chinese.

B4L06-2-23.chinese: 這部電影的字幕翻譯得很糟糕，讓人弄不清楚它的意思。
B4L06-2-23.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de zìmù fānyì de hěn zāogāo, ràng rén nòng bù qīngchǔ tā de yìsi.
B4L06-2-23.english: The subtitles of this movie are translated very poorly, making it unclear what it means.

B4L06-2-24.chinese: 請你把空罐子放在袋子裡，好讓垃圾車一起回收。
B4L06-2-24.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ kōng guànzi fàng zài dàizi lǐ, hǎo ràng lājīchē yīqǐ huíshōu.
B4L06-2-24.english: Please put the empty cans in the bag, so that the garbage truck can recycle them together.

B4L06-2-25.chinese: 雖然現在網路很普遍了，還是有不少人喜歡聽電臺的節目。
B4L06-2-25.pinyin: Suīrán xiànzài wǎnglù hěn pǔbiàn le, hái shì yǒu bùshǎo rén xǐhuān tīng diàntái de jiémù.
B4L06-2-25.english: Although the internet is very common now, there are still quite a few people who like to listen to radio station programs.

B4L06-2-26.chinese: 如果從事某項工作能令你忘掉時間，或許就可當作一生的事業。
B4L06-2-26.pinyin: Rúguǒ cóngshì mǒu xiàng gōngzuò néng lìng nǐ wàngdiào shíjiān, huòxǔ jiù kě dàngzuò yīshēng de shìyè.
B4L06-2-26.english: If being engaged in a certain job can make you forget time, perhaps it can be treated as a lifelong career.

B4L06-2-27.chinese: 有位功夫明星的動作很快，一次能踢十幾腿，真的讓人驚訝。
B4L06-2-27.pinyin: Yǒu wèi gōngfu míngxīng de dòngzuò hěn kuài, yī cì néng tī shí jǐ tuǐ, zhēn de ràng rén jīngyà.
B4L06-2-27.english: A certain kung fu star's moves are very fast; he can kick more than ten times in one go—it really surprises people.

B4L06-2-28.chinese: 國內外的社會運動，經常都是因為人民的意見不被尊重而引起的。
B4L06-2-28.pinyin: Guónèi wài de shèhuì yùndòng, jīngcháng dōu shì yīnwèi rénmín de yìjiàn bù bèi zūnjìng ér yǐnqǐ de.
B4L06-2-28.english: Social movements at home and abroad are often caused because people's opinions are not respected.

B4L06-2-29.chinese: 一個政府如果事事控制人民，沒有給人民自由，就不是個理想的政府。
B4L06-2-29.pinyin: Yī gè zhèngfǔ rúguǒ shìshì kòngzhì rénmín, méiyǒu gěi rénmín zìyóu, jiù bù shì gè lǐxiǎng de zhèngfǔ.
B4L06-2-29.english: If a government controls the people in everything and does not give the people freedom, it is not an ideal government.

B4L06-2-30.chinese: 自從他改變飲食習慣以後，就變得既健康又有活力。
B4L06-2-30.pinyin: Zìcóng tā gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn yǐhòu, jiù biàn de jì jiànkāng yòu yǒu huólì.
B4L06-2-30.english: Ever since he changed his eating habits, he has become both healthy and full of vitality.

B4L07-1-01.chinese: 說到興趣，我們全家的興趣都不同，總是你玩你的，我做我的。
B4L07-1-01.pinyin: Shuō dào xìngqù, wǒmen quánjiā de xìngqù dōu bùtóng, zǒng shì nǐ wán nǐ de, wǒ zuò wǒ de.
B4L07-1-01.english: Speaking of interests, our whole family's interests are all different; it's always you play yours, and I do mine.

B4L07-1-02.chinese: 在這家餐廳，沒有人替你服務，點菜、拿碗筷等一切都得自助。
B4L07-1-02.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng, méiyǒu rén tì nǐ fúwù, diǎncài, ná wǎnkuài děng yīqiè dōu děi zìzhù.
B4L07-1-02.english: In this restaurant, no one serves you; ordering dishes, getting bowls and chopsticks, and everything else must be self-service.

B4L07-1-03.chinese: 所謂「人助天助」的意思，就是得自己先努力，天(God,Heavens)才會幫助你。
B4L07-1-03.pinyin: Suǒwèi “rén zhù tiān zhù” de yìsi, jiù shì děi zìjǐ xiān nǔlì, tiān cái huì bāngzhù nǐ.
B4L07-1-03.english: The so-called meaning of 'people help, Heaven helps' is that you must first work hard yourself, and only then will Heaven help you.

B4L07-1-04.chinese: 春天是花開的季節，在愛情故事中，往往也是適合戀愛的季節。
B4L07-1-04.pinyin: Chūntiān shì huā kāi de jìjié, zài àiqíng gùshì zhōng, wǎngwǎng yě shì shìhé liàn'ài de jìjié.
B4L07-1-04.english: Spring is the season when flowers blossom; in love stories, it is often also the season suitable for falling in love.

B4L07-1-05.chinese: 媽媽買了鮮花來插花，她覺得插花是一門藝術，讓人欣賞到花的美。
B4L07-1-05.pinyin: Māma mǎi le xiānhuā lái chāhuā, tā juéde chāhuā shì yī mén yìshù, ràng rén xīnshǎng dào huā de měi.
B4L07-1-05.english: Mom bought fresh flowers to do flower arranging; she feels that flower arranging is an art that lets people appreciate the beauty of flowers.

B4L07-1-06.chinese: 吃飯的時候把筷子插在碗裡，會被臺灣人認為沒有規矩。
B4L07-1-06.pinyin: Chīfàn de shíhòu bǎ kuàizi chā zài wǎn lǐ, huì bèi Táiwān rén rènwéi méiyǒu guījǔ.
B4L07-1-06.english: When eating, sticking chopsticks into a bowl will be considered by Taiwanese people as having no manners.

B4L07-1-07.chinese: 這家醫院每個月都到鄉下地區免費為老人門診。
B4L07-1-07.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn měi ge yuè dōu dào xiāngxià dìqū miǎnfèi wèi lǎorén ménzhěn.
B4L07-1-07.english: This hospital goes to rural areas every month to provide free outpatient service for the elderly.

B4L07-1-08.chinese: 冷氣的溫度要是控制得剛好，不但對健康好，也能省點兒電費。
B4L07-1-08.pinyin: Lěngqì de wēndù yàoshi kòngzhì de gānghǎo, bùdàn duì jiànkāng hǎo, yě néng shěng diǎnr diànfèi.
B4L07-1-08.english: If the air conditioner's temperature is controlled to be just right, it is not only good for health but also saves a bit on electricity bills.

B4L07-1-09.chinese: 這所學校規定學生每兩週至少參加一次服務學習活動。
B4L07-1-09.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng měi liǎng zhōu zhìshǎo cānjiā yí cì fúwù xuéxí huódòng.
B4L07-1-09.english: This school requires students to participate in at least one service-learning activity every two weeks.

B4L07-1-10.chinese: 我叔叔總是說工作很累想休息，可是休了假之後又覺得無聊。
B4L07-1-10.pinyin: Wǒ shūshu zǒngshì shuō gōngzuò hěn lèi xiǎng xiūxi, kěshì xiū le jià zhīhòu yòu juéde wúliáo.
B4L07-1-10.english: My uncle always says work is tiring and he wants to rest, but after taking a vacation, he feels bored again.

B4L07-1-11.chinese: 你的身體狀況不太好，就別自己開車了，讓我送你回家。
B4L07-1-11.pinyin: Nǐ de shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng bú tài hǎo, jiù bié zìjǐ kāichē le, ràng wǒ sòng nǐ huí jiā.
B4L07-1-11.english: Your physical condition is not very good, so don't drive yourself; let me take you home.

B4L07-1-12.chinese: 參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
B4L07-1-12.pinyin: Cānjiā lǚxíngtuán huò zìzhù lǚyóu gè yǒu gè de yōudiǎn, lǎn de zìjǐ ānpái xíngchéng de rén, jiù gēnzhe dǎoyóu zǒu ba.
B4L07-1-12.english: Joining a tour group or traveling independently each has its own advantages; those who are too lazy to arrange their own itinerary should just follow the tour guide.

B4L07-1-13.chinese: 根據規定，每位旅客只能攜帶一件七公斤以下的行李上飛機。
B4L07-1-13.pinyin: Gēnjù guīdìng, měi wèi lǚkè zhǐ néng xiédài yí jiàn qī gōngjīn yǐxià de xíngli shàng fēijī.
B4L07-1-13.english: According to regulations, each traveler can only carry one piece of luggage under seven kilograms onto the plane.

B4L07-1-14.chinese: 我們工廠與那家旅行社有合作關係，廠內員工如果報名他們的旅行團，都可以享受優惠價。
B4L07-1-14.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngchǎng yǔ nà jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu hézuò guānxì, chǎng nèi yuángōng rúguǒ bàomíng tāmen de lǚxíngtuán, dōu kěyǐ xiǎngshòu yōuhuì jià.
B4L07-1-14.english: Our factory has a partnership with that travel agency; if employees sign up for their tour group, they can all enjoy a discounted price.

B4L07-1-15.chinese: 旅行團的行程及路線是公司及導遊決定的，不喜歡的話，就只能自助旅遊了。
B4L07-1-15.pinyin: Lǚxíngtuán de xíngchéng jí lùxiàn shì gōngsī jí dǎoyóu juédìng de, bù xǐhuān de huà, jiù zhǐ néng zìzhù lǚyóu le.
B4L07-1-15.english: The itinerary and route of a tour group are decided by the company and the tour guide; if you don't like it, then you can only travel independently.

B4L07-1-16.chinese: 今年學校的預算只夠修理宿舍的衛生設備，其他需要改善的只能等到明年了。
B4L07-1-16.pinyin: Jīnnián xuéxiào de yùsuàn zhǐ gòu xiūlǐ sùshè de wèishēng shèbèi, qítā xūyào gǎishàn de zhǐ néng děng dào míngnián le.
B4L07-1-16.english: This year the school's budget is only enough to repair the dormitory's sanitary facilities; other things that need improvement can only wait until next year.

B4L07-1-17.chinese: 這個旅行團的目的地是中國北京(Beijing)，旅客目的是參觀古蹟及拜訪朋友。
B4L07-1-17.pinyin: Zhège lǚxíngtuán de mùdìdì shì Zhōngguó Běijīng, lǚkè mùdì shì cānguān gǔjì jí bàifǎng péngyǒu.
B4L07-1-17.english: The destination of this tour group is Beijing, China; the travelers' purpose is to visit historical sites and visit friends.

B4L07-1-18.chinese: 這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
B4L07-1-18.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yèwǎn yīn gè zhǒng gè yàng de cǎisè dēngguāng, ér shǐde jǐngsè jì làngmàn yòu mírén.
B4L07-1-18.english: At night, this city, because of various colorful lights, makes the scenery both romantic and charming.

B4L07-1-23.chinese: 我國四季都有美麗的風景：春季時平原有花海、夏季時海灘有日出、秋季時山區有紅樹、冬季時高山有白雪，都十分迷人。
B4L07-1-23.pinyin: Wǒ guó sìjì dōu yǒu měilì de fēngjǐng: chūnjì shí píngyuán yǒu huāhǎi, xiàjì shí hǎitān yǒu rìchū, qiūjì shí shānqū yǒu hóngshù, dōngjì shí gāoshān yǒu báixuě, dōu shífēn mírén.
B4L07-1-23.english: Our country has beautiful scenery in all four seasons: in spring, the plains have seas of flowers; in summer, the beaches have sunrises; in autumn, the mountains have red trees; in winter, the high mountains have white snow—all are very charming.

B4L07-1-24.chinese: 你來得正好，請你幫我檢查這些文件，我一個人實在做不來。
B4L07-1-24.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ jiǎnchá zhèxiē wénjiàn, wǒ yí ge rén shízài zuò bù lái.
B4L07-1-24.english: You've come at just the right time; please help me check these documents—I really can't do it alone.

B4L07-1-25.chinese: 我很少到這個地區，所以對附近的路沒什麼印象。
B4L07-1-25.pinyin: Wǒ hěn shǎo dào zhège dìqū, suǒyǐ duì fùjìn de lù méi shénme yìnxiàng.
B4L07-1-25.english: I rarely come to this area, so I don't have much impression of the roads nearby.

B4L07-1-27.chinese: 白天沙漠裡的沙子很燙(to be scalded)，要是光著腳，一定會被燙傷的。
B4L07-1-27.pinyin: Báitiān shāmò lǐ de shāzi hěn tàng, yàoshi guāngzhe jiǎo, yídìng huì bèi tàngshāng de.
B4L07-1-27.english: During the day, the sand in the desert is very hot; if you go barefoot, you will definitely get burned.

B4L07-1-28.chinese: 那家中式點心店的紅豆沙包子又香又甜，我時常買來當作早餐。
B4L07-1-28.pinyin: Nà jiā zhōngshì diǎnxīn diàn de hóngdòushā bāozi yòu xiāng yòu tián, wǒ shícháng mǎi lái dàngzuò zǎocān.
B4L07-1-28.english: The red bean paste buns at that Chinese dim sum shop are both fragrant and sweet; I often buy them for breakfast.

B4L07-1-29.chinese: 我通常在家吃晚餐，只有好朋友邀請我吃飯，才會出門。
B4L07-1-29.pinyin: Wǒ tōngcháng zài jiā chī wǎncān, zhǐyǒu hǎo péngyǒu yāoqǐng wǒ chīfàn, cái huì chūmén.
B4L07-1-29.english: I usually eat dinner at home; only when a good friend invites me to eat do I go out.

B4L07-1-31.chinese: 我去英國留學時，常利用週末到旅行社打工，帶觀光客到著名的景點觀光。
B4L07-1-31.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yīngguó liúxué shí, cháng lìyòng zhōumò dào lǚxíngshè dǎgōng, dài guānguāngkè dào zhùmíng de jǐngdiǎn guānguāng.
B4L07-1-31.english: When I studied abroad in the UK, I often used weekends to work part-time at a travel agency, taking tourists sightseeing to famous attractions.

B4L07-1-32.chinese: 觀光客都說日本四季的景色都很有特色，有機會我要親自去體驗一下。
B4L07-1-32.pinyin: Guānguāngkè dōu shuō Rìběn sìjì de jǐngsè dōu hěn yǒu tèsè, yǒu jīhuì wǒ yào qīnzì qù tǐyàn yíxià.
B4L07-1-32.english: Tourists all say that Japan's scenery in all four seasons is very distinctive; if I have the chance, I want to experience it for myself.

B4L07-1-33.chinese: 鄉村生活雖然不如都市那樣方便，但風景美多了。
B4L07-1-33.pinyin: Xiāngcūn shēnghuó suīrán bùrú dūshì nàyàng fāngbiàn, dàn fēngjǐng měi duō le.
B4L07-1-33.english: Although countryside life is not as convenient as the city, the scenery is much more beautiful.

B4L07-1-34.chinese: 大自然除了有各種動植物，還有山地、平原、河流等等，這一切應該是上帝創造的。
B4L07-1-34.pinyin: Dàzìrán chúle yǒu gè zhǒng dòngzhíwù, hái yǒu shāndì, píngyuán, héliú děngděng, zhè yíqiè yīnggāi shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de.
B4L07-1-34.english: In addition to having various animals and plants, nature also has mountains, plains, rivers, and so on; all of this was presumably created by God.

B4L07-1-35.chinese: 學校每學期都帶學生到郊外旅行，體驗大自然的美好。
B4L07-1-35.pinyin: Xuéxiào měi xuéqī dōu dài xuéshēng dào jiāowài lǚxíng, tǐyàn dàzìrán de měihǎo.
B4L07-1-35.english: Every semester, the school takes students on trips to the outskirts to experience the beauty of nature.

B4L07-1-36.chinese: 在瀑布旁邊照相要看看周圍環境，別不小心掉下去了。
B4L07-1-36.pinyin: Zài pùbù pángbiān zhàoxiàng yào kànkan zhōuwéi huánjìng, bié bù xiǎoxīn diào xiàqù le.
B4L07-1-36.english: When taking photos next to a waterfall, you should look at the surrounding environment; don't accidentally fall down.

B4L07-1-37.chinese: 登山的時候得注意安全，事前多準備，才能享受登山的樂趣。
B4L07-1-37.pinyin: Dēngshān de shíhou děi zhùyì ānquán, shìqián duō zhǔnbèi, cái néng xiǎngshòu dēngshān de lèqù.
B4L07-1-37.english: When climbing a mountain, you must pay attention to safety; prepare more beforehand so you can enjoy the fun of mountain climbing.

B4L07-1-38.chinese: 要去山上看夜景的話，最好帶著手電筒。
B4L07-1-38.pinyin: Yào qù shān shàng kàn yèjǐng de huà, zuìhǎo dài zhe shǒudiàntǒng.
B4L07-1-38.english: If you want to go up the mountain to see the nightscape, it's best to bring a flashlight.

B4L07-1-39.chinese: 這處風景區非常有名，假日都擠滿了遊客。
B4L07-1-39.pinyin: Zhè chù fēngjǐngqū fēicháng yǒumíng, jiàrì dōu jǐ mǎn le yóukè.
B4L07-1-39.english: This scenic area is very famous; on holidays it is crowded with tourists.

B4L07-1-40.chinese: 上次你跟我提的事，我一點兒印象都沒有，真是不好意思。
B4L07-1-40.pinyin: Shàng cì nǐ gēn wǒ tí de shì, wǒ yìdiǎnr yìnxiàng dōu méiyǒu, zhēn shì bù hǎoyìsi.
B4L07-1-40.english: The matter you mentioned to me last time—I don't have the slightest impression of it; I'm really sorry.

B4L07-1-41.chinese: 我夢想有一天可以到世界各地旅行。
B4L07-1-41.pinyin: Wǒ mèngxiǎng yǒu yìtiān kěyǐ dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng.
B4L07-1-41.english: I dream of one day being able to travel to all parts of the world.

B4L07-1-42.chinese: 每天光說夢想，一點兒用都沒有，還是努力實現比較實在。
B4L07-1-42.pinyin: Měitiān guāng shuō mèngxiǎng, yìdiǎnr yòng dōu méiyǒu, háishì nǔlì shíxiàn bǐjiào shízài.
B4L07-1-42.english: Just talking about dreams every day is of no use at all; it's more practical to work hard to achieve them.

B4L07-1-43.chinese: 班機起飛前，服務人員都會為旅客說明應注意的安全規定。
B4L07-1-43.pinyin: Bānjī qǐfēi qián, fúwù rényuán dōu huì wèi lǚkè shuōmíng yīng zhùyì de ānquán guīdìng.
B4L07-1-43.english: Before the flight takes off, the service staff will explain the safety regulations that should be noted to the passengers.

B4L07-1-44.chinese: 我請旅行社代訂從台北直飛美國的班機，機票較貴，但能節省不少時間。
B4L07-1-44.pinyin: Wǒ qǐng lǚxíngshè dài dìng cóng Táiběi zhífēi Měiguó de bānjī, jīpiào jiào guì, dàn néng jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
B4L07-1-44.english: I asked the travel agency to book a flight from Taipei directly to the US; the ticket is more expensive, but it can save quite a bit of time.

B4L07-1-45.chinese: 這個地區的路規劃得不太理想，不僅沒有一條是直的，方向也有點兒亂，很容易就迷路了。
B4L07-1-45.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū de lù guīhuà de bú tài lǐxiǎng, bùjǐn méiyǒu yì tiáo shì zhí de, fāngxiàng yě yǒudiǎnr luàn, hěn róngyì jiù mílù le.
B4L07-1-45.english: The roads in this area are not planned very ideally; not only is there not a single straight one, but the directions are also a bit chaotic, so it's easy to get lost.

B4L07-1-46.chinese: 從國外坐飛機到臺灣來，有時需要轉機。
B4L07-1-46.pinyin: Cóng guówài zuò fēijī dào Táiwān lái, yǒushí xūyào zhuǎnjī.
B4L07-1-46.english: When flying from abroad to Taiwan, sometimes you need to transfer flights.

B4L07-1-47.chinese: 聽說那場演唱會很熱門，我們最好先預訂門票。
B4L07-1-47.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì hěn rèmén, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān yùdìng ménpiào.
B4L07-1-47.english: I heard that concert is very popular; we'd better reserve tickets in advance.

B4L07-1-48.chinese: 你的商品計畫，我可以幫你一起做，反正我晚上沒事。
B4L07-1-48.pinyin: Nǐ de shāngpǐn jìhuà, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ yìqǐ zuò, fǎnzhèng wǒ wǎnshang méi shì.
B4L07-1-48.english: I can help you work on your product plan together; anyway, I have nothing to do tonight.

B4L07-1-49.chinese: 這場大型戶外活動因為租不到合適的地方，就被取消了。
B4L07-1-49.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dàxíng hùwài huódòng yīnwèi zū bú dào héshì de dìfāng, jiù bèi qǔxiāo le.
B4L07-1-49.english: This large outdoor event was canceled because a suitable place couldn't be rented.

B4L07-1-50.chinese: 這班飛機因為天氣不穩定，所以誤點了。
B4L07-1-50.pinyin: Zhè bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì bù wěndìng, suǒyǐ wùdiǎn le.
B4L07-1-50.english: This flight was behind schedule because the weather was unstable.

B4L07-1-51.chinese: 這個題目怪難的，連老師都要想很久。
B4L07-1-51.pinyin: Zhè ge tímù guài nán de, lián lǎoshī dōu yào xiǎng hěn jiǔ.
B4L07-1-51.english: This question is quite difficult; even the teacher has to think about it for a long time.

B4L07-1-52.chinese: 現在去看第一場表演時間快來不及了，要不我們改看下一場吧。
B4L07-1-52.pinyin: Xiànzài qù kàn dì yī chǎng biǎoyǎn shíjiān kuài láibují le, yàobù wǒmen gǎi kàn xià yì chǎng ba.
B4L07-1-52.english: It's almost too late to go see the first performance now; otherwise, let's watch the next one instead.

B4L07-1-54.chinese: 那家早餐店的生意很好，你得早點(兒)去，才買得到早點。
B4L07-1-54.pinyin: Nà jiā zǎocāndiàn de shēngyì hěn hǎo, nǐ děi zǎodiǎnr qù, cái mǎi de dào zǎodiǎn.
B4L07-1-54.english: That breakfast shop does good business; you have to go a bit earlier to be able to buy breakfast.

B4L07-1-55.chinese: 老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
B4L07-1-55.pinyin: Lǎoshī bù mǎnyì wǒmen zhè yì zǔ de bàogào, yào wǒmen chóng zuò yí cì.
B4L07-1-55.english: The teacher is not satisfied with our group's report and wants us to do it again.

B4L07-1-57.chinese: 為了旅客搭機安全，機場入境、出境時都要檢查行李。
B4L07-1-57.pinyin: Wèi le lǚkè dā jī ānquán, jīchǎng rùjìng, chūjìng shí dōu yào jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
B4L07-1-57.english: For passenger flight safety, luggage must be checked when entering and leaving the country at the airport.

B4L07-1-58.chinese: 自從住校以後，我得學習自己收拾、整理房間。
B4L07-1-58.pinyin: Zìcóng zhùxiào yǐhòu, wǒ děi xuéxí zìjǐ shōushi, zhěnglǐ fángjiān.
B4L07-1-58.english: Ever since I started living at school, I have had to learn to tidy up and organize my room myself.

B4L07-1-59.chinese: 有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
B4L07-1-59.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā wèi le xīyǐn gèng duō de guānguāngkè lái lǚyóu, jiù bǎ yìxiē chūjìng, rùjìng de shǒuxù gǎi jiǎndān le.
B4L07-1-59.english: Some countries, in order to attract more tourists to travel, have simplified some exit and entry procedures.

B4L07-1-60.chinese: 開車時萬一發生車禍，千萬要冷靜，以免情況更嚴重。
B4L07-1-60.pinyin: Kāichē shí wànyī fāshēng chēhuò, qiānwàn yào lěngjìng, yǐmiǎn qíngkuàng gèng yánzhòng.
B4L07-1-60.english: If a car accident happens while driving, one must by all means stay calm, so as to avoid the situation becoming more serious.

B4L07-2-01.chinese: 我去澳洲登山時，碰見了正在自助旅行的老朋友，真巧！
B4L07-2-01.pinyin: Wǒ qù Àozhōu dēngshān shí, pèngjiàn le zhèngzài zìzhù lǚxíng de lǎo péngyou, zhēn qiǎo!
B4L07-2-01.english: When I went mountain climbing in Australia, I ran into an old friend who was traveling independently—what a coincidence!

B4L07-2-03.chinese: 行動不方便的乘客乘車時，車站有服務員為他們服務。
B4L07-2-03.pinyin: Xíngdòng bù fāngbiàn de chéngkè chéngchē shí, chēzhàn yǒu fúwùyuán wèi tāmen fúwù.
B4L07-2-03.english: When passengers with limited mobility ride the train, there are service staff at the station to serve them.

B4L07-2-04.chinese: 這家餐廳的帳單已經加了服務費了，你不必再給小費。
B4L07-2-04.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de zhàngdān yǐjīng jiā le fúwùfèi le, nǐ búbì zài gěi xiǎofèi.
B4L07-2-04.english: This restaurant's bill already includes a service charge; you don't need to give a tip.

B4L07-2-05.chinese: 有些運動中心規定個人得帶自己的毛巾，否則不可以進去。
B4L07-2-05.pinyin: Yǒuxiē yùndòng zhōngxīn guīdìng gèrén děi dài zìjǐ de máojīn, fǒuzé bù kěyǐ jìnqù.
B4L07-2-05.english: Some sports centers require individuals to bring their own towels; otherwise, they cannot enter.

B4L07-2-06.chinese: 下過雨後道路比較滑，開車時速度別太快。
B4L07-2-06.pinyin: Xià guò yǔ hòu dàolù bǐjiào huá, kāichē shí sùdù bié tài kuài.
B4L07-2-06.english: After it has rained, the road is rather slippery; when driving, don't go too fast.

B4L07-2-07.chinese: 我來教你中國功夫，我怎麼打，你就跟著照打。
B4L07-2-07.pinyin: Wǒ lái jiāo nǐ Zhōngguó gōngfu, wǒ zěnme dǎ, nǐ jiù gēnzhe zhào dǎ.
B4L07-2-07.english: I'll teach you Chinese kung fu: how I strike, you just follow and strike accordingly.

B4L07-2-08.chinese: 在熱鬧的都市裡，常見一些人在街頭表演。
B4L07-2-08.pinyin: Zài rènao de dūshì lǐ, cháng jiàn yīxiē rén zài jiētóu biǎoyǎn.
B4L07-2-08.english: In bustling cities, you often see some people performing in the street.

B4L07-2-09.chinese: 週六你到我家來寫作業，或者我們一起到圖書館去讀書也行。
B4L07-2-09.pinyin: Zhōuliù nǐ dào wǒ jiā lái xiě zuòyè, huòzhě wǒmen yīqǐ dào túshūguǎn qù dúshū yě xíng.
B4L07-2-09.english: On Saturday you can come to my house to do homework, or we can go to the library together to study—that works too.

B4L07-2-10.chinese: 天氣不穩定的時候，氣溫也時時跟著變化(to change,to vary)。
B4L07-2-10.pinyin: Tiānqì bù wěndìng de shíhou, qìwēn yě shíshí gēnzhe biànhuà.
B4L07-2-10.english: When the weather is unstable, the temperature also constantly changes along with it.

B4L07-2-11.chinese: 這條街道旁有各式各樣的商店與餐廳，假日時相當熱鬧。
B4L07-2-11.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào páng yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shāngdiàn yǔ cāntīng, jiàrì shí xiāngdāng rènao.
B4L07-2-11.english: Along this street there are all kinds of shops and restaurants; on holidays it is quite bustling.

B4L07-2-13.chinese: 缺少運動的人總是說自己太忙，缺時間去活動。
B4L07-2-13.pinyin: Quēshǎo yùndòng de rén zǒngshì shuō zìjǐ tài máng, quē shíjiān qù huódòng.
B4L07-2-13.english: People who lack exercise always say they are too busy and lack time to get active.

B4L07-2-14.chinese: 知道自己誤會別人以後，最好早一點兒跟對方道歉。
B4L07-2-14.pinyin: Zhīdào zìjǐ wùhuì biérén yǐhòu, zuì hǎo zǎo yīdiǎnr gēn duìfāng dàoqiàn.
B4L07-2-14.english: After you realize you have misunderstood someone, it's best to apologize to the other person a bit earlier.

B4L07-2-15.chinese: 我看著你只是想告訴你，你的臉上黏了東西。
B4L07-2-15.pinyin: Wǒ kànzhe nǐ zhǐshì xiǎng gàosu nǐ, nǐ de liǎn shàng zhān le dōngxi.
B4L07-2-15.english: I'm looking at you merely because I want to tell you that something is stuck on your face.

B4L07-2-16.chinese: 生日時，老婆親手織了一頂帽子送我，讓我好感動。
B4L07-2-16.pinyin: Shēngrì shí, lǎopo qīnshǒu zhī le yī dǐng màozi sòng wǒ, ràng wǒ hǎo gǎndòng.
B4L07-2-16.english: On my birthday, my wife knitted a hat with her own hands and gave it to me, which moved me very much.

B4L07-2-17.chinese: 那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
B4L07-2-17.pinyin: Nà xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjìtú nǐ yī gè rén fùzé tài xīnkǔ le, dào bùrú zhǎo tóngshì yīqǐ lái zuò.
B4L07-2-17.english: It's too hard for you to be responsible for that new product's design drawings all by yourself; it would be better to find colleagues to do it together.

B4L07-2-18.chinese: 他一直熱愛翻譯工作，不論多困難都會想辦法克服。
B4L07-2-18.pinyin: Tā yīzhí rè'ài fānyì gōngzuò, bùlùn duō kùnnan dōu huì xiǎng bànfǎ kèfú.
B4L07-2-18.english: He has always been passionate about translation work; no matter how difficult it is, he will find a way to overcome it.

B4L07-2-19.chinese: 我們吃完早餐，就動身去舞蹈教室練習舞蹈。
B4L07-2-19.pinyin: Wǒmen chī wán zǎocān, jiù dòngshēn qù wǔdǎo jiàoshì liànxí wǔdǎo.
B4L07-2-19.english: After we finished breakfast, we set off for the dance studio to practice dance.

B4L07-2-20.chinese: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
B4L07-2-20.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng bùjǐn xíngchéng fēngfù, bìngqiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bùshǎo péngyou, kuòdà le shìyě.
B4L07-2-20.english: This long-distance trip not only had a rich itinerary, but also let me make quite a few friends and broadened my horizons.

B4L08-1-01.chinese: 經理對新產品計畫的指示不太清楚，我們最好去問清楚。
B4L08-1-01.pinyin: Jīnglǐ duì xīn chǎnpǐn jìhuà de zhǐshì bù tài qīngchu, wǒmen zuì hǎo qù wèn qīngchu.
B4L08-1-01.english: The manager's instructions about the new product plan are not very clear; we'd better go ask and clarify.

B4L08-1-02.chinese: 我明天要把這份作業交給老師，遲了老師就不收了。
B4L08-1-02.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào bǎ zhè fèn zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī, chí le lǎoshī jiù bù shōu le.
B4L08-1-02.english: I need to hand this homework to the teacher tomorrow; if it's late, the teacher won't accept it.

B4L08-1-03.chinese: 生活忙碌的時候，也要給自己留一些休息時間。
B4L08-1-03.pinyin: Shēnghuó mánglù de shíhou, yě yào gěi zìjǐ liú yīxiē xiūxi shíjiān.
B4L08-1-03.english: When life is busy, you should still leave yourself some time to rest.

B4L08-1-04.chinese: 我的電腦無法上網，檢查之後才發現網路線沒有接著電腦。
B4L08-1-04.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo wúfǎ shàngwǎng, jiǎnchá zhīhòu cái fāxiàn wǎnglùxiàn méiyǒu jiēzhe diànnǎo.
B4L08-1-04.english: My computer can't get online; only after checking did I discover that the network cable was not connected to the computer.

B4L08-1-05.chinese: 我的同事遲到的次數太多了，這個月被扣了半個月的薪水。
B4L08-1-05.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngshì chídào de cìshù tài duō le, zhè ge yuè bèi kòu le bàn ge yuè de xīnshuǐ.
B4L08-1-05.english: My colleague has been late too many times; this month half a month's salary was deducted.

B4L08-1-06.chinese: 每個人都有煩惱，如果能好好處理，就能從過程中得到經驗。
B4L08-1-06.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu fánnǎo, rúguǒ néng hǎohǎo chǔlǐ, jiù néng cóng guòchéng zhōng dédào jīngyàn.
B4L08-1-06.english: Everyone has worries; if you can handle them well, you can gain experience from the process.

B4L08-1-07.chinese: 感冒要是一個星期左右還沒好，就應該去看醫生。
B4L08-1-07.pinyin: Gǎnmào yàoshi yī ge xīngqī zuǒyòu hái méi hǎo, jiù yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
B4L08-1-07.english: If a cold still hasn't gotten better after around a week, you should go see a doctor.

B4L08-1-08.chinese: 每天早上都有人在附近公園大聲唱流行歌，聽久了真的很煩。
B4L08-1-08.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang dōu yǒu rén zài fùjìn gōngyuán dàshēng chàng liúxínggē, tīng jiǔ le zhēn de hěn fán.
B4L08-1-08.english: Every morning someone sings pop songs loudly in the nearby park; after hearing it for a long time, it's really annoying.

B4L08-1-09.chinese: 主管的工作壓力往往比下面的員工更大。
B4L08-1-09.pinyin: Zhǔguǎn de gōngzuò yālì wǎngwǎng bǐ xiàmiàn de yuángōng gèng dà.
B4L08-1-09.english: A supervisor's work pressure is often greater than that of the employees below them.

B4L08-1-10.chinese: 當你心裡覺得難受的時候，可以跟好朋友聊聊。
B4L08-1-10.pinyin: Dāng nǐ xīnlǐ juéde nánshòu de shíhou, kěyǐ gēn hǎo péngyou liáoliao.
B4L08-1-10.english: When you feel upset inside, you can chat with a good friend.

B4L08-1-12.chinese: 逃避或許是解決問題的一種方式，但有些問題是你逃不了，不得不解決的。
B4L08-1-12.pinyin: Táobì huòxǔ shì jiějué wèntí de yī zhǒng fāngshì, dàn yǒuxiē wèntí shì nǐ táo bù liǎo, bùdébù jiějué de.
B4L08-1-12.english: Escaping may be one way to solve a problem, but some problems are ones you cannot escape and have no choice but to solve.

B4L08-1-13.chinese: 他的臉色白不是因為不舒服，是因為他平日很少出門。
B4L08-1-13.pinyin: Tā de liǎnsè bái bùshì yīnwèi bù shūfu, shì yīnwèi tā píngrì hěn shǎo chūmén.
B4L08-1-13.english: His complexion is pale not because he feels unwell, but because he rarely goes out on ordinary days.

B4L08-1-14.chinese: 要是你每天都坐在電腦前，不起來運動運動，遲早會生病的。
B4L08-1-14.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ měitiān dōu zuò zài diànnǎo qián, bù qǐlái yùndòng yùndòng, chízǎo huì shēngbìng de.
B4L08-1-14.english: If you sit in front of the computer every day and don't get up to exercise, sooner or later you will get sick.

B4L08-1-15.chinese: 有人一天到晚總看著手機，連錯過了精彩的生活時刻也不知道。
B4L08-1-15.pinyin: Yǒu rén yìtiāndàowǎn zǒng kànzhe shǒujī, lián cuòguòle jīngcǎi de shēnghuó shíkè yě bù zhīdào.
B4L08-1-15.english: Some people always look at their phones from morning till night, and don't even know when they've missed wonderful moments in life.

B4L08-1-16.chinese: 剛跑完步最好不要馬上坐下，這樣對心臟不好。
B4L08-1-16.pinyin: Gāng pǎowán bù zuìhǎo bùyào mǎshàng zuòxià, zhèyàng duì xīnzàng bù hǎo.
B4L08-1-16.english: Right after running, it's best not to sit down immediately; that's not good for your heart.

B4L08-1-17.chinese: 碰到危險時，人的心跳總跳得很快。
B4L08-1-17.pinyin: Pèngdào wēixiǎn shí, rén de xīntiào zǒng tiào de hěn kuài.
B4L08-1-17.english: When encountering danger, a person's heartbeat always beats very fast.

B4L08-1-18.chinese: 我的腰越來越胖，現在買的褲子尺寸比以前大了兩號。
B4L08-1-18.pinyin: Wǒ de yāo yuèláiyuè pàng, xiànzài mǎi de kùzi chǐcùn bǐ yǐqián dàle liǎng hào.
B4L08-1-18.english: My waist is getting fatter and fatter; the size of pants I buy now is two sizes larger than before.

B4L08-1-19.chinese: 聽說騎腳踏車可以讓大腿瘦一點兒。
B4L08-1-19.pinyin: Tīngshuō qí jiǎotàchē kěyǐ ràng dàtuǐ shòu yìdiǎnr.
B4L08-1-19.english: I've heard that riding a bicycle can make your thighs a little thinner.

B4L08-1-20.chinese: 我對人體各部分的功能很有興趣，不過我沒想過當醫生。
B4L08-1-20.pinyin: Wǒ duì réntǐ gè bùfèn de gōngnéng hěn yǒu xìngqù, bùguò wǒ méi xiǎngguò dāng yīshēng.
B4L08-1-20.english: I'm very interested in the functions of the various parts of the human body, but I've never thought about becoming a doctor.

B4L08-1-21.chinese: 肚子痛有時不一定是消化器官的問題，得去醫院檢查。
B4L08-1-21.pinyin: Dùzi tòng yǒushí bù yídìng shì xiāohuà qìguān de wèntí, děi qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
B4L08-1-21.english: A stomachache is sometimes not necessarily a problem with the digestive organs; you need to go to the hospital for an examination.

B4L08-1-22.chinese: 關上燈、關上手機，這麼做你才能好好休息。
B4L08-1-22.pinyin: Guānshàng dēng, guānshàng shǒujī, zhème zuò nǐ cái néng hǎohǎo xiūxi.
B4L08-1-22.english: Turn off the lights, turn off your phone—only by doing this can you get a good rest.

B4L08-1-23.chinese: 人類大腦分成幾區，有的管語言，有的管記憶，很有意思。
B4L08-1-23.pinyin: Rénlèi dànǎo fēnchéng jǐ qū, yǒude guǎn yǔyán, yǒude guǎn jìyì, hěn yǒu yìsi.
B4L08-1-23.english: The human brain is divided into several areas; some manage language, some manage memory—it's very interesting.

B4L08-1-25.chinese: 有的房子前院、後院都有花園，住起來一定很舒服。
B4L08-1-25.pinyin: Yǒude fángzi qiányuàn, hòuyuàn dōu yǒu huāyuán, zhù qǐlái yídìng hěn shūfu.
B4L08-1-25.english: Some houses have gardens in both the front yard and the backyard; living there must be very comfortable.

B4L08-1-26.chinese: 我在市場買了漂亮的花盆，可是還不知道種什麼植物比較好。
B4L08-1-26.pinyin: Wǒ zài shìchǎng mǎile piàoliang de huāpén, kěshì hái bù zhīdào zhòng shénme zhíwù bǐjiào hǎo.
B4L08-1-26.english: I bought a beautiful flower pot at the market, but I still don't know what plant would be better to grow.

B4L08-1-27.chinese: 阿溫對花草很有興趣，不論生長在平原或山地的，他都叫得出名字來。
B4L08-1-27.pinyin: Ā Wēn duì huācǎo hěn yǒu xìngqù, bùlùn shēngzhǎng zài píngyuán huò shāndì de, tā dōu jiàodechū míngzi lái.
B4L08-1-27.english: A-Wen is very interested in flowers and plants; no matter whether they grow on plains or in mountains, he can name them all.

B4L08-1-29.chinese: 那個農村裡有個小農場，他們生產的鮮奶冰淇淋非常好吃。
B4L08-1-29.pinyin: Nàge nóngcūn lǐ yǒu ge xiǎo nóngchǎng, tāmen shēngchǎn de xiānnǎi bīngqílín fēicháng hǎochī.
B4L08-1-29.english: In that village there is a small farm; the fresh milk ice cream they produce is very delicious.

B4L08-1-30.chinese: 每次我受不了工作壓力時，就會到湖邊散步，看到平靜的湖水，心裡就會平靜下來。
B4L08-1-30.pinyin: Měi cì wǒ shòubuliǎo gōngzuò yālì shí, jiù huì dào húbiān sànbù, kàndào píngjìng de húshuǐ, xīnlǐ jiù huì píngjìng xiàlái.
B4L08-1-30.english: Every time I can't stand the work pressure, I go for a walk by the lake; seeing the tranquil lake water, my heart becomes peaceful.

B4L08-1-31.chinese: 哎喲，已經半夜一點多了！我們就別再加班寫產品計畫了，等明天再繼續吧！
B4L08-1-31.pinyin: Āiyō, yǐjīng bànyè yìdiǎn duō le! Wǒmen jiù bié zài jiābān xiě chǎnpǐn jìhuà le, děng míngtiān zài jìxù ba!
B4L08-1-31.english: Woah, it's already past one in the morning! Let's stop working overtime to write the product plan, and continue tomorrow!

B4L08-1-34.chinese: 緊張的時候試著慢慢呼吸，吸一口氣，再慢慢呼出來，可以讓你輕鬆一點兒。
B4L08-1-34.pinyin: Jǐnzhāng de shíhou shìzhe mànman hūxī, xī yì kǒu qì, zài mànman hū chūlái, kěyǐ ràng nǐ qīngsōng yìdiǎnr.
B4L08-1-34.english: When you're nervous, try to breathe slowly: breathe in, then slowly breathe out—it can make you a little more relaxed.

B4L08-1-35.chinese: 曾經失去一切的人，更懂得愛惜現在擁有的一切。
B4L08-1-35.pinyin: Céngjīng shīqù yíqiè de rén, gèng dǒngde àixī xiànzài yōngyǒu de yíqiè.
B4L08-1-35.english: People who have once lost everything understand even more how to cherish everything they have now.

B4L08-1-36.chinese: 有人說好看的人像花瓶，好看卻沒有用，這句話我完全不同意。
B4L08-1-36.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō hǎokàn de rén xiàng huāpíng, hǎokàn què méiyǒu yòng, zhè jù huà wǒ wánquán bù tóngyì.
B4L08-1-36.english: Some people say that good-looking people are like flower vases—good-looking but useless; I completely disagree with this statement.

B4L08-1-37.chinese: 自己做的肥皂用起來比較安心，也能選擇自己喜歡的氣味。
B4L08-1-37.pinyin: Zìjǐ zuò de féizào yòng qǐlái bǐjiào ānxīn, yě néng xuǎnzé zìjǐ xǐhuan de qìwèi.
B4L08-1-37.english: Soap made by yourself feels safer to use, and you can also choose the scent you like.

B4L08-1-38.chinese: 那道菜一點兒都不鹹，我猜或許是忘了放鹽巴。
B4L08-1-38.pinyin: Nà dào cài yìdiǎnr dōu bù xián, wǒ cāi huòxǔ shì wàngle fàng yánbā.
B4L08-1-38.english: That dish isn't salty at all; I guess maybe they forgot to add salt.

B4L08-1-39.chinese: 你彈吉他彈得真不錯，如果你願意教我，我想跟你學。
B4L08-1-39.pinyin: Nǐ tán jítā tán de zhēn búcuò, rúguǒ nǐ yuànyì jiāo wǒ, wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ xué.
B4L08-1-39.english: You play the guitar really well; if you're willing to teach me, I'd like to learn from you.

B4L08-1-40.chinese: 我國四十歲以下的單身女性人數，比去年增加了百分之十。
B4L08-1-40.pinyin: Wǒ guó sìshí suì yǐxià de dānshēn nǚxìng rénshù, bǐ qùnián zēngjiāle bǎifēnzhī shí.
B4L08-1-40.english: The number of single women under forty in our country increased by ten percent compared to last year.

B4L08-1-41.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
B4L08-1-41.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
B4L08-1-41.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

B4L08-1-42.chinese: 小王追求祝小姐好幾年了，不過祝小姐一直只把她當好友。
B4L08-1-42.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng zhuīqiú Zhù xiǎojiě hǎo jǐ nián le, búguò Zhù xiǎojiě yìzhí zhǐ bǎ tā dāng hǎoyǒu.
B4L08-1-42.english: Xiao Wang has been pursuing Miss Zhu for several years, but Miss Zhu has always only regarded him as a good friend.

B4L08-1-43.chinese: 錢先生買了一只上百萬的鑽石戒指，當成跟女友求婚的禮物。
B4L08-1-43.pinyin: Qián xiānsheng mǎi le yì zhī shàng bǎi wàn de zuànshí jièzhǐ, dāngchéng gēn nǚyǒu qiúhūn de lǐwù.
B4L08-1-43.english: Mr. Qian bought a diamond ring worth over a million, considering it a gift to propose to his girlfriend.

B4L08-1-44.chinese: 電視臺播出的娛樂節目多半是唱歌跳舞的表演，能讓觀眾心情愉快。
B4L08-1-44.pinyin: Diànshìtái bōchū de yúlè jiémù duōbàn shì chànggē tiàowǔ de biǎoyǎn, néng ràng guānzhòng xīnqíng yúkuài.
B4L08-1-44.english: Most of the entertainment programs broadcast by TV stations are singing and dancing performances, which can make the audience feel happy.

B4L08-1-45.chinese: 路教授最近發表的這套跟人體大腦有關的理論，令其他科學家很感興趣。
B4L08-1-45.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zuìjìn fābiǎo de zhè tào gēn réntǐ dànǎo yǒuguān de lǐlùn, lìng qítā kēxuéjiā hěn gǎn xìngqù.
B4L08-1-45.english: This set of theories related to the human brain recently published by Professor Lu has made other scientists very interested.

B4L08-1-46.chinese: 有時候只要什麼都不想，好好睡一覺，就能讓人們紓壓。
B4L08-1-46.pinyin: Yǒu shíhòu zhǐyào shénme dōu bù xiǎng, hǎohǎo shuì yí jiào, jiù néng ràng rénmen shūyā.
B4L08-1-46.english: Sometimes as long as you don't think about anything and just get a good sleep, it can relieve people's stress.

B4L08-1-47.chinese: 時間有時能消除煩惱，不能解決的事就暫時放在一邊吧。
B4L08-1-47.pinyin: Shíjiān yǒu shí néng xiāochú fánnǎo, bù néng jiějué de shì jiù zànshí fàng zài yìbiān ba.
B4L08-1-47.english: Time can sometimes eliminate worries; for things that can't be solved, just put them aside for the time being.

B4L08-1-48.chinese: A:你說自己沒有想做的事，難道你沒有夢想嗎？ B:我只想簡單過生活，再說，沒有夢想難道不行嗎？
B4L08-1-48.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō zìjǐ méiyǒu xiǎng zuò de shì, nándào nǐ méiyǒu mèngxiǎng ma? B: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng jiǎndān guò shēnghuó, zàishuō, méiyǒu mèngxiǎng nándào bùxíng ma?
B4L08-1-48.english: A: You say you have nothing you want to do—don't you have dreams? B: I just want to live a simple life; besides, is it not okay to have no dreams?

B4L08-1-49.chinese: 我常跟電腦下棋，因為想玩就玩，不必擔心時間早晚。
B4L08-1-49.pinyin: Wǒ cháng gēn diànnǎo xiàqí, yīnwèi xiǎng wán jiù wán, búbì dānxīn shíjiān zǎowǎn.
B4L08-1-49.english: I often play chess with the computer, because I can play whenever I want, and I don't need to worry about the time of day.

B4L08-1-50.chinese: 每個人都得經驗老病死，這些都是自然發生，避免不了的。
B4L08-1-50.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu děi jīngyàn lǎo bìng sǐ, zhèxiē dōu shì zìrán fāshēng, bìmiǎn bù liǎo de.
B4L08-1-50.english: Everyone must experience aging, illness, and death; these happen naturally and cannot be avoided.

B4L08-1-51.chinese: 這一盤棋你下得真好，你一定花了很多工夫研究。
B4L08-1-51.pinyin: Zhè yì pán qí nǐ xià de zhēn hǎo, nǐ yídìng huā le hěn duō gōngfu yánjiū.
B4L08-1-51.english: You played this game of chess really well; you must have spent a lot of effort studying.

B4L08-1-52.chinese: 昨天電視臺的氣象報告說今天會下雨，果然一大早就下起雨來了。
B4L08-1-52.pinyin: Zuótiān diànshìtái de qìxiàng bàogào shuō jīntiān huì xiàyǔ, guǒrán yí dàzǎo jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
B4L08-1-52.english: Yesterday the TV station's weather report said it would rain today, and just as expected, it started raining early in the morning.

B4L08-1-53.chinese: 看見有困難的人們，有能力的話就得想辦法幫助他們，不應該不理他們。
B4L08-1-53.pinyin: Kànjiàn yǒu kùnnán de rénmen, yǒu nénglì de huà jiù děi xiǎng bànfǎ bāngzhù tāmen, bù yīnggāi bù lǐ tāmen.
B4L08-1-53.english: When you see people in difficulty, if you are able, you should think of ways to help them; you shouldn't pay no attention to them.

B4L08-1-54.chinese: 一失眠就吃藥不是好辦法，最好跟醫生談談，試著找出原因。
B4L08-1-54.pinyin: Yì shīmián jiù chī yào bú shì hǎo bànfǎ, zuìhǎo gēn yīshēng tántán, shìzhe zhǎo chū yuányīn.
B4L08-1-54.english: Taking medicine as soon as you suffer from insomnia is not a good solution; it's best to talk with a doctor and try to find the cause.

B4L08-2-01.chinese: 我沒有帶大門的鑰匙，不得不攀牆進去。
