B4L08-2-01.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu dài dàmén de yàoshi, bùdébù pān qiáng jìnqù.
B4L08-2-01.english: I didn't bring the key to the main door, so I had no choice but to climb over the wall to get in.

B4L08-2-02.chinese: 今天海邊的浪不大，不適合去衝浪。
B4L08-2-02.pinyin: Jīntiān hǎibiān de làng bú dà, bú shìhé qù chōnglàng.
B4L08-2-02.english: The waves at the beach are not big today, so it's not suitable to go surfing.

B4L08-2-03.chinese: 開會時他遲到了，只好悄悄地坐在會議室後面。
B4L08-2-03.pinyin: Kāihuì shí tā chídào le, zhǐhǎo qiāoqiāo de zuò zài huìyìshì hòumiàn.
B4L08-2-03.english: He was late for the meeting, so he had no choice but to quietly sit at the back of the conference room.

B4L08-2-04.chinese: 自殺或許能令個人不再受到痛苦，但卻把痛苦留給了身邊的人。
B4L08-2-04.pinyin: Zìshā huòxǔ néng lìng gèrén bú zài shòudào tòngkǔ, dàn què bǎ tòngkǔ liú gěi le shēnbiān de rén.
B4L08-2-04.english: Suicide may be able to make the individual no longer suffer pain, but it leaves the pain to the people around them.

B4L08-2-05.chinese: 我愛看漫畫，在漫畫裡可以看見許多人們還沒實現的夢想。
B4L08-2-05.pinyin: Wǒ ài kàn mànhuà, zài mànhuà lǐ kěyǐ kànjiàn xǔduō rénmen hái méi shíxiàn de mèngxiǎng.
B4L08-2-05.english: I love reading comics; in comics, you can see many dreams that people have not yet realized.

B4L08-2-06.chinese: 喜劇中的男女主角，不論相處過程中碰到多少挫折，結局總是快樂又幸福的。
B4L08-2-06.pinyin: Xǐjù zhōng de nánnǚ zhǔjiǎo, búlùn xiāngchǔ guòchéng zhōng pèngdào duōshǎo cuòzhé, jiéjú zǒngshì kuàilè yòu xìngfú de.
B4L08-2-06.english: In comedies, no matter how many setbacks the male and female leads encounter during their time together, the ending is always happy and blissful.

B4L08-2-07.chinese: 考完試以後，我們去海洋公園開開心心地玩一場吧。
B4L08-2-07.pinyin: Kǎo wán shì yǐhòu, wǒmen qù hǎiyáng gōngyuán kāikāixīnxīn de wán yì chǎng ba.
B4L08-2-07.english: After the exam is over, let's go to Ocean Park and have a fun time.

B4L08-2-08.chinese: 露營時我沒帶枕頭，只好把背包當作枕頭，睡起來挺不舒服的。
B4L08-2-08.pinyin: Lùyíng shí wǒ méi dài zhěntou, zhǐhǎo bǎ bēibāo dàngzuò zhěntou, shuì qǐlái tǐng bù shūfu de.
B4L08-2-08.english: When camping, I didn't bring a pillow, so I had to use my backpack as a pillow; sleeping was quite uncomfortable.

B4L08-2-09.chinese: 他本來是一滴酒都不碰的人，你就別再叫他喝了。
B4L08-2-09.pinyin: Tā běnlái shì yì dī jiǔ dōu bú pèng de rén, nǐ jiù bié zài jiào tā hē le.
B4L08-2-09.english: He is originally a person who doesn't touch even a drop of alcohol, so don't ask him to drink anymore.

B4L08-2-10.chinese: 我曾經在賣精油的商店服務過一段時間。
B4L08-2-10.pinyin: Wǒ céngjīng zài mài jīngyóu de shāngdiàn fúwù guò yí duàn shíjiān.
B4L08-2-10.english: I once worked at a store that sells essential oils for a period of time.

B4L08-2-11.chinese: 在天氣好的夜晚，星光看起來更加浪漫。
B4L08-2-11.pinyin: Zài tiānqì hǎo de yèwǎn, xīngguāng kàn qǐlái gèngjiā làngmàn.
B4L08-2-11.english: On nights with good weather, the starlight looks even more romantic.

B4L08-2-12.chinese: 為了拍跟武術有關的電影，那位美國明星到中國學習了半年的中國功夫。
B4L08-2-12.pinyin: Wèile pāi gēn wǔshù yǒuguān de diànyǐng, nà wèi Měiguó míngxīng dào Zhōngguó xuéxí le bàn nián de Zhōngguó gōngfu.
B4L08-2-12.english: In order to shoot a movie related to martial arts, that American star went to China to study Chinese kung fu for half a year.

B4L08-2-13.chinese: 一般來說，到舞廳跳舞的多數是年輕人。
B4L08-2-13.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, dào wǔtīng tiàowǔ de duōshù shì niánqīngrén.
B4L08-2-13.english: Generally speaking, most of those who go to the dance hall to dance are young people.

B4L08-2-14.chinese: 這場籃球比賽我們贏了對方二十分，真是太痛快了。
B4L08-2-14.pinyin: Zhè chǎng lánqiú bǐsài wǒmen yíng le duìfāng èrshí fēn, zhēn shì tài tòngkuài le.
B4L08-2-14.english: We won this basketball game against the other team by twenty points—it was really so exhilarating!

B4L08-2-15.chinese: 我聽見有人在敲門，你去看看是誰來了。
B4L08-2-15.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn yǒu rén zài qiāo mén, nǐ qù kànkan shì shéi lái le.
B4L08-2-15.english: I hear someone knocking at the door—go see who has come.

B4L08-2-16.chinese: 他做運動時手甩得太用力，把手錶都甩得飛出去了。
B4L08-2-16.pinyin: Tā zuò yùndòng shí shǒu shuǎi de tài yònglì, bǎ shǒubiǎo dōu shuǎi de fēi chūqù le.
B4L08-2-16.english: When he was exercising, he swung his arms too forcefully and swung his watch flying off.

B4L08-2-17.chinese: 我的朋友會理頭髮，為了省錢我們常常去找他。
B4L08-2-17.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu huì lǐ tóufa, wèile shěng qián wǒmen chángcháng qù zhǎo tā.
B4L08-2-17.english: My friend can cut hair; in order to save money, we often go to him.

B4L08-2-18.chinese: 以前學校規定女學生的髮型都要一樣，而且長度不能超過耳朵。
B4L08-2-18.pinyin: Yǐqián xuéxiào guīdìng nǚ xuéshēng de fàxíng dōu yào yīyàng, érqiě chángdù bùnéng chāoguò ěrduo.
B4L08-2-18.english: In the past, the school required that female students' hairstyles all be the same, and the length could not exceed the ears.

B4L08-2-19.chinese: 他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
B4L08-2-19.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén nénglì yǐ dádào xiāngdāng hǎo de shuǐzhǔn, zài Táiwān niàn yánjiūsuǒ méi wèntí.
B4L08-2-19.english: His Chinese ability has already reached a fairly good level; studying at a graduate school in Taiwan is no problem.

B4L08-2-20.chinese: 每年安排一段時間去旅行，說不定能帶給你更豐富的生活。
B4L08-2-20.pinyin: Měi nián ānpái yī duàn shíjiān qù lǚxíng, shuōbudìng néng dài gěi nǐ gèng fēngfù de shēnghuó.
B4L08-2-20.english: If you arrange a period of time to travel every year, it might bring you a richer life.

B4L08-2-21.chinese: 我們無法控制別人的行為，卻能夠改變自己的想法。
B4L08-2-21.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ kòngzhì biérén de xíngwéi, què nénggòu gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
B4L08-2-21.english: We cannot control other people's behavior, but we can change our own thoughts.

B4L08-2-22.chinese: 公司上頭要求小張一個人完成任務，同事們都認為有點兒勉強。
B4L08-2-22.pinyin: Gōngsī shàngtóu yāoqiú Xiǎo Zhāng yī gè rén wánchéng rènwu, tóngshìmen dōu rènwéi yǒudiǎnr miǎnqiǎng.
B4L08-2-22.english: The company higher-ups asked Xiao Zhang to complete the task alone; his colleagues all thought it was a bit of a stretch.

B4L08-2-23.chinese: 你不需要事事都跟別人做比較，自己過得輕鬆愉快就好。
B4L08-2-23.pinyin: Nǐ bù xūyào shìshì dōu gēn biérén zuò bǐjiào, zìjǐ guò de qīngsōng yúkuài jiù hǎo.
B4L08-2-23.english: You don't need to compare yourself with others in everything; it's fine as long as you live relaxed and happy.

B4L09-1-01.chinese: 你既然把工廠交給他，就得放手讓他去管理。
B4L09-1-01.pinyin: Nǐ jìrán bǎ gōngchǎng jiāo gěi tā, jiù děi fàngshǒu ràng tā qù guǎnlǐ.
B4L09-1-01.english: Since you've handed the factory over to him, you must let go and let him manage it.

B4L09-1-02.chinese: 如果遇到無法處理的心理問題，最好請專業人員來輔導。
B4L09-1-02.pinyin: Rúguǒ yùdào wúfǎ chǔlǐ de xīnlǐ wèntí, zuìhǎo qǐng zhuānyè rényuán lái fǔdǎo.
B4L09-1-02.english: If you encounter psychological problems you cannot handle, it's best to ask professionals to give guidance.

B4L09-1-03.chinese: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
B4L09-1-03.pinyin: Cóng xiǎoshíhou qǐ, tā de dì-yī zhìyuàn jiùshì dāng yī wèi bǎohù guójiā de jūnrén.
B4L09-1-03.english: Since childhood, his first aspiration has been to be a soldier who protects the country.

B4L09-1-04.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
B4L09-1-04.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
B4L09-1-04.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

B4L09-1-05.chinese: 林老師是我的高中導師，在學習上也是影響我最深的人。
B4L09-1-05.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī shì wǒ de gāozhōng dǎoshī, zài xuéxí shàng yěshì yǐngxiǎng wǒ zuì shēn de rén.
B4L09-1-05.english: Teacher Lin was my high school homeroom teacher and is also the person who has influenced me most in my studies.

B4L09-1-06.chinese: 每次有人拜託他幫忙，他都沒拒絕過，因此大家都說他是「好好先生」(yes-man)。
B4L09-1-06.pinyin: Měi cì yǒu rén bàituō tā bāngmáng, tā dōu méi jùjué guò, yīncǐ dàjiā dōu shuō tā shì “hǎohǎo xiānshēng”.
B4L09-1-06.english: Every time someone asks him for help, he has never refused, so everyone calls him a "yes-man."

B4L09-1-07.chinese: 在照顧及教育孩子上，父母都具有相同的法律義務。
B4L09-1-07.pinyin: Zài zhàogù jí jiàoyù háizi shàng, fùmǔ dōu jùyǒu xiāngtóng de fǎlǜ yìwù.
B4L09-1-07.english: In caring for and educating children, both parents have the same legal obligation.

B4L09-1-08.chinese: 我從沒去過澳洲，無法想像那裡的景色有多美。
B4L09-1-08.pinyin: Wǒ cóng méi qùguò Àozhōu, wúfǎ xiǎngxiàng nàlǐ de jǐngsè yǒu duō měi.
B4L09-1-08.english: I have never been to Australia and cannot imagine how beautiful the scenery there is.

B4L09-1-09.chinese: 本地社區的房子常被好奇的觀光客破壞，令人們十分不滿。
B4L09-1-09.pinyin: Běndì shèqū de fángzi cháng bèi hàoqí de guānguāngkè pòhuài, lìng rénmen shífēn bùmǎn.
B4L09-1-09.english: Houses in the local community are often damaged by curious tourists, which makes people very dissatisfied.

B4L09-1-10.chinese: 在指導演員的表達方式上，這位導演的經驗相當豐富。
B4L09-1-10.pinyin: Zài zhǐdǎo yǎnyuán de biǎodá fāngshì shàng, zhè wèi dǎoyǎn de jīngyàn xiāngdāng fēngfù.
B4L09-1-10.english: In guiding actors' ways of expression, this director's experience is quite rich.

B4L09-1-11.chinese: 如果想當語言教師，得先考取教師證書，將來找工作較順利。
B4L09-1-11.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dāng yǔyán jiàoshī, děi xiān kǎoqǔ jiàoshī zhèngshū, jiānglái zhǎo gōngzuò jiào shùnlì.
B4L09-1-11.english: If you want to be a language teacher, you must first pass the exam to obtain a teaching certificate; then finding a job in the future will be smoother.

B4L09-1-12.chinese: 有時一個人的前途無法先規劃好，必須自己創造。
B4L09-1-12.pinyin: Yǒushí yī gè rén de qiántú wúfǎ xiān guīhuà hǎo, bìxū zìjǐ chuàngzào.
B4L09-1-12.english: Sometimes a person's prospects cannot be planned out in advance; one must create them oneself.

B4L09-1-13.chinese: 有些事明明不對，卻因沒人敢說，久了以後就被社會接受了。
B4L09-1-13.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì míngmíng bù duì, què yīn méi rén gǎn shuō, jiǔ le yǐhòu jiù bèi shèhuì jiēshòu le.
B4L09-1-13.english: Some things are obviously wrong, yet because no one dares to speak up, after a long time they are accepted by society.

B4L09-1-14.chinese: 部分大學科系對學生成績的要求非常高，畢業條件也較嚴格。
B4L09-1-14.pinyin: Bùfèn dàxué kēxì duì xuéshēng chéngjì de yāoqiú fēicháng gāo, bìyè tiáojiàn yě jiào yángé.
B4L09-1-14.english: Some university departments have very high requirements for student grades, and graduation conditions are also stricter.

B4L09-1-15.chinese: 花蓮太魯閣的確很漂亮，難怪每年都吸引許多觀光客去參觀。
B4L09-1-15.pinyin: Huālián Tàilǔgé dequè hěn piàoliang, nánguài měinián dōu xīyǐn xǔduō guānguāngkè qù cānguān.
B4L09-1-15.english: Hualien's Taroko Gorge is indeed very beautiful; no wonder it attracts many tourists to visit every year.

B4L09-1-16.chinese: 夏天在海灘上踏著浪散步，是一件非常享受的事。
B4L09-1-16.pinyin: Xiàtiān zài hǎitān shàng tà zhe làng sànbù, shì yí jiàn fēicháng xiǎngshòu de shì.
B4L09-1-16.english: In summer, strolling on the beach while stepping on the waves is a very enjoyable thing.

B4L09-1-17.chinese: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
B4L09-1-17.pinyin: Dāng nǐ miànlín kùnnán huò tiǎozhàn shí, yě zhèng shì biǎoxiàn gèrén zhìhuì yǔ nénglì de zuì jiā shíkè.
B4L09-1-17.english: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also exactly the best moment to demonstrate personal wisdom and ability.

B4L09-1-18.chinese: 在意外的發生原因沒查清楚之前，別隨便冤枉任何人。
B4L09-1-18.pinyin: Zài yìwài de fāshēng yuányīn méi chá qīngchu zhīqián, bié suíbiàn yuānwang rènhé rén.
B4L09-1-18.english: Before the cause of the accident is clearly investigated, don't wrongly accuse anyone casually.

B4L09-1-19.chinese: 你正好說出了我的心裡話，真是我的知心好友。
B4L09-1-19.pinyin: Nǐ zhènghǎo shuōchū le wǒ de xīnlihuà, zhēn shì wǒ de zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
B4L09-1-19.english: You happened to say exactly what's in my heart; you are truly my close friend.

B4L09-1-20.chinese: 伯父的孩子是對雙胞胎，不只是樣子，連說話的聲音都像。
B4L09-1-20.pinyin: Bófù de háizi shì duì shuāngbāotāi, bù zhǐshì yàngzi, lián shuōhuà de shēngyīn dōu xiàng.
B4L09-1-20.english: My uncle's children are a pair of twins; not only do they look alike, even their speaking voices are similar.

B4L09-1-21.chinese: 自從去年伯母退休後，就帶著伯父到處去旅行了。
B4L09-1-21.pinyin: Zìcóng qùnián bómǔ tuìxiū hòu, jiù dàizhe bófù dàochù qù lǚxíng le.
B4L09-1-21.english: Ever since my aunt retired last year, she has been taking my uncle traveling everywhere.

B4L09-1-22.chinese: 假如失去了人民的信心與支持，國家也會變得不安定。
B4L09-1-22.pinyin: Jiǎrú shīqù le rénmín de xìnxīn yǔ zhīchí, guójiā yě huì biàn de bù āndìng.
B4L09-1-22.english: If it loses the people's confidence and support, the country will also become unstable.

B4L09-1-23.chinese: 我們應該培養獨立思考的能力，別被身邊各種訊息左右。
B4L09-1-23.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi péiyǎng dúlì sīkǎo de nénglì, bié bèi shēnbiān gèzhǒng xùnxī zuǒyòu.
B4L09-1-23.english: We should cultivate the ability to think independently; don't be controlled by all kinds of information around you.

B4L09-1-24.chinese: 他今天去傳統市場買菜，特別做了拿手菜招待好友。
B4L09-1-24.pinyin: Tā jīntiān qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi cài, tèbié zuò le náshǒucài zhāodài hǎoyǒu.
B4L09-1-24.english: Today he went to the traditional market to buy groceries and especially made his specialty dishes to entertain good friends.

B4L09-1-25.chinese: 有些國家機場對攜帶物品的規定很嚴，出國前最好了解清楚。
B4L09-1-25.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā jīchǎng duì xiédài wùpǐn de guīdìng hěn yán, chūguó qián zuìhǎo liǎojiě qīngchu.
B4L09-1-25.english: Some countries' airports have very strict regulations on carried items; before going abroad, it's best to understand them clearly.

B4L09-1-26.chinese: 他一有不順心的事，就會嘮叨個沒完，有時真讓人受不了。
B4L09-1-26.pinyin: Tā yì yǒu bú shùnxīn de shì, jiù huì láodao ge méiwán, yǒushí zhēn ràng rén shòu bù liǎo.
B4L09-1-26.english: Whenever he has something unpleasant, he will nag endlessly; sometimes it really is unbearable.

B4L09-1-28.chinese: 到外面做了丟人的事，自己和家人也會覺得丟臉。
B4L09-1-28.pinyin: Dào wàimiàn zuò le diūrén de shì, zìjǐ hé jiārén yě huì juéde diūliǎn.
B4L09-1-28.english: If you go out and do something shameful, you and your family will also feel disgraced.

B4L09-1-29.chinese: 如果真心愛對方，就不必在乎對方的樣子與生活背景。
B4L09-1-29.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhēnxīn ài duìfāng, jiù búbì zàihu duìfāng de yàngzi yǔ shēnghuó bèijǐng.
B4L09-1-29.english: If you truly love the other person, you don't need to care about their appearance and background.

B4L09-1-30.chinese: 在處理那位顧客的問題上，餐廳的態度真令我失望。
B4L09-1-30.pinyin: Zài chǔlǐ nà wèi gùkè de wèntí shàng, cāntīng de tàidù zhēn lìng wǒ shīwàng.
B4L09-1-30.english: In handling that customer's problem, the restaurant's attitude really disappointed me.

B4L09-1-31.chinese: 申請留學的過程中，最讓人操心的可能就是寫讀書計畫了。
B4L09-1-31.pinyin: Shēnqǐng liúxué de guòchéng zhōng, zuì ràng rén cāoxīn de kěnéng jiù shì xiě dúshū jìhuà le.
B4L09-1-31.english: In the process of applying to study abroad, what worries people the most is probably writing the study plan.

B4L09-1-32.chinese: 我想了許多辦法去達成公司的目標，卻還是得不到主管的支持。
B4L09-1-32.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng le xǔduō bànfǎ qù dáchéng gōngsī de mùbiāo, què háishì dé bú dào zhǔguǎn de zhīchí.
B4L09-1-32.english: I thought of many ways to achieve the company's goal, but still couldn't get the supervisor's support.

B4L09-1-33.chinese: 如果說能回到過去，我最想放下工作，追求自己的興趣。
B4L09-1-33.pinyin: Rúguǒshuō néng huídào guòqù, wǒ zuì xiǎng fàngxià gōngzuò, zhuīqiú zìjǐ de xìngqù.
B4L09-1-33.english: If I could return to the past, I would most want to set aside work and pursue my own interests.

B4L09-1-34.chinese: 在古代，國王所說的話是絕對的，也是最高的命令。
B4L09-1-34.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, guówáng suǒ shuō de huà shì juéduì de, yě shì zuì gāo de mìnglìng.
B4L09-1-34.english: In ancient times, what the king said was absolute and also the highest command.

B4L09-1-35.chinese: 國王命下面的人死，那些人就非死不可。
B4L09-1-35.pinyin: Guówáng mìng xiàmiàn de rén sǐ, nàxiē rén jiù fēi sǐ bùkě.
B4L09-1-35.english: If the king ordered the people below to die, those people had no choice but to die.

B4L09-1-36.chinese: 每次當我們在學習華語上遇到困難，老師總是耐心地教導大家。
B4L09-1-36.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒmen zài xuéxí Huáyǔ shàng yùdào kùnnán, lǎoshī zǒngshì nàixīn de jiàodǎo dàjiā.
B4L09-1-36.english: Every time we encounter difficulties in learning Chinese, the teacher always patiently teaches everyone.

B4L09-1-37.chinese: 好的開始是成功的一半，第一步往往最重要。
B4L09-1-37.pinyin: Hǎo de kāishǐ shì chénggōng de yíbàn, dì yī bù wǎngwǎng zuì zhòngyào.
B4L09-1-37.english: A good beginning is half of success; the first step is often the most important.

B4L09-1-38.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
B4L09-1-38.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
B4L09-1-38.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

B4L09-1-39.chinese: 我逛街時經過了一排小吃攤，就買幾樣回來當作宵夜。
B4L09-1-39.pinyin: Wǒ guàngjiē shí jīngguò le yì pái xiǎochītān, jiù mǎi jǐ yàng huílái dàngzuò xiāoyè.
B4L09-1-39.english: When I was shopping, I passed a row of food stalls and bought a few items to bring back as a late-night snack.

B4L09-1-40.chinese: 妳去面試時稍微化妝一下，是一種禮貌。
B4L09-1-40.pinyin: Nǐ qù miànshì shí shāowēi huàzhuāng yíxià, shì yì zhǒng lǐmào.
B4L09-1-40.english: When you go for an interview, putting on a little makeup is a kind of courtesy.

B4L09-1-41.chinese: 經過我的說明，他反而有些糊塗了，看來我的解釋不太清楚。
B4L09-1-41.pinyin: Jīngguò wǒ de shuōmíng, tā fǎn'ér yǒuxiē hútú le, kànlái wǒ de jiěshì bù tài qīngchu.
B4L09-1-41.english: After my explanation, he actually became somewhat confused; it seems my explanation wasn't very clear.

B4L09-1-42.chinese: 為了發展個人事業而放下學業，多數人是很難做到的。
B4L09-1-42.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gèrén shìyè ér fàngxià xuéyè, duōshù rén shì hěn nán zuòdào de.
B4L09-1-42.english: To give up one's studies in order to develop a personal career is something most people find very hard to do.

B4L09-1-43.chinese: 去旅行的話，我有法子讓你用最少的預算擁有最豐富的行程。
B4L09-1-43.pinyin: Qù lǚxíng de huà, wǒ yǒu fǎzi ràng nǐ yòng zuì shǎo de yùsuàn yǒngyǒu zuì fēngfù de xíngchéng.
B4L09-1-43.english: If you go traveling, I have a way to let you have the richest itinerary with the smallest budget.

B4L09-1-44.chinese: 小王的閱讀報告寫得很精彩，連教授都在課堂上當面誇獎他。
B4L09-1-44.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng de yuèdú bàogào xiě de hěn jīngcǎi, lián jiàoshòu dōu zài kètáng shàng dāngmiàn kuājiǎng tā.
B4L09-1-44.english: Xiao Wang's reading report was written wonderfully; even the professor praised him to his face in class.

B4L09-1-45.chinese: 除非別人願意，否則你不該強迫其他人全按你的意見做事。
B4L09-1-45.pinyin: Chúfēi biérén yuànyì, fǒuzé nǐ bù gāi qiángpò qítā rén quán àn nǐ de yìjiàn zuòshì.
B4L09-1-45.english: Unless others are willing, otherwise you should not force other people to do everything according to your opinion.

B4L09-1-46.chinese: 根據手機公司的分析，明年大尺寸手機的市場需求會提高五倍以上。
B4L09-1-46.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒujī gōngsī de fēnxī, míngnián dà chǐcùn shǒujī de shìchǎng xūqiú huì tígāo wǔ bèi yǐshàng.
B4L09-1-46.english: According to the cell phone company's analysis, next year the market demand for large-size cell phones will increase by more than five times.

B4L09-1-47.chinese: 最近酒後開車的車禍新聞越來越多，政府得好好處罰這些人。
B4L09-1-47.pinyin: Zuìjìn jiǔhòu kāichē de chēhuò xīnwén yuè lái yuè duō, zhèngfǔ děi hǎohǎo chǔfá zhèxiē rén.
B4L09-1-47.english: Recently there has been more and more news of car accidents from drunk driving; the government must properly punish these people.

B4L09-1-49.chinese: 我跟他的個性、想法都合得來，就是飲食習慣合不來。
B4L09-1-49.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā de gèxìng, xiǎngfǎ dōu hé de lái, jiùshì yǐnshí xíguàn hé bù lái.
B4L09-1-49.english: He and I get along in personality and ideas, but it's just our eating habits that are incompatible.

B4L09-1-50.chinese: 這家醫院的規定一條又一條的，看得我眼睛都累了。
B4L09-1-50.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de guīdìng yī tiáo yòu yī tiáo de, kàn de wǒ yǎnjing dōu lèi le.
B4L09-1-50.english: This hospital's regulations are one article after another; reading them made my eyes tired.

B4L09-1-51.chinese: 外面風大，最好穿件外套出門，免得感冒了。
B4L09-1-51.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà, zuìhǎo chuān jiàn wàitào chūmén, miǎnde gǎnmào le.
B4L09-1-51.english: It's windy outside; it's best to put on a jacket before going out, so as not to catch a cold.

B4L09-2-01.chinese: 教授學生做人的道理與教授知識同樣重要。
B4L09-2-01.pinyin: Jiàoshòu xuéshēng zuòrén de dàolǐ yǔ jiàoshòu zhīshì tóngyàng zhòngyào.
B4L09-2-01.english: Instructing students in the principles of how to conduct themselves is just as important as instructing them in knowledge.

B4L09-2-02.chinese: 經過兩段不幸的感情生活，那位女士對愛情已失去了信心。
B4L09-2-02.pinyin: Jīngguò liǎng duàn bùxìng de gǎnqíng shēnghuó, nà wèi nǚshì duì àiqíng yǐ shīqù le xìnxīn.
B4L09-2-02.english: After two unfortunate romantic relationships, that lady has already lost confidence in love.

B4L09-2-03.chinese: 我爸爸認為我們這一代做事不夠積極，缺少耐心。
B4L09-2-03.pinyin: Wǒ bàba rènwéi wǒmen zhè yī dài zuòshì bù gòu jījí, quēshǎo nàixīn.
B4L09-2-03.english: My dad thinks our generation is not proactive enough in doing things and lacks patience.

B4L09-2-04.chinese: 當父母的總是希望子女將來能有成就，過著幸福的日子。
B4L09-2-04.pinyin: Dāng fùmǔ de zǒngshì xīwàng zǐnǚ jiānglái néng yǒu chéngjiù, guòzhe xìngfú de rìzi.
B4L09-2-04.english: Parents always hope their children will have achievements in the future and live happy days.

B4L09-2-05.chinese: 要想成為成功的上班族，一切就得照規矩來。
B4L09-2-05.pinyin: Yào xiǎng chéngwéi chénggōng de shàngbānzú, yīqiè jiù děi zhào guīju lái.
B4L09-2-05.english: If you want to become a successful office worker, everything must be done according to the rules.

B4L09-2-06.chinese: 他只是開個小玩笑而已，你何必那麼在乎呢？
B4L09-2-06.pinyin: Tā zhǐshì kāi gè xiǎo wánxiào éryǐ, nǐ hébì nàme zàihu ne?
B4L09-2-06.english: He was just making a little joke, why should you care so much?

B4L09-2-07.chinese: 為了使客戶安心使用，我們公司產品訂了嚴格的生產標準。
B4L09-2-07.pinyin: Wèile shǐ kèhù ānxīn shǐyòng, wǒmen gōngsī chǎnpǐn dìng le yángé de shēngchǎn biāozhǔn.
B4L09-2-07.english: In order to let customers use them with peace of mind, our company has set strict production standards for its products.

B4L09-2-08.chinese: 一小部分人引起的戰爭使人民付出了相當大的代價。
B4L09-2-08.pinyin: Yī xiǎo bùfèn rén yǐnqǐ de zhànzhēng shǐ rénmín fùchū le xiāngdāng dà de dàijià.
B4L09-2-08.english: The war caused by a small group of people made the people pay a considerable price.

B4L09-2-09.chinese: 嬰兒學說話時，身邊的人說什麼，他們就會照著說。
B4L09-2-09.pinyin: Yīng'ér xué shuōhuà shí, shēnbiān de rén shuō shénme, tāmen jiù huì zhàozhe shuō.
B4L09-2-09.english: When babies learn to speak, whatever the people around them say, they will say it accordingly.

B4L09-2-10.chinese: 學習外國語言時最好能找位專業的老師，好改正自己的錯誤。
B4L09-2-10.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiguó yǔyán shí zuìhǎo néng zhǎo wèi zhuānyè de lǎoshī, hǎo gǎizhèng zìjǐ de cuòwù.
B4L09-2-10.english: When learning a foreign language, it's best to find a professional teacher so as to correct your own mistakes.

B4L09-2-11.chinese: 經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
B4L09-2-11.pinyin: Jīngguò nà cì rènwu jiàoxùn hòu, Xiǎo Zhōu zuòshì jiù biàn de gèngjiā xiǎoxīn le.
B4L09-2-11.english: After the lesson from that mission, Xiao Zhou became even more careful in doing things.

B4L09-2-12.chinese: 她愛好化妝、穿名牌服裝，目的是希望別人讚美她。
B4L09-2-12.pinyin: Tā àihào huàzhuāng, chuān míngpái fúzhuāng, mùdì shì xīwàng biérén zànměi tā.
B4L09-2-12.english: She loves makeup and wearing name-brand clothes; her purpose is to hope others praise her.

B4L09-2-13.chinese: 他來臺灣主要是想了解當地風俗，此外也想學習一點兒華語。
B4L09-2-13.pinyin: Tā lái Táiwān zhǔyào shì xiǎng liǎojiě dāngdì fēngsú, cǐwài yě xiǎng xuéxí yīdiǎnr Huáyǔ.
B4L09-2-13.english: He came to Taiwan mainly to understand local customs; in addition, he also wants to learn a little Chinese.

B4L09-2-14.chinese: 不要僅根據表面來判斷一個人或一件事，得花時間深入瞭解。
B4L09-2-14.pinyin: Bùyào jǐn gēnjù biǎomiàn lái pànduàn yī gè rén huò yī jiàn shì, děi huā shíjiān shēnrù liǎojiě.
B4L09-2-14.english: Don't judge a person or a matter based only on the surface; you must spend time to understand deeply.

B4L09-2-15.chinese: 這家公司的工作條件和待遇都不錯，吸引不少年輕人來面試。
B4L09-2-15.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de gōngzuò tiáojiàn hé dàiyù dōu bùcuò, xīyǐn bùshǎo niánqīngrén lái miànshì.
B4L09-2-15.english: This company's working conditions and pay are both good, attracting many young people to come for interviews.

B4L09-2-16.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了嚴重的流行病，使人民受到相當大的生活壓力。
B4L09-2-16.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le yánzhòng de liúxíngbìng, shǐ rénmín shòudào xiāngdāng dà de shēnghuó yālì.
B4L09-2-16.english: A serious epidemic broke out in the Asian region, causing people to receive considerable life pressure.

B4L09-2-17.chinese: 亞洲地區發生了戰爭，使人民生活上所受的的壓力相當大。
B4L09-2-17.pinyin: Yàzhōu dìqū fāshēng le zhànzhēng, shǐ rénmín shēnghuó shàng suǒ shòu de yālì xiāngdāng dà.
B4L09-2-17.english: War broke out in the Asian region, causing the pressure that people received in life to be considerable.

B4L09-2-18.chinese: 他相當迷那位明星，因此不管穿的用的都模仿他。
B4L09-2-18.pinyin: Tā xiāngdāng mí nà wèi míngxīng, yīncǐ bùguǎn chuān de yòng de dōu mófǎng tā.
B4L09-2-18.english: He is quite obsessed with that star, so regardless of what he wears or uses, he imitates him.

B4L09-2-19.chinese: 有些國家的傳統戲劇常利用影子和燈光效果來表演。
B4L09-2-19.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā de chuántǒng xìjù cháng lìyòng yǐngzi hé dēngguāng xiàoguǒ lái biǎoyǎn.
B4L09-2-19.english: Traditional theater in some countries often uses shadows and lighting effects to perform.

B4L09-2-20.chinese: 做事不順利時別只想著逃避，得好好面對才行。
B4L09-2-20.pinyin: Zuòshì bù shùnlì shí bié zhǐ xiǎngzhe táobì, děi hǎohǎo miànduì cái xíng.
B4L09-2-20.english: When things don't go smoothly, don't just think about escaping; you must face them properly.

B4L10-1-01.chinese: 他去當環保志工是為了保護自然環境，也是為了培養耐心。
B4L10-1-01.pinyin: Tā qù dāng huánbǎo zhìgōng shì wèile bǎohù zìrán huánjìng, yě shì wèile péiyǎng nàixīn.
B4L10-1-01.english: He went to be an environmental volunteer in order to protect the natural environment, and also to cultivate patience.

B4L10-1-02.chinese: 那個小孩跑得太快，一不小心就跌倒了。
B4L10-1-02.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái pǎo de tài kuài, yībùxiǎoxīn jiù diēdǎo le.
B4L10-1-02.english: That child ran too fast and accidentally fell down.

B4L10-1-03.chinese: 根據美國某項研究資料，青少年因腦震盪而被送到醫院的意外中，超過一半是因為激烈運動引起的。
B4L10-1-03.pinyin: Gēnjù Měiguó mǒu xiàng yánjiū zīliào, qīngshàonián yīn nǎozhèndàng ér bèi sòng dào yīyuàn de yìwài zhōng, chāoguò yībàn shì yīnwèi jīliè yùndòng yǐnqǐ de.
B4L10-1-03.english: According to a certain American research study, among accidents in which teenagers are sent to the hospital due to cerebral concussion, more than half are caused by intense sports.

B4L10-1-05.chinese: 根據手術的種類，病人在動手術前能吃的食物也不太相同。
B4L10-1-05.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒushù de zhǒnglèi, bìngrén zài dòng shǒushù qián néng chī de shíwù yě bù tài xiāngtóng.
B4L10-1-05.english: Depending on the type of surgery, the food patients can eat before undergoing surgery is also not quite the same.

B4L10-1-06.chinese: 他的頭部被棒球打中並當場昏迷，還好幾分鐘後就醒過來了。
B4L10-1-06.pinyin: Tā de tóubù bèi bàngqiú dǎ zhòng bìng dāngchǎng hūnmí, háihǎo jǐ fēnzhōng hòu jiù xǐng guòlái le.
B4L10-1-06.english: He was hit in the head by a baseball and lost consciousness on the spot; fortunately, he woke up after a few minutes.

B4L10-1-07.chinese: 張小姐很膽小，看到車禍現場有人流了很多血，當場就昏倒了。
B4L10-1-07.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě hěn dǎnxiǎo, kàn dào chēhuò xiànchǎng yǒu rén liú le hěn duō xiě, dāngchǎng jiù hūndǎo le.
B4L10-1-07.english: Miss Zhang is very timid; when she saw someone bleeding a lot at the car accident scene, she fainted on the spot.

B4L10-1-08.chinese: 一個人不管多有錢、多有地位，過世之後什麼也帶不走。
B4L10-1-08.pinyin: Yī ge rén bùguǎn duō yǒu qián, duō yǒu dìwèi, guòshì zhīhòu shénme yě dài bù zǒu.
B4L10-1-08.english: No matter how rich or how high-status a person is, after passing away, they can't take anything with them.

B4L10-1-09.chinese: 總統到地震災區慰問災民，並保證會協助他們恢復正常的生活。
B4L10-1-09.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng dào dìzhèn zāiqū wèiwèn zāimín, bìng bǎozhèng huì xiézhù tāmen huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
B4L10-1-09.english: The president went to the earthquake disaster area to express sympathy and solicitude for the victims, and promised to help them restore a normal life.

B4L10-1-12.chinese: 現在去醫院拿藥，藥袋上都會把藥方及使用方式寫得很清楚。
B4L10-1-12.pinyin: Xiànzài qù yīyuàn ná yào, yàodài shàng dōu huì bǎ yàofāng jí shǐyòng fāngshì xiě de hěn qīngchǔ.
B4L10-1-12.english: Now when you go to the hospital to get medicine, the medicine bag always clearly writes the prescription and how to use it.

B4L10-1-13.chinese: 那個病人不知道中了哪一種毒，不僅皮膚變黑，也昏迷好幾天了。
B4L10-1-13.pinyin: Nàge bìngrén bù zhīdào zhòng le nǎ yī zhǒng dú, bùjǐn pífū biàn hēi, yě hūnmí hǎo jǐ tiān le.
B4L10-1-13.english: That patient doesn't know what kind of poison he was poisoned with; not only has his skin turned black, but he has also been in a coma for several days.

B4L10-1-14.chinese: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
B4L10-1-14.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì rěnnài yīxià jiù guòqù le, shénme dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎojià de fāngshì jiějué, chízǎo huì chūshì de.
B4L10-1-14.english: Some things pass after enduring them for a bit; if you want to solve everything by arguing, sooner or later there will be an accident.

B4L10-1-15.chinese: 對我來說，食物營養不營養無所謂，只要好吃就行了。
B4L10-1-15.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, shíwù yíngyǎng bù yíngyǎng wúsuǒwèi, zhǐyào hǎochī jiù xíng le.
B4L10-1-15.english: To me, whether food is nutritious or not doesn't matter; as long as it's tasty, that's fine.

B4L10-1-16.chinese: 要是你擔心營養不夠的話，吃點兒維他命對身體健康會有幫助的。
B4L10-1-16.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ dānxīn yíngyǎng bù gòu de huà, chī diǎnr wéitāmìng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng huì yǒu bāngzhù de.
B4L10-1-16.english: If you're worried about not getting enough nutrition, taking some vitamins will help your health.

B4L10-1-17.chinese: 當外科醫生不容易，不僅要有手術的專業能力，體力也得夠好。
B4L10-1-17.pinyin: Dāng wàikē yīshēng bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào yǒu shǒushù de zhuānyè nénglì, tǐlì yě děi gòu hǎo.
B4L10-1-17.english: Being a surgery doctor is not easy; you not only need professional surgical skills, but your physical strength also has to be good enough.

B4L10-1-18.chinese: 這家醫院的內科有最新設備，因此成為許多病人的第一選擇。
B4L10-1-18.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de nèikē yǒu zuìxīn shèbèi, yīncǐ chéngwéi xǔduō bìngrén de dì yī xuǎnzé.
B4L10-1-18.english: This hospital's internal medicine department has the latest equipment, so it has become the first choice for many patients.

B4L10-1-20.chinese: A:幸虧有你的建議，投資計畫才有很好的結果，真是多謝你了？ B:哪裡哪裡，都是你自己努力得到的成果，要謝就謝你自己吧！
B4L10-1-20.pinyin: A: Xìngkuī yǒu nǐ de jiànyì, tóuzī jìhuà cái yǒu hěn hǎo de jiéguǒ, zhēn shì duōxiè nǐ le? B: Nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, dōu shì nǐ zìjǐ nǔlì dédào de chéngguǒ, yào xiè jiù xiè nǐ zìjǐ ba!
B4L10-1-20.english: A: Thanks to your suggestion, the investment plan got a very good result; thank you so much! B: Not at all, it's all the result of your own hard work; if you want to thank anyone, thank yourself!

B4L10-1-21.chinese: 他第一次嘗試滑雪，跌了好幾次，好不容易才學會。
B4L10-1-21.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì chángshì huáxuě, diē le hǎo jǐ cì, hǎobùróngyì cái xuéhuì.
B4L10-1-21.english: He tried skiing for the first time, fell several times, and only managed to learn it with great difficulty.

B4L10-1-22.chinese: 醫生說，要是睡前喝了太多水，早上起來時臉就會有點兒腫。
B4L10-1-22.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, yàoshi shuì qián hē le tài duō shuǐ, zǎoshang qǐlái shí liǎn jiù huì yǒudiǎnr zhǒng.
B4L10-1-22.english: The doctor said that if you drink too much water before bed, your face will be a bit swollen when you get up in the morning.

B4L10-1-23.chinese: 像足球、籃球那樣激烈的運動，常讓運動員的小腿、手、腳受傷。
B4L10-1-23.pinyin: Xiàng zúqiú, lánqiú nàyàng jīliè de yùndòng, cháng ràng yùndòngyuán de xiǎotuǐ, shǒu, jiǎo shòushāng.
B4L10-1-23.english: Intense sports like soccer and basketball often cause athletes to injure their lower legs, hands, and feet.

B4L10-1-25.chinese: 台灣這場地震的規模很大，使許多人受輕傷、重傷。
B4L10-1-25.pinyin: Táiwān zhè chǎng dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, shǐ xǔduō rén shòu qīngshāng, zhòngshāng.
B4L10-1-25.english: The scale of this earthquake in Taiwan was very large, causing many people to suffer minor and serious injuries.

B4L10-1-26.chinese: 當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
B4L10-1-26.pinyin: Dāng wǒ tīngdào bèi gōngsī lùqǔ de xiāoxi shí, hái yǐwéi shì zuòmèng, rěnbuzhù yònglì niēle zìjǐ yīxià.
B4L10-1-26.english: When I heard the news that I was hired by the company, I still thought I was dreaming, and I couldn't help but pinch myself hard.

B4L10-1-27.chinese: 奶奶養了幾隻雞，每天早上習慣抓兩把玉米餵牠們。
B4L10-1-27.pinyin: Nǎinai yǎngle jǐ zhī jī, měitiān zǎoshang xíguàn zhuā liǎng bǎ yùmǐ wèi tāmen.
B4L10-1-27.english: Grandma raises several chickens, and every morning she is used to grabbing two handfuls of corn to feed them.

B4L10-1-28.chinese: 早上在草地上散步，突然看見一條蛇經過，害得我一直流冷汗。
B4L10-1-28.pinyin: Zǎoshang zài cǎodì shàng sànbù, tūrán kànjiàn yī tiáo shé jīngguò, hàide wǒ yīzhí liú lěnghàn.
B4L10-1-28.english: While walking on the grass this morning, I suddenly saw a snake pass by, which made me keep breaking out in a cold sweat.

B4L10-1-29.chinese: 對夏天一活動汗就流個不停的女性來說，化妝實在是件麻煩事。
B4L10-1-29.pinyin: Duì xiàtiān yī huódòng hàn jiù liú ge bùtíng de nǚxìng lái shuō, huàzhuāng shízài shì jiàn máfan shì.
B4L10-1-29.english: For women who sweat nonstop as soon as they move in summer, putting on makeup is really a troublesome thing.

B4L10-1-30.chinese: 軍人接到任務時，不管多麼危險都得努力完成。
B4L10-1-30.pinyin: Jūnrén jiēdào rènwu shí, bùguǎn duōme wēixiǎn dōu děi nǔlì wánchéng.
B4L10-1-30.english: When soldiers receive a mission, no matter how dangerous it is, they must strive to complete it.

B4L10-1-31.chinese: 科學家在他的時代所努力的結果，都可能會在未來開花結果。
B4L10-1-31.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zài tā de shídài suǒ nǔlì de jiéguǒ, dōu kěnéng huì zài wèilái kāihuā jiéguǒ.
B4L10-1-31.english: The results of scientists' efforts in their era may all bear fruit in the future.

B4L10-1-34.chinese: 在中國北方，所謂的「大夫」就是醫師，做的是替人醫病的工作。
B4L10-1-34.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó běifāng, suǒwèi de “dàifu” jiùshì yīshī, zuò de shì tì rén yī bìng de gōngzuò.
B4L10-1-34.english: In northern China, the so-called 'dàifu' is a doctor, whose job is to treat people's illnesses.

B4L10-1-35.chinese: 好餐廳的第一條件就是保持乾淨，讓客人有舒適的環境。
B4L10-1-35.pinyin: Hǎo cāntīng de dì yī tiáojiàn jiùshì bǎochí gānjìng, ràng kèrén yǒu shūshì de huánjìng.
B4L10-1-35.english: The first condition for a good restaurant is to keep it clean, so that customers have a comfortable environment.

B4L10-1-36.chinese: 當別人遇到不愉快的事時，應該避免說些刺激他的話。
B4L10-1-36.pinyin: Dāng biérén yùdào bù yúkuài de shì shí, yīnggāi bìmiǎn shuō xiē cìjī tā de huà.
B4L10-1-36.english: When others encounter unpleasant things, one should avoid saying things that irritate them.

B4L10-1-37.chinese: 他手上有傷，醫師建議他三日以內不要碰水，以免感染。
B4L10-1-37.pinyin: Tā shǒu shàng yǒu shāng, yīshī jiànyì tā sān rì yǐnèi bùyào pèng shuǐ, yǐmiǎn gǎnrǎn.
B4L10-1-37.english: He has an injury on his hand, and the doctor advised him not to touch water for three days to avoid infection.

B4L10-1-38.chinese: 有的小朋友很討厭打針，一看見護理師拿針筒(medical syringe)的樣子就哭了。
B4L10-1-38.pinyin: Yǒude xiǎopéngyǒu hěn tǎoyàn dǎzhēn, yī kànjiàn hùlǐshī ná zhēntǒng de yàngzi jiù kū le.
B4L10-1-38.english: Some children really hate getting injections; as soon as they see the nurse holding a syringe, they cry.

B4L10-1-39.chinese: 我的裙子破了個洞，還好室友有針和線，幫我補了起來。
B4L10-1-39.pinyin: Wǒ de qúnzi pòle ge dòng, háohǎo shìyǒu yǒu zhēn hé xiàn, bāng wǒ bǔle qǐlái.
B4L10-1-39.english: My skirt had a hole, but luckily my roommate had a needle and thread and helped me mend it.

B4L10-1-40.chinese: 今天上健康教育課時，老師在教室裡掛了一張人體血管圖。
B4L10-1-40.pinyin: Jīntiān shàng jiànkāng jiàoyù kè shí, lǎoshī zài jiàoshì lǐ guàle yī zhāng réntǐ xuèguǎn tú.
B4L10-1-40.english: In health education class today, the teacher hung a diagram of human blood vessels in the classroom.

B4L10-1-41.chinese: 那個甜點的顏色像鮮血一樣，讓我嚇了一跳。
B4L10-1-41.pinyin: Nàge tiándiǎn de yánsè xiàng xiānxuè yīyàng, ràng wǒ xiàle yī tiào.
B4L10-1-41.english: The color of that dessert was like fresh blood, which gave me a fright.

B4L10-1-42.chinese: 大多數的模特兒都是腿長腰細的，穿什麼服裝都好看。
B4L10-1-42.pinyin: Dàduōshù de mótèr dōu shì tuǐ cháng yāo xì de, chuān shénme fúzhuāng dōu hǎokàn.
B4L10-1-42.english: Most models have long legs and thin waists, so they look good in whatever clothes they wear.

B4L10-1-43.chinese: 坐火車時，一旁的旅客不停地講電話，吵得我受不了。
B4L10-1-43.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē shí, yīpáng de lǚkè bùtíng de jiǎng diànhuà, chǎo de wǒ shòubuliǎo.
B4L10-1-43.english: When I was on the train, the passenger beside me kept talking on the phone, making such a noise that I couldn't stand it.

B4L10-1-44.chinese: 今天光是整理前院的花草樹木就讓我累得要命，只好明天再整理後院了。
B4L10-1-44.pinyin: Jīntiān guāng shì zhěnglǐ qiányuàn de huācǎo shùmù jiù ràng wǒ lèi de yàomìng, zhǐhǎo míngtiān zài zhěnglǐ hòuyuàn le.
B4L10-1-44.english: Today, just tidying up the flowers, plants, and trees in the front yard made me extremely tired, so I'll have to do the backyard tomorrow.

B4L10-1-46.chinese: 談生意時千萬別打斷客戶的話，不然做生意的機會很可能就斷了。
B4L10-1-46.pinyin: Tán shēngyì shí qiānwàn bié dǎduàn kèhù de huà, bùrán zuò shēngyì de jīhuì hěn kěnéng jiù duàn le.
B4L10-1-46.english: When discussing business, never interrupt the client, otherwise the opportunity to do business may very well be broken off.

B4L10-1-47.chinese: 我買了一個機器，不但能幫我量體重，還能量身高。
B4L10-1-47.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile yī ge jīqì, bùdàn néng bāng wǒ liáng tǐzhòng, hái néng liáng shēngāo.
B4L10-1-47.english: I bought a machine that can not only help me measure my weight but also measure my height.

B4L10-1-48.chinese: 動物的體溫不見得都是不變的，像蛇的體溫就隨著環境而變。
B4L10-1-48.pinyin: Dòngwù de tǐwēn bù jiàndé dōu shì bùbiàn de, xiàng shé de tǐwēn jiù suízhe huánjìng ér biàn.
B4L10-1-48.english: Animal body temperatures are not necessarily constant; for example, a snake's body temperature changes with the environment.

B4L10-1-49.chinese: 醫師要我到廁所大便，再拿一點兒放在盒子送去檢查。
B4L10-1-49.pinyin: Yīshī yào wǒ dào cèsuǒ dàbiàn, zài ná yīdiǎnr fàng zài hézi lǐ sòng qù jiǎnchá.
B4L10-1-49.english: The doctor asked me to go to the restroom to defecate, then take a little and put it in a box to send for testing.

B4L10-1-50.chinese: 想小便的時候千萬別忍耐，否則對健康的影響相當大。
B4L10-1-50.pinyin: Xiǎng xiǎobiàn de shíhou qiānwàn bié rěnnài, fǒuzé duì jiànkāng de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
B4L10-1-50.english: When you need to urinate, never hold it in, otherwise the impact on your health is considerable.

B4L10-1-51.chinese: 媽媽發現嬰兒尿得整件內褲都是尿，就幫他換了新的。
B4L10-1-51.pinyin: Māma fāxiàn yīng'ér niào de zhěng jiàn nèikù dōu shì niào, jiù bāng tā huànle xīn de.
B4L10-1-51.english: The mother discovered that the baby had urinated so much that his whole underwear was full of urine, so she helped him change into new ones.

B4L10-1-52.chinese: 黃媽媽感冒那幾天，她女兒每天煮粥給她吃，真是懂事。
B4L10-1-52.pinyin: Huáng māma gǎnmào nà jǐ tiān, tā nǚ'ér měitiān zhǔ zhōu gěi tā chī, zhēn shì dǒngshì.
B4L10-1-52.english: During the days when Mrs. Huang had a cold, her daughter cooked porridge for her every day; she is really sensible.

B4L10-1-53.chinese: 我最近皮膚又紅又癢，暫時不能吃太辣或太鹹的食物。
B4L10-1-53.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn pífū yòu hóng yòu yǎng, zànshí bùnéng chī tài là huò tài xián de shíwù.
B4L10-1-53.english: Recently my skin has been red and itchy, so for the time being I can't eat food that is too spicy or too salty.

B4L10-1-54.chinese: 貓很享受抓癢，但要是你抓錯地方或方式不對，反而會使貓發脾氣。
B4L10-1-54.pinyin: Māo hěn xiǎngshòu zhuā yǎng, dàn yàoshi nǐ zhuā cuò dìfāng huò fāngshì bù duì, fǎn'ér huì shǐ māo fā píqì.
B4L10-1-54.english: Cats really enjoy having their itches scratched, but if you scratch the wrong place or in the wrong way, it will instead make the cat lose its temper.

B4L10-1-55.chinese: 他正在修改明天要交出去的計畫，你別去打擾他。
B4L10-1-55.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài xiūgǎi míngtiān yào jiāo chūqù de jìhuà, nǐ bié qù dǎrǎo tā.
B4L10-1-55.english: He is revising the plan that is due tomorrow; don't go disturb him.

B4L10-1-56.chinese: 商品想賣得好，就得準備一筆廣告費，多多宣傳。
B4L10-1-56.pinyin: Shāngpǐn xiǎng mài de hǎo, jiù děi zhǔnbèi yī bǐ guǎnggào fèi, duōduō xuānchuán.
B4L10-1-56.english: If you want products to sell well, you have to prepare a sum for advertising expenses and promote them more.

B4L10-2-01.chinese: 他現在的身體狀況很糟，請暫時先別去探他的病。
B4L10-2-01.pinyin: Tā xiànzài de shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng hěn zāo, qǐng zànshí xiān bié qù tàn tā de bìng.
B4L10-2-01.english: His current health condition is very bad; please don't go visit him while he's sick for now.

B4L10-2-02.chinese: 開車時千萬別把頭探出車窗外，以免發生危險。
B4L10-2-02.pinyin: Kāichē shí qiānwàn bié bǎ tóu tàn chū chēchuāng wài, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
B4L10-2-02.english: When driving, by all means don't stick your head out of the car window, to avoid danger.

B4L10-2-03.chinese: 水災過後應立刻打掃環境，才能降低傳染病流行的機會。
B4L10-2-03.pinyin: Shuǐzāi guòhòu yīng lìkè dǎsǎo huánjìng, cái néng jiàngdī chuánrǎnbìng liúxíng de jīhuì.
B4L10-2-03.english: After a flood, one should immediately clean up the environment; only then can the chance of infectious diseases spreading be reduced.

B4L10-2-04.chinese: 有些病頭幾個月的症狀不明顯，得做進一步的檢查才能確定。
B4L10-2-04.pinyin: Yǒuxiē bìng tóu jǐ gè yuè de zhèngzhuàng bù míngxiǎn, děi zuò jìnyībù de jiǎnchá cái néng quèdìng.
B4L10-2-04.english: For some diseases, the symptoms in the first few months are not obvious; further examination is needed to confirm.

B4L10-2-05.chinese: 那位教授提供病毒給軍隊使用，有些人認為他應該出來道歉。
B4L10-2-05.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu tígōng bìngdú gěi jūnduì shǐyòng, yǒuxiē rén rènwéi tā yīnggāi chūlái dàoqiàn.
B4L10-2-05.english: That professor provided viruses for the military to use; some people think he should come out and apologize.

B4L10-2-06.chinese: 這次傳染病的病毒很厲害，出門得戴著口罩，免得被傳染。
B4L10-2-06.pinyin: Zhè cì chuánrǎnbìng de bìngdú hěn lìhài, chūmén děi dàizhe kǒuzhào, miǎnde bèi chuánrǎn.
B4L10-2-06.english: The virus of this infectious disease is very severe; when going out, you must wear a mask so as not to get infected.

B4L10-2-07.chinese: 學校的布告欄總是隨著季節改變而有不同的設計。
B4L10-2-07.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bùgàolán zǒngshì suízhe jìjié gǎibiàn ér yǒu bùtóng de shèjì.
B4L10-2-07.english: The school's bulletin board always has different designs as the seasons change.

B4L10-2-08.chinese: 公司的布告上貼著超市打折活動的廣告，感覺真的很怪。
B4L10-2-08.pinyin: Gōngsī de bùgào shàng tiēzhe chāoshì dǎzhé huódòng de guǎnggào, gǎnjué zhēn de hěn guài.
B4L10-2-08.english: The company's notice has an ad for a supermarket discount event posted on it; it feels really strange.

B4L10-2-09.chinese: 公司的工作須知訂得非常詳細，不過從來沒有員工仔細看完。
B4L10-2-09.pinyin: Gōngsī de gōngzuò xūzhī dìng de fēicháng xiángxì, bùguò cónglái méiyǒu yuángōng zǐxì kàn wán.
B4L10-2-09.english: The company's work guidelines are set out in great detail, but no employee has ever read them carefully all the way through.

B4L10-2-10.chinese: 開會前經理要求大家勿開手機，專心討論會議內容。
B4L10-2-10.pinyin: Kāihuì qián jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā wù kāi shǒujī, zhuānxīn tǎolùn huìyì nèiróng.
B4L10-2-10.english: Before the meeting, the manager asked everyone not to turn on their cell phones and to focus on discussing the meeting content.

B4L10-2-11.chinese: 帶孩子到餐廳用餐，得提醒他們別到處奔跑，免得跌倒。
B4L10-2-11.pinyin: Dài háizi dào cāntīng yòngcān, děi tíxǐng tāmen bié dàochù bēnpǎo, miǎnde diēdǎo.
B4L10-2-11.english: When taking children to a restaurant to eat, you must remind them not to run around, so they don't fall.

B4L10-2-12.chinese: 為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
B4L10-2-12.pinyin: Wèile rénmín de jiànkāng, xǔduō guójiā dōu jìnzhǐ jìnkǒu shòudào huánjìng wūrǎn de nóngchǎnpǐn.
B4L10-2-12.english: For the health of the people, many countries prohibit the import of agricultural products that have been polluted by the environment.

B4L10-2-14.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
B4L10-2-14.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
B4L10-2-14.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

B4L10-2-15.chinese: 對科學家或藝術家來說，提供他們一個不受限制的工作環境是很重要的。
B4L10-2-15.pinyin: Duì kēxuéjiā huò yìshùjiā lái shuō, tígōng tāmen yī gè bù shòu xiànzhì de gōngzuò huánjìng shì hěn zhòngyào de.
B4L10-2-15.english: For scientists or artists, providing them with a work environment that is not restricted is very important.

B4L10-2-16.chinese: 父母要求孩子不論在任何情況都不許騙人。
B4L10-2-16.pinyin: Fùmǔ yāoqiú háizi bùlùn zài rènhé qíngkuàng dōu bùxǔ piàn rén.
B4L10-2-16.english: Parents require that their children must not lie under any circumstances.

B4L10-2-17.chinese: 如果你亂吃垃圾食品，就算按時運動，體重也很難減輕。
B4L10-2-17.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ luàn chī lājī shípǐn, jiùsuàn ànshí yùndòng, tǐzhòng yě hěn nán jiǎnqīng.
B4L10-2-17.english: If you eat junk food indiscriminately, even if you exercise on time, it will still be very hard to lose weight.

B4L10-2-18.chinese: 個人在使用各式各樣的網路服務時，也應該注意隱私問題。
B4L10-2-18.pinyin: Gèrén zài shǐyòng gè shì gè yàng de wǎnglù fúwù shí, yě yīnggāi zhùyì yǐnsī wèntí.
B4L10-2-18.english: When individuals use various kinds of internet services, they should also pay attention to privacy issues.

B4L10-2-19.chinese: 當我難過的時候，最需要的是家人與好友的安慰。
B4L10-2-19.pinyin: Dāng wǒ nánguò de shíhòu, zuì xūyào de shì jiārén yǔ hǎoyǒu de ānwèi.
B4L10-2-19.english: When I am sad, what I need most is the comfort of family and good friends.

B4L10-2-20.chinese: 隨著空氣被汙染的情況越來越嚴重，得到癌症的機會也增加了。
B4L10-2-20.pinyin: Suízhe kōngqì bèi wūrǎn de qíngkuàng yuèláiyuè yánzhòng, dédào áizhèng de jīhuì yě zēngjiā le.
B4L10-2-20.english: As the situation of air pollution becomes more and more serious, the chance of getting cancer has also increased.

B4L10-2-21.chinese: 這位外科醫師不僅很會開刀，對病人也很有耐心。
B4L10-2-21.pinyin: Zhè wèi wàikē yīshī bùjǐn hěn huì kāidāo, duì bìngrén yě hěn yǒu nàixīn.
B4L10-2-21.english: This surgeon is not only very skilled at performing operations, but also very patient with patients.

B4L11-1-02.chinese: 我好友都已結婚了，什麼時候才換我辦喜事，請大家喝喜酒？
B4L11-1-02.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoyǒu dōu yǐjīng jiéhūn le, shénme shíhòu cái huàn wǒ bàn xǐshì, qǐng dàjiā hē xǐjiǔ?
B4L11-1-02.english: All my good friends are already married; when will it be my turn to hold a wedding and invite everyone to drink at the wedding banquet?

B4L11-1-03.chinese: 聽說那位新郎在事業上很有成就，況且優點也不少，跟他結婚的女人應該很幸福。
B4L11-1-03.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà wèi xīnláng zài shìyè shàng hěn yǒu chéngjiù, kuàngqiě yōudiǎn yě bù shǎo, gēn tā jiéhūn de nǚrén yīnggāi hěn xìngfú.
B4L11-1-03.english: I heard that bridegroom has great achievements in his career, and moreover has many good qualities; the woman who marries him should be very happy.

B4L11-1-04.chinese: 客人都抵達婚禮現場了，新娘卻還沒開始化妝，太誇張了！
B4L11-1-04.pinyin: Kèrén dōu dǐdá hūnlǐ xiànchǎng le, xīnniáng què hái méi kāishǐ huàzhuāng, tài kuāzhāng le!
B4L11-1-04.english: The guests have all arrived at the wedding venue, but the bride hasn't even started putting on makeup yet—that's too outrageous!

B4L11-1-05.chinese: 旗袍是華人最有特色的服裝之一，我想訂一套屬於我的旗袍。
B4L11-1-05.pinyin: Qípáo shì Huárén zuì yǒu tèsè de fúzhuāng zhī yī, wǒ xiǎng dìng yī tào shǔyú wǒ de qípáo.
B4L11-1-05.english: The cheongsam is one of the most distinctive costumes of the Chinese people; I want to order a cheongsam of my own.

B4L11-1-06.chinese: 在臺灣，目前已被發現的蝴蝶大約有三百七十種以上。
B4L11-1-06.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, mùqián yǐ bèi fāxiàn de húdié dàyuē yǒu sānbǎi qīshí zhǒng yǐshàng.
B4L11-1-06.english: In Taiwan, the butterflies that have been discovered so far number approximately over 370 species.

B4L11-1-07.chinese: 阿里山上的樹木又高又粗，好幾棵樹木的年齡都超過一千年了。
B4L11-1-07.pinyin: Ālǐshān shàng de shùmù yòu gāo yòu cū, hǎojǐ kē shùmù de niánlíng dōu chāoguò yīqiān nián le.
B4L11-1-07.english: The trees on Alishan are both tall and thick; several of them are over a thousand years old.

B4L11-1-08.chinese: 我大哥去年娶了英國太太，我們都好喜歡這位美麗的大嫂。
B4L11-1-08.pinyin: Wǒ dàgē qùnián qǔle Yīngguó tàitai, wǒmen dōu hǎo xǐhuān zhè wèi měilì de dàsǎo.
B4L11-1-08.english: My eldest brother married a British wife last year; we all really like this beautiful sister-in-law.

B4L11-1-09.chinese: 王媽媽一直把媳婦當作自己的女兒，當他們家的媳婦真幸福。
B4L11-1-09.pinyin: Wáng māma yīzhí bǎ xífù dàngzuò zìjǐ de nǚ'ér, dāng tāmen jiā de xífù zhēn xìngfú.
B4L11-1-09.english: Mrs. Wang has always treated her daughter-in-law as her own daughter; being their family's daughter-in-law is truly blessed.

B4L11-1-10.chinese: 我好友昨天和女朋友分手了，這幾天心情很糟，我得去安慰安慰他。
B4L11-1-10.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoyǒu zuótiān hé nǚpéngyǒu fēnshǒu le, zhè jǐ tiān xīnqíng hěn zāo, wǒ děi qù ānwèi ānwèi tā.
B4L11-1-10.english: My good friend broke up with his girlfriend yesterday; he's been in a terrible mood these past few days, so I need to go comfort him.

B4L11-1-11.chinese: 在自由戀愛的時代中，還是有人透過相親的方式來認識另一半。
B4L11-1-11.pinyin: Zài zìyóu liàn'ài de shídài zhōng, háishì yǒu rén tòuguò xiāngqīn de fāngshì lái rènshi lìng yībàn.
B4L11-1-11.english: In this era of free love, there are still people who get to know their other half through blind dates.

B4L11-1-12.chinese: 我們全家都是信基督教的，不論教會舉辦什麼活動，我們都一定去參加。
B4L11-1-12.pinyin: Wǒmen quánjiā dōu shì xìn Jīdūjiào de, bùlùn jiàohuì jǔbàn shénme huódòng, wǒmen dōu yīdìng qù cānjiā.
B4L11-1-12.english: Our whole family is Christian; no matter what activities the church holds, we always go to participate.

B4L11-1-13.chinese: 我同事下個月總算要和交往十年的女朋友結婚了，真是不容易啊！。
B4L11-1-13.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì xià ge yuè zǒngsuàn yào hé jiāowǎng shí nián de nǚpéngyǒu jiéhūn le, zhēn shì bù róngyì a!
B4L11-1-13.english: My colleague is finally going to marry his girlfriend of ten years next month—it really wasn't easy!

B4L11-1-14.chinese: 以往在冬天才開的花，沒想到夏天就開了，大家都覺得很意外。
B4L11-1-14.pinyin: Yǐwǎng zài dōngtiān cái kāi de huā, méi xiǎngdào xiàtiān jiù kāi le, dàjiā dōu juéde hěn yìwài.
B4L11-1-14.english: Flowers that used to bloom only in winter unexpectedly bloomed in summer; everyone felt very surprised.

B4L11-1-15.chinese: 那位新郎的歲數比新娘大十五歲，可是兩人看起來一樣年輕。
B4L11-1-15.pinyin: Nà wèi xīnláng de suìshù bǐ xīnniáng dà shíwǔ suì, kěshì liǎng rén kàn qǐlái yīyàng niánqīng.
B4L11-1-15.english: That groom's age is fifteen years older than the bride's, but the two of them look equally young.

B4L11-1-17.chinese: 在華人社會中，見面時晚輩先問候長輩是應有的禮貌。
B4L11-1-17.pinyin: Zài Huárén shèhuì zhōng, jiànmiàn shí wǎnbèi xiān wènhòu zhǎngbèi shì yīngyǒu de lǐmào.
B4L11-1-17.english: In Chinese society, when meeting, it is proper etiquette for the younger generation to greet the elders first.

B4L11-1-18.chinese: 他在國外旅行時因為簽證有問題，回國時間只好提前了。
B4L11-1-18.pinyin: Tā zài guówài lǚxíng shí yīnwèi qiānzhèng yǒu wèntí, huíguó shíjiān zhǐhǎo tíqián le.
B4L11-1-18.english: While traveling abroad, because there was a problem with his visa, his return date had to be moved up.

B4L11-1-20.chinese: 王先生上週向他女友求婚，沒想到才過了幾天就訂婚了。
B4L11-1-20.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng shàng zhōu xiàng tā nǚyǒu qiúhūn, méi xiǎngdào cái guòle jǐ tiān jiù dìnghūn le.
B4L11-1-20.english: Mr. Wang proposed to his girlfriend last week; unexpectedly, just a few days later they got engaged.

B4L11-1-22.chinese: 不管未婚或者已婚的人，在現實生活中都有需要面對的問題。
B4L11-1-22.pinyin: Bùguǎn wèihūn huòzhě yǐhūn de rén, zài xiànshí shēnghuó zhōng dōu yǒu xūyào miànduì de wèntí.
B4L11-1-22.english: Whether unmarried or married, people all have problems they need to face in real life.

B4L11-1-23.chinese: 戴小姐的父母對婚禮相當重視，連喜帖都是他們親自設計的。
B4L11-1-23.pinyin: Dài xiǎojiě de fùmǔ duì hūnlǐ xiāngdāng zhòngshì, lián xǐtiě dōu shì tāmen qīnzì shèjì de.
B4L11-1-23.english: Miss Dai's parents place great importance on the wedding; even the wedding invitations were designed by them personally.

B4L11-1-24.chinese: 開學典禮時校長所演講的內容又短又精彩，讓我印象很深。
B4L11-1-24.pinyin: Kāixué diǎnlǐ shí xiàozhǎng suǒ yǎnjiǎng de nèiróng yòu duǎn yòu jīngcǎi, ràng wǒ yìnxiàng hěn shēn.
B4L11-1-24.english: The content of the principal's speech at the opening ceremony was both short and wonderful; it left a deep impression on me.

B4L11-1-25.chinese: 最近賣的新飲料很有特色，所以光臨我們店的客人越來越多。
B4L11-1-25.pinyin: Zuìjìn mài de xīn yǐnliào hěn yǒu tèsè, suǒyǐ guānglín wǒmen diàn de kèrén yuè lái yuè duō.
B4L11-1-25.english: The new drinks sold recently are very distinctive, so more and more customers are honoring our shop with their presence.

B4L11-1-26.chinese: 要是你不能喝酒，跟客戶乾杯時可以用茶代替酒。
B4L11-1-26.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ bù néng hē jiǔ, gēn kèhù gānbēi shí kěyǐ yòng chá dàitì jiǔ.
B4L11-1-26.english: If you can't drink alcohol, when you toast with clients you can use tea instead of liquor.

B4L11-1-27.chinese: 他順利當上那家大飯店的廚師後，好多朋友都打電話祝賀他。
B4L11-1-27.pinyin: Tā shùnlì dāngshàng nà jiā dà fàndiàn de chúshī hòu, hǎoduō péngyǒu dōu dǎ diànhuà zhùhè tā.
B4L11-1-27.english: After he successfully became a chef at that big hotel, many friends called to congratulate him.

B4L11-1-28.chinese: 李媽媽把寶寶每天的生活都記錄下來，寫成一篇篇的日記。
B4L11-1-28.pinyin: Lǐ māma bǎ bǎobǎo měi tiān de shēnghuó dōu jìlù xiàlái, xiěchéng yī piān piān de rìjì.
B4L11-1-28.english: Mrs. Li recorded the baby's daily life, writing it into diary entries one after another.

B4L11-1-29.chinese: 夫妻之間要是缺少了愛情，日子就比較難過下去。
B4L11-1-29.pinyin: Fūqī zhījiān yàoshi quēshǎole àiqíng, rìzi jiù bǐjiào nánguò xiàqù.
B4L11-1-29.english: If husband and wife lack love between them, life becomes harder to endure.

B4L11-1-30.chinese: 這個背包在設計上沒什麼特色，只是印了某位明星隨手畫的圖，沒想到就要賣上萬元，實在有點兒誇張。
B4L11-1-30.pinyin: Zhège bēibāo zài shèjì shàng méi shénme tèsè, zhǐshì yìnle mǒu wèi míngxīng suíshǒu huà de tú, méi xiǎngdào jiù yào mài shàng wàn yuán, shízài yǒudiǎnr kuāzhāng.
B4L11-1-30.english: This backpack has nothing distinctive in its design; it just has a picture casually drawn by some celebrity printed on it. I never expected it to sell for over ten thousand dollars—that's really a bit outrageous.

B4L11-1-31.chinese: 這個角色一直找不到合適的演員，幸好那位明星點頭答應演出，否則影片就拍不成了。
B4L11-1-31.pinyin: Zhège juésè yīzhí zhǎo bù dào héshì de yǎnyuán, xìngkuī nà wèi míngxīng diǎntóu dāyìng yǎnchū, fǒuzé yǐngpiàn jiù pāi bù chéng le.
B4L11-1-31.english: They couldn't find a suitable actor for this role all along; fortunately, that celebrity nodded and agreed to perform, otherwise the film couldn't have been made.

B4L11-1-33.chinese: 經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。
B4L11-1-33.pinyin: Jīngguò xuèyè jiǎnchá, rénmen jiù kěyǐ zhīdào zìjǐ de xuèxíng.
B4L11-1-33.english: Through a blood test, people can know their own blood type.

B4L11-1-34.chinese: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
B4L11-1-34.pinyin: Xīnxíng bǐdiàn xiāoshòu shí jiàgé tōngcháng bǐjiào guì, yǒushí dào bùrú mǎi fúhé gèrén xūyào de jiùxíng bǐdiàn.
B4L11-1-34.english: When new-model laptops are sold, the price is usually relatively expensive; sometimes it would be better to buy an old-model laptop that fits one's personal needs.

B4L11-1-35.chinese: 王伯伯為兒子辦喜事，擺了五十桌喜酒，熱鬧極了。
B4L11-1-35.pinyin: Wáng bóbo wèi érzi bàn xǐshì, bǎi le wǔshí zhuō xǐjiǔ, rènào jí le.
B4L11-1-35.english: Uncle Wang held a wedding for his son and set up fifty tables of wedding wine—it was extremely lively.

B4L11-1-36.chinese: 這只箱子是以前奶奶留給我的，對我來說是很珍貴的禮物。
B4L11-1-36.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiāngzi shì yǐqián nǎinai liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō shì hěn zhēnguì de lǐwù.
B4L11-1-36.english: This suitcase is one that my grandmother left to me in the past; to me, it is a very precious gift.

B4L11-1-37.chinese: 鑽石因為無法大量出產，所以才變得珍貴。
B4L11-1-37.pinyin: Zuànshí yīnwèi wúfǎ dàliàng chūchǎn, suǒyǐ cái biàn de zhēnguì.
B4L11-1-37.english: Because diamonds cannot be produced in large quantities, they have become precious.

B4L11-1-38.chinese: 那只鑽石戒指的設計極有特色，很適合當作婚戒(wedding ring)。
B4L11-1-38.pinyin: Nà zhī zuànshí jièzhǐ de shèjì jí yǒu tèsè, hěn shìhé dāngzuò hūnjiè.
B4L11-1-38.english: The design of that diamond ring is extremely distinctive; it is very suitable to serve as a wedding ring.

B4L11-1-39.chinese: 他上班時常戴著一副黑色眼鏡，那副樣子總是讓我忘不了。
B4L11-1-39.pinyin: Tā shàngbān shí cháng dài zhe yī fù hēisè yǎnjìng, nà fù yàngzi zǒngshì ràng wǒ wàng bù liǎo.
B4L11-1-39.english: When he goes to work, he often wears a pair of black glasses; that look always makes me unable to forget it.

B4L11-1-40.chinese: 你那一付筷子剛剛掉到地上弄髒了，我再幫你換一付新的。
B4L11-1-40.pinyin: Nǐ nà yī fù kuàizi gānggāng diào dào dìshàng nòng zāng le, wǒ zài bāng nǐ huàn yī fù xīn de.
B4L11-1-40.english: That pair of chopsticks of yours just fell on the ground and got dirty; I'll help you exchange them for a new pair.

B4L11-1-41.chinese: 錢小姐戴的那副耳環就像星光一樣美麗，聽說那是祖母留給她的回憶。
B4L11-1-41.pinyin: Qián xiǎojiě dài de nà fù ěrhuán jiù xiàng xīngguāng yīyàng měilì, tīngshuō nà shì zǔmǔ liú gěi tā de huíyì.
B4L11-1-41.english: That pair of earrings Miss Qian is wearing is as beautiful as starlight; I heard that they are a memory her grandmother left to her.

B4L11-1-42.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
B4L11-1-42.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
B4L11-1-42.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

B4L11-1-43.chinese: 按照中國的傳統觀念，女人未嫁時得聽父親的話，嫁了人之後就得聽丈夫的。
B4L11-1-43.pinyin: Ànzhào Zhōngguó de chuántǒng guānniàn, nǚrén wèi jià shí děi tīng fùqīn de huà, jià le rén zhīhòu jiù děi tīng zhàngfu de.
B4L11-1-43.english: According to traditional Chinese concepts, before a woman marries she must listen to her father's words, and after she marries she must listen to her husband's.

B4L11-1-44.chinese: 她想嫁給有錢人家(rénjiā)是她自己的事，你幹嘛管人家(rénjia)的事？
B4L11-1-44.pinyin: Tā xiǎng jià gěi yǒuqián rénjiā shì tā zìjǐ de shì, nǐ gànmá guǎn rénjia de shì?
B4L11-1-44.english: That she wants to marry into a wealthy family is her own business; why do you meddle in other people's business?

B4L11-1-45.chinese: 幸福的婚姻不僅需要觀念的溝通，更需要感情的交流。
B4L11-1-45.pinyin: Xìngfú de hūnyīn bùjǐn xūyào guānniàn de gōutōng, gèng xūyào gǎnqíng de jiāoliú.
B4L11-1-45.english: A happy marriage not only requires communication of ideas but even more requires an exchange of feelings.

B4L11-1-46.chinese: 我喜歡陪家人到公園的草地上野餐，氣氛溫暖又歡喜。
B4L11-1-46.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān péi jiārén dào gōngyuán de cǎodì shàng yěcān, qìfēn wēnnuǎn yòu huānxǐ.
B4L11-1-46.english: I like to accompany my family to the park's lawn for a picnic; the atmosphere is warm and joyous.

B4L11-1-47.chinese: 我去臺灣朋友家吃飯時，他的家人不斷夾菜給我，讓我很不好意思。
B4L11-1-47.pinyin: Wǒ qù Táiwān péngyǒu jiā chīfàn shí, tā de jiārén bùduàn jiā cài gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ hěn bù hǎoyìsi.
B4L11-1-47.english: When I went to a Taiwanese friend's home to eat, his family kept placing food into my bowl, which made me very embarrassed.

B4L11-1-48.chinese: 這桌喜酒有很多海鮮，但我只能吃魚，其他種類的海鮮都會讓我皮膚紅腫(inflamed)。
B4L11-1-48.pinyin: Zhè zhuō xǐjiǔ yǒu hěn duō hǎixiān, dàn wǒ zhǐ néng chī yú, qítā zhǒnglèi de hǎixiān dōu huì ràng wǒ pífū hóngzhǒng.
B4L11-1-48.english: This table of wedding wine has a lot of seafood, but I can only eat fish; other types of seafood all make my skin swell and turn red.

B4L11-1-49.chinese: 我的白髮隨著年齡越來越多了，我想找一天去染頭髮。
B4L11-1-49.pinyin: Wǒ de báifà suízhe niánlíng yuèláiyuè duō le, wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī tiān qù rǎn tóufa.
B4L11-1-49.english: My white hairs are increasing with age; I want to find a day to go dye my hair.

B4L11-1-50.chinese: 鵝一看到陌生人就會大叫，所以鄉村裡有人把鵝當成狗來看家(kānjiā， to guard the house)。
B4L11-1-50.pinyin: É yī kàndào mòshēngrén jiù huì dàjiào, suǒyǐ xiāngcūn lǐ yǒu rén bǎ é dāngchéng gǒu lái kānjiā.
B4L11-1-50.english: As soon as a goose sees a stranger, it will honk loudly, so in the countryside some people treat geese like dogs to guard the house.

B4L11-1-51.chinese: 開車去喝喜酒的人碰到敬酒時最好拒絕，免得回家路上發生意外。
B4L11-1-51.pinyin: Kāichē qù hē xǐjiǔ de rén pèngdào jìngjiǔ shí zuìhǎo jùjué, miǎnde huíjiā lùshàng fāshēng yìwài.
B4L11-1-51.english: People who drive to drink wedding wine had best refuse when they encounter a toast, so as to avoid an accident on the way home.

B4L11-1-52.chinese: 現代的口紅不僅使用方便，在顏色上也有不少變化。
B4L11-1-52.pinyin: Xiàndài de kǒuhóng bùjǐn shǐyòng fāngbiàn, zài yánsè shàng yě yǒu bùshǎo biànhuà.
B4L11-1-52.english: Modern lipstick is not only convenient to use, but also has quite a few variations in color.

B4L11-1-53.chinese: 麵包如果不想烤得太乾，可以在烤前噴點兒水。
B4L11-1-53.pinyin: Miànbāo rúguǒ bù xiǎng kǎo de tài gān, kěyǐ zài kǎo qián pēn diǎnr shuǐ.
B4L11-1-53.english: If you don't want the bread to be baked too dry, you can spray a little water before baking.

B4L11-1-54.chinese: 每次到了新年，華人就會在門前放鞭炮，好好地熱鬧一番。
B4L11-1-54.pinyin: Měi cì dào le xīnnián, Huárén jiù huì zài mén qián fàng biānpào, hǎohǎo de rènào yī fān.
B4L11-1-54.english: Every time the New Year arrives, Chinese people set off firecrackers in front of their doors and have a good lively time.

B4L11-1-55.chinese: 我們公司的大型宴會活動，一向是宣傳部門負責處理的。
B4L11-1-55.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī de dàxíng yànhuì huódòng, yīxiàng shì xuānchuán bùmén fùzé chǔlǐ de.
B4L11-1-55.english: Our company's large-scale banquet events have always been handled by the publicity department.

B4L11-1-56.chinese: 一般來說，參加正式活動都得好好打扮，服裝也應該講究。
B4L11-1-56.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, cānjiā zhèngshì huódòng dōu děi hǎohǎo dǎbàn, fúzhuāng yě yīnggāi jiǎngjiu.
B4L11-1-56.english: Generally speaking, to attend formal events one must dress up properly, and clothing should also be carefully chosen.

B4L11-1-57.chinese: A:那所大學雖然相當著名，但我國政府不承認他們的學位(academic degree)。B:許多國家都承認那所大學的學位，貴國哪裡有不承認的道理？
B4L11-1-57.pinyin: A: Nà suǒ dàxué suīrán xiāngdāng zhùmíng, dàn wǒguó zhèngfǔ bù chéngrèn tāmen de xuéwèi. B: Xǔduō guójiā dōu chéngrèn nà suǒ dàxué de xuéwèi, guìguó nǎlǐ yǒu bù chéngrèn de dàolǐ?
B4L11-1-57.english: A: Although that university is quite famous, our government does not recognize their academic degrees. B: Many countries recognize that university's degrees—how could your esteemed country have any reason not to recognize them?

B4L11-1-58.chinese: 想擁有一段百年好合的婚姻，除了真心的愛情之外，也應重視家庭的責任。
B4L11-1-58.pinyin: Xiǎng yǒngyǒu yī duàn bǎiniánhǎohé de hūnyīn, chúle zhēnxīn de àiqíng zhīwài, yě yīng zhòngshì jiātíng de zérèn.
B4L11-1-58.english: If you want to have a marriage that is a harmonious union forever, in addition to genuine love, you should also value family responsibility.

B4L11-1-59.chinese: 孩子：我玩電腦遊戲玩得正高興，你為什麼不讓我繼續玩？爸爸：得了！你玩到眼睛都紅了。去外面運動運動。
B4L11-1-59.pinyin: Háizi: Wǒ wán diànnǎo yóuxì wán de zhèng gāoxìng, nǐ wèishénme bù ràng wǒ jìxù wán? Bàba: Dé le! Nǐ wán dào yǎnjing dōu hóng le. Qù wàimiàn yùndòng yùndòng.
B4L11-1-59.english: Child: I'm having a great time playing computer games, why won't you let me keep playing? Dad: That's enough! You've played until your eyes are all red. Go outside and get some exercise.

B4L11-1-60.chinese: A:江先生對父母很孝順，個性又溫柔，將來一定是好先生。B:這還用說嗎？要是妳對他有意思，就得早點兒行動喔！
B4L11-1-60.pinyin: A: Jiāng xiānsheng duì fùmǔ hěn xiàoshùn, gèxìng yòu wēnróu, jiānglái yīdìng shì hǎo xiānsheng. B: Zhè hái yòng shuō ma? Yàoshi nǐ duì tā yǒu yìsi, jiù děi zǎo diǎnr xíngdòng o!
B4L11-1-60.english: A: Mr. Jiang is very filial to his parents and has a gentle personality; in the future he will definitely be a good husband. B: You're telling me! If you're interested in him, you'd better make a move early!

B4L11-2-01.chinese: 他贏了這次選舉只是運氣好罷了，其實他沒什麼能力。
B4L11-2-01.pinyin: Tā yíng le zhè cì xuǎnjǔ zhǐshì yùnqi hǎo bàle, qíshí tā méi shénme nénglì.
B4L11-2-01.english: He won this election only because he was lucky, that's all; actually, he doesn't have much ability.

B4L11-2-02.chinese: 你想參加這項長跑比賽的話，可以到網站報名，登記之後會有人跟你聯絡。
B4L11-2-02.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng cānjiā zhè xiàng chángpǎo bǐsài de huà, kěyǐ dào wǎngzhàn bàomíng, dēngjì zhīhòu huì yǒu rén gēn nǐ liánluò.
B4L11-2-02.english: If you want to participate in this long-distance race, you can sign up on the website; after you register, someone will contact you.

B4L11-2-03.chinese: 這次活動大家都化裝參加，要是你碰見我大概認不出我是誰。
B4L11-2-03.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng dàjiā dōu huàzhuāng cānjiā, yàoshi nǐ pèngjiàn wǒ dàgài rèn bù chū wǒ shì shéi.
B4L11-2-03.english: Everyone is attending this event in disguise; if you run into me, you probably won't recognize who I am.

B4L11-2-04.chinese: 如果有任何困難請別客氣，我很樂意幫你的忙。
B4L11-2-04.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu rènhé kùnnan qǐng bié kèqi, wǒ hěn lèyì bāng nǐ de máng.
B4L11-2-04.english: If you have any difficulties, please don't be polite; I am very willing to help you.

B4L11-2-05.chinese: 連經理很講話，開會時老是說個不停，別人都沒說話的分。
B4L11-2-05.pinyin: Lián jīnglǐ hěn jiǎng huà, kāihuì shí lǎoshì shuō gè bù tíng, biérén dōu méi shuōhuà de fèn.
B4L11-2-05.english: Manager Lian talks a lot; during meetings he never stops talking, and others have no share of the speaking.

B4L11-2-06.chinese: 有人覺得留鬍子比較帥，我倒是覺得留了鬍子看起來比較老。
B4L11-2-06.pinyin: Yǒu rén juéde liú húzi bǐjiào shuài, wǒ dàoshì juéde liú le húzi kàn qǐlái bǐjiào lǎo.
B4L11-2-06.english: Some people think that having a beard looks more handsome, but I actually think that having a beard makes you look older.

B4L11-2-07.chinese: 小周找到理想工作後，女友特地送了一條領帶當作禮物，還親手為他打領帶，祝賀他有個好的開始。
B4L11-2-07.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu zhǎodào lǐxiǎng gōngzuò hòu, nǚyǒu tèdì sòng le yī tiáo lǐngdài dāngzuò lǐwù, hái qīnshǒu wèi tā dǎ lǐngdài, zhùhè tā yǒu gè hǎo de kāishǐ.
B4L11-2-07.english: After Xiao Zhou found his ideal job, his girlfriend specially gave him a necktie as a gift, and even personally tied the necktie for him, congratulating him on a good start.

B4L11-2-08.chinese: 天氣這麼熱，你居然穿著一件大外套，不覺得不舒服嗎？
B4L11-2-08.pinyin: Tiānqì zhème rè, nǐ jūrán chuānzhe yī jiàn dà wàitào, bù juéde bù shūfu ma?
B4L11-2-08.english: The weather is so hot, yet you unexpectedly are wearing a big coat—don't you feel uncomfortable?

B4L11-2-09.chinese: 你別看她一臉害羞的樣子，在熟人面前她可是很開朗的。
B4L11-2-09.pinyin: Nǐ bié kàn tā yī liǎn hàixiū de yàngzi, zài shúrén miànqián tā kěshì hěn kāilǎng de.
B4L11-2-09.english: Don't judge her by her shy appearance; in front of acquaintances she is actually very cheerful.

B4L11-2-10.chinese: 我的親戚是數學教授，每次我有這方面的問題就向他請教。
B4L11-2-10.pinyin: Wǒ de qīnqi shì shùxué jiàoshòu, měi cì wǒ yǒu zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí jiù xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
B4L11-2-10.english: My relative is a math professor; every time I have a question in this area, I consult him.

B4L11-2-11.chinese: 有些女性懷孕時飲食習慣會有極大的改變，醫生說這是正常現象。
B4L11-2-11.pinyin: Yǒuxiē nǚxìng huáiyùn shí yǐnshí xíguàn huì yǒu jídà de gǎibiàn, yīshēng shuō zhè shì zhèngcháng xiànxiàng.
B4L11-2-11.english: Some women experience great changes in their eating habits when they become pregnant; doctors say this is a normal phenomenon.

B4L11-2-12.chinese: 人生短短幾十年，一輩子很快就過去了，因此應該活得精彩、過得有意義。
B4L11-2-12.pinyin: Rénshēng duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yībèizi hěn kuài jiù guòqù le, yīncǐ yīnggāi huó de jīngcǎi, guò de yǒu yìyì.
B4L11-2-12.english: Life is only a short few decades; a lifetime passes quickly, so one should live splendidly and meaningfully.

B4L11-2-13.chinese: 看見別人事業很成功，除了羨慕以外，更要學習他的優點。
B4L11-2-13.pinyin: Kànjiàn biérén shìyè hěn chénggōng, chúle xiànmù yǐwài, gèng yào xuéxí tā de yōudiǎn.
B4L11-2-13.english: When you see others being very successful in their careers, besides envying them, you should also learn from their strengths.

B4L11-2-14.chinese: 在冬天的深夜裡，坐在溫暖的地毯上靜靜地看書是一種享受。
B4L11-2-14.pinyin: Zài dōngtiān de shēnyè lǐ, zuò zài wēnnuǎn de dìtǎn shàng jìngjìng de kànshū shì yī zhǒng xiǎngshòu.
B4L11-2-14.english: In the late night of winter, sitting on a warm carpet and reading quietly is a kind of enjoyment.

B4L11-2-15.chinese: 金小姐常利用假日，牽著家中那隻活潑的小黑狗到街上逛逛。
B4L11-2-15.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě cháng lìyòng jiàrì, qiānzhe jiā zhōng nà zhī huópō de xiǎo hēigǒu dào jiē shàng guàngguang.
B4L11-2-15.english: Miss Jin often uses her holidays to hold the leash of that lively little black dog at home and take it for a stroll on the streets.

B4L11-2-16.chinese: 在公車上，看到年紀大的人應該讓位子請他們坐。
B4L11-2-16.pinyin: Zài gōngchē shàng, kàndào niánjì dà de rén yīnggāi ràng wèizi qǐng tāmen zuò.
B4L11-2-16.english: On the bus, when you see elderly people, you should yield your seat and ask them to sit.

B4L11-2-17.chinese: 章小姐接觸電影表演工作不久，雖然還是新人，對表演技巧倒是掌握得挺好的。
B4L11-2-17.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě jiēchù diànyǐng biǎoyǎn gōngzuò bùjiǔ, suīrán hái shì xīnrén, duì biǎoyǎn jìqiǎo dàoshì zhǎngwò de tǐng hǎo de.
B4L11-2-17.english: Miss Zhang has not been involved in film acting for long; although she is still a newcomer, she has actually mastered acting techniques quite well.

B4L11-2-18.chinese: 故事中的女主角吻了白馬一下，白馬就變成了英俊的國王。
B4L11-2-18.pinyin: Gùshì zhōng de nǚzhǔjiǎo wěn le báimǎ yīxià, báimǎ jiù biànchéng le yīngjùn de guówáng.
B4L11-2-18.english: The female protagonist in the story kissed the white horse once, and the white horse turned into a handsome king.

B4L11-2-19.chinese: 為了安全起見，颱風天到山區露營的行為是被嚴格禁止的。
B4L11-2-19.pinyin: Wèile ānquán qǐjiàn, táifēng tiān dào shānqū lùyíng de xíngwéi shì bèi yángé jìnzhǐ de.
B4L11-2-19.english: For the sake of safety, camping in mountainous areas on typhoon days is strictly prohibited.

B4L12-1-01.chinese: 他想寫一本以各行各業人物當作題材的長篇小說。
B4L12-1-01.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiě yī běn yǐ gègèhánggèyè rénwù dāngzuò tícái de chángpiān xiǎoshuō.
B4L12-1-01.english: He wants to write a full-length novel that uses people from all walks of life as its subject matter.

B4L12-1-02.chinese: 我們公司因為業務需要，最近增加了不少人力。
B4L12-1-02.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī yīnwèi yèwù xūyào, zuìjìn zēngjiā le bùshǎo rénlì.
B4L12-1-02.english: Because of business needs, our company has recently added quite a bit of manpower.

B4L12-1-03.chinese: 大多數投資專家都不敢保證在房屋市場一定能賺錢。
B4L12-1-03.pinyin: Dàduōshù tóuzī zhuānjiā dōu bù gǎn bǎozhèng zài fángwū shìchǎng yīdìng néng zhuànqián.
B4L12-1-03.english: Most investment experts do not dare to guarantee that you can definitely make money in the housing market.

B4L12-1-04.chinese: 跟那位學者談話是種享受，能夠自由又自在地交換想法。
B4L12-1-04.pinyin: Gēn nà wèi xuézhě tánhuà shì zhǒng xiǎngshòu, nénggòu zìyóu yòu zìzài de jiāohuàn xiǎngfǎ.
B4L12-1-04.english: Talking with that scholar is a kind of enjoyment—being able to exchange ideas freely and comfortably.

B4L12-1-05.chinese: 當你大學畢業，不再升學時，就得考慮就業問題了。
B4L12-1-05.pinyin: Dāng nǐ dàxué bìyè, bù zài shēngxué shí, jiù děi kǎolǜ jiùyè wèntí le.
B4L12-1-05.english: When you graduate from university and are no longer pursuing further studies, you then have to consider the issue of employment.

B4L12-1-06.chinese: 有能力的人就算不幸失業了，將來還是有許多機會等待著他。
B4L12-1-06.pinyin: Yǒu nénglì de rén jiùsuàn bùxìng shīyè le, jiānglái háishì yǒu xǔduō jīhuì děngdàizhe tā.
B4L12-1-06.english: Even if capable people unfortunately lose their jobs, there are still many opportunities waiting for them in the future.

B4L12-1-07.chinese: 這對夫婦打扮得相當講究，讓我對他們從事的行業很感興趣。
B4L12-1-07.pinyin: Zhè duì fūfù dǎbàn de xiāngdāng jiǎngjiū, ràng wǒ duì tāmen cóngshì de hángyè hěn gǎn xìngqù.
B4L12-1-07.english: This couple dresses quite elegantly, which makes me very interested in the profession they are engaged in.

B4L12-1-08.chinese: 天天說自己外行、不願嘗試的人，就無法更深入地瞭解世界。
B4L12-1-08.pinyin: Tiāntiān shuō zìjǐ wàiháng, bù yuàn chángshì de rén, jiù wúfǎ gèng shēnrù de liǎojiě shìjiè.
B4L12-1-08.english: People who say they are laymen every day and are unwilling to try cannot understand the world more deeply.

B4L12-1-09.chinese: 公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
B4L12-1-09.pinyin: Gōngsī bùduàn tuīxiāo xīnxíng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn, tōngcháng shì wèile cìjī kèhù gòumǎi.
B4L12-1-09.english: Companies constantly promote new types of electronic products, usually in order to stimulate customers to buy.

B4L12-1-10.chinese: 各行各業都有屬於自己的專業，無法比較誰高誰低。
B4L12-1-10.pinyin: Gè háng gè yè dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de zhuānyè, wúfǎ bǐjiào shéi gāo shéi dī.
B4L12-1-10.english: Every profession has its own specialty; it is impossible to compare who is higher and who is lower.

B4L12-1-11.chinese: 個性親切、大方，通常是從事服務業的最佳人才。
B4L12-1-11.pinyin: Gèxìng qīnqiè, dàfāng, tōngcháng shì cóngshì fúwùyè de zuìjiā réncái.
B4L12-1-11.english: People with a friendly and generous personality are usually the best talent for working in the service industry.

B4L12-1-12.chinese: 那家報社非常細心，他們的文章從沒出現過一個錯字。
B4L12-1-12.pinyin: Nà jiā bàoshè fēicháng xìxīn, tāmen de wénzhāng cóng méi chūxiànguò yí gè cuòzì.
B4L12-1-12.english: That newspaper publisher is very careful; their articles have never had a single typo.

B4L12-1-13.chinese: 公司如果關心客戶並達成他們的需求，對業務或多或少有好處。
B4L12-1-13.pinyin: Gōngsī rúguǒ guānxīn kèhù bìng dáchéng tāmen de xūqiú, duì yèwù huòduōhuòshǎo yǒu hǎochù.
B4L12-1-13.english: If a company cares about its customers and meets their needs, it is more or less beneficial to the business.

B4L12-1-14.chinese: 手機廠商時常邀請明星替他們的產品宣傳。
B4L12-1-14.pinyin: Shǒujī chǎngshāng shícháng yāoqǐng míngxīng tì tāmen de chǎnpǐn xuānchuán.
B4L12-1-14.english: Mobile phone manufacturers often invite celebrities to promote their products.

B4L12-1-15.chinese: 擁有一架小飛機並親自在天空上駕駛，一直是孫小姐的夢想。
B4L12-1-15.pinyin: Yōngyǒu yí jià xiǎo fēijī bìng qīnzì zài tiānkōng shàng jiàshǐ, yìzhí shì Sūn xiǎojiě de mèngxiǎng.
B4L12-1-15.english: Owning a small airplane and piloting it in the sky oneself has always been Miss Sun's dream.

B4L12-1-16.chinese: 我們特地到當地的滑雪用品工廠參觀，並進行技術交流。
B4L12-1-16.pinyin: Wǒmen tèdì dào dāngdì de huáxuě yòngpǐn gōngchǎng cānguān, bìng jìnxíng jìshù jiāoliú.
B4L12-1-16.english: We specially visited a local ski equipment factory and conducted technical exchanges.

B4L12-1-17.chinese: 我習慣把每一筆支出都記錄起來，提醒自己少花點兒錢。
B4L12-1-17.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn bǎ měi yì bǐ zhīchū dōu jìlù qǐlái, tíxǐng zìjǐ shǎo huā diǎnr qián.
B4L12-1-17.english: I am used to recording every expense, to remind myself to spend a little less money.

B4L12-1-18.chinese: 你的才能符合我們公司的條件，是我們需要的人才。
B4L12-1-18.pinyin: Nǐ de cáinéng fúhé wǒmen gōngsī de tiáojiàn, shì wǒmen xūyào de réncái.
B4L12-1-18.english: Your talent matches our company's requirements; you are the talent we need.

B4L12-1-19.chinese: 水和冰基本上是相同的，只是因溫度而產生不同的變化。
B4L12-1-19.pinyin: Shuǐ hé bīng jīběnshàng shì xiāngtóng de, zhǐshì yīn wēndù ér chǎnshēng bùtóng de biànhuà.
B4L12-1-19.english: Water and ice are basically the same; they just undergo different changes due to temperature.

B4L12-1-20.chinese: 對人民來說，最大的不幸就是國家機構腐敗。
B4L12-1-20.pinyin: Duì rénmín lái shuō, zuìdà de bùxìng jiùshì guójiā jīgòu fǔbài.
B4L12-1-20.english: For the people, the greatest misfortune is corruption in national institutions.

B4L12-1-21.chinese: 企業為了錄用合適的人才，而採用各式各樣的方式。
B4L12-1-21.pinyin: Qǐyè wèile lùyòng héshì de réncái, ér cǎiyòng gè shì gè yàng de fāngshì.
B4L12-1-21.english: Enterprises adopt various methods in order to hire suitable talent.

B4L12-1-22.chinese: 在機構、組織擔任的職位越高，代表個人所負擔的責任越重。
B4L12-1-22.pinyin: Zài jīgòu, zǔzhī dānrèn de zhíwèi yuè gāo, dàibiǎo gèrén suǒ fùdān de zérèn yuè zhòng.
B4L12-1-22.english: The higher the position one holds in an institution or organization, the heavier the responsibility the individual bears.

B4L12-1-23.chinese: 就算擁有高收入，也不見得能讓你過著幸福美好的生活。
B4L12-1-23.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yōngyǒu gāo shōurù, yě bújiàndé néng ràng nǐ guòzhe xìngfú měihǎo de shēnghuó.
B4L12-1-23.english: Even if you have a high income, it does not necessarily mean you can live a happy and wonderful life.

B4L12-1-24.chinese: 開車時不闖紅燈，是為了自己和別人的生命安全。
B4L12-1-24.pinyin: Kāichē shí bù chuǎng hóngdēng, shì wèile zìjǐ hé biérén de shēngmìng ānquán.
B4L12-1-24.english: Not running red lights when driving is for the safety of your own and others' lives.

B4L12-1-25.chinese: 中國的古書雖然難懂，慢慢讀的話，我倒是多少能理解一些。
B4L12-1-25.pinyin: Zhōngguó de gǔshū suīrán nándǒng, mànman dú de huà, wǒ dàoshì duōshǎo néng lǐjiě yìxiē.
B4L12-1-25.english: Although ancient Chinese books are difficult to understand, if I read them slowly, I can more or less understand some of it.

B4L12-1-26.chinese: 購買任何商品時都應考慮功能以及價格。
B4L12-1-26.pinyin: Gòumǎi rènhé shāngpǐn shí dōu yīng kǎolǜ gōngnéng yǐjí jiàgé.
B4L12-1-26.english: When purchasing any product, one should consider its functions as well as its price.

B4L12-1-27.chinese: 一項計畫假如目標不明確，往往就得不到想要的結果。
B4L12-1-27.pinyin: Yí xiàng jìhuà jiǎrú mùbiāo bù míngquè, wǎngwǎng jiù dé bú dào xiǎngyào de jiéguǒ.
B4L12-1-27.english: If a plan's goals are not clear-cut, it often fails to achieve the desired results.

B4L12-1-28.chinese: 想當節目主持人，具有好口才是最基本的條件。
B4L12-1-28.pinyin: Xiǎng dāng jiémù zhǔchírén, jùyǒu hǎo kǒucái shì zuì jīběn de tiáojiàn.
B4L12-1-28.english: If you want to be a program host, having good eloquence is the most basic requirement.

B4L12-1-29.chinese: 接待客戶是有技巧的，弄不好可能會丟了生意。
B4L12-1-29.pinyin: Jiēdài kèhù shì yǒu jìqiǎo de, nòng bù hǎo kěnéng huì diū le shēngyì.
B4L12-1-29.english: Receiving clients requires skill; if you don't handle it well, you might lose the business.

B4L12-1-30.chinese: 有些學校將教育當成商品來買賣，但也有人不支持。
B4L12-1-30.pinyin: Yǒuxiē xuéxiào jiāng jiàoyù dàngchéng shāngpǐn lái mǎimài, dàn yě yǒu rén bù zhīchí.
B4L12-1-30.english: Some schools treat education as a commodity to buy and sell, but there are also people who do not support this.

B4L12-1-31.chinese: 在法律及法院之前，每個人都是平等的。
B4L12-1-31.pinyin: Zài fǎlǜ jí fǎyuàn zhīqián, měi ge rén dōu shì píngděng de.
B4L12-1-31.english: Before the law and the court, everyone is equal.

B4L12-1-32.chinese: 辦公時他常在桌上擺一杯熱咖啡，說是咖啡香能讓精神更好。
B4L12-1-32.pinyin: Bàngōng shí tā cháng zài zhuō shàng bǎi yī bēi rè kāfēi, shuō shì kāfēi xiāng néng ràng jīngshén gèng hǎo.
B4L12-1-32.english: When handling official business, he often places a cup of hot coffee on the desk, saying that the coffee aroma can make him feel more alert.

B4L12-1-33.chinese: 動不動就發脾氣的人，往往無法接受別人的寶貴建議。
B4L12-1-33.pinyin: Dòngbùdòng jiù fā píqì de rén, wǎngwǎng wúfǎ jiēshòu biérén de bǎoguì jiànyì.
B4L12-1-33.english: People who easily lose their temper often cannot accept others' valuable advice.

B4L12-1-34.chinese: 他對志工服務一向有興趣，哪怕做得又忙又累，他也願意。
B4L12-1-34.pinyin: Tā duì zhìgōng fúwù yīxiàng yǒu xìngqù, nǎpà zuò de yòu máng yòu lèi, tā yě yuànyì.
B4L12-1-34.english: He has always been interested in volunteer service; even if it is busy and tiring, he is willing to do it.

B4L12-1-35.chinese: 對企業來說，一個人的工作能力往往比學歷更加重要。
B4L12-1-35.pinyin: Duì qǐyè lái shuō, yī ge rén de gōngzuò nénglì wǎngwǎng bǐ xuélì gèngjiā zhòngyào.
B4L12-1-35.english: For enterprises, a person's work ability is often more important than their educational background.

B4L12-1-36.chinese: 說實話，文憑不是最重要的，重要的是個人的知識與才能。
B4L12-1-36.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, wénpíng bù shì zuì zhòngyào de, zhòngyào de shì gèrén de zhīshì yǔ cáinéng.
B4L12-1-36.english: To be honest, a diploma is not the most important thing; what is important is a person's knowledge and ability.

B4L12-1-37.chinese: 有些事情光是勤勞沒有用，得用對方法才行。
B4L12-1-37.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shìqíng guāng shì qínláo méiyǒu yòng, děi yòng duì fāngfǎ cái xíng.
B4L12-1-37.english: For some things, just being hardworking is not useful; you have to use the right method.

B4L12-1-38.chinese: 這部電腦的鍵盤有幾個鍵壞了，我得找人修理它。
B4L12-1-38.pinyin: Zhè bù diànnǎo de jiànpán yǒu jǐ ge jiàn huài le, wǒ děi zhǎo rén xiūlǐ tā.
B4L12-1-38.english: Several keys on this computer's keyboard are broken; I need to find someone to repair it.

B4L12-1-39.chinese: 等一會兒開會時麻煩你負責打字，把開會的內容記錄下來。
B4L12-1-39.pinyin: Děng yīhuìr kāihuì shí máfan nǐ fùzé dǎzì, bǎ kāihuì de nèiróng jìlù xiàlái.
B4L12-1-39.english: When the meeting starts in a moment, please be responsible for typing and record the meeting content.

B4L12-1-40.chinese: 學校安排我們到鄉下當「一日農民」，體驗農夫的辛苦。
B4L12-1-40.pinyin: Xuéxiào ānpái wǒmen dào xiāngxià dāng “yī rì nóngmín”, tǐyàn nóngfū de xīnkǔ.
B4L12-1-40.english: The school arranged for us to go to the countryside to be a 'farmer for a day' and experience the hardships of farmers.

B4L12-1-41.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
B4L12-1-41.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
B4L12-1-41.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

B4L12-1-42.chinese: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
B4L12-1-42.pinyin: Jìniàn yóupiào yībān dōu shì yǐ lìshǐ shàng de dàshì huò zhòngyào rénwù dàngzuò zhǔtí.
B4L12-1-42.english: Commemorative stamps generally use major historical events or important figures as their themes.

B4L12-1-45.chinese: 工會代表跟老闆討論工資問題，認為公司給的工錢仍然太低。
B4L12-1-45.pinyin: Gōnghuì dàibiǎo gēn lǎobǎn tǎolùn gōngzī wèntí, rènwéi gōngsī gěi de gōngqián réngrán tài dī.
B4L12-1-45.english: The union representative discussed the wage issue with the boss, believing that the wages the company offers are still too low.

B4L12-1-46.chinese: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
B4L12-1-46.pinyin: Zìdònghuà gōngchǎng bùjǐn shǐ shēngchǎn sùdù gèng kuài, tóngshí yě néng bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí.
B4L12-1-46.english: Automated factories not only make production speed faster but also can guarantee product quality.

B4L12-1-47.chinese: 有朋友與家人的鼓勵，使他在面對任何困難時都十分自信。
B4L12-1-47.pinyin: Yǒu péngyǒu yǔ jiārén de gǔlì, shǐ tā zài miànduì rènhé kùnnán shí dōu shífēn zìxìn.
B4L12-1-47.english: With the encouragement of friends and family, he is very confident when facing any difficulty.

B4L12-1-49.chinese: 遇人少比較，遇事放得下，日子就能過得更輕鬆自在。
B4L12-1-49.pinyin: Yù rén shǎo bǐjiào, yù shì fàng de xià, rìzi jiù néng guò de gèng qīngsōng zìzài.
B4L12-1-49.english: Meet people with fewer comparisons, and let go of things when you encounter them; then life can be lived more easily and comfortably.

B4L12-2-01.chinese: 到機場時看見一群戲迷正追著電影明星照相，真有意思。
B4L12-2-01.pinyin: Dào jīchǎng shí kànjiàn yī qún xìmí zhèng zhuī zhe diànyǐng míngxīng zhàoxiàng, zhēn yǒu yìsi.
B4L12-2-01.english: When I arrived at the airport, I saw a group of theater fans chasing after a movie star to take photos; it was really interesting.

B4L12-2-02.chinese: 他的計畫使公司賠了一大筆錢，因此他以辭職表示負責。
B4L12-2-02.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shǐ gōngsī péi le yī dà bǐ qián, yīncǐ tā yǐ cízhí biǎoshì fùzé.
B4L12-2-02.english: His plan caused the company to lose a large sum of money, so he resigned to show responsibility.

B4L12-2-03.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
