B4L12-2-03.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
B4L12-2-03.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

B4L12-2-04.chinese: 他對亞洲文化相當有興趣，計畫將來走遍全亞洲。
B4L12-2-04.pinyin: Tā duì Yàzhōu wénhuà xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, jìhuà jiānglái zǒu biàn quán Yàzhōu.
B4L12-2-04.english: He is quite interested in Asian culture and plans to travel all over Asia in the future.

B4L12-2-05.chinese: 想導演一部以蟲子當作主角的電影，真不是件容易的事。
B4L12-2-05.pinyin: Xiǎng dǎoyǎn yī bù yǐ chóngzi dàngzuò zhǔjiǎo de diànyǐng, zhēn bù shì jiàn róngyì de shì.
B4L12-2-05.english: Wanting to direct a movie with insects as the main characters is really not an easy thing.

B4L12-2-06.chinese: 就算沒有很高的學位，只要用心一樣能對國家社會有貢獻。
B4L12-2-06.pinyin: Jiùsuàn méiyǒu hěn gāo de xuéwèi, zhǐyào yòngxīn yīyàng néng duì guójiā shèhuì yǒu gòngxiàn.
B4L12-2-06.english: Even without a high academic degree, as long as you are dedicated, you can still contribute to the country and society.

B4L12-2-07.chinese: 他用很珍貴的茶具來泡品質很普通的茶葉，真浪費。
B4L12-2-07.pinyin: Tā yòng hěn zhēnguì de chájù lái pào pǐnzhí hěn pǔtōng de cháyè, zhēn làngfèi.
B4L12-2-07.english: He uses very precious tea utensils to brew tea leaves of very ordinary quality; what a waste.

B4L12-2-08.chinese: 都市人口如果過度成長，容易引發環保及交通問題。
B4L12-2-08.pinyin: Dūshì rénkǒu rúguǒ guòdù chéngzhǎng, róngyì yǐnfā huánbǎo jí jiāotōng wèntí.
B4L12-2-08.english: If urban population grows excessively, it easily leads to environmental and traffic problems.

B4L12-2-09.chinese: 從我辦公室隔著玻璃往外看，可以看見開滿鮮花的花園。
B4L12-2-09.pinyin: Cóng wǒ bàngōngshì gézhe bōlí wǎng wài kàn, kěyǐ kànjiàn kāi mǎn xiānhuā de huāyuán.
B4L12-2-09.english: Looking out through the glass from my office, I can see a garden full of blooming flowers.

B4L12-2-10.chinese: 為了發展工業而不斷開發，這樣下去森林早晚會被破壞光的。
B4L12-2-10.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gōngyè ér bùduàn kāifā, zhèyàng xiàqù sēnlín zǎowǎn huì bèi pòhuài guāng de.
B4L12-2-10.english: Developing industry by constantly exploiting resources, if this continues, the forests will sooner or later be completely destroyed.

B4L12-2-11.chinese: 用人類的角度去看大自然， 就看不出大自然的本來價值。
B4L12-2-11.pinyin: Yòng rénlèi de jiǎodù qù kàn dàzìrán, jiù kàn bù chū dàzìrán de běnlái jiàzhí.
B4L12-2-11.english: Looking at nature from a human perspective, you cannot see nature's original value.

B4L12-2-12.chinese: 這種化妝品是針對東方人的皮膚設計的，在臺灣賣得很好。
B4L12-2-12.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huàzhuāngpǐn shì zhēnduì dōngfāngrén de pífū shèjì de, zài Táiwān mài de hěn hǎo.
B4L12-2-12.english: This kind of cosmetics is designed specifically for Eastern people's skin, and sells very well in Taiwan.

B4L12-2-13.chinese: 我與高中同學已十多年沒見了，想找個適當時間邀請大家聚聚。
B4L12-2-13.pinyin: Wǒ yǔ gāozhōng tóngxué yǐ shí duō nián méi jiàn le, xiǎng zhǎo ge shìdàng shíjiān yāoqǐng dàjiā jù ju.
B4L12-2-13.english: I haven't seen my high school classmates for over ten years; I want to find an appropriate time to invite everyone to get together.

B4L12-2-14.chinese: 他利用石頭、木頭在山上建了一間美麗的小屋。
B4L12-2-14.pinyin: Tā lìyòng shítou, mùtou zài shān shàng jiàn le yī jiān měilì de xiǎowū.
B4L12-2-14.english: He used stones and wood to build a beautiful little house on the mountain.

B4L12-2-15.chinese: 從事電視新聞工作的人有義務傳播正確的消息。
B4L12-2-15.pinyin: Cóngshì diànshì xīnwén gōngzuò de rén yǒu yìwù chuánbō zhèngquè de xiāoxi.
B4L12-2-15.english: People working in television news have an obligation to disseminate correct information.

B4L12-2-16.chinese: 對他來說，這趟旅行的唯一目的僅是為了尋找畫畫的題材。
B4L12-2-16.pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, zhè tàng lǚxíng de wéiyī mùdì jǐn shì wèile xúnzhǎo huà huà de tícái.
B4L12-2-16.english: For him, the only purpose of this trip is solely to find subjects for painting.

B4L12-2-17.chinese: 這對情侶找了幾位朋友商量，一起安排結婚典禮。
B4L12-2-17.pinyin: Zhè duì qínglǚ zhǎo le jǐ wèi péngyou shāngliang, yīqǐ ānpái jiéhūn diǎnlǐ.
B4L12-2-17.english: This couple found several friends to consult with and together arrange their wedding ceremony.

B4L12-2-18.chinese: 當你願意開放自己的心時， 你所見的世界也會更加地美妙。
B4L12-2-18.pinyin: Dāng nǐ yuànyì kāifàng zìjǐ de xīn shí, nǐ suǒ jiàn de shìjiè yě huì gèngjiā de měimiào.
B4L12-2-18.english: When you are willing to open your heart, the world you see will also become even more wonderful.

B4L12-2-19.chinese: 他想成為網路作家，不過擔心將來的收入可能不穩定。
B4L12-2-19.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi wǎnglù zuòjiā, bùguò dānxīn jiānglái de shōurù kěnéng bù wěndìng.
B4L12-2-19.english: He wants to become an online writer, but worries that his future income may be unstable.

B4L12-2-20.chinese: 人的性格主要是受成長環境的影響，跟性別沒有太大的關係。
B4L12-2-20.pinyin: Rén de xìnggé zhǔyào shì shòu chéngzhǎng huánjìng de yǐngxiǎng, gēn xìngbié méiyǒu tài dà de guānxi.
B4L12-2-20.english: A person's personality is mainly influenced by their growing environment, and has little to do with gender.

B4L12-2-21.chinese: 他放下工作回家鄉的理由，是因為家裡的農場無人照顧。
B4L12-2-21.pinyin: Tā fàngxià gōngzuò huí jiāxiāng de lǐyóu, shì yīnwèi jiā lǐ de nóngchǎng wú rén zhàogù.
B4L12-2-21.english: The reason he gave up his job and returned to his hometown is that no one was taking care of the family farm.

B4L12-2-22.chinese: 每個人都有不小心發生錯誤的時候，不需要取笑別人。
B4L12-2-22.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng cuòwù de shíhou, bù xūyào qǔxiào biérén.
B4L12-2-22.english: Everyone has times when they accidentally make mistakes; there is no need to make fun of others.

B4L13-1-01.chinese: 小孩都希望擁有一臺能幫他寫功課的機器人。
B4L13-1-01.pinyin: Xiǎohái dōu xīwàng yōngyǒu yī tái néng bāng tā xiě gōngkè de jīqìrén.
B4L13-1-01.english: All children hope to have a robot that can help them do their homework.

B4L13-1-02.chinese: 這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
B4L13-1-02.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shǐyòng de dàxíng jīxiè quán dōu shì qiǎnlǜsè de, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu tèsè.
B4L13-1-02.english: The large machinery used in this factory is all light green, and looks very distinctive.

B4L13-1-03.chinese: 那家博物館平日展覽的物品很多，中多半與古代科技有關。
B4L13-1-03.pinyin: Nà jiā bówùguǎn píngrì zhǎnlǎn de wùpǐn hěn duō, qízhōng duōbàn yǔ gǔdài kējì yǒu guān.
B4L13-1-03.english: That museum exhibits many items on weekdays, most of which are related to ancient technology.

B4L13-1-04.chinese: 他因為生活條件的限制，而放棄了出國留學的機會。
B4L13-1-04.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi shēnghuó tiáojiàn de xiànzhì, ér fàngqì le chūguó liúxué de jīhuì.
B4L13-1-04.english: Due to limitations in his living conditions, he gave up the opportunity to study abroad.

B4L13-1-05.chinese: 他對人很不客氣，因此大家都懶得理他。
B4L13-1-05.pinyin: Tā duì rén hěn bù kèqi, yīncǐ dàjiā dōu lǎn de lǐ tā.
B4L13-1-05.english: He is very impolite to people, so everyone cannot be bothered to pay attention to him.

B4L13-1-06.chinese: 小張出車禍雖然賠了很多錢，不過好在人沒事。
B4L13-1-06.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng chū chēhuò suīrán péi le hěn duō qián, bùguò hǎozài rén méi shì.
B4L13-1-06.english: Although Xiao Zhang had a car accident and paid a lot of money, fortunately no one was hurt.

B4L13-1-07.chinese: 對顧客來說，品牌代表了對公司服務的印象以及商品的品質。
B4L13-1-07.pinyin: Duì gùkè lái shuō, pǐnpái dàibiǎo le duì gōngsī fúwù de yìnxiàng yǐjí shāngpǐn de pǐnzhì.
B4L13-1-07.english: For customers, a brand represents the impression of the company's service as well as the quality of the product.

B4L13-1-08.chinese: 李伯伯對做家事有很多妙主意，因此附近的鄰居常向他請教。
B4L13-1-08.pinyin: Lǐ bóbo duì zuò jiāshì yǒu hěn duō miào zhǔyi, yīncǐ fùjìn de línjū cháng xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
B4L13-1-08.english: Uncle Li has many clever ideas for doing housework, so neighbors nearby often ask him for advice.

B4L13-1-09.chinese: 她在電子工廠上班，難怪拆機器的技術非常熟練。
B4L13-1-09.pinyin: Tā zài diànzǐ gōngchǎng shàngbān, nánguài chāi jīqì de jìshù fēicháng shúliàn.
B4L13-1-09.english: She works at an electronics factory, no wonder her skill in disassembling machines is very proficient.

B4L13-1-10.chinese: 你去書房把地板拖乾淨，好放我新買的地毯。
B4L13-1-10.pinyin: Nǐ qù shūfáng bǎ dìbǎn tuō gānjìng, hǎo fàng wǒ xīn mǎi de dìtǎn.
B4L13-1-10.english: Go to the study and mop the floor clean, so we can put down the new carpet I bought.

B4L13-1-11.chinese: 很多人購物不在乎商品的品牌，只要耐用就好。
B4L13-1-11.pinyin: Hěnduō rén gòuwù bù zàihu shāngpǐn de pǐnpái, zhǐyào nàiyòng jiù hǎo.
B4L13-1-11.english: Many people don't care about the brand of a product when shopping; as long as it's durable, that's fine.

B4L13-1-12.chinese: 小王剛買了一臺電腦，有些功能還不太會操作。
B4L13-1-12.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng gāng mǎi le yì tái diànnǎo, yǒuxiē gōngnéng hái bú tài huì cāozuò.
B4L13-1-12.english: Xiao Wang just bought a computer, and there are still some functions he doesn't really know how to operate.

B4L13-1-13.chinese: 我新學的舞蹈很複雜，常忘了什麼時候前進或後退。
B4L13-1-13.pinyin: Wǒ xīn xué de wǔdǎo hěn fùzá, cháng wàng le shénme shíhou qiánjìn huò hòutuì.
B4L13-1-13.english: The dance I'm newly learning is very complicated; I often forget when to move forward or backward.

B4L13-1-14.chinese: 這兩臺機器樣子相同，但在構造與功能上是有差別的。
B4L13-1-14.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tái jīqì yàngzi xiāngtóng, dàn zài gòuzào yǔ gōngnéng shàng shì yǒu chābié de.
B4L13-1-14.english: These two machines look the same, but they differ in structure and function.

B4L13-1-15.chinese: 她在嬰兒車上安裝了一排不同顏色的小燈，看起來很特別。
B4L13-1-15.pinyin: Tā zài yīng'érchē shàng ānzhuāng le yì pái bùtóng yánsè de xiǎo dēng, kàn qǐlái hěn tèbié.
B4L13-1-15.english: She installed a row of small lights of different colors on the stroller; it looks very special.

B4L13-1-16.chinese: 這輛車雖然是從美國進口，但零件卻是在越南生產的。
B4L13-1-16.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē suīrán shì cóng Měiguó jìnkǒu, dàn língjiàn què shì zài Yuènán shēngchǎn de.
B4L13-1-16.english: Although this car is imported from the US, its parts are actually produced in Vietnam.

B4L13-1-17.chinese: 別看張老闆平日吃的、用的都很省，其實他是某家大型電子企業的老闆。
B4L13-1-17.pinyin: Bié kàn Zhāng lǎobǎn píngrì chī de, yòng de dōu hěn shěng, qíshí tā shì mǒu jiā dàxíng diànzǐ qǐyè de lǎobǎn.
B4L13-1-17.english: Don't be fooled by how economical Boss Zhang is in what he eats and uses every day—he's actually the boss of a large electronics company.

B4L13-1-18.chinese: 今天王醫師門診，沒有護理師協助，什麼事都得自己動手。
B4L13-1-18.pinyin: Jīntiān Wáng yīshī ménzhěn, méiyǒu hùlǐshī xiézhù, shénme shì dōu děi zìjǐ dòngshǒu.
B4L13-1-18.english: Dr. Wang is seeing patients today, and without a nurse assisting, he has to set about everything himself.

B4L13-1-19.chinese: 她最近失眠了，連吃了三天的藥也沒改善。
B4L13-1-19.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn shīmián le, lián chī le sān tiān de yào yě méi gǎishàn.
B4L13-1-19.english: She has had insomnia recently; she took medicine for three days in a row and still didn't improve.

B4L13-1-20.chinese: 要是病人頭很暈又有發燒症狀時，就必須立刻送醫院檢查。
B4L13-1-20.pinyin: Yàoshi bìngrén tóu hěn yūn yòu yǒu fāshāo zhèngzhuàng shí, jiù bìxū lìkè sòng yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
B4L13-1-20.english: If a patient is very dizzy and also has fever symptoms, they must be sent to the hospital for examination immediately.

B4L13-1-21.chinese: 運動後吃根香蕉可以補充體力。
B4L13-1-21.pinyin: Yùndòng hòu chī gēn xiāngjiāo kěyǐ bǔchōng tǐlì.
B4L13-1-21.english: Eating a banana after exercise can replenish your energy.

B4L13-1-22.chinese: 表情豐富、能模仿不同人物，是演員應有的基本條件。
B4L13-1-22.pinyin: Biǎoqíng fēngfù, néng mófǎng bùtóng rénwù, shì yǎnyuán yīng yǒu de jīběn tiáojiàn.
B4L13-1-22.english: Having rich facial expressions and being able to imitate different characters are basic requirements for an actor.

B4L13-1-23.chinese: 別看超人那麼受歡迎就羨慕他，其實能力越強，身上的責任也越重。
B4L13-1-23.pinyin: Bié kàn Chāorén nàme shòu huānyíng jiù xiànmù tā, qíshí nénglì yuè qiáng, shēnshang de zérèn yě yuè zhòng.
B4L13-1-23.english: Don't envy Superman just because he's so popular; actually, the stronger your abilities, the heavier your responsibilities.

B4L13-1-24.chinese: 環保署規定禁止使用塑膠袋後，使用購物袋的人就漸漸增加了。
B4L13-1-24.pinyin: Huánbǎoshǔ guīdìng jìnzhǐ shǐyòng sùjiāodài hòu, shǐyòng gòuwùdài de rén jiù jiànjiàn zēngjiā le.
B4L13-1-24.english: After the Environmental Protection Administration banned the use of plastic bags, the number of people using shopping bags gradually increased.

B4L13-1-25.chinese: 接觸陌生的事情及環境時，往往令人有點兒不安，這樣的感覺是很自然的。
B4L13-1-25.pinyin: Jiēchù mòshēng de shìqíng jí huánjìng shí, wǎngwǎng lìng rén yǒudiǎnr bù'ān, zhèyàng de gǎnjué shì hěn zìrán de.
B4L13-1-25.english: When coming into contact with unfamiliar things and environments, people often feel a bit uneasy; this feeling is very natural.

B4L13-1-26.chinese: 千萬別帶著笨重的行李去旅行，那會給你帶來很多麻煩。
B4L13-1-26.pinyin: Qiānwàn bié dài zhe bènzhòng de xíngli qù lǚxíng, nà huì gěi nǐ dàilái hěnduō máfan.
B4L13-1-26.english: By all means don't travel with heavy, cumbersome luggage; that will bring you a lot of trouble.

B4L13-1-27.chinese: 根據氣象資料，這個颱風未來兩天會往西移動，週五起對台灣產生影響。
B4L13-1-27.pinyin: Gēnjù qìxiàng zīliào, zhège táifēng wèilái liǎng tiān huì wǎng xī yídòng, zhōuwǔ qǐ duì Táiwān chǎnshēng yǐngxiǎng.
B4L13-1-27.english: According to meteorological data, this typhoon will move westward over the next two days and will begin to affect Taiwan from Friday.

B4L13-1-28.chinese: 我想在床旁邊擺個書桌，不過空間不太夠，你可以幫我把床移到牆邊嗎？
B4L13-1-28.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài chuáng pángbiān bǎi ge shūzhuō, búguò kōngjiān bú tài gòu, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ bǎ chuáng yí dào qiáng biān ma?
B4L13-1-28.english: I want to put a desk next to the bed, but there isn't quite enough space. Could you help me move the bed to the wall?

B4L13-1-29.chinese: 那家公司的鍵盤常出問題，我再傻也不會跟他們購買。
B4L13-1-29.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngsī de jiànpán cháng chū wèntí, wǒ zài shǎ yě bú huì gēn tāmen gòumǎi.
B4L13-1-29.english: That company's keyboards often have problems; no matter how foolish I am, I wouldn't buy from them.

B4L13-1-30.chinese: 今天搭捷運參加演唱會的民眾很多，車上擠得都不能轉身。
B4L13-1-30.pinyin: Jīntiān dā jiéyùn cānjiā yǎnchànghuì de mínzhòng hěn duō, chē shàng jǐ de dōu bù néng zhuǎnshēn.
B4L13-1-30.english: There were many people taking the MRT to the concert today; the train was so crowded that you couldn't even turn around.

B4L13-1-31.chinese: 祕書趁老闆不在把商品計畫偷走，這事已經交給法院處理了。
B4L13-1-31.pinyin: Mìshū chèn lǎobǎn bú zài bǎ shāngpǐn jìhuà tōu zǒu, zhè shì yǐjīng jiāo gěi fǎyuàn chǔlǐ le.
B4L13-1-31.english: The secretary took advantage of the boss's absence to steal the product plan; this matter has already been handed over to the court.

B4L13-1-32.chinese: 經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
B4L13-1-32.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shǒushù, dé le zhòngbìng de yīng'ér zhōngyú shùnlì de bǎo zhù le shēngmìng.
B4L13-1-32.english: After this surgery, the seriously ill baby finally had its life successfully protected.

B4L13-1-33.chinese: 如果不與別人競爭，你就無法進步。
B4L13-1-33.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù yǔ biérén jìngzhēng, nǐ jiù wúfǎ jìnbù.
B4L13-1-33.english: If you don't compete with others, you won't be able to make progress.

B4L13-1-34.chinese: 臺灣企業到發展中國家設立工廠，是因為當地的人工便宜。
B4L13-1-34.pinyin: Táiwān qǐyè dào fāzhǎnzhōng guójiā shèlì gōngchǎng, shì yīnwèi dāngdì de réngōng piányi.
B4L13-1-34.english: Taiwanese enterprises set up factories in developing countries because local labor is cheap.

B4L13-1-35.chinese: 這本小說的內容重複性太高，一點新鮮感都沒有。
B4L13-1-35.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō de nèiróng chóngfùxìng tài gāo, yìdiǎn xīnxiāngǎn dōu méiyǒu.
B4L13-1-35.english: The content of this novel is too repetitive; it has no freshness at all.

B4L13-1-36.chinese: 這個字不好念，我重複了好幾次，同學都說不對，害我好想放棄。
B4L13-1-36.pinyin: Zhège zì bù hǎo niàn, wǒ chóngfù le hǎo jǐ cì, tóngxué dōu shuō bù duì, hài wǒ hǎo xiǎng fàngqì.
B4L13-1-36.english: This character is hard to pronounce; I repeated it several times, and my classmates all said it was wrong, which made me really want to give up.

B4L13-1-37.chinese: 人們為了節省勞力，發明了許多實用的機械。
B4L13-1-37.pinyin: Rénmen wèile jiéshěng láolì, fāmíng le xǔduō shíyòng de jīxiè.
B4L13-1-37.english: In order to save labor, people invented many practical machines.

B4L13-1-38.chinese: 這項化學實驗在過程中出了問題，我分析了很久才找出原因。
B4L13-1-38.pinyin: Zhè xiàng huàxué shíyàn zài guòchéng zhōng chū le wèntí, wǒ fēnxī le hěn jiǔ cái zhǎochū yuányīn.
B4L13-1-38.english: This chemistry experiment had a problem during the process; I analyzed it for a long time before finding the cause.

B4L13-1-39.chinese: 我討厭搬家，因為大型的家具不好搬運。
B4L13-1-39.pinyin: Wǒ tǎoyàn bānjiā, yīnwèi dàxíng de jiājù bù hǎo bānyùn.
B4L13-1-39.english: I hate moving because large furniture is hard to move.

B4L13-1-40.chinese: 她沒有針對此事發表看法，所以不知道她贊不贊成。
B4L13-1-40.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhēnduì cǐ shì fābiǎo kànfǎ, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào tā zàn bù zànchéng.
B4L13-1-40.english: She didn't express her views on this matter, so we don't know whether she approves or not.

B4L13-1-41.chinese: 隨著科技進步，醫學也不斷前進，當醫師的人得多充實自己。
B4L13-1-41.pinyin: Suízhe kējì jìnbù, yīxué yě bùduàn qiánjìn, dāng yīshī de rén děi duō chōngshí zìjǐ.
B4L13-1-41.english: With technological progress, medicine also continuously advances; those who become doctors must enrich themselves a lot.

B4L13-1-42.chinese: 對學生來說，經常失眠可能降低學習效率。
B4L13-1-42.pinyin: Duì xuéshēng lái shuō, jīngcháng shīmián kěnéng jiàngdī xuéxí xiàolǜ.
B4L13-1-42.english: For students, frequent insomnia may reduce learning efficiency.

B4L13-1-44.chinese: 這家造船公司製造的船因成本高，價錢稍微貴了一點兒。
B4L13-1-44.pinyin: Zhè jiā zàochuán gōngsī zhìzào de chuán yīn chéngběn gāo, jiàqián shāowēi guì le yīdiǎnr.
B4L13-1-44.english: The ships manufactured by this shipbuilding company are slightly more expensive because of high costs.

B4L13-1-45.chinese: 一般來說，手工做的麵包比機器做的好吃。
B4L13-1-45.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, shǒugōng zuò de miànbāo bǐ jīqì zuò de hǎochī.
B4L13-1-45.english: Generally speaking, handmade bread tastes better than machine-made bread.

B4L13-1-46.chinese: A:你要不要跟我一起去茶館喝杯茶？ B:與其去喝茶，我倒想去外面走走，看看花草樹木。
B4L13-1-46.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù cháguǎn hē bēi chá? B: Yǔqí qù hē chá, wǒ dào xiǎng qù wàimiàn zǒuzǒu, kànkan huā cǎo shùmù.
B4L13-1-46.english: A: Do you want to go to the teahouse with me to have a cup of tea? B: Rather than go drink tea, I'd actually like to go for a walk outside and look at the flowers, grass, and trees.

B4L13-1-47.chinese: 你在外面花錢吃不健康的食物，還不如自己在家煮。
B4L13-1-47.pinyin: Nǐ zài wàimiàn huāqián chī bù jiànkāng de shíwù, hái bùrú zìjǐ zài jiā zhǔ.
B4L13-1-47.english: You spend money eating unhealthy food outside; you'd be better off cooking at home yourself.

B4L13-2-01.chinese: 她最近臉色都不好，我們是否該關心她一下？
B4L13-2-01.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn liǎnsè dōu bù hǎo, wǒmen shìfǒu gāi guānxīn tā yīxià?
B4L13-2-01.english: She hasn't been looking well lately; should we show her some concern?

B4L13-2-02.chinese: 在歷史上，每次革命都對社會造成非常大的影響。
B4L13-2-02.pinyin: Zài lìshǐ shàng, měi cì gémìng dōu duì shèhuì zàochéng fēicháng dà de yǐngxiǎng.
B4L13-2-02.english: In history, every revolution has had a very great impact on society.

B4L13-2-03.chinese: 無論發生什麼事，她都會跟父母商量，並參考他們的意見。
B4L13-2-03.pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme shì, tā dōu huì gēn fùmǔ shāngliang, bìng cānkǎo tāmen de yìjiàn.
B4L13-2-03.english: No matter what happens, she will discuss it with her parents and refer to their opinions.

B4L13-2-05.chinese: 跑步比賽的起點跟終點之間都有人協助，避免參加比賽的人發生狀況。
B4L13-2-05.pinyin: Pǎobù bǐsài de qǐdiǎn gēn zhōngdiǎn zhījiān dōu yǒu rén xiézhù, bìmiǎn cānjiā bǐsài de rén fāshēng zhuàngkuàng.
B4L13-2-05.english: Between the starting point and the finishing line of the running race, there are people assisting to prevent situations from happening to the participants.

B4L13-2-06.chinese: 隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
B4L13-2-06.pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐ chǎnyè fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shòudào hěn shēn de yǐngxiǎng.
B4L13-2-06.english: With the development of the electronics industry, people's living habits have also been deeply affected.

B4L13-2-07.chinese: 從事新工作時往往經驗不足，因此向別人請教是必需的。
B4L13-2-07.pinyin: Cóngshì xīn gōngzuò shí wǎngwǎng jīngyàn bùzú, yīncǐ xiàng biérén qǐngjiào shì bìxū de.
B4L13-2-07.english: When starting a new job, one often lacks experience, so asking others for advice is necessary.

B4L13-2-08.chinese: 我的電腦系統無法升級，所以很多功能都不能使用。
B4L13-2-08.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo xìtǒng wúfǎ shēngjí, suǒyǐ hěn duō gōngnéng dōu bùnéng shǐyòng.
B4L13-2-08.english: My computer system cannot be upgraded, so many functions cannot be used.

B4L13-2-09.chinese: 這條道路限制車速五十公里，你不能再加速了。
B4L13-2-09.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dàolù xiànzhì chēsù wǔshí gōnglǐ, nǐ bùnéng zài jiāsù le.
B4L13-2-09.english: This road has a speed limit of 50 kilometers; you cannot accelerate any more.

B4L13-2-10.chinese: 自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
B4L13-2-10.pinyin: Zìcóng cǎiyòng zhuānjiā tígōng de fāngfǎ hòu, cháyè de chǎnliàng yǐ zēngjiā bǎifēnzhī wǔshí.
B4L13-2-10.english: Since adopting the method provided by experts, the production output of tea leaves has increased by 50 percent.

B4L13-2-11.chinese: 化裝舞會上他打扮成一具機器人，連說話走路都模仿機器人。
B4L13-2-11.pinyin: Huàzhuāng wǔhuì shàng tā dǎbàn chéng yī jù jīqìrén, lián shuōhuà zǒulù dōu mófǎng jīqìrén.
B4L13-2-11.english: At the masquerade ball, he dressed up as a robot, even imitating a robot when speaking and walking.

B4L13-2-12.chinese: 為了保住勞工的福利，她到處去演講。
B4L13-2-12.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhù láogōng de fúlì, tā dàochù qù yǎnjiǎng.
B4L13-2-12.english: In order to protect laborers' welfare, she went everywhere to give speeches.

B4L13-2-13.chinese: 路上安裝紅綠燈，是要保障民眾的交通安全。
B4L13-2-13.pinyin: Lùshàng ānzhuāng hónglǜdēng, shì yào bǎozhàng mínzhòng de jiāotōng ānquán.
B4L13-2-13.english: Installing traffic lights on the road is to safeguard the public's traffic safety.

B4L13-2-14.chinese: 父母反對她從事電影行業，哪怕收入很高，還是不贊成。
B4L13-2-14.pinyin: Fùmǔ fǎnduì tā cóngshì diànyǐng hángyè, nǎpà shōurù hěn gāo, háishì bù zànchéng.
B4L13-2-14.english: Her parents oppose her working in the film industry; even if the income is high, they still do not approve.

B4L13-2-15.chinese: 在自由國家，只要人民覺得不合理，都能跟相關部門抗議。
B4L13-2-15.pinyin: Zài zìyóu guójiā, zhǐyào rénmín juéde bù hélǐ, dōu néng gēn xiāngguān bùmén kàngyì.
B4L13-2-15.english: In a free country, as long as people feel something is unreasonable, they can protest to the relevant departments.

B4L13-2-16.chinese: 老師提醒學生有疑問要馬上解決，免得越到後面越不了解。
B4L13-2-16.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng yǒu yíwèn yào mǎshàng jiějué, miǎnde yuè dào hòumiàn yuè bù liǎojiě.
B4L13-2-16.english: The teacher reminded the students that if they have any questions, they should resolve them immediately, lest the further they go, the less they understand.

B4L13-2-17.chinese: 她的專業是人工智慧，這個領域的問題可以請教她。
B4L13-2-17.pinyin: Tā de zhuānyè shì réngōng zhìhuì, zhège lǐngyù de wèntí kěyǐ qǐngjiào tā.
B4L13-2-17.english: Her specialty is artificial intelligence; you can ask her about problems in this field.

B4L13-2-18.chinese: 當森林漸漸從地球上消失時，可能使全球氣候產生重大的變化。
B4L13-2-18.pinyin: Dāng sēnlín jiànjiàn cóng dìqiú shàng xiāoshī shí, kěnéng shǐ quánqiú qìhòu chǎnshēng zhòngdà de biànhuà.
B4L13-2-18.english: When forests gradually disappear from the Earth, it may cause major changes in the global climate.

B4L13-2-19.chinese: 現在已經沒有所謂的鐵飯碗了，有專業技術才有保障。
B4L13-2-19.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng méiyǒu suǒwèi de tiěfànwǎn le, yǒu zhuānyè jìshù cái yǒu bǎozhàng.
B4L13-2-19.english: Nowadays there is no so-called iron rice bowl anymore; only with professional skills can you have security.

B4L13-2-20.chinese: 這件事我根本不了解，所以沒辦法給你適當的建議。
B4L13-2-20.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ gēnběn bù liǎojiě, suǒyǐ méi bànfǎ gěi nǐ shìdàng de jiànyì.
B4L13-2-20.english: I simply don't understand this matter at all, so I have no way to give you appropriate advice.

B4L13-2-21.chinese: 她到印尼買了一些木頭做的禮品，加工後再到網路上售出。
B4L13-2-21.pinyin: Tā dào Yìnní mǎi le yīxiē mùtou zuò de lǐpǐn, jiāgōng hòu zài dào wǎnglù shàng shòuchū.
B4L13-2-21.english: She went to Indonesia and bought some gifts made of wood; after processing them, she then sold them online.

B4L13-2-22.chinese: 除了他以外，我們都會駕駛汽車。 (Prep)。我買了一雙除臭的襪子送給他。 (V)。一百除二的答案是五十。 (Vst)。
B4L13-2-22.pinyin: Chúle tā yǐwài, wǒmen dōu huì jiàshǐ qìchē. (Prep). Wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng chúchòu de wàzi sòng gěi tā. (V). Yībǎi chú èr de dá'àn shì wǔshí. (Vst).
B4L13-2-22.english: Except for him, we all can drive a car. (Prep). I bought a pair of deodorizing socks to give to him. (V). The answer to one hundred divided by two is fifty. (Vst).

B4L13-2-23.chinese: 無論做錯事或出差錯，任何人都應主動負起責任。
B4L13-2-23.pinyin: Wúlùn zuòcuò shì huò chū chācuò, rènhé rén dōu yīng zhǔdòng fùqǐ zérèn.
B4L13-2-23.english: Whether you do something wrong or a mistake occurs, anyone should take responsibility proactively.

B4L13-2-24.chinese: 腦部血管很複雜，做腦部手術時不能有任何的差錯。
B4L13-2-24.pinyin: Nǎobù xuèguǎn hěn fùzá, zuò nǎobù shǒushù shí bùnéng yǒu rènhé de chācuò.
B4L13-2-24.english: The blood vessels in the brain are very complex; when performing brain surgery, there must not be any mistake.

B4L13-2-25.chinese: 使用高度技術製造出來的工業生產機器，操作起來往往更有效率。
B4L13-2-25.pinyin: Shǐyòng gāodù jìshù zhìzào chūlái de gōngyè shēngchǎn jīqì, cāozuò qǐlái wǎngwǎng gèng yǒu xiàolǜ.
B4L13-2-25.english: Industrial production machines manufactured using highly advanced technology often operate more efficiently.

B4L13-2-26.chinese: 他在山裡迷路了，只好順著河流往山下走。
B4L13-2-26.pinyin: Tā zài shān lǐ mílù le, zhǐhǎo shùnzhe héliú wǎng shān xià zǒu.
B4L13-2-26.english: He got lost in the mountains, so he had no choice but to follow the river downstream.

B4L13-2-27.chinese: 教育是國家的根本，能改變國家的未來。
B4L13-2-27.pinyin: Jiàoyù shì guójiā de gēnběn, néng gǎibiàn guójiā de wèilái.
B4L13-2-27.english: Education is the foundation of a country; it can change the country's future.

B4L14-1-01.chinese: 他想等中文程度達到高級以後，就來臺灣念大學。
B4L14-1-01.pinyin: Tā xiǎng děng Zhōngwén chéngdù dádào gāojí yǐhòu, jiù lái Táiwān niàn dàxué.
B4L14-1-01.english: He wants to wait until his Chinese proficiency reaches the advanced level, and then come to Taiwan to attend university.

B4L14-1-04.chinese: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
B4L14-1-04.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngmíng, chéngjì yòu fēicháng hǎo, yīncǐ wánchéng chūjí bān de kèchéng hòu, xuéxiào ràng tā tiàoguò zhōngjí, dào gāojí bān xuéxí, yīlián tiào le liǎng jí.
B4L14-1-04.english: He is very smart and his grades are also excellent, so after completing the beginner-level class curriculum, the school let him skip the intermediate level and study in the advanced class—he skipped two levels in a row.

B4L14-1-05.chinese: 他初到臺灣時，十分不適應當地的氣候。
B4L14-1-05.pinyin: Tā chū dào Táiwān shí, shífēn bù shìyìng dāngdì de qìhòu.
B4L14-1-05.english: When he first arrived in Taiwan, he was quite unaccustomed to the local climate.

B4L14-1-06.chinese: 他是華僑，說中文時常帶點兒當地的口音。
B4L14-1-06.pinyin: Tā shì huáqiáo, shuō Zhōngwén shí cháng dài diǎnr dāngdì de kǒuyīn.
B4L14-1-06.english: He is an overseas Chinese; when he speaks Chinese, he often has a bit of a local accent.

B4L14-1-07.chinese: 網路商店時常在過節時舉辦降價活動來吸引顧客。
B4L14-1-07.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn shícháng zài guòjié shí jǔbàn jiàngjià huódòng lái xīyǐn gùkè.
B4L14-1-07.english: Online stores often hold discount events during festivals to attract customers.

B4L14-1-08.chinese: 我吃得少，每天早上也運動，但是我的體重仍然超重。
B4L14-1-08.pinyin: Wǒ chī de shǎo, měitiān zǎoshang yě yùndòng, dànshì wǒ de tǐzhòng réngrán chāozhòng.
B4L14-1-08.english: I eat little and also exercise every morning, but my weight is still overweight.

B4L14-1-09.chinese: 冰箱裡的牛奶早就過期了，你還不扔掉嗎？
B4L14-1-09.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ de niúnǎi zǎo jiù guòqī le, nǐ hái bù rēngdiào ma?
B4L14-1-09.english: The milk in the fridge expired long ago—aren't you going to throw it away yet?

B4L14-1-11.chinese: 想有效解決身材肥胖的問題，就應避免吃太肥的肉、太油的菜，同時還得多運動。
B4L14-1-11.pinyin: Xiǎng yǒuxiào jiějué shēncái féipàng de wèntí, jiù yīng bìmiǎn chī tài féi de ròu, tài yóu de cài, tóngshí hái děi duō yùndòng.
B4L14-1-11.english: If you want to effectively solve the problem of being obese, you should avoid eating meat that is too fatty and dishes that are too oily, and at the same time you also need to exercise more.

B4L14-1-12.chinese: 那個網站在拍賣手工肥皂，買一送一，蠻划算的。
B4L14-1-12.pinyin: Nàge wǎngzhàn zài pāimài shǒugōng féizào, mǎi yī sòng yī, mán huásuàn de.
B4L14-1-12.english: That website is auctioning handmade soap, buy one get one free—quite a bargain.

B4L14-1-13.chinese: 火腿裡放了很多鹽巴，醫師不建議爺爺多吃。
B4L14-1-13.pinyin: Huǒtuǐ lǐ fàng le hěn duō yánbā, yīshī bù jiànyì yéye duō chī.
B4L14-1-13.english: A lot of salt is put in ham; the doctor does not recommend that Grandpa eat much of it.

B4L14-1-15.chinese: 奶奶在後院不只種了綠豆及黃豆，還種了許多蔬菜。
B4L14-1-15.pinyin: Nǎinai zài hòuyuàn bùzhǐ zhòng le lǜdòu jí huángdòu, hái zhòng le xǔduō shūcài.
B4L14-1-15.english: Grandma not only planted mung beans and soybeans in the backyard, but also planted many vegetables.

B4L14-1-16.chinese: 弟弟不喜歡吃肉包子裡的餡，他覺得很油膩。
B4L14-1-16.pinyin: Dìdi bù xǐhuān chī ròubāozi lǐ de xiànr, tā juéde hěn yóunì.
B4L14-1-16.english: My younger brother doesn't like to eat the filling in meat buns; he thinks it's very greasy.

B4L14-1-17.chinese: 奶油不但種類多，並且是做甜點時不能少的材料。
B4L14-1-17.pinyin: Nǎiyóu bùdàn zhǒnglèi duō, bìngqiě shì zuò tiándiǎn shí bùnéng shǎo de cáiliào.
B4L14-1-17.english: Butter not only comes in many types, but is also an indispensable ingredient when making desserts.

B4L14-1-18.chinese: 這家廠商針對老年人的需求生產了一種新奶粉。
B4L14-1-18.pinyin: Zhè jiā chǎngshāng zhēnduì lǎoniánrén de xūqiú shēngchǎn le yī zhǒng xīn nǎifěn.
B4L14-1-18.english: This manufacturer, targeting the needs of the elderly, has produced a new kind of powdered milk.

B4L14-1-19.chinese: 算起來我們已經好久沒吃餃子了，買點兒麵粉、青菜和肉，回家包餃子吧。
B4L14-1-19.pinyin: Suàn qǐlái wǒmen yǐjīng hǎojiǔ méi chī jiǎozi le, mǎi diǎnr miànfěn, qīngcài hé ròu, huí jiā bāo jiǎozi ba.
B4L14-1-19.english: Counting it up, we haven't eaten dumplings for a long time; let's buy some flour, vegetables, and meat, and go home to make dumplings.

B4L14-1-20.chinese: 能得到觀眾熱情掌聲的表演，才算是有魅力的表演。
B4L14-1-20.pinyin: Néng dédào guānzhòng rèqíng zhǎngshēng de biǎoyǎn, cái suànshì yǒu mèilì de biǎoyǎn.
B4L14-1-20.english: Only a performance that can receive enthusiastic applause from the audience is considered to be a charming performance.

B4L14-1-21.chinese: 爸爸為了迎接伯父回臺灣過節，把客房打掃得很乾淨。
B4L14-1-21.pinyin: Bàba wèile yíngjiē bófù huí Táiwān guòjié, bǎ kèfáng dǎsǎo de hěn gānjìng.
B4L14-1-21.english: In order to welcome Uncle back to Taiwan for the holiday, Dad cleaned the guest room very clean.

B4L14-1-23.chinese: 我話先說在前頭，要是你不照他所說的去做，等後頭出了問題，情況可就更複雜了。
B4L14-1-23.pinyin: Wǒ huà xiān shuō zài qiántou, yàoshi nǐ bù zhào tā suǒ shuō de qù zuò, děng hòutou chū le wèntí, qíngkuàng kě jiù gèng fúzá le.
B4L14-1-23.english: I'll say this first (up front): if you don't do as he says, when problems arise later, the situation will become even more complicated.

B4L14-1-24.chinese: 夏天運動過後，喝杯冰冰涼涼的冷飲，感覺很痛快。
B4L14-1-24.pinyin: Xiàtiān yùndòng guò hòu, hē bēi bīngbīngliángliáng de lěngyǐn, gǎnjué hěn tòngkuài.
B4L14-1-24.english: After exercising in summer, drinking a glass of ice-cold cold drink feels very refreshing.

B4L14-1-25.chinese: 工作有壓力時，應適當地分配你的工作及娛樂時間。
B4L14-1-25.pinyin: Gōngzuò yǒu yālì shí, yīng shìdàng de fēnpèi nǐ de gōngzuò jí yúlè shíjiān.
B4L14-1-25.english: When work is stressful, you should appropriately allocate your work and leisure time.

B4L14-1-26.chinese: 老方住院開刀時，同事們都輪流到醫院慰問並照顧他。
B4L14-1-26.pinyin: Lǎo Fāng zhùyuàn kāidāo shí, tóngshìmen dōu lúnliú dào yīyuàn wèiwèn bìng zhàogù tā.
B4L14-1-26.english: When Old Fang was hospitalized for surgery, his colleagues all took turns going to the hospital to comfort and take care of him.

B4L14-1-27.chinese: 妹妹個子比較高，手也長， 買衣服時都得注意袖子的長度。
B4L14-1-27.pinyin: Mèimei gèzi bǐjiào gāo, shǒu yě cháng, mǎi yīfu shí dōu děi zhùyì xiùzi de chángdù.
B4L14-1-27.english: My younger sister is relatively tall and has long arms, so when buying clothes she always has to pay attention to the sleeve length.

B4L14-1-28.chinese: 他把朋友送他的畫先捲起來，等有空時再找地方掛上。
B4L14-1-28.pinyin: Tā bǎ péngyou sòng tā de huà xiān juǎn qǐlái, děng yǒu kòng shí zài zhǎo dìfang guà shàng.
B4L14-1-28.english: He first rolled up the painting his friend gave him, and when he has time he'll find a place to hang it.

B4L14-1-29.chinese: 我們到小張家時，他端了一盤切好的水果來招待我們。
B4L14-1-29.pinyin: Wǒmen dào Xiǎo Zhāng jiā shí, tā duān le yī pán qiē hǎo de shuǐguǒ lái zhāodài wǒmen.
B4L14-1-29.english: When we arrived at Little Zhang's house, he brought out a plate of cut fruit to treat us.

B4L14-1-30.chinese: 小孩子剛學習用筷子吃麵條時，常需要媽媽先替他把麵拌一拌。
B4L14-1-30.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi gāng xuéxí yòng kuàizi chī miàntiáo shí, cháng xūyào māma xiān tì tā bǎ miàn bàn yī bàn.
B4L14-1-30.english: When little children first learn to eat noodles with chopsticks, they often need their mother to first mix the noodles for them.

B4L14-1-31.chinese: 明天一大早要動身出國旅遊，所以我在睡前先把鬧鐘調好。
B4L14-1-31.pinyin: Míngtiān yīdàzǎo yào dòngshēn chūguó lǚyóu, suǒyǐ wǒ zài shuì qián xiān bǎ nàozhōng tiáo hǎo.
B4L14-1-31.english: We need to set off early tomorrow morning to travel abroad, so before going to bed I'll first adjust the alarm clock.

B4L14-1-32.chinese: 自從開始掉頭髮以後，醫師就建議他每天吃半顆維他命。
B4L14-1-32.pinyin: Zìcóng kāishǐ diào tóufa yǐhòu, yīshī jiù jiànyì tā měitiān chī bàn kē wéitāmìng.
B4L14-1-32.english: Ever since he started losing hair, the doctor has suggested he take half a vitamin pill every day.

B4L14-1-33.chinese: 蛋黃月餅的營養豐富，可是不能多吃，不然很容易發胖。
B4L14-1-33.pinyin: Dànhuáng yuèbǐng de yíngyǎng fēngfù, kěshì bùnéng duō chī, bùrán hěn róngyì fāpàng.
B4L14-1-33.english: Egg yolk mooncakes are rich in nutrition, but you can't eat too many, otherwise you'll easily gain weight.

B4L14-1-34.chinese: 她把蛋白拌進麵粉裡，加點兒花生烤一烤，又香又好吃。
B4L14-1-34.pinyin: Tā bǎ dànbái bàn jìn miànfěn lǐ, jiā diǎnr huāshēng kǎo yī kǎo, yòu xiāng yòu hǎochī.
B4L14-1-34.english: She mixed the egg white into the flour, added some peanuts, and baked it; it's fragrant and delicious.

B4L14-1-35.chinese: 我在喝粥時習慣加一些芝麻進去，喝起來很香。
B4L14-1-35.pinyin: Wǒ zài hē zhōu shí xíguàn jiā yīxiē zhīma jìnqù, hē qǐlái hěn xiāng.
B4L14-1-35.english: When I drink congee, I'm used to adding some sesame seeds; it tastes very fragrant.

B4L14-1-36.chinese: 有人喜歡在枕頭上抹一點兒自己喜歡的香水，聽說可以紓壓。
B4L14-1-36.pinyin: Yǒu rén xǐhuān zài zhěntou shàng mǒ yīdiǎnr zìjǐ xǐhuān de xiāngshuǐ, tīngshuō kěyǐ shūyā.
B4L14-1-36.english: Some people like to dab a little of their favorite perfume on their pillow; it's said to relieve stress.

B4L14-1-37.chinese: 包著紅豆餡，裹著花生粉的麻糬，是臺灣著名的傳統甜點。
B4L14-1-37.pinyin: Bāo zhe hóngdòu xiàn, guǒ zhe huāshēngfěn de máshǔ, shì Táiwān zhùmíng de chuántǒng tiándiǎn.
B4L14-1-37.english: Mochi wrapped with red bean filling and coated with peanut powder is a famous traditional Taiwanese dessert.

B4L14-1-38.chinese: 在吃湯麵之前淋上點兒芝麻油，吃起來味道更好。
B4L14-1-38.pinyin: Zài chī tāngmiàn zhīqián lín shàng diǎnr zhīmayóu, chī qǐlái wèidào gèng hǎo.
B4L14-1-38.english: Before eating noodle soup, drizzle on a little sesame oil; it tastes even better.

B4L14-1-39.chinese: 從過去到現在，尊敬長輩一直是華人最重視的傳統觀念之一。
B4L14-1-39.pinyin: Cóng guòqù dào xiànzài, zūnjìng zhǎngbèi yīzhí shì Huárén zuì zhòngshì de chuántǒng guānniàn zhī yī.
B4L14-1-39.english: From the past to the present, respecting elders has always been one of the traditional values that Chinese people value most.

B4L14-1-40.chinese: 許多世紀以來，受壓迫的民族都渴望擁有平等的待遇。
B4L14-1-40.pinyin: Xǔduō shìjì yǐlái, shòu yāpò de mínzú dōu kěwàng yǒngyǒu píngděng de dàiyù.
B4L14-1-40.english: For many centuries, oppressed peoples have longed for equal treatment.

B4L14-1-42.chinese: 這家旅行社有宣傳活動，所以裡頭、外頭都站滿了人。
B4L14-1-42.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu xuānchuán huódòng, suǒyǐ lǐtou, wàitou dōu zhàn mǎn le rén.
B4L14-1-42.english: This travel agency has a promotional event, so both inside and outside are full of people.

B4L14-1-43.chinese: 華人過春節時有個風俗，就是每戶人家都會在門口貼春聯。
B4L14-1-43.pinyin: Huárén guò Chūnjié shí yǒu ge fēngsú, jiùshì měi hù rénjiā dōu huì zài ménkǒu tiē chūnlián.
B4L14-1-43.english: When Chinese people celebrate Spring Festival, there is a custom: every household will paste spring couplets at the door.

B4L14-1-44.chinese: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
B4L14-1-44.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèér céng duō cì cānyù liánxùjù yǎnchū, xiāngdāng shòu huānyíng.
B4L14-1-44.english: That model has participated in TV drama performances many times and is quite popular.

B4L14-1-45.chinese: 不知道是什麼緣故，每次當我見到你時，總是覺得很歡喜。
B4L14-1-45.pinyin: Bù zhīdào shì shénme yuángù, měi cì dāng wǒ jiàn dào nǐ shí, zǒngshì juéde hěn huānxǐ.
B4L14-1-45.english: I don't know what the reason is, but every time I see you, I always feel very happy.

B4L14-1-46.chinese: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
B4L14-1-46.pinyin: Zìcóng zhèngfǔ xuānbù shíyóu, diànfèi shuāng zhǎng de zuòfǎ yǐlái, fǎnduì de mínzhòng rénshù yǐ jìn qī chéng.
B4L14-1-46.english: Since the government announced the policy of raising both oil and electricity prices, the number of people opposed has approached seventy percent.

B4L14-1-48.chinese: 我媽媽退休後，就在家幫忙照顧孫子和孫女。
B4L14-1-48.pinyin: Wǒ māma tuìxiū hòu, jiù zài jiā bāngmáng zhàogù sūnzi hé sūnnǚ.
B4L14-1-48.english: After my mother retired, she helps take care of her grandson and granddaughter at home.

B4L14-1-49.chinese: 我們週末常去鄉下走走，享受農村生活，黃昏時才回市區。
B4L14-1-49.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò cháng qù xiāngxià zǒuzou, xiǎngshòu nóngcūn shēnghuó, huánghūn shí cái huí shìqū.
B4L14-1-49.english: We often go to the countryside on weekends to enjoy rural life, and only return to the city at dusk.

B4L14-1-50.chinese: 下午颱風就要來了，看樣子得趕快去超市買點兒食物。
B4L14-1-50.pinyin: Xiàwǔ táifēng jiù yào lái le, kàn yàngzi děi gǎnkuài qù chāoshì mǎi diǎnr shíwù.
B4L14-1-50.english: The typhoon is coming this afternoon; it looks like we need to hurry to the supermarket to buy some food.

B4L14-2-01.chinese: 世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
B4L14-2-01.pinyin: Shìjiè gèdì de shénhuà suīrán bú jiàndé dōu zhēnshí, què néng ràng rénmen duōshǎo liǎojiě yīxiē gǔdài de fēngsú xíguàn.
B4L14-2-01.english: Although myths from around the world are not necessarily all true, they can still let people understand some ancient customs and habits to some extent.

B4L14-2-02.chinese: 在華人社會中，農曆七月是拜祖先的月份。
B4L14-2-02.pinyin: Zài huárén shèhuì zhōng, nónglì qīyuè shì bài zǔxiān de yuèfèn.
B4L14-2-02.english: In Chinese societies, the seventh month of the lunar calendar is the month for worshipping ancestors.

B4L14-2-03.chinese: 大學畢業後，同學們就奔向自己的人生目標，五年後才聚在一起。
B4L14-2-03.pinyin: Dàxué bìyè hòu, tóngxuémen jiù bēn xiàng zìjǐ de rénshēng mùbiāo, wǔ nián hòu cái jù zài yīqǐ.
B4L14-2-03.english: After graduating from university, classmates rush toward their own life goals, and only get together five years later.

B4L14-2-04.chinese: 傳說月亮上住著一隻兔子，這個神話留給孩子們許多想像空間。
B4L14-2-04.pinyin: Chuánshuō yuèliang shàng zhù zhe yī zhī tùzi, zhège shénhuà liú gěi háizimen xǔduō xiǎngxiàng kōngjiān.
B4L14-2-04.english: Legend has it that a rabbit lives on the moon; this myth leaves children a lot of room for imagination.

B4L14-2-05.chinese: 小寒特別喜愛射氣球遊戲，每次去逛夜市時總要完五、六回。
B4L14-2-05.pinyin: Xiǎohán tèbié xǐ'ài shè qìqiú yóuxì, měi cì qù guàng yèshì shí zǒng yào wán wǔ, liù huí.
B4L14-2-05.english: Xiaohan especially loves shooting balloon games; every time he goes to the night market, he always plays five or six rounds.

B4L14-2-06.chinese: 老師問的題目太難，大家只好望著老師，看老師怎麼回答。
B4L14-2-06.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèn de tímù tài nán, dàjiā zhǐhǎo wàng zhe lǎoshī, kàn lǎoshī zěnme huídá.
B4L14-2-06.english: The question the teacher asked was too difficult, so everyone could only gaze at the teacher to see how the teacher would answer.

B4L14-2-07.chinese: 這次申請獎學金，達到標準的學生總共不超過十人。
B4L14-2-07.pinyin: Zhè cì shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn, dádào biāozhǔn de xuéshēng zǒnggòng bù chāoguò shí rén.
B4L14-2-07.english: For this scholarship application, the students who meet the standard total no more than ten people.

B4L14-2-08.chinese: 中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
B4L14-2-08.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de rénmen xiāngxìn, dāng hǎorén pèng dào wēixiǎn huò kùnnán shí, huì yǒu shénxiān dào rénjiān lái bāngzhù tāmen.
B4L14-2-08.english: People in ancient China believed that when good people encountered danger or difficulties, immortals would come to the human world to help them.

B4L14-2-09.chinese: 古代人非常尊敬大自然，認為土地、山與河都有神。
B4L14-2-09.pinyin: Gǔdài rén fēicháng zūnjìng dàzìrán, rènwéi tǔdì, shān yǔ hé dōu yǒu shén.
B4L14-2-09.english: Ancient people greatly respected nature and believed that the land, mountains, and rivers all have deities.

B4L14-2-10.chinese: 他勸我別太在意別人的眼光，把自己負責的事完成就好。
B4L14-2-10.pinyin: Tā quàn wǒ bié tài zàiyì biérén de yǎnguāng, bǎ zìjǐ fùzé de shì wánchéng jiù hǎo.
B4L14-2-10.english: He advised me not to care too much about others' opinions, and to just complete the things I am responsible for.

B4L14-2-11.chinese: 迷信的人老是相信一些不真實的迷信，例如：黑貓會帶來不好的運氣、送傘給情人就會分手什麼的。
B4L14-2-11.pinyin: Míxìn de rén lǎoshì xiāngxìn yīxiē bù zhēnshí de míxìn, lìrú: hēimāo huì dàilái bù hǎo de yùnqì, sòng sǎn gěi qíngrén jiù huì fēnshǒu shénme de.
B4L14-2-11.english: Superstitious people always believe in some untrue superstitions, for example: black cats will bring bad luck, giving an umbrella to a lover will lead to a breakup, and so on.

B4L14-2-12.chinese: 射箭看來容易，但想把箭射好，就得辛苦地練習。
B4L14-2-12.pinyin: Shèjiàn kànlái róngyì, dàn xiǎng bǎ jiàn shè hǎo, jiù děi xīnkǔ de liànxí.
B4L14-2-12.english: Archery seems easy, but if you want to shoot arrows well, you have to practice hard.

B4L14-2-13.chinese: 我們公司在這次電子展共發表了九項新產品，並吸引不少國外客戶來參觀。
B4L14-2-13.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài zhè cì diànzǐ zhǎn gòng fābiǎo le jiǔ xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn, bìng xīyǐn bù shǎo guówài kèhù lái cānguān.
B4L14-2-13.english: Our company altogether launched nine new products at this electronics exhibition, and attracted many foreign clients to visit.

B4L14-2-14.chinese: 這次的說話比賽要求參加的學生說一個神奇的外國故事。
B4L14-2-14.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuōhuà bǐsài yāoqiú cānjiā de xuéshēng shuō yī gè shénqí de wàiguó gùshì.
B4L14-2-14.english: This speech contest requires participating students to tell a magical foreign story.

B4L14-2-15.chinese: 這次會議的效率真差，有人竟然沒看資料就來了，真是誇張。
B4L14-2-15.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de xiàolǜ zhēn chà, yǒu rén jìngrán méi kàn zīliào jiù lái le, zhēn shì kuāzhāng.
B4L14-2-15.english: The efficiency of this meeting is really poor; someone surprisingly came without even looking at the materials—that's really outrageous.

B4L14-2-16.chinese: 小戴在這場籃球比賽中表現相當優秀，投中了三十多分，因此被教練選中，代表學校參加全國比賽。
B4L14-2-16.pinyin: Xiǎodài zài zhè chǎng lánqiú bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn xiāngdāng yōuxiù, tóu zhòng le sānshí duō fēn, yīncǐ bèi jiàoliàn xuǎn zhòng, dàibiǎo xuéxiào cānjiā quánguó bǐsài.
B4L14-2-16.english: Xiaodai performed quite excellently in this basketball game, hitting over thirty points, and was therefore selected by the coach to represent the school in the national competition.

B4L14-2-17.chinese: 這家餐廳我去過一次，對他們的菜很失望，從此就不去了。
B4L14-2-17.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng wǒ qù guò yī cì, duì tāmen de cài hěn shīwàng, cóngcǐ jiù bù qù le.
B4L14-2-17.english: I have been to this restaurant once and was very disappointed with their food, so since then I have not gone back.

B4L14-2-18.chinese: 學校的畢業典禮辦得很精彩，讓我們度過了愉快的一天。
B4L14-2-18.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bìyè diǎnlǐ bàn de hěn jīngcǎi, ràng wǒmen dùguò le yúkuài de yī tiān.
B4L14-2-18.english: The school's graduation ceremony was held wonderfully, allowing us to spend a happy day.

B4L14-2-19.chinese: 春假時我打算到泰國小島上的鄉村去度個假。
B4L14-2-19.pinyin: Chūnjià shí wǒ dǎsuàn dào Tàiguó xiǎodǎo shàng de xiāngcūn qù dù gè jià.
B4L14-2-19.english: During spring break, I plan to go to a village on a small island in Thailand to spend a vacation.

B4L14-2-20.chinese: 朋友認為生日晚會不喝酒就沒有歡樂的氣氛。
B4L14-2-20.pinyin: Péngyou rènwéi shēngrì wǎnhuì bù hē jiǔ jiù méiyǒu huānlè de qìfēn.
B4L14-2-20.english: My friend thinks that if there is no drinking at a birthday party, there won't be a joyous atmosphere.

B4L14-2-21.chinese: 他與妻子雖然已結婚多年，感情仍維持得很好，真令人羨慕。
B4L14-2-21.pinyin: Tā yǔ qīzi suīrán yǐ jiéhūn duō nián, gǎnqíng réng wéichí de hěn hǎo, zhēn lìng rén xiànmù.
B4L14-2-21.english: Although he and his wife have been married for many years, their affection is still maintained very well; it truly makes people envious.

B4L14-2-22.chinese: 他失業了，但妻子三人卻仍在一旁支持著他，讓他安心了不少。
B4L14-2-22.pinyin: Tā shīyè le, dàn qīzi sān rén què réng zài yīpáng zhīchí zhe tā, ràng tā ānxīn le bùshǎo.
B4L14-2-22.english: He lost his job, but his wife and three children still supported him on the side, which made him feel much more at ease.

B4L14-2-23.chinese: 根據華人民間的說法，過年時如果收到紅包，整年就會有好運氣。
B4L14-2-23.pinyin: Gēnjù Huárén mínjiān de shuōfǎ, guònián shí rúguǒ shōudào hóngbāo, zhěng nián jiù huì yǒu hǎoyùnqi.
B4L14-2-23.english: According to Chinese folk sayings, if you receive a red envelope during the New Year, you will have good luck for the whole year.

B4L14-2-24.chinese: 在戶外的夜景中攝影，以月光當作背景可增加神秘的感覺。
B4L14-2-24.pinyin: Zài hùwài de yèjǐng zhōng shèyǐng, yǐ yuèguāng dāngzuò bèijǐng kě zēngjiā shénmì de gǎnjué.
B4L14-2-24.english: When photographing outdoor night scenes, using moonlight as the background can add a mysterious feeling.

B4L14-2-25.chinese: 今天的自然科學課程所介紹的主題是月球的構造。
B4L14-2-25.pinyin: Jīntiān de zìrán kēxué kèchéng suǒ jièshào de zhǔtí shì yuèqiú de gòuzào.
B4L14-2-25.english: The topic introduced in today's natural science course is the structure of the moon.

B4L15-1-01.chinese: 要保持古文物原來的樣子不容易，需要好好照顧。
B4L15-1-01.pinyin: Yào bǎochí gǔ wénwù yuánlái de yàngzi bù róngyì, xūyào hǎohǎo zhàogù.
B4L15-1-01.english: It is not easy to keep ancient cultural artifacts in their original condition; they need to be well taken care of.

B4L15-1-02.chinese: 在人生地不熟的地方旅行時，如有當地人帶路，就可以節省不少時間。
B4L15-1-02.pinyin: Zài rénshēngdìbùshú de dìfāng lǚxíng shí, rú yǒu dāngdìrén dàilù, jiù kěyǐ jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
B4L15-1-02.english: When traveling in a place where you are unfamiliar with the people and surroundings, if a local leads the way, you can save quite a bit of time.

B4L15-1-03.chinese: 按照我國官方規定，民間辦理環保活動可向官方申請經費。
B4L15-1-03.pinyin: Ànzhào wǒ guó guānfāng guīdìng, mínjiān bànlǐ huánbǎo huódòng kě xiàng guānfāng shēnqǐng jīngfèi.
B4L15-1-03.english: According to our country's official regulations, when non-governmental organizations hold environmental activities, they can apply to the government for funding.

B4L15-1-04.chinese: 對我來說，閱讀醫學系列的小說是一個很好的休閒活動。
B4L15-1-04.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, yuèdú yīxué xìliè de xiǎoshuō shì yī gè hěn hǎo de xiūxián huódòng.
B4L15-1-04.english: For me, reading medical series novels is a very good leisure activity.

B4L15-1-05.chinese: 這位著名畫家的作品，目前正在美術館展出。
B4L15-1-05.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhùmíng huàjiā de zuòpǐn, mùqián zhèngzài měishùguǎn zhǎnchū.
B4L15-1-05.english: This famous painter's works are currently on display at the art museum.

B4L15-1-06.chinese: 設計師利用上電視的機會，展示他今年設計的服裝。
B4L15-1-06.pinyin: Shèjìshī lìyòng shàng diànshì de jīhuì, zhǎnshì tā jīnnián shèjì de fúzhuāng.
B4L15-1-06.english: The designer used the opportunity of appearing on TV to display the clothing he designed this year.

B4L15-1-07.chinese: 他希望能在海邊舉辦婚禮，可是一直找不到理想的場地。
B4L15-1-07.pinyin: Tā xīwàng néng zài hǎibiān jǔbàn hūnlǐ, kěshì yīzhí zhǎo bù dào lǐxiǎng de chǎngdì.
B4L15-1-07.english: He hopes to hold his wedding by the seaside, but he has not been able to find an ideal venue.

B4L15-1-08.chinese: 妳身高一百七十公分，體重六十公斤，還不到減肥的程度。
B4L15-1-08.pinyin: Nǐ shēngāo yībǎi qīshí gōngfēn, tǐzhòng liùshí gōngjīn, hái bù dào jiǎnféi de chéngdù.
B4L15-1-08.english: You are 170 cm tall and weigh 60 kg; you are not yet at the level where you need to lose weight.

B4L15-1-09.chinese: 當室內與戶外溫度的差別很大時，我就容易感冒。
B4L15-1-09.pinyin: Dāng shìnèi yǔ hùwài wēndù de chābié hěn dà shí, wǒ jiù róngyì gǎnmào.
B4L15-1-09.english: When the difference between indoor and outdoor temperatures is large, I easily catch a cold.

B4L15-1-10.chinese: 臺灣的小學教導孩子從平常生活中學習遵守規定。
B4L15-1-10.pinyin: Táiwān de xiǎoxué jiàodǎo háizi cóng píngcháng shēnghuó zhōng xuéxí zūnshǒu guīdìng.
B4L15-1-10.english: Elementary schools in Taiwan teach children to learn to comply with rules in their daily lives.

B4L15-1-12.chinese: 孩子們好不容易才安靜，別去鬧他們，不然又要開始吵鬧了。
B4L15-1-12.pinyin: Háizimen hǎobùróngyì cái ānjìng, bié qù nào tāmen, bùrán yòu yào kāishǐ chǎonào le.
B4L15-1-12.english: The children have finally quieted down with great difficulty; don't go disturb them, or they will start making noise again.

B4L15-1-13.chinese: 這項研究計畫只針對少部分區域實驗，參考價值不高。
B4L15-1-13.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū jìhuà zhǐ zhēnduì shǎo bùfèn qūyù shíyàn, cānkǎo jiàzhí bù gāo.
B4L15-1-13.english: This research project only conducts experiments in a small number of areas, so its reference value is not high.

B4L15-1-14.chinese: 由於網路發達，現代人大都習慣上網購物。
B4L15-1-14.pinyin: Yóuyú wǎnglù fādá, xiàndài rén dàdōu xíguàn shàngwǎng gòuwù.
B4L15-1-14.english: Due to the development of the Internet, modern people for the most part are accustomed to shopping online.

B4L15-1-15.chinese: 他決定搬到國外去，所以打算出售臺灣的房屋。
B4L15-1-15.pinyin: Tā juédìng bān dào guówài qù, suǒyǐ dǎsuàn chūshòu Táiwān de fángwū.
B4L15-1-15.english: He has decided to move abroad, so he plans to sell his house in Taiwan.

B4L15-1-16.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
B4L15-1-16.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
B4L15-1-16.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

B4L15-1-17.chinese: 假如擔心弄丟重要的資料，可複製一份存在電腦裡。
B4L15-1-17.pinyin: Jiǎrú dānxīn nòngdiū zhòngyào de zīliào, kě fùzhì yī fèn cún zài diànnǎo lǐ.
B4L15-1-17.english: If you are worried about losing important data, you can make a copy and save it on the computer.

B4L15-1-18.chinese: 難得出國旅行，一定要多照幾張相片留念。
B4L15-1-18.pinyin: Nándé chūguó lǚxíng, yīdìng yào duō zhào jǐ zhāng xiàngpiàn liúniàn.
B4L15-1-18.english: It is rare to travel abroad, so you must take a few more photos to keep as souvenirs.

B4L15-1-19.chinese: 這套陶瓷茶具是專家以手工方式做的，因此價格也不便宜。
B4L15-1-19.pinyin: Zhè tào táocí chájù shì zhuānjiā yǐ shǒugōng fāngshì zuò de, yīncǐ jiàgé yě bù piányí.
B4L15-1-19.english: This ceramic tea set was made by an expert by hand, so the price is not cheap either.

B4L15-1-20.chinese: 網路購物辦理退貨時，必須保持商品原來的外觀才行。
B4L15-1-20.pinyin: Wǎnglù gòuwù bànlǐ tuìhuò shí, bìxū bǎochí shāngpǐn yuánlái de wàiguān cái xíng.
B4L15-1-20.english: When returning items purchased online, you must keep the product's original appearance.

B4L15-1-21.chinese: 申請簽證的表格請填完整資料，以免無法順利申請。
B4L15-1-21.pinyin: Shēnqǐng qiānzhèng de biǎogé qǐng tián wánzhěng zīliào, yǐmiǎn wúfǎ shùnlì shēnqǐng.
B4L15-1-21.english: Please fill out the visa application form with complete information, so as to avoid being unable to apply successfully.

B4L15-1-22.chinese: 保存食物的方式會影響食物的新鮮程度。
B4L15-1-22.pinyin: Bǎocún shíwù de fāngshì huì yǐngxiǎng shíwù de xīnxiān chéngdù.
B4L15-1-22.english: The way of preserving food will affect the freshness of the food.

B4L15-1-23.chinese: 雖然受到了重大的挫折，可是他並沒有放棄自己的夢想。
B4L15-1-23.pinyin: Suīrán shòudào le zhòngdà de cuòzhé, kěshì tā bìng méiyǒu fàngqì zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
B4L15-1-23.english: Although he suffered a major setback, he actually did not give up his dream.

B4L15-1-24.chinese: 這棟房子空間小，位置離市區又遠，所以價值三百萬而已。
B4L15-1-24.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi kōngjiān xiǎo, wèizhì lí shìqū yòu yuǎn, suǒyǐ jiàzhí sānbǎi wàn éryǐ.
B4L15-1-24.english: This house has little space and is far from the city center, so it is worth only three million.

B4L15-1-25.chinese: 根據本大樓的管理規定，私人物品不可堆在公共區域。
B4L15-1-25.pinyin: Gēnjù běn dàlóu de guǎnlǐ guīdìng, sīrén wùpǐn bùkě duī zài gōnggòng qūyù.

B4L16-1-02.english: This reporter specializes in reporting social news; the way he reports news is quite professional.

B4L16-1-03.chinese: 運動選手在參加比賽前，補充營養的飲食很重要。
B4L16-1-03.pinyin: Yùndòng xuǎnshǒu zài cānjiā bǐsài qián, bǔchōng yíngyǎng de yǐnshí hěn zhòngyào.
B4L16-1-03.english: Before athletes participate in a competition, a diet that replenishes nutrition is very important.

B4L16-1-04.chinese: 我們打算用擲銅錢的方式，來決定讓誰處理這件事。
B4L16-1-04.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn yòng zhì tóngqián de fāngshì, lái juédìng ràng shéi chǔlǐ zhè jiàn shì.
B4L16-1-04.english: We plan to use the method of tossing a copper coin to decide who will handle this matter.

B4L16-1-06.chinese: 擲標槍、射箭、開槍(to shoot)需要的技巧都不同，想熟練就得多連練習。
B4L16-1-06.pinyin: Zhì biāoqiāng, shèjiàn, kāiqiāng xūyào de jìqiǎo dōu bùtóng, xiǎng shúliàn jiù děi duō liànxí.
B4L16-1-06.english: The skills required for javelin throwing, archery, and shooting a gun are all different; if you want to become proficient, you must practice more.

B4L16-1-07.chinese: 這次文學比賽，我參加的項目是作文。
B4L16-1-07.pinyin: Zhè cì wénxué bǐsài, wǒ cānjiā de xiàngmù shì zuòwén.
B4L16-1-07.english: In this literature competition, the event I am participating in is essay writing.

B4L16-1-08.chinese: 出國旅行最好辦個保險，發生意外時才能獲得保障。
B4L16-1-08.pinyin: Chūguó lǚxíng zuìhǎo bàn ge bǎoxiǎn, fāshēng yìwài shí cái néng huòdé bǎozhàng.
B4L16-1-08.english: When traveling abroad, it is best to get insurance; only then can you obtain protection when an accident occurs.

B4L16-1-09.chinese: 她參加這場比賽的唯一目的，就是為了贏得第一名。
B4L16-1-09.pinyin: Tā cānjiā zhè chǎng bǐsài de wéiyī mùdì, jiùshì wèile yíngdé dì yī míng.
B4L16-1-09.english: The sole purpose of her participating in this competition is to win first place.

B4L16-1-10.chinese: 經過多次訓練，他總算贏得這場球賽的冠軍。
B4L16-1-10.pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì xùnliàn, tā zǒngsuàn yíngdé zhè chǎng qiúsài de guànjūn.
B4L16-1-10.english: After many training sessions, he finally won the championship of this ball game.

B4L16-1-11.chinese: 每面國旗都代表一個國家，而且設計上都具有獨特的意義。
B4L16-1-11.pinyin: Měi miàn guóqí dōu dàibiǎo yī ge guójiā, érqiě shèjì shàng dōu jùyǒu dútè de yìyì.
B4L16-1-11.english: Every national flag represents a country, and each has a unique meaning in its design.

B4L16-1-12.chinese: 這座圓形廣場是為了紀念自由而建的。
B4L16-1-12.pinyin: Zhè zuò yuánxíng guǎngchǎng shì wèile jìniàn zìyóu ér jiàn de.
B4L16-1-12.english: This circular plaza was built to commemorate freedom.

B4L16-1-13.chinese: 她的物品上都有個小小的蝴蝶標誌，避免別人拿錯。
B4L16-1-13.pinyin: Tā de wùpǐn shàng dōu yǒu ge xiǎoxiǎo de húdié biāozhì, bìmiǎn biérén ná cuò.
B4L16-1-13.english: All her items have a small butterfly mark on them, to avoid others taking them by mistake.

B4L16-1-14.chinese: 這本書是這位作家的代表作品，研究他的人都很熟悉。
B4L16-1-14.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì zhè wèi zuòjiā de dàibiǎo zuòpǐn, yánjiū tā de rén dōu hěn shúxī.
B4L16-1-14.english: This book is this author's representative work; those who study him are all very familiar with it.

B4L16-1-15.chinese: 訓練出著名跳高選手的教練認為，要跳得高，技巧很重要。
B4L16-1-15.pinyin: Xùnliàn chū zhùmíng tiàogāo xuǎnshǒu de jiàoliàn rènwéi, yào tiào de gāo, jìqiǎo hěn zhòngyào.
B4L16-1-15.english: The coach who trained a famous high jump athlete believes that to jump high, technique is very important.

B4L16-1-16.chinese: 我不太會跳高，跳遠倒是跳得還不錯。
B4L16-1-16.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài huì tiàogāo, tiàoyuǎn dàoshì tiào de hái bùcuò.
B4L16-1-16.english: I am not very good at high jump, but as for long jump, I am actually not bad.

B4L16-1-17.chinese: 孫小姐最近談成了幾筆大生意，表現出色，於是公司決定提高她的薪水。
B4L16-1-17.pinyin: Sūn xiǎojiě zuìjìn tán chéng le jǐ bǐ dà shēngyì, biǎoxiàn chūsè, yúshì gōngsī juédìng tígāo tā de xīnshuǐ.
B4L16-1-17.english: Miss Sun recently closed several big deals and her performance was outstanding, so the company decided to raise her salary.

B4L16-1-18.chinese: 她的外語能力不錯，因此公司經常派她到國外出差。
B4L16-1-18.pinyin: Tā de wàiyǔ nénglì bùcuò, yīncǐ gōngsī jīngcháng pài tā dào guówài chūchāi.
B4L16-1-18.english: Her foreign language ability is good, so the company often sends her abroad on business trips.

B4L16-1-19.chinese: 他對發展新科技向來保守，不願接受人工智慧產品。
B4L16-1-19.pinyin: Tā duì fāzhǎn xīn kējì xiànglái bǎoshǒu, bù yuàn jiēshòu réngōng zhìhuì chǎnpǐn.
B4L16-1-19.english: He has always been conservative about developing new technology and is unwilling to accept artificial intelligence products.

B4L16-1-20.chinese: 李博士在國際上相當有名，他的研究總能引發學者討論。
B4L16-1-20.pinyin: Lǐ bóshì zài guójì shàng xiāngdāng yǒumíng, tā de yánjiū zǒng néng yǐnfā xuézhě tǎolùn.
B4L16-1-20.english: Dr. Li is quite famous internationally; his research always sparks discussions among scholars.

B4L16-1-21.chinese: 他告訴孩子不需要事事追求第一，但做任何事都必須盡力。
B4L16-1-21.pinyin: Tā gàosù háizi bù xūyào shìshì zhuīqiú dì yī, dàn zuò rènhé shì dōu bìxū jìnlì.
B4L16-1-21.english: He told his children that they don't need to pursue first place in everything, but they must strive their hardest in whatever they do.

B4L16-1-22.chinese: 她是一個很實際的人，對愛情從來不抱著美好的想像。
B4L16-1-22.pinyin: Tā shì yī ge hěn shíjì de rén, duì àiqíng cónglái bù bàozhe měihǎo de xiǎngxiàng.
B4L16-1-22.english: She is a very practical person and has never held beautiful fantasies about love.

B4L16-1-23.chinese: 戰爭雖然勝利了，這個國家卻也失去了許多寶貴的生命。
B4L16-1-23.pinyin: Zhànzhēng suīrán shènglì le, zhè ge guójiā què yě shīqù le xǔduō bǎoguì de shēngmìng.
B4L16-1-23.english: Although the war was won, this country also lost many precious lives.

B4L16-1-24.chinese: 樂觀的人會積極挑戰困難，就算無法成功也不會感到失望。
B4L16-1-24.pinyin: Lèguān de rén huì jījí tiǎozhàn kùnnán, jiùsuàn wúfǎ chénggōng yě bù huì gǎndào shīwàng.
B4L16-1-24.english: Optimistic people will actively challenge difficulties; even if they cannot succeed, they will not feel disappointed.

B4L16-1-25.chinese: 每個宗教都有屬於自己的獨特儀式。
B4L16-1-25.pinyin: Měi ge zōngjiào dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de dútè yíshì.
B4L16-1-25.english: Every religion has its own unique ceremonies.

B4L16-1-26.chinese: 這次活動是公司主辦的，目的是為了增加同事之間的感情。
B4L16-1-26.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì gōngsī zhǔbàn de, mùdì shì wèile zēngjiā tóngshì zhījiān de gǎnqíng.
B4L16-1-26.english: This event is organized by the company, and the purpose is to increase the bonds among colleagues.

B4L16-1-27.chinese: 做生意與其花大錢廣告，不如提高品質，讓顧客替你宣傳。
B4L16-1-27.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì yǔqí huā dà qián guǎnggào, bùrú tígāo pǐnzhí, ràng gùkè tì nǐ xuānchuán.
B4L16-1-27.english: In doing business, rather than spending a lot of money to advertise, it is better to improve quality and let customers promote you.

B4L16-1-28.chinese: 總統在廣場點燃煙火，跟民眾一起慶祝新年。
B4L16-1-28.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng zài guǎngchǎng diǎnrán yānhuǒ, gēn mínzhòng yìqǐ qìngzhù xīnnián.
B4L16-1-28.english: The president set off fireworks in the square and celebrated the New Year together with the public.

B4L16-1-29.chinese: 人人都崇拜明星，但有多少人了解成功背後所付出的一切？
B4L16-1-29.pinyin: Rénrén dōu chóngbài míngxīng, dàn yǒu duōshǎo rén liǎojiě chénggōng bèihòu suǒ fùchū de yíqiè?
B4L16-1-29.english: Everyone adores stars, but how many people understand all that is sacrificed behind success?

B4L16-1-30.chinese: 他看了歷史電影後，就非常崇拜戰爭中的革命英雄。
B4L16-1-30.pinyin: Tā kàn le lìshǐ diànyǐng hòu, jiù fēicháng chóngbài zhànzhēng zhōng de gémìng yīngxióng.
B4L16-1-30.english: After he watched a historical movie, he greatly adored the revolutionary heroes in the war.

B4L16-1-31.chinese: 難得今天有空，我們不如一口氣解決工作上所有的問題吧。
B4L16-1-31.pinyin: Nándé jīntiān yǒu kòng, wǒmen bùrú yìkǒuqì jiějué gōngzuò shàng suǒyǒu de wèntí ba.
B4L16-1-31.english: It's rare to have free time today; why don't we solve all the work problems in one go.

B4L16-1-32.chinese: 他熱愛路跑活動，只要是相關比賽，一定少不了他。
B4L16-1-32.pinyin: Tā rè'ài lùpǎo huódòng, zhǐyào shì xiāngguān bǐsài, yídìng shǎo bù liǎo tā.
B4L16-1-32.english: He loves road running events; as long as it's a related race, he is sure to be there.

B4L16-1-33.chinese: 看到自己國家的國旗進入奧運會場，民眾也不斷揮著手上的小旗子，替自己的國家加油。
B4L16-1-33.pinyin: Kàn dào zìjǐ guójiā de guóqí jìnrù Àoyùn huìchǎng, mínzhòng yě búduàn huī zhe shǒu shàng de xiǎo qízi, tì zìjǐ de guójiā jiāyóu.
B4L16-1-33.english: Seeing their country's national flag enter the Olympic venue, the public also continuously waved the small flags in their hands to cheer for their country.

B4L16-1-34.chinese: 參加廚師比賽，只要味道部分的分數很高，就有機會得獎。
B4L16-1-34.pinyin: Cānjiā chúshī bǐsài, zhǐyào wèidào bùfèn de fēnshù hěn gāo, jiù yǒu jīhuì déjiǎng.
B4L16-1-34.english: In a chef competition, as long as the score for the taste section is high, there is a chance to win a prize.

B4L16-1-35.chinese: 巴德在華語能力測驗中得了86分，還拿到了華語高級證書，讓她開心了半天。
B4L16-1-35.pinyin: Bādé zài Huáyǔ nénglì cèyàn zhōng dé le bāshíliù fēn, hái ná dào le Huáyǔ gāojí zhèngshū, ràng tā kāixīn le bàntiān.
B4L16-1-35.english: Bade scored 86 on the Chinese proficiency test and also obtained an advanced Chinese certificate, which made her happy for a long time.

B4L16-1-36.chinese: 為了吸引人才，廣告企業提供獎金給優秀的設計師。
B4L16-1-36.pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn réncái, guǎnggào qǐyè tígōng jiǎngjīn gěi yōuxiù de shèjìshī.
B4L16-1-36.english: In order to attract talent, advertising companies offer bonuses to outstanding designers.

B4L16-1-37.chinese: 學校書法比賽的獎品是一臺平板電腦，希望能鼓勵大家參加。
B4L16-1-37.pinyin: Xuéxiào shūfǎ bǐsài de jiǎngpǐn shì yì tái píngbǎn diànnǎo, xīwàng néng gǔlì dàjiā cānjiā.
B4L16-1-37.english: The prize for the school calligraphy competition is a tablet computer, hoping to encourage everyone to participate.

B4L16-1-38.chinese: 在抗議新建工廠的活動中，當地的環保團體聯合起來表達他們的需求。
B4L16-1-38.pinyin: Zài kàngyì xīn jiàn gōngchǎng de huódòng zhōng, dāngdì de huánbǎo tuántǐ liánhé qǐlái biǎodá tāmen de xūqiú.
B4L16-1-38.english: In the protest against the construction of a new factory, local environmental groups united to express their demands.

B4L16-1-39.chinese: 在全球環境會議中，聯合國邀請了一些環保團體共同參與。
B4L16-1-39.pinyin: Zài quánqiú huánjìng huìyì zhōng, Liánhéguó yāoqǐng le yìxiē huánbǎo tuántǐ gòngtóng cānyù.
B4L16-1-39.english: At the global environmental conference, the United Nations invited some environmental groups to participate together.

B4L16-1-40.chinese: 我跟幾個愛好歷史的朋友一起組了社團，專門研究古文物。
B4L16-1-40.pinyin: Wǒ gēn jǐ ge àihào lìshǐ de péngyǒu yìqǐ zǔ le shètuán, zhuānmén yánjiū gǔ wénwù.
B4L16-1-40.english: I formed a club together with several friends who love history, specifically to study ancient artifacts.

B4L16-1-41.chinese: 國際棒球比賽快開始了，那一群剛入棒球場、穿藍色運動服的就是臺灣隊。
B4L16-1-41.pinyin: Guójì bàngqiú bǐsài kuài kāishǐ le, nà yì qún gāng jìnrù bàngqiúchǎng, chuān lánsè yùndòngfú de jiùshì Táiwān duì.
B4L16-1-41.english: The international baseball game is about to start; that group that just entered the baseball field wearing blue sportswear is the Taiwan team.

B4L16-1-42.chinese: 賽跑前要先做點兒運動，免得受傷。
B4L16-1-42.pinyin: Sàipǎo qián yào xiān zuò diǎnr yùndòng, miǎnde shòushāng.
B4L16-1-42.english: Before racing, you should do some exercise first, so as to avoid getting hurt.

B4L16-1-43.chinese: 我剛拖了地，地上還是溼的，你最好繞過去比較安全。
B4L16-1-43.pinyin: Wǒ gāng tuō le dì, dìshàng háishì shī de, nǐ zuìhǎo rào guòqù bǐjiào ānquán.
B4L16-1-43.english: I just mopped the floor, and the floor is still wet; you'd better go around it, it's safer.

B4L16-1-44.chinese: 為了找件漂亮又划算的衣服，她可是能逛百貨公司好幾圈的。
B4L16-1-44.pinyin: Wèile zhǎo jiàn piàoliang yòu huásuàn de yīfu, tā kěshì néng guàng bǎihuò gōngsī hǎo jǐ quān de.
B4L16-1-44.english: In order to find a beautiful and cost-effective piece of clothing, she can really walk several laps around a department store.

B4L16-1-45.chinese: 職業棒球隊在比賽時，會請專業啦啦隊來製造熱鬧氣氛。
B4L16-1-45.pinyin: Zhíyè bàngqiú duì zài bǐsài shí, huì qǐng zhuānyè lālādùi lái zhìzào rènào qìfēn.
B4L16-1-45.english: When professional baseball teams are playing, they invite professional cheerleading squads to create a lively atmosphere.

B4L16-1-46.chinese: 夏天到了，我們去海邊走走，順便去打個海灘排球。
B4L16-1-46.pinyin: Xiàtiān dào le, wǒmen qù hǎibiān zǒuzou, shùnbiàn qù dǎ ge hǎitān páiqiú.
B4L16-1-46.english: Summer has arrived; let's go for a walk by the beach and play some beach volleyball while we're at it.

B4L16-1-47.chinese: 這項語法不太重要，我賭考試一定不會考。
B4L16-1-47.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yǔfǎ bú tài zhòngyào, wǒ dǔ kǎoshì yídìng bú huì kǎo.
B4L16-1-47.english: This grammar point is not very important; I bet it definitely won't be on the exam.

B4L16-1-48.chinese: 這場棒球比賽已打到最後一局，可是仍無法看出誰輸誰贏。
B4L16-1-48.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bàngqiú bǐsài yǐ dǎ dào zuìhòu yì jú, kěshì réng wúfǎ kànchū shéi shū shéi yíng.
B4L16-1-48.english: This baseball game has already reached the final inning, but it is still impossible to tell who will lose and who will win.

B4L16-1-49.chinese: 那支軍隊受的是特殊訓練，只在發生重大戰爭時才派出。
B4L16-1-49.pinyin: Nà zhī jūnduì shòu de shì tèshū xùnliàn, zhǐ zài fāshēng zhòngdà zhànzhēng shí cái pàichū.
B4L16-1-49.english: That army unit receives special training and is only dispatched when a major war occurs.

B4L16-1-50.chinese: 我的球隊因為練習不夠，這一季的表現也不太理想。
B4L16-1-50.pinyin: Wǒ de qiúduì yīnwèi liànxí bú gòu, zhè yí jì de biǎoxiàn yě bú tài lǐxiǎng.
B4L16-1-50.english: Because my sports team didn't practice enough, its performance this season is also not ideal.

B4L16-1-51.chinese: 我們學校的啦啦隊隊員個子都很高，舞蹈的技巧也很出色。
B4L16-1-51.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lālāduì duìyuán gèzi dōu hěn gāo, wǔdǎo de jìqiǎo yě hěn chūsè.
B4L16-1-51.english: The cheerleading team members of our school are all very tall, and their dance skills are also excellent.

B4L16-1-52.chinese: 這面金牌是完全用金子做的，外觀也相當獨特。
B4L16-1-52.pinyin: Zhè miàn jīnpái shì wánquán yòng jīnzi zuò de, wàiguān yě xiāngdāng dútè.
B4L16-1-52.english: This gold medal is made entirely of gold, and its appearance is also quite unique.

B4L16-2-01.chinese: 她推動學習革命，讓學生主動參與規劃課程。
B4L16-2-01.pinyin: Tā tuīdòng xuéxí gémìng, ràng xuéshēng zhǔdòng cānyǔ guīhuà kèchéng.
B4L16-2-01.english: She promoted a learning revolution, letting students actively participate in planning the curriculum.

B4L16-2-02.chinese: 主管的責任之一是幫員工爭取更好的福利。
B4L16-2-02.pinyin: Zhǔguǎn de zérèn zhī yī shì bāng yuángōng zhēngqǔ gèng hǎo de fúlì.
B4L16-2-02.english: One of the supervisor's responsibilities is to fight for better benefits for the employees.

B4L16-2-03.chinese: 這家工廠奪下了著名品牌產品的製造機會。
B4L16-2-03.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng duó xià le zhùmíng pǐnpái chǎnpǐn de zhìzào jīhuì.
B4L16-2-03.english: This factory seized the manufacturing opportunity for a famous brand's products.

B4L16-2-04.chinese: 這一屆的學生絕大部分都在畢業以前找到了工作。
B4L16-2-04.pinyin: Zhè yī jiè de xuéshēng jué dà bùfèn dōu zài bìyè yǐqián zhǎodào le gōngzuò.
B4L16-2-04.english: The vast majority of this year's graduating class found jobs before graduation.

B4L16-2-05.chinese: 這臺食品加工設備的構造相當複雜，其中約三分之一的零件還是由國外進口。
B4L16-2-05.pinyin: Zhè tái shípǐn jiāgōng shèbèi de gòuzào xiāngdāng fùzá, qízhōng yuē sān fēn zhī yī de língjiàn hái shì yóu guówài jìnkǒu.
B4L16-2-05.english: The structure of this food processing equipment is quite complex, and about one third of its parts are still imported from abroad.

B4L16-2-06.chinese: 期中測驗的結果明天就會公布，大家都很緊張。
B4L16-2-06.pinyin: Qīzhōng cèyàn de jiéguǒ míngtiān jiù huì gōngbù, dàjiā dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
B4L16-2-06.english: The results of the midterm exam will be announced tomorrow, and everyone is very nervous.

B4L16-2-07.chinese: 這項新發明解決了許多環保問題，發明的人還受國家表揚。
B4L16-2-07.pinyin: Zhè xiàng xīn fāmíng jiějué le xǔduō huánbǎo wèntí, fāmíng de rén hái shòu guójiā biǎoyáng.
B4L16-2-07.english: This new invention solved many environmental problems, and the inventor was even praised by the country.

B4L16-2-08.chinese: 生命中每一刻都很珍貴，隨時多用點心、多付出，就能令人生更美好。
B4L16-2-08.pinyin: Shēngmìng zhōng měi yī kè dōu hěn zhēnguì, suíshí duō yòng diǎn xīn, duō fùchū, jiù néng lìng rénshēng gèng měihǎo.
B4L16-2-08.english: Every moment in life is precious; always put in a little more effort and give a little more, and you can make life more beautiful.

B4L16-2-09.chinese: 關於生命的意義，每個人的想法都不同。
B4L16-2-09.pinyin: Guānyú shēngmìng de yìyì, měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ dōu bùtóng.
B4L16-2-09.english: Regarding the meaning of life, everyone's thoughts are different.

B4L16-2-10.chinese: 別怕失敗，因為失敗的經驗比成功更珍貴。
B4L16-2-10.pinyin: Bié pà shībài, yīnwèi shībài de jīngyàn bǐ chénggōng gèng zhēnguì.
B4L16-2-10.english: Don't be afraid of failure, because the experience of failure is more precious than success.

B4L16-2-12.chinese: 一開始奧運僅安排男子比賽項目，後來才有女子項目的比賽。
B4L16-2-12.pinyin: Yī kāishǐ Àoyùn jǐn ānpái nánzǐ bǐsài xiàngmù, hòulái cái yǒu nǚzǐ xiàngmù de bǐsài.
B4L16-2-12.english: At first, the Olympics only arranged men's events; only later were there women's events.

B4L16-2-13.chinese: 錯誤通常來自粗心，因此無論事情大小都該用心處理。
B4L16-2-13.pinyin: Cuòwù tōngcháng láizì cūxīn, yīncǐ wúlùn shìqíng dàxiǎo dōu gāi yòngxīn chǔlǐ.
B4L16-2-13.english: Mistakes usually come from carelessness, so no matter how big or small the matter is, it should be handled with care.

B4L16-2-14.chinese: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
B4L16-2-14.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāihuài le xīn mǎi de shǒujī, yīncǐ nánguò de yàomìng.
B4L16-2-14.english: He accidentally dropped and broke his newly bought cell phone, so he was extremely upset.

B4L16-2-15.chinese: 這家國際企業因商品銷售情況不理想，決定退出亞洲市場。
B4L16-2-15.pinyin: Zhè jiā guójì qǐyè yīn shāngpǐn xiāoshòu qíngkuàng bù lǐxiǎng, juédìng tuìchū Yàzhōu shìchǎng.
B4L16-2-15.english: This international enterprise, because product sales were not ideal, decided to withdraw from the Asian market.

B4L16-2-16.chinese: 情侶之間如果無法相信彼此，很容易就分手了。
B4L16-2-16.pinyin: Qínglǚ zhījiān rúguǒ wúfǎ xiāngxìn bǐcǐ, hěn róngyì jiù fēnshǒu le.
B4L16-2-16.english: If couples cannot trust each other, they easily break up.

B4L16-2-17.chinese: 重道德的人，即使在沒人看見的地方也會注意自己的行為。
B4L16-2-17.pinyin: Zhòng dàodé de rén, jíshǐ zài méi rén kànjiàn de dìfāng yě huì zhùyì zìjǐ de xíngwéi.
B4L16-2-17.english: A person who values morality will pay attention to their behavior even in places where no one is watching.

B4L16-2-18.chinese: 公司全體都支持昨天公告的那條規定。
B4L16-2-18.pinyin: Gōngsī quántǐ dōu zhīchí zuótiān gōnggào de nà tiáo guīdìng.
B4L16-2-18.english: The entire company supports the regulation announced yesterday.

B4L16-2-19.chinese: 這項規定是由大會成員一起討論後決定的，必須嚴格遵守。
B4L16-2-19.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng shì yóu dàhuì chéngyuán yīqǐ tǎolùn hòu juédìng de, bìxū yángé zūnshǒu.
B4L16-2-19.english: This regulation was decided after discussion by the assembly members together, and must be strictly followed.

B4L16-2-20.chinese: 通常第一名只有一位，但有時也會出現例外的情況。
B4L16-2-20.pinyin: Tōngcháng dì yī míng zhǐyǒu yī wèi, dàn yǒushí yě huì chūxiàn lìwài de qíngkuàng.
B4L16-2-20.english: Usually there is only one first place, but sometimes there are exceptions.

B4L16-2-21.chinese: 對我來說，擁有和平的日子其實是最單純的幸福。
B4L16-2-21.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, yǒngyǒu hépíng de rìzi qíshí shì zuì dānchún de xìngfú.
B4L16-2-21.english: To me, having peaceful days is actually the simplest happiness.

B4L16-2-22.chinese: 與鄰居建立友好的關係，能為你帶來很多好處。
B4L16-2-22.pinyin: Yǔ línjū jiànlì yǒuhǎo de guānxì, néng wèi nǐ dàilái hěn duō hǎochù.
B4L16-2-22.english: Establishing friendly relations with neighbors can bring you many benefits.

B4L16-2-23.chinese: 團體活動中，不團結就失去了合作的意義。
B4L16-2-23.pinyin: Tuántǐ huódòng zhōng, bù tuánjié jiù shīqù le hézuò de yìyì.
B4L16-2-23.english: In group activities, if there is no unity, then the meaning of cooperation is lost.

B4L16-2-24.chinese: 公司的待遇不公平，於是他決定辭職。
B4L16-2-24.pinyin: Gōngsī de dàiyù bù gōngpíng, yúshì tā juédìng cízhí.
B4L16-2-24.english: The company's treatment was unfair, so he decided to resign.

B4L16-2-25.chinese: 裁判的工作是確定每位選手都遵守規定，讓比賽順利進行。
B4L16-2-25.pinyin: Cáipàn de gōngzuò shì quèdìng měi wèi xuǎnshǒu dōu zūnshǒu guīdìng, ràng bǐsài shùnlì jìnxíng.
B4L16-2-25.english: The referee's job is to make sure every athlete follows the rules, so that the competition runs smoothly.

B4L16-2-26.chinese: 解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
B4L16-2-26.pinyin: Jiějué zhǒngzú zhījiān yīn wénhuà chāyì chǎnshēng de wèntí, zuì hǎo de bànfǎ jiùshì hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
B4L16-2-26.english: To solve problems that arise between races due to cultural differences, the best approach is mutual respect.

B4L16-2-27.chinese: 對任何人的態度，不該因種族、國籍或性別而不同。
B4L16-2-27.pinyin: Duì rènhé rén de tàidù, bù gāi yīn zhǒngzú, guójí huò xìngbié ér bùtóng.
B4L16-2-27.english: One's attitude toward anyone should not differ because of race, nationality, or gender.

B4L16-2-28.chinese: 假如人人都發揮人性美好的一面，就能給社會帶來和平。
B4L16-2-28.pinyin: Jiǎrú rénrén dōu fāhuī rénxìng měihǎo de yī miàn, jiù néng gěi shèhuì dàilái hépíng.
B4L16-2-28.english: If everyone brings out the beautiful side of human nature, then it can bring peace to society.
